playbooks.title: Warrior — Fury — Melee DPS (raid / dungeon)
playbooks.intro:
Covers dual-wield Fury (the default raid spec) and the two-handed "2H Fury / Slam" variant that the sources treat as a Fury build after Class Changes 3 (July 2025). Arms is a separate playbook (`arms-melee-dps.md`) because the sources argue about which is better and the rotations differ.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). Within pre-1.18.1 the Warrior kit changed three times: Class Changes 2 ("CC2", 1.17.2, live 2024-11-01), the December 2024 revision, and Class Changes 3 ("CC3", 1.18.0, live 2025-08-15). Every recommendation below says which kit it was written for.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: melee DPS; the class's raid-DPS spec. Also the historical basis of the "fury-prot" tank (see `fury-tank.md`).
- **Strengths (sources)**: best-scaling DPS in the game once geared — "Their gear scaling is ridiculous so yes they get very powerful, best tank and best DPS" [Harkus (player), 2023-09-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=64560#p64560); "Warrior (At least fury and fury/prot) warrior is the best DPS and best tank at endgame with gear" [Bigsmerf (player), 2023-09-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=64561#p64561); staff in March 2025: "All Warrior specializations are currently in a strong position ... Given Warriors' well-documented scaling potential, the new raid loot may further enhance their power" [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504). Raid utility beyond damage: Sunder Armor for the whole raid, Battle Shout, reliable interrupts, and the ability to off-tank adds in DPS gear [Atreidon (player), 2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112515#p112515); "even dps warriors can and often do OT, pick up mobs etc ... Not to mention Battle shout, 200AP is huge!" [Heretic1987 (player), 2026-02-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167515#p167515).
- **Weaknesses (sources)**: extremely gear dependent ("Warriors are THE most gear dependent class in the game" [Roxanneflowers (player), 2020-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=8310#p8310)); dual wield needs hit gear before it works ("switch to fury when you get 9% hit" [Reploidrocsa (player), 2023-10-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=67965#p67965)); "fury in general is more gear dependant than arms" [Cheruscan (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156442#p156442); no self-sustain outside Blood Craze / Blood Drinker; bad at solo farming ("War is the worst class, by far, to 'solo farm'" [Idontcareatall (player), 2024-11-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105723#p105723)).
- **Content**: raids (MC → Kara40) — favored. Dungeons at 60 — fine, but Arms' Sweeping Strikes is preferred for cleave (see Arms playbook). Leveling — contested (see `leveling.md`). PvP — Fury is the "lone wolf / self-healing" spec after CC3 (see `arms-pvp.md`). Hardcore — no Fury-specific hardcore advice in the sources beyond leveling.
- **Community standing**: **favored** raid DPS spec (consensus 2023–2025): "Fury takes you there, arms will not" [Akos1896 (player), 2024-05-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95013#p95013); "Not having flurry is not viable for dps that's pretty much the whole story" [Justgens (player), 2023-07-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=53805#p53805). **Contested since mid-2025**: "Arms is definitely up there with fury, maybe 5% behind in MC, BWL and Naxx but definitely better than fury in AQ40 and especially Kara40 where every boss has bazillion adds" [Ellifta (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139087#p139087); "Arms warrior is already the best DPS spec in game. Check out turtlogs" [Noephix (player), 2025-06-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135319#p135319); and in Feb 2026 a player calls "2h fury, in which you slam a lot" the meta build [Warrior37 (player), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168301#p168301). Other players: "2h fury isnt a spec anymore. If you use twohanders go arms" [Atreidon (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156441#p156441) vs "2h fury uses Slam" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-10-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157054#p157054) and "Wake up Neo! Missed CC3?" [armsgirl (player), 2025-10-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157453#p157453). Bots: default to DW Fury in raids; treat 2H Fury (Slam) as an equally accepted alternative post-CC3; treat Arms as accepted in AQ40/Kara40.
- Reputation problem: warriors are envied/over-represented in raids ("582 warriors logged in naxx, and 317 paladins" [amanagor (player), 2024-12-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112676#p112676); guilds "have at least 6-7 slots open for warrior dps" [amanagor (player), 2024-12-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111704#p111704)); expect "warrior envy" threads and do not gloat on meters.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
The forum gives builds only as opaque calculator links plus partial verbal lists. No post lists a full 51-point raid Fury allocation talent by talent. What follows is the union of the explicit statements; the "unassigned" points are a gap.

### DW Fury raid build (CC2/CC3 tree; unchanged by 1.18.1 except Ravager's rename)

Sourced points:

| Tree | Talent | Points | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fury | Cruelty | 5/5 | [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489) ("Cruelty 5/5"); [Xudo (player), 2025-01-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=116686#p116686) |
| Fury | Dual Wield Specialization | 5/5 | Berettadin (above): "Dual Wield Specialization 5/5"; the +10% off-hand hit is the CC2 replacement for HS queueing [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102974) |
| Fury | Improved Shouts | 5/5 | Berettadin (above) ("Demoralizing Shout is a staple"); Xudo (above): "Instead you invest to Improved Shouts" |
| Fury | Enrage | 5/5 | Berettadin (above); raid rationale — Enrage is a proc "you're getting critted every fight" (leveling) — for raids the forum notes Bloodrage activates Enrage [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-11-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105804#p105804) |
| Fury | Improved Execute (ex Reckless Execute) | 2/2 | "Reckless Execute and Death Wish" for team DPS [Berettadin (above)]; execute-phase priority [Wolf of Rage (player), 2025-03-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122923#p122923) |
| Fury | Death Wish | 1/1 | Berettadin, Xudo (above) |
| Fury | Flurry | 5/5 (4/5 in some 2H variants) | Xudo (above): "Improved Whirlwind for 2 points and flurry for 4 points"; "Not having flurry is not viable" [Justgens (player), 2023-07-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=53805#p53805) |
| Fury | Bloodthirst | 1/1 | spec definition |
| Fury | Blood Craze | 0 or 3 | **contested**: "dont skill bloodcraze thats 3 talent points down the drain" [Atreidon (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156441#p156441) vs "blood craze being a must take now in fury" [Abiozan (player), 2024-12-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112930#p112930) (leveling/solo context) |
| Fury | Blood Drinker | 0 (raid) / 3 (PvP, solo) | "you can't get both Blood Drinker and 2h Weapon Spec ... that makes Blood Drinker designed specifically for dual wield" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-10-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155730#p155730); PvP DW Blood Drinker [Eyeburn (player), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169850#p169850) |
| Fury | Unbridled Wrath | 0 (DW) / 5 (2H) | "Unbridled Wrath really only shines when dual wielding daggers" [Hctwowfan (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157895#p157895); "talent is a total trash unless you're a dagger enjoyer" [armsgirl (player), 2025-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158567#p158567); Xudo takes it in the 2H build (above) |
| Arms | Tactical Mastery | 2–5 | "Tactical Mastery is only worth 1 thing: having enough Rage for Disarm" [Berettadin (above)]; "2/5 tactical mastery and 3/3 improved rend to get access to Impale" [Xudo (player), 2024-12-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=114301#p114301) |
| Arms | Improved Rend | 2/2 (tax) | "Improved Rend is a talent tax for later abilities" [Berettadin (above)]; Xudo (above) |
| Arms | Deflection / Improved Charge / Improved Overpower | filler on the way to Impale | "Improved Overpower is actually quite nice ... but it's not cheap" [Berettadin (above)]; 5% parry "is good" [Xudo (player), 2024-11-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110486#p110486) |
| Arms | Deep Wounds 3/3, Impale 2/2 | yes | "At endgame though, it and impale are pretty good!" [Syrathegreat (player), 2023-04-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=42850#p42850); Xudo's 2H fury build "up to Impale" (above). Note Deep Wounds bug report: ticks for ~35% instead of 60% weapon damage [Cromius (player), 2025-09-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149915#p149915) — unresolved in the extracted threads |

Unassigned: the sources do not say where the remaining points go (Booming Voice vs Improved Heroic Strike vs Piercing Howl vs Improved Berserker Rage). Gap. The "trash king" / "parse chad" 60 links given for 2H, and the DW 60 link, are opaque: [armsgirl (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157920#p157920) — `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warrior?points=dQQACYAQ-AoFAoAAoZCFAB-` (DW at 60), `...?points=FQADCYDQB-FoAAoAAoRCF-` ("trash king", 2H), `...?points=FQADCYDQ-FoAAoAAoRCFAB-` ("parse chad", 2H). A pre-CC2-tree "general standard" DW Fury link: [Rudyraccoon (player), 2024-11-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=109923#p109923) `...?points=DQFARYAIAAAAAAAoFoBYAoBAFYBAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` (posted after CC2 went live, so it is on the CC2 tree). Also [Yasara (player), 2024-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106151#p106151) two Fury leveling links and [Lazocar (player), 2024-11-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=109225#p109225) `...?points=DQFAQYAQAAAAAAAoFApYAoBAFYBAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D`.

External build/sim resources named by the forum (not fetched; content unknown): "the go-to for warriors afaik: https://rentry.co/e3i565dk" [Muck5955 (player), 2025-10-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156287#p156287); Turtle WarriorSim `https://zebouski.github.io/WarriorSim-TurtleWoW/` ("mostly accurate at simming dw fury and 2h hamstring spam specs, but there is no 2h slam support" [Ugoboom (player), 2023-02-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=35760#p35760)) and `https://thrunk112.github.io/WarriorSim-TurtleWoW` (community wiki `https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Warrior`).

### 2H Fury (Slam) variant — CC2/CC3 tree

From [Xudo (player), 2025-01-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=116686#p116686) (written on the Dec-2024 kit, before Flurry affected Slam): Arms "up to Impale" (Tactical Mastery, Improved Rend 2, Deep Wounds, Impale), **Two-Handed Weapon Specialization 3/3** and **Improved Slam 2/2** in Arms; Fury: Cruelty 5, Unbridled Wrath 5, Improved Shouts, Death Wish, then either "Improved Whirlwind for 2 points and flurry for 4 points" (link `...?points=FQRAQYDQACAAAAFoAooACARAEAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=`) or "Master of Arms which also directly buffs your damage and Sweeping strikes" (link `...?points=FQRAQYDQpCAAAAFoAooACABAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=`). After CC3, Flurry also cuts Slam cast time [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159), and 1.18.1 corrected that reduction to 1.92 s at 5/5 [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) — so the 2H Fury build got stronger in CC3 and slightly weaker in 1.18.1. Player noting the pre-1.18.1 cast time: "slam alone takes 1.6-1.8s to cast" [Warrior37 (player), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168301#p168301). Blood Drinker cannot be combined with 2H spec (Eyeburn, above) — single source.

### Patch validity

- CC2-era statements (Nov 2024 – Jul 2025) about Bloodthirst self-damage/Enrage procs are **obsolete** since 2024-12-20.
- CC3 (2025-08-15) changed Execute (no cooldown), Improved Execute (rage cost), Blood Drinker (unconditional heal under Enrage/Death Wish/Recklessness) and Flurry→Slam. Anything about "Reckless Execute" or the Execute cooldown predates CC3.
- 1.18.1 changed nothing structural for DW Fury; it renamed Improved Whirlwind to Ravager, fixed Flurry's Slam cast reduction (2H nerf) and changed T1/T3 set bonuses. No source after 2026-03-20 re-evaluates the Fury raid build; treat the CC3 build as valid for 1.18.1 with those caveats.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- **Hit**: 9% for raid bosses (level 63) so abilities never miss; white hits still miss with dual wield: "You don't need the 9% immediately. This is the end-value for lvl 63 (Raidbosses) and ensures that your skills don't miss. Whitehits will still miss ... For lvl 60 dungeons ~5% are fine" [Tomberry (player), 2023-10-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=73184#p73184); "You get a huge power spike the moment you get 9% hit so your abilities won't miss ... won't come until you're lv 60 with some hit gear from dungeons and 20 man raids" [Reploidrocsa (player), 2023-09-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=64581#p64581). Consensus. With racial/item weapon skill the cap is lower: "+5 weapon skill races hit cap = 6% for yellow attacks, while 300 weapon skill hit cap = 9%" [Struki (player), 2023-04-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=40417#p40417) (posed as a question; vanilla baseline). Two-handers: "14% hit rating with a 2hander? you need 8% max" [Cheruscan (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156442#p156442) (single source; the exact 2H cap on Turtle's linearized weapon-skill formula is a gap — staff announced "Linearizing Weapon Skill vs Defense Skill" [Torta (staff) dev blog, 2024-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=13840) without publishing the table in the extracted posts).
- **Dual wield miss**: "DW adds a 19% chance to miss on both hands, combined with the base 5%, that's 24%. The new talent in fury increases ONLY your OH hit chance by 10%" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-08-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147408#p147408) (vanilla-baseline numbers restated for Turtle).
- **Weapon skill**: still matters; Human/Orc/Goblin racials nerfed but kept; +weapon-skill items added (Edgemaster's alternatives, Ashkin Belt, Ouro gauntlets) [Syrathegreat (player), 2023-06-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49836#p49836), [1.17.2 final itemization changelog (staff), 2024](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=15404). Weapon-skill effect chart: "10 skill will save the 2H warrior the need for 3% gear hit, and a modest portion of their damage (white glancing blows) will improve by 30%" [Rokit (player), 2023-05-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=46107#p46107); "+7 ... is just a mere ~2% shy of highest diminishing returns" [Trymv1 (player), 2023-05-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=46167#p46167). Weapon skill does **not** reduce boss parry on Turtle per testing ("parry chance remains 14%, whereas dodge chance does decrease to roughly 4.6%" — quoted from Daaki 2023 by [Xudo (player), 2026-03-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170790#p170790)).
- **After hit**: crit and AP/Strength — "once you start stacking crit and attack power you'll have more and more rage so you'll be able to spend in more and more abilities" (Reploidrocsa, above); "figuring out how much crit = hit = str = agi, is not straightforward, which is why this sim is useful" (community wiki Warrior page). Fury "needs crit to matter" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-08-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149483#p149483). Exact stat weights: **gap** — no post gives numbers; the forum defers to the sim.
- **Weapon choice**: slow main hand, fast off hand is the tradition; on Turtle the reason (HS queue off-hand trick) is gone, "The current answer is probably better rage generation still" [Voodoochile (player), 2025-07-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141043#p141043); Unbridled Wrath procs per hit so a fast OH procs it more [Voodoochile (player), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141443#p141443). Single source.
- **Spirit**: T3 has Spirit; "spirit scales super good on warriors" [Reploidrocsa (player), 2024-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106146#p106146) vs "Spirit is a Dead stat" [Melfrato1 (player), 2025-06-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135336#p135336) — contested; it is a downtime/regen stat, not a DPS stat.
- **While leveling**: see `leveling.md` — Strength/Stamina, weapon damage first; hit gear scarce so DW is punished.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation (raid, DW Fury)
rotationSingle.markdown:
The forum gives no single authoritative Fury priority list for the CC3 kit. Assembled from the Arms thread (which covers stance, Sunder, execute phase) and macro threads:

**Opener**: Charge (if out of combat) → Bloodrage (activates Enrage since 2024-11-01) → Sunder Armor first if you are a warrior in a raid: "if you fight raid bosses, every warrior should always use it once as the first ability. 5 stacks of sunders on a mob increase not only your dps by about 15-20%, but also the dps of every other physical dps!" [Atreidon (player), 2025-03-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122809#p122809) → Berserker Stance, Death Wish when the fight starts (no source gives exact timing; see cooldowns).

**Priority** (stay in Berserker Stance: "You should be in Berserker Stance all the time to benefit from the extra Crit ... Battle Stance offers nothing and Defensive Stance instead lowers your output" [Wolf of Rage (player), 2025-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122609#p122609)):

1. Target ≤ 20% HP → **Execute** with surplus rage (see execute phase). Improved Execute makes it cost 2/5 less; no cooldown since CC3.
2. **Bloodthirst** on cooldown ("A fury dps warrior have: Bloodthirst - Whirlwind - Overpower - Hamstring -/ Slam, as skill hit" [Toffe (player), 2024-10-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=104303#p104303), written on CC2 launch).
3. **Whirlwind** on cooldown ("You should be using Whirlwind off Cooldown" — Wolf of Rage, above; Ravager/Improved Whirlwind shortens it by up to 2 s).
4. **Sunder Armor** as the filler if the boss has < 5 stacks or the tank is not a warrior: "use sunder armor as a filler over hamsteing if the target doesnt yet hav 5 sunders or if the tank is not a warrior ... you can use it just fine in berserker stance" (Atreidon, above). Sunder is also the official proc-fishing filler since CC2 ("elevating Sunder Armor as a tool to trigger weapon effects" [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102974)).
5. **Hamstring** as an instant proc-fishing filler (Windfury Totem, Hand of Justice, Sword spec) — pre-1.18.1 it had a 6 s cooldown; **1.18.1 removed the cooldown** so it is spammable again [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). Contested detail: "Sunder Armor ... will not trigger Sword Specialization" [Wolf of Rage (player), 2025-03-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122819#p122819) vs "SA is a physical attack that can proc on hit everything any other attack can proc: OP, WF, swordspec etc." [armsgirl (player), 2025-05-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=129704#p129704). Note Master of Arms (Sword) is an Arms talent, irrelevant to pure Fury.
6. **Heroic Strike** only as a rage dump at high rage: "only ever really bother with Heroic Strike as a last-resort Rage dump if you have nothing available and your Rage is at 70 or more" (Wolf of Rage, above). A player DPS macro uses `[rage>55] Whirlwind`, `[rage>42] Heroic Strike`, else Bloodthirst [Bigbearimpact (player), 2024-05-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=96085#p96085) and a SuperMacro variant that HS at >42 rage and WW at >55 only while target HP > 21% [Ericnew (player), 2024-07-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=100095#p100095) — player macros, not tested by the thread. Remember HS-queued swings generate no rage and the off-hand no longer auto-hits during the queue (CC2).
7. Keep **Battle Shout** up (Improved Shouts lengthens it); Demoralizing Shout if nobody else applies it.

**Execute phase (< 20%)**: "Yes, and you should prefer to use your biggest Cooldowns during that period (Human Racial for extra Crit OR Recklessness; Bloodrage ...), and time the Executes so that you're getting the most out of the Rage that you use up -- swing and then use Execute, since you might get a Crit for fat Rage ... allowing a max-burst Execute" [Wolf of Rage (player), 2025-03-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122923#p122923) (written for Arms with the old Precision Cut refund; the "swing, then Execute" timing applies to Fury too). Fury-specific: "Under 20% hp Fury stops using filler skills and spends all its surplus rage on Execute instead of dumping with Heroic Strike and using fillers for Windfury. There's a talent deep in Fury that helps that by reducing the base cost so even with the misses inherent to dual wield you can Execute your rage down to 0 and still be able to use it again after 1.5sec of autoattacks" [Licata (player), 2026-01-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166667#p166667).

**2H Fury (Slam) single target**: "Auto attack -> Slam -> Instant : Repeat. If you do not have the rage for both slam and an instant, skip the slam. Install a swing timer mod. Slam should be casted immediately after your AA goes off ... Don't ever touch heroic strike" (vanilla-era Blizzard-forum text quoted approvingly by [Xudo (player), 2025-01-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=116686#p116686)). Since Dec 2024 Slam **continues** the swing timer and can be cast while moving, so "you will almost always have to use it just about immediately upon swinging. You may have enough time for one Ability (1 GCD, 1.5s wait time)" [Wolf of Rage (player), 2025-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122609#p122609); "go arms tree and learn to use slam between your auto timer this is the optimal and maybe only way to do decent dps as 2h warr" [marvian (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156445#p156445). Slam's rage is spent on cast completion and the following white hit usually refunds about the same [Hemdall (player), 2025-08-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=146665#p146665). Swing-timer Slam macro (SP_SwingTimer `st_timer`, SuperMacro): [Tacticalnelf (player), 2024-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=100433#p100433) — casts Slam only when `st_timer > UnitAttackSpeed*0.9`.

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **2–3 targets**: Whirlwind on cooldown; Cleave instead of Heroic Strike as the on-next-swing (Ravager cuts Cleave's cost by 1/2/3 in 1.18.1); Sunder only to 50% HP on trash: "for ordinary enemies ... you should consider using Sunder only up to 50% remaining Health" [Wolf of Rage (player), 2025-03-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122819#p122819). Sweeping Strikes is Arms-only; DW Fury has no cleave burst — a stated reason Arms wins in AQ40/Kara40 (Ellifta, above).
- **4+ targets**: same buttons; warriors "excel in dps when fighting multiple enemies" per Atreidon (above), but the sources give no 4+ specific priority for Fury. Gap. Be aware of threat: cleaving warriors are the classic offenders ("Good dps will watch their own aggro, avoid cleave and AE damage" [Ishilu (player), 2023-05-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=47618#p47618)).

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Death Wish** (1/1 talent): use on pull or execute phase; no exact rule in the sources. Blood Drinker heals during it (CC3).
- **Recklessness** (shares a 30-min cooldown with Retaliation and Shield Wall — players ask to unlink them [Zamera (player), 2025-07-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141635#p141635), [Guilliman (player), 2023-05-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=48015#p48015); not changed by staff in the extracted threads): "use your biggest Cooldowns during [execute]" (Wolf of Rage, above); "every 30mins you become a literal god with your big cooldown" [Cheruscan (player), 2025-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152804#p152804). Improved Disciplines (Arms) cuts 4/8/12 min.
- **Bloodrage**: on cooldown; activates Enrage (staff 2024-11-01) and gives rage before the pull; costs health.
- **Berserker Rage**: fear break; Improved Berserker Rage (CC3) adds 5/10 rage and 50/100% freedom on use — more a PvP pick.
- **Rage**: new formula since CC2 — "We have plenty of rage. I did few duels and my rage bar was full. On lvl 19 white attack for 100 damage grant ~18 rage" [Xudo (player), 2024-11-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105917#p105917). Rage decay out of combat: 2 rage per 2 s. T1 3-set (1.18.1): 10% per ability hit to gain 15 rage. **No rage from absorbed hits**: "Not being able to generate rage on shields is absolutely crippling" [Snoof (player), 2025-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152740#p152740) — contested by "Twow gave you ability to generate rage against aborbs and immunities" [Ataika (player), 2025-07-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140665#p140665). Unresolved.
- **Downtime**: warriors eat after most fights when solo ("need to eat constantly" — Reploidrocsa, above); in raids irrelevant.

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Stand behind the boss (parry/block avoidance is a tank problem: "DPS stand behind the boss, they cant be parried or blocked at all" [Cheruscan (player), 2026-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170725#p170725)).
- Apply/maintain 5 Sunders when the tank is not a warrior (Atreidon, above); Battle Shout for the group.
- Interrupt with Pummel (Berserker Stance) — warriors "can kick reliably with less sacrifice to their dps" (Atreidon, above).
- Off-tank adds in DPS gear when needed: "DPS warriors just save the raid by tanking any trashnob just in dps gear" (Atreidon, above); "even dps warriors can and often do OT, pick up mobs etc. For ex in MC warr and druid dps would be preferable to rogues because of both Garr and Majordomo fights" [Heretic1987 (player), 2026-02-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167515#p167515).
- Watch threat; do not overtake a prot warrior early (their snap threat can be lost to a parried Shield Slam — see `protection-tank.md`).
- Weapon swaps: swapping resets the swing timer and triggers a GCD, so avoid mid-rotation swaps [Licata (player), 2026-01-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166667#p166667).

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
The forum has no maintained Turtle pre-raid/BiS list ("To my knowledge no one has publicly posted a T-WoW pre-raid bis list" [Philandros (player), 2022-11-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=28796#p28796); "There kinda isn't one" [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115674#p115674)). Named items:

- Pre-raid: Hateforge Quarry trinket "one of the few pre-raid trinkets that have hit on it, on top of armor pen" [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-06-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134748#p134748); Silvermoon Remnants revered via runecloth (Alliance) / Revantusk daily (Horde) for "many amazing pre-raid blues" [Noephix (player), 2025-06-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135325#p135325); Hand of Justice (BRD Emperor), the ~level-30 Jewelcrafting AP trinket [Akos1896 (player), 2025-02-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119534#p119534); Rune of the Guard Captain (Hinterlands elite troll quest; AP + hit), Blackhand's Breadth (UBRS quest, +2% crit) [Steakhouse (player), 2025-02-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119537#p119537); Flurry Axe "pre-raid BIS for fury warrior" [Malvagita52 (player), 2022-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=25531#p25531); crafted Lionheart Helm, Titanic Leggings, Thick Obsidian Breastplate, Pauldrons of Deflection, Stronghold Gauntlets as an armorsmith path [Boblin (player), 2025-05-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132704#p132704). Lionheart Helm was announced for a nerf in 2023 (player-quoted new stats "18 stam, 32 AP, 2 crit, 1 hit" with Helm of Endless Rage buffed to compensate [Syrathegreat (player), 2023-06-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49836#p49836)); Helm of Endless Rage was buffed again in 1.18.1 (Strength 25→28, Agility 25→27, Stamina 26→28) [Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272). (The 1.18.0 "Lionheart Helmet" stamina change is the Paladin T3.5 set, not the crafted warrior helm.)
- Weapon skill: Edgemaster's Handguards and Turtle's added +skill items (Ashkin Belt "almost as good as Onslaught Girdle"; Hungering Cold; Hakkari Warblades) [Syrathegreat (player), 2023-06-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49836#p49836), [Ninetyone (player), 2023-06-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49833#p49833).
- Raid 2H: Untamed Blade / Bonereaver's Edge "near bis and available right away from mc and the first boss in bwl" [Econrel (player), 2024-09-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=100900#p100900); BRE "Procs per minute returned to original Vanilla value, reducing it from 3 to 2" [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105276#p105276) (players asked "how bad is the BRE nerf?" [Frantsel (player), 2025-02-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120789#p120789), no answer); The Untamed Blade damage raised 192-289 → 205-302 in 1.18.1 [Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272); Might of Menethil, Dark Edge of Insanity, Severance, Kel'Thuzad mace named as end weapons [Springboards (player), 2025-12-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162626#p162626); Thunderfury (proc damages main target only on Turtle; jumps apply the debuff) [Atreidon (player), 2025-10-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156891#p156891) (contested in thread).
- Tier: T2 DPS set "really good stuff"; T3 DPS set has Spirit and weak bonuses — "Tier 3 warrior dps does not need to be good. Its the far easier gearing choice to offset dps warrior pieces" [Atreidon (player), 2024-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106299#p106299); Kara40: "3p t3.5+Dreadslayer set is BiS now, wth Meph leather chest" [Noephix (player), 2025-06-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135310#p135310) (single source; the T3.5 6-set/5-set bonus is called "ass" — "that's why you wear ANOTHER kara40 set for hat and shoulders" [Noephix (player), 2025-06-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135344#p135344)). 1.18.1 changed T1 3-set and T3 4-set (staff, above). Other staff set changes: Warrior T0/0.5 (6/4-set) "Also energizes you for 10 Rage when triggered" and Royal Seal of Eldre'thalas (Warrior) "Now grants 30 Attack Power and 8 Defense" [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105276#p105276); Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj mini-set 3-set (Warrior) "If your Heroic Strike or Slam is dodged or parried, you gain 5 Rage" [Dragunovi (staff), 2025-06-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137624#p137624). "The best gloves for fury warriors are mail" [Balake (player), 2020-07-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6659#p6659) (2020; item context unknown).
- Enchants/consumables: no Turtle-specific consumable list in the Warrior forum. Named: Diamond Flask was nerfed ("warrior flask nerf", 1.17.2 itemization thread); Mongoose potions, flasks [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489); Windfury Totem works with sharpening stones on Turtle but "you don't get bonus attack power for extra attack" [Xudo (player), 2024-10-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103287#p103287); world buffs are a 20-40% DPS increase for warriors [Abiozan (player), 2024-12-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112930#p112930). Gap: enchant list.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes (bots must avoid)
mistakes.markdown:
- Dual wielding without hit gear / before ~9% hit or before level ~50 (consensus; see stat priority and `leveling.md`).
- Using Heroic Strike as a rotational ability instead of a ≥70-rage dump (Wolf of Rage, above); queuing HS starves rage (HS swings generate none — [Roxanneflowers (player), 2020-07-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=7046#p7046)).
- Not sundering because "it's a Defensive Stance ability" ("Many warriors think it can only be used in defensive stance" — Atreidon, above).
- Going 2H while specced deep Fury without Improved Slam / 2H spec, or with 14% hit on a 2H (the Turtlelover case).
- Taking Blood Craze / Blood Drinker in a raid build (contested; skip for pure raid DPS per Atreidon).
- Whirlwind/Cleave on CC'd targets; Deep Wounds breaks Intimidating Shout/sap: "the bleed can break hard CC" (Syrathegreat, above).
- Swapping weapons mid-fight for Master Strike effects (resets swing timer — Licata, above).
- Being loud about meters: "Make warriors do less dmg to be more in line with EVERYBODY else" [Shamma (player), 2022-11-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=29437#p29437) — the community is sensitive about warrior stacking.

extraSections.heading: Official kit (what the spec is built on) — staff, pre-1.18.1 unless noted
extraSections.markdown:
Read `../../1.18.1-master-changelog.md` if it has been filled in; if it is thin, these are the staff posts:

- CC2 (2024-10-12), [Dragunovi (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102974): new rage formula ("90% depending on your gear and 10% ... weapon speed"; "The top is the same, but the bottom has been raised up"); Anger Management rage-decay part baseline; **off-hand no longer auto-hits while Heroic Strike is queued** (compensated by Dual Wield Specialization +2/4/6/8/10% off-hand hit, moved to row 2); Dual Wield taught at 10; Slam taught at 14; Hamstring 6 s cooldown; Sunder Armor 10 rage; **Unbridled Wrath** 15/30/45/60/75%, "effect is now doubled for two-handed weapons"; **Improved Shouts** (merged Battle/Demo shout talents, row 3); **Blood Craze** 2/4/6% of total health; **Enrage** 8 s, no swing cap; **Improved Pummel**; **Improved Whirlwind** (row 5, −1/1.5/2 s); **Battlefield Mobility** (Improved Intercept, also Intervene); **Blood Drinker** (row 6); Bloodthirst reworked to "X damage plus 30% attack power" with self-damage. Flurry and Death Wish unchanged by that post.
- 2024-11-01, [Dragunovi (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105804#p105804): Enrage damage 25% → 15%; **Bloodrage now activates Enrage**; Slam cast 2.0 s; Decisive Strike 2.5 s.
- 2024-12-20, [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460): **Bloodthirst no longer self-damages** (so no Enrage proc), +5% movement speed 6 s, base damage 100/130/160/200, **35% AP**; **Enrage 4/8/12/16/20%**; **Decisive Strike removed; Slam is now 2.5 s cast, continues the swing timer, usable while moving**, ranks 50/60/70/80/90% weapon damage ("those with 3.8s weapons should see about a -18% damage nerf with this ability"); Execute back to vanilla values with 4.5 s cooldown; Reckless Execute 1.5 s / removes the cooldown.
- 2025-03-30, [Torta (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504): Improved Pummel now a 50% snare, 50/100%.
- CC3 (2025-07-25), [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159): **Execute cooldown removed**; Reckless Execute renamed back to **Improved Execute** (−2/5 rage), swapped position with Battlefield Mobility (which now also cuts Charge cooldown 2/4 s); **Flurry now also reduces the cast time of Slam** ("We hope this change breathes new life into Two-Handed Fury"); Bloodthirst speed 10%; **Blood Drinker reworked: "While under the effect of Enrage, Death Wish or Recklessness, your attack and abilities heal you for 1/1.5/2% of you maximum health"**; new **Improved Berserker Rage** (row 6, 2 pts: 5/10 rage, 50/100% freedom on activation); Slam ranks 65/80/90/100%.
- 1.18.1 (announced 2026-01-23, live 2026-03-20), [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071): Hamstring cooldown removed; Improved Whirlwind renamed **Ravager** (also −1/2/3 rage on Cleave); **Flurry's Slam reduction corrected — with 5/5 Flurry, Slam is 1.92 s, not 1.75 s** (a nerf to 2H Fury); T1 3-set: 10% chance on ability hit to gain 15 rage; T3 4-set: +4% crit damage bonus of abilities.
- Post-1.18.1 hotfix 2026-03-21, [Torta (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608): "Flurry will now properly be consumed when attacking" (the line does not name the class).
- Player claim about Flurry's size: "they nerfed flurry. 15% attack speed now, for five whole talent points still" [Bigsmerf (player), 2024-12-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111670#p111670) — single source; no staff line in the extracted posts confirms the number.

playbooks.title: Warrior — Arms — PvP (battlegrounds / world PvP), with Fury and Protection PvP notes
playbooks.intro:
Arms is the PvP spec the forum agrees on for the Mortal Strike debuff; Fury is the post-CC3 "self-sustain / lone wolf" alternative; Protection PvP is a meme with two real tools. The forum's PvP threads are mostly complaint threads ("warrior is F-tier") answered by "get gear and a pocket healer" — the playbook keeps both sides and marks them contested.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). Within pre-1.18.1 the kit changed at CC2 (1.17.2, 2024-11-01), the December 2024 revision, and CC3 (1.18.0, 2025-08-15). PvP-relevant kit facts changed at every step (Hamstring cooldown added at CC2, removed at 1.18.1; Counterattack → Master Strike at CC3; Improved Berserker Rage and Blood Drinker rework at CC3; PvP dampening in 1.18.0, made class-specific in 1.18.1).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: melee DPS / frontline in battlegrounds and world PvP. Realistic job: "warrior job is to charge and be a threat that everyone should avoid in melee" [Xudo (player), 2025-10-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155546#p155546); "Warrior is best as a 'distraction / damage sponge'" [Manletow (player), 2024-11-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108331#p108331).
- **Community standing — contested, the single most argued topic in the Warrior forum**:
  - "Bad": "Warrior is one of the if not the weakest class in PvP if you don't have a pocket heal or a toolbox full of consumables" [Kerebrien (player), 2022-09-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=24464#p24464); "PvP wise, you're kinda fucked" [Bigsmerf (player), 2023-09-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=64561#p64561); "Warrior will NEVER be viable. It should simply not be played in PVP" [Manletow (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139157#p139157); "People claiming that warrior PvP is good or even just fine are lying and/or coping" [Eyeburn (player), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169850#p169850); "Warrior PvP idd felt like shit after CC2" [Stonnefree2 (player), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141430#p141430); "Charge -> Graveyard the life line of warrior on BG's" [Bloodline1x9 (player), 2025-05-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130241#p130241).
  - "Good with support": "warrior is actually the strongest class in PvP if they get supported well, infinite ressource, 2 interrupts (3 if you pack a dagger for master strike) + intercept ... every 30mins you become a literal god with your big cooldown" [Cheruscan (player), 2025-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152804#p152804); "Warriors are a BEAST in a organized team" [Wsta (player), 2025-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144634#p144634); "Warrior hpal combo, sitting on a 70-0" [Kalocsa (player), 2025-07-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140725#p140725); "A warrior with great gear that is supported by a dispelling healer will wreck a lot of stuff" [Thaladar (player), 2025-07-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140712#p140712); "Warrior's PvP identity is that you need gear and a pocket healer, and that's fine" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-10-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155525#p155525); "Warrior is strongest class with healer on his/her back. Get pocket healer" [Mdzielak (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172120#p172120) (post-1.18.1).
  - Middle: "Warrior is very good at a couple of things in PvP — pressuring healers, killing squishy melees and surprising mispositioned casters with high burst damage. The big problem ... REALLY overreliant on things that aren't in its kit" [Snoof (player), 2025-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152740#p152740); "Warrior is bad in 3 cases 1) you use no macros at all and no engineering. 2) you are undergeared 3) you are clueless with tunnels vision" [Volkyte (player), 2025-07-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140710#p140710).
- **Where it works**: premades/organised groups (Cheruscan, Wsta, Atreidon), next to healers ("You should never move alone to the battleground. Watch your priests, shamans & paladins and move with them" [Atreidon (player), 2025-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162631#p162631)). **Where it does not**: duels/1v1 ("warrior is not a duel class ... You shouldnt seek out 1v1s as a Warrior. Especially not vs the self sufficient classes (Shaman Druid & Paladin)" [Atreidon (player), 2026-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164520#p164520)); level-19 bracket ("warriors are kitable by almost all classes" [Xudo (player), 2025-10-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155546#p155546)); one player recommends PvP only below 60: "if you really want to PvP as a Warrior, I would suggest you do it between levels 1 to 59" [Magicknight (player), 2026-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171300#p171300).
- **Post-1.18.1 standing**: complaint thread continues unchanged ("Warrior weak. We need upgrade" [Bootwin (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172074#p172074); "saw a warrior go 42 and 9 yesterday. This must be a skill issue" [amanagor (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172123#p172123)). No post-1.18.1 source re-evaluates the Hamstring cooldown removal in practice. Gap.

stats.heading: Stat priority (PvP)
stats.markdown:
1. **Stamina first** — the one gearing rule several experienced posters agree on: "put on the tanking t3 pieces+lifegiving gem and STAMINA enchants/armor kits. That will let you get 7k hp unbuffed ... 10k hp with gem buffed. No other class can bring you down 1v1 pound for pound" [Springboards (player), 2024-10-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=104533#p104533); "going stamina on gear instead of glass 3.8k-4.5k hp warrior you should be 5.5k-6k unbuffed, stamina enchants tanking neck tanking rings tank gear etc" [Springboards (player), 2025-12-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162626#p162626); "you need the bwl trinket that gives you 20% more hp" [Terrydavis (player), 2026-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171279#p171279) — identified as Lifegiving Gem [Magicknight (player), 2026-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171300#p171300). Arms enables this: "you scale off weapon damage more, this allows the warrior to equip more stamina heavy gear" [Citramate (player), 2023-05-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=47208#p47208).
2. **Weapon damage (top-end)** — "your base damage on weapon like BRE/MoM/DEI/severance should be more than enough" [Springboards (player), 2025-12-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162626#p162626); "you need an endgame weapon" [Terrydavis (player), 2026-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171279#p171279); "a Good weapon is a CTUN AXE" [Boeuff (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171438#p171438).
3. Hit/crit/AP after that — no PvP-specific numbers in the sources. Gap. No PvP stat weights or resilience-like stat exists ("Need resilience" is a wish [Bloodline1x9 (player), 2025-05-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130241#p130241)).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target "rotation" (PvP priority)
rotationSingle.markdown:
PvP has no rotation; the sources give openers and principles.

1. **Open**: Charge (out of combat only — "Not being able to charge while in combat is completely dumb" [Kerebrien (player), 2022-09-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=24464#p24464); casters "cast some nothing spell like pain or counterspell at max range to get you in combat and deny you the ability to enter the fight with any kind of momentum" [Snoof (player), 2025-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152740#p152740)) or Intercept (Berserker Stance) if already in combat → **Hamstring** immediately (no cooldown since 1.18.1; 6 s cooldown from CC2 to 1.18.0) → Bloodrage before approaching a rogue "to prevent Sap" then Demoralizing Shout to break stealth [Xudo (player), 2024-11-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105917#p105917).
2. **Mortal Strike** on cooldown (healing debuff is the reason to be Arms); **Overpower** on dodge; **Execute** under 20% (no cooldown since CC3).
3. **Master Strike** as the situational CC: dagger swap for a silence on casters, axe for the 4 s root, sword for disarm (staff definition; Cheruscan/Snoof above). Snoof's caveat: "trying to make an ability do that many different things is just not a good idea ... axes being the 'correct' option" [Snoof (player), 2025-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152740#p152740).
4. **Pummel** (Battle Stance since CC2) as the interrupt; Shield Bash if you carry a shield.
5. **Disarm** vs melee (keep 20 rage via Tactical Mastery — Xudo above); **Intimidating Shout** as the escape/peel (unreliable fear "especially if you're alliance going up against Will of the Forsaken and tremor totems" [Snoof (player), 2025-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152740#p152740)).
6. **Polearm kiting** (with 5/5 Master of Arms): Hamstring then hold 7 yd range against other melee [Manletow (player), 2024-10-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103527#p103527) — single source.
7. Do not stand in a caster's kiting pattern; "abuse line of sight ... he is kiting the mages not letting them kite him" [Springboards (player), 2024-10-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=104533#p104533).

Level-19 bracket specifics (Xudo's matchup list: paladins ignore Hamstring, hunters Wing Clip back, priests SW:P you into combat before Charge, shamans kite around Earthbind, mages Frost Nova after Charge, locks dot-and-kite, druids Faerie Fire + root) [Xudo (player), 2025-10-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155546#p155546); rage is plentiful at 19 ("white attack for 100 damage grant ~18 rage") and Pummel/Slam are good there [Xudo (player), 2024-11-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105917#p105917).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target
rotationAoe.markdown:
- 2–3 targets: Sweeping Strikes + Whirlwind + Cleave (Bloodline1x9's "Sweeping Fury" logic: SS doubles WW and Cleave damage [Bloodline1x9 (player), 2023-09-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=62559#p62559) — pre-CC2 build, mechanic still exists); Piercing Howl for AoE snare (Likaleo above); Intimidating Shout for AoE fear ("Much of warriors best tools shine in group play (Mortal Strike, AoE Fear, Hamstring, Disarm and so on)" [Atreidon (player), 2026-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164520#p164520)).
- 4+: **do not** "charge in to a group of enemies ---> do one Whirlwind with 2hander ---> die like a bitch in 5 seconds" [Manletow (player), 2024-11-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108331#p108331). Tauren War Stomp is the only AoE stun (Springboards p=162626, p=170772).

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Free Action Potion** is treated as part of the kit: "You must have a free action potion for most fights and tea/sugar is a must as well" [Chudman123 (player), 2024-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=89398#p89398); "use fap on CD basically" [Chudman123 (player), 2024-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=89399#p89399); "Warriors can pop a fap then intercept the mage. then he cant slow you" [Snkx (player), 2025-09-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152000#p152000); "if FAP isn't removed somehow, any half-decent warrior basically wins by default against multiple classes" [Gantulga (player), 2024-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=89403#p89403). Contested as a design complaint ("When you argue with someone about this, they will answer 'Buy Free Action Potion'" [Bloodline1x9 (player), 2025-05-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130241#p130241)).
- Other matchup consumables (2022 list, pre-CC2): Frost Reflector vs hunters, FAP vs mages/druids, Greater Holy Protection Potion vs ret, Crystal of Zin-Malor + Sippy/Resto pot vs affliction lock, PvP trinket or Living Action vs rogue [Kerebrien (player), 2022-09-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=24464#p24464); "Reflect trinkets and Permanent Sheen of Zanza vs mages" [Wsta (player), 2025-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144634#p144634); "timbermaw ancestor which really helps in arena" [Chudman123 (player), 2024-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=89398#p89398).
- **Engineering** gadgets: "final step is engi gadgets, correct macros and rage management" [Springboards (player), 2025-12-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162626#p162626); Volkyte above.
- **Retaliation / Shield Wall / Recklessness** (30-min cooldowns): "super powerful in the right situation, but the cooldown is so long you only get to cast it once every other BG" [Snoof (player), 2025-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152740#p152740); Cheruscan's "every 30mins you become a literal god".
- **Berserker Rage**: fear immunity; with Improved Berserker Rage (Fury, CC3) a root/snare break on a 30 s cooldown [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159).
- **Rage**: you start every fight at 0 ("Warrior is the sole exception -- they begin every fight at their absolute weakest" [Manletow (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139157#p139157)); absorb shields give no rage ("Not being able to generate rage on shields is absolutely crippling" [Snoof (player), 2025-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152740#p152740)); Charge gives 9 rage baseline (Xudo p=105917).
- Macros: Charge-or-Hamstring by stance/range macro [Dasenel (player), 2022-09-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=24213#p24213); Nampower for stance-swap queueing [Karlythegnarly (player), 2025-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122633#p122633); wiki `Warrior_Macros` page (repo copy).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Play next to your healers and dispellers; your value is MS on their kill target and Hamstring/Disarm/fear peels (Atreidon p=162631, p=164520; Thaladar p=151245).
- Soak: with stamina gear you are the target that costs the enemy mana ("enemy players spend mana to kill him. Meanwhile he was healed from other side" [Xudo (player), 2025-10-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155546#p155546); Manletow p=108331).
- Avoid enhancement shamans head-on: "enhance shaman always outmelee'd warrior.always.no exceptions ... use your toolkit like fear, disarm and stack stamina/kite" [Springboards (player), 2025-12-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164130#p164130); Windfury "has no internal cd" and Stormstrike forces procs [Springboards (player), 2025-12-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164133#p164133). Counter-suggestion: deep prot with Thunderfury (ferundal, single source).
- Dampening era (1.18.0+): "nobody is scared of physical damage. This puts warriors in the position of easily kited, easily bursted, and easily survivable" [Eyeburn (player), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169850#p169850) — single source, pre-release of the class-specific dampening numbers.
- Race: Tauren (War Stomp, HP), Gnome (escape), Night Elf (Shadowmeld, nerfed) [Springboards (player), 2025-12-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162626#p162626); Orc stun resist nerfed at CC2 (Manletow p=103527).

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- Tank tier pieces / Lifegiving Gem / stamina enchants and armor kits; KT mace still hits hard (Springboards p=104533). Weapons named: BRE, Might of Menethil, DEI, Severance (Springboards p=162626), C'Thun axe (Boeuff), Thunderfury for Blood Drinker procs (Eyeburn p=169850). Don't rely on Ice Barbed Spear / Unstoppable Force at 60 [Snkx (player), 2025-09-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152000#p152000).
- Consumables: FAP, Living Action, tea/sugar, reflectors, Sheen of Zanza, engineering (above). No enchant list beyond "stamina enchants". Gap.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Solo-queuing and seeking 1v1s (Atreidon, Cheruscan, Mdzielak).
- Max-damage gearing with 4k HP instead of stamina (Springboards ×2).
- Whirlwind-into-the-zerg opener (Manletow p=108331).
- No FAP/consumables ("Majority of Warriors crying about Harmstring nerf haven't used a single FAP outside raids" [Wsta (player), 2025-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144634#p144634)).
- Fighting enhancement shamans in melee (Springboards).
- Reading pre-1.18.1 Hamstring advice as current: the 6 s cooldown was the era's central complaint ("it is the 6s cd on hamstring" [Isvya (player), 2024-10-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103679#p103679); [Gladius (player), 2025-02-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119652#p119652); [Taralej90 (player), 2025-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144606#p144606); [Eyeburn (player), 2025-08-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148022#p148022)) and it is gone since 2026-03-20.

extraSections.heading: Official kit (staff) — PvP-relevant lines
extraSections.markdown:
- CC2 (2024-10-12) [Dragunovi (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102974): **Hamstring 6 s cooldown**; Master of Arms (polearm +2 yd range; per-weapon effects); Counterattack; Pummel usable in Battle Stance (player reading: "Having Pummel in Battle Stance is much needed" [Manletow (player), 2024-10-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103527#p103527)); Improved Intervene (snare immunity 3 s, Protection row 3 — "good news - warriors have something to break roots. Bad news - you need to invest talents to protection tree ... you can get Mortal Strike and Improved Intervene" [Xudo (player), 2024-10-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103288#p103288)); Blood Craze 2/4/6%.
- 2024-12-20 [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460): Execute back to vanilla values with a 4.5 s cooldown (later removed); Mortal Strike 105–120%.
- 2025-03-30 [Torta (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504): Improved Pummel 50% snare.
- CC3 (2025-07-25) [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159): **Master Strike** replaces Counterattack — 35% weapon damage, 20 rage, 30 s cooldown; main-hand effect: Mace disorient 3 s (breaks on damage), Sword disarm 3 s, Axe immobilize 4 s, Polearm +100% weapon damage vs mounted and dismount, Fist knockdown 2 s, Staff +25% parry 10 s, Dagger silence 3 s ("Combined with Master of Arms, this talent encourages tactical weapon swaps"); **Battlefield Mobility** also −2/4 s Charge cooldown (swapped position with Improved Execute); **Blood Drinker** reworked: "While under the effect of Enrage, Death Wish or Recklessness, your attack and abilities heal you for 1/1.5/2% of you maximum health" ("greatly improved self-sustain, especially in PvP and solo play"); **Improved Berserker Rage** (Fury row 6, 2 points): 5/10 rage and 50/100% chance to free from movement impairing effects on activation ("we hope to see that this opens up a niche for building Fury for PvP"); Execute cooldown removed; MS 115–130%.
- 1.18.1 (announced 2026-01-23, live 2026-03-20) [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071): **"Removed cooldown from Hamstring"**; PvP Dampening debuff (introduced 1.18.0) becomes class/spec-specific ("More information regarding numbers will be given at a later date" — no numbers in the extracted posts; gap).

standing.source_quality: medium: many posts but mostly rants; consistent advice only on stamina gearing, support play and consumables
standing.notes: The class's PvP spec because of Mortal Strike. Standing is the single most argued topic in the Warrior forum and splits on one axis - support: worthless solo, 'strongest class in PvP if they get supported well'. All Hamstring-cooldown-era advice (2024-11 to 2026-03-19) is obsolete and nobody re-evaluated PvP after the cooldown was removed.

yaml.agreement: contested overall (F-tier vs strongest-with-support); consensus on: Arms for Mortal Strike, stamina gearing, play with healers/dispellers, FAP and consumables, avoid 1v1 and enhancement shamans

patch_validity.notes: 1.18.1 removed the Hamstring cooldown (added at CC2) and made PvP dampening class-specific (numbers not in repo). Master Strike (CC3) replaced Counterattack (CC2). Decisive Strike builds (pre-Dec-2024) obsolete. No post-1.18.1 re-evaluation.
