sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown:
Covers the three leveling approaches the forum actually argues about: **2H Arms** (the majority recommendation), **dual-wield Fury** (the alternative that became viable with Class Changes 2 and Blood Drinker/Blood Craze), and **Protection via dungeons** (recommended against by most, defended by a few). Sources span 2022–2026 and three kit versions; every recommendation names its kit.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). Kit versions inside pre-1.18.1: pre-CC2 (before 2024-11-01), CC2 (1.17.2, 2024-11-01: new rage formula, dual wield at level 10, Slam at 14, Hamstring 6 s cooldown, talent trees rebuilt [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102974)), the 2024-12-20 revision (Decisive Strike removed, Slam 2.5 s cast usable while moving [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460)), CC3 (1.18.0, 2025-08-15: Master Strike, Blood Drinker rework, Execute cooldown removed [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159)), 1.18.1 (Hamstring cooldown removed [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)).

sections.heading: Which spec — the argument
sections.markdown:
- **2H Arms (majority, all eras)**: "Arms is honestly the best way to level if you want to do so as dps" [Mazeperception (player), 2022-02-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=16543#p16543); "You shouldn't be dual wielding while leveling. Not enough hit gear. Go 2hand arms and you'll melt stuff with a half decent weapon. The new rage formula works great for leveling I steam rolled to 60 with a 2 hander" [Grizb37 (player), 2025-08-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144945#p144945); "Fury was never a way to level. At least not until like 50-ish levels, when you can get some thrashing weapons and a bit of a hit gear" [armsgirl (player), 2025-08-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149087#p149087); "Main selling point for Arms is Sweeping Strikes which turns you into an aoe machine and a great dungeon tank. Also Bloodthirst scales with AP which you usually don't have much while leveling. MS on the other hand scales with weapon damage" [Khagrim (player), 2024-11-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107379#p107379); "Level 40 and a decent amount of crit. If you don't have that much, then arms will be better" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-08-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149483#p149483).
- **DW Fury (minority pre-CC2, growing after CC2/CC3)**: "I enjoy leveling warr as fury. I would even challenge that it is slower than arms. Also makes it easier to tank in dungeons" [Zulnam (player), 2023-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60478#p60478); "I leveled DW from 20-50 and had a good time ... I definitely had more rage to spend" [Pistol (player), 2022-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=28473#p28473); "My basic advice for leveling is choose Fury. The most important talents are about longevity and reducing downtime, and that means Blood Craze. You're getting critted every fight; 6% back makes a real difference" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489); "Fury is absolutely the way to go if you are solo and can get a decent mainhand. Blooddrinker is insane for solo leveling once you hit 35+" [Soreb (player), 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149364#p149364); "Since the offhand +10 hit talent early in Fury tree, theres no reason not to" [Kerenis (player), 2026-02-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167721#p167721); "while arms is fun, imo fury is way faster due to blood craze + blood drinker" [amanagor (player), 2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173445#p173445) (post-1.18.1); "Arms or fury are both fine for leveling, and DW definitely has some advantages in terms of mitigating lost damage from avoidance, and in feeding you overpower procs" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-09-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151373#p151373). The hit problem stated numerically: DW "adds a 19% chance to miss on both hands, combined with the base 5%, that's 24%" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-08-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147408#p147408); counter: "You can counter it by doing green quests" [Xudo (player), 2025-08-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147440#p147440).
- **2H Fury for leveling**: "As of the recent patch leveling 2h fury is pretty pointless, the class changes basically deleted the playstyle" [Turbosaxophonic (player), 2024-11-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106806#p106806) (CC2); after CC3 the Slam build exists at 60 (see `fury-melee-dps.md`) and one HC leveler uses Slam a lot: "Find yourself a slow 2h weapon and use slam in your rotation a lot" [Hctwowfan (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157895#p157895). Contested.
- **Protection (dungeon leveling)** — **contested, majority against**: "Do not level as a Prot Warrior ... Prior to raids, you do not need to be Prot in order to tank well" [Redmagejoe (player), 2023-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37550#p37550); "Ignore the protection talent tree ... your spells baseline are plenty good enough to tank anything before raids no matter your spec" [Kairion (player), 2023-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60459#p60459); "Taking 2 times as long to do quests as i was doing on arms was not fun at all" [Zhilo (player), 2023-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37911#p37911); "Prot isn't actually a good tank while levelling in Classic ... Arms becomes the best levelling tank spec due to talents like tactical mastery and improved thunderclap" [Syrathegreat (player), 2024-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=90022#p90022); "You can but it's slow. I did it by spamming dungeons ... Prepare for not having threat around lvl 50-54" [Akos1896 (player), 2024-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=89977#p89977). For: "This is best spec to level warri if you wanna go dungeons ... You will have Shield Wall and Last Stand for a critical situation" [Bloodline1x9 (player), 2023-03-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37690#p37690) (HC, turtle glyph); "Prot is actually a decent leveler right now, and you get insta queue pops being a tank" [Drazenexe (player), 2025-12-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164108#p164108); post-1.18.1 the tree still gets called a leveling weak spot: "Shield Specialization does not generate enough rage to make it on par with Duel Wielding or 2H Warriors" [SvenS2 (player), 2026-04-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175303#p175303).
- **"Any spec works"** (post-CC2 consensus tone): "Both Arms and Fury are good for leveling and have no problem tanking leveling dungeons" [SvenS2 (player), 2026-04-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173980#p173980); "you can level in any spec u want ... would reccomend to switch around at like level 40 and use some gold to respecc" [Morkahja (player), 2026-02-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167706#p167706); "Warriors went from one of the worst leveling class to near one of best with recent rage changes. I'm getting like 40 rage after charging and one hitting the mob with a white weapon at level 27" [Grizb37 (player), 2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112520#p112520).

sections.heading: Build A — 2H Arms (default), talent order 10–60
sections.markdown:
The only level-by-level route in the sources (CC3 tree, written for 1.18.0; the 1.18.1 changes do not touch these talents except the Boundless Anger/Precision Cut swap, which is a 60 concern): [armsgirl (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157920#p157920), build link to 40 `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warrior?points=DQCDKYDIp-Ao-` (opaque):

| Order | Talent | Points | Reaches at (5 pts/row logic; levels are the reader's arithmetic — the post gives order only) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Cruelty (Fury) | 5/5 | ~level 14 |
| 2 | Tactical Mastery (Arms) | 3/5 | ~17 |
| 3 | Improved Rend (Arms) | 2/2 | ~19 |
| 4 | Improved Thunder Clap (Arms) | 3/3 | ~22 |
| 5 | Deflection (Arms) | 2/5 | ~24 |
| 6 | Improved Overpower (Arms) | 2/2 | ~26 |
| 7 | Dual Wield Specialization (Fury) | 3/3 as written | ~29 |
| 8 | Two-Handed Weapon Specialization (Arms) | 3/3 as written | ~32 |
| 9 | Impale (Arms) | 1/2 | ~33 |
| 10 | Master Strike (Arms) | 1/1 | ~34 |
| 11 | Sweeping Strikes (Arms) | 1/1 | ~35 |
| 12 | Master of Arms (Arms) | 5/5 | ~40 |

(The "3/3" for Dual Wield Specialization and Two-Handed Weapon Specialization is how the post writes it; the route mixes DW and 2H talents on purpose — "Then if you want to go 2H you switch" to a 60 build. Rank maxima are not restated here because the CC2 tree changed several rank counts; check the calculator.) Hctwowfan's tweak to the same build: "0/5 in improved shouts and instead put those into 2/2 improved slam and 3/3 blood craze" [Hctwowfan (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157895#p157895).

Other Arms leveling links (opaque, CC2 era): Yasara's "classic armsbuild for leveling" `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warrior?points=DQFARYDQpYAABABoAoBYAoAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` with Overpower and Counterattack ranked up [Yasara (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108095#p108095) (Counterattack no longer exists — CC3); Czasku's Arms-to-30 `...?points=FQFAQYAQAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` [Czasku (player), 2024-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106723#p106723).

Talent notes: Tactical Mastery is what makes early tanking work — "You would start Arms if you plan to tank early because it grabs tac mastery and imp tclap. Those two talents will be 90% of your ability to tank for a good while" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-09-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151619#p151619); "TacMastery lets you do stuff like Charge -> Def stance -> ThunderClap -> Demo Shout" [Oomentaloo (player), 2025-09-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150752#p150752). Axe Specialization at 30 is why the Whirlwind Axe is the pick: "at lvl 30 you can take Axe Specialization which is additional 5% ... When you're lvl 40 you get Mortal Strike" [Czasku (player), 2024-09-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101834#p101834) — note Master of Arms replaced the per-weapon specializations at CC2, so this is pre-CC2 reasoning; the axe's top-end damage argument still holds ("the axe has the highest top dmg" [Hctwowfan (player), 2024-09-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101830#p101830); damage ranges per Whirlwind weapon [Atreidon (player), 2024-09-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101831#p101831)).

sections.heading: Build B — DW Fury (from ~level 10, or switch at 40–50)
sections.markdown:
Sourced talents (Berettadin, CC2 era; Blood Drinker per Soreb/amanagor, CC3+): "Cruelty 5/5, Dual Wield Specialization 5/5, Blood Craze 3/3, Improved Shouts 5/5, (Demoralizing Shout is a staple and you're reducing damage taken), and Enrage 5/5. After that ... for PvE leveling Flurry is excellent. On the Arms side Improved Heroic Strike helps since HS is your primary rage spender. Improved Rend is a talent tax ... Tactical Mastery is only worth 1 thing: having enough Rage for Disarm ... Improved Overpower is actually quite nice since you'll generate a lot of enemy Dodges" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489). Add Blood Drinker 3/3 at 35+ ("insane for solo leveling once you hit 35+" [Soreb (player), 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149364#p149364)) — order not given (gap). Bloodthirst at 40. The 60 DW link (opaque): `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warrior?points=dQQACYAQ-AoFAoAAoZCFAB-` [armsgirl (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157920#p157920). Unbridled Wrath is skipped by DW levelers ("Duel Wield Specialization provides significantly more rage" [SvenS2 (player), 2026-04-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175303#p175303)); "Unbridled Wrath really only shines when dual wielding daggers" [Hctwowfan (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157895#p157895).

Weapons: "main hand weapons of 2.8+ speed" [armsgirl (player), 2025-08-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149087#p149087); a slow main hand ("fury just needs to prioritize strength and a slow mainhand" [Armet (player), 2024-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84970#p84970)).

sections.heading: Build C — Protection via dungeons
sections.markdown:
- Czasku: Arms 2H to 30 (spam Slam/Rend), respec at 30 to Prot with 1H+shield, link `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warrior?points=FQFARYAQBYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAVAFoIAQABQAAAAA%3D` (opaque), "The last 4 points spend on what you like. Cruelty/One Handed Weapon Spec" [Czasku (player), 2024-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106723#p106723) (CC2).
- Kobemaru: Arms first, "around 25 you can put some points into Prot for the +15% threat talent and defensive talents. All good defensive talents in the prot tree are early on" [Kobemaru (player), 2023-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37913#p37913) (pre-CC2; Defiance moved to row 4 at CC2).
- Xudo's pre-CC2 tank talent order (new-button-first): Deflection/Anger Management → Anticipation → Shield Specialization 3 → Last Stand → Improved Shield Block → Toughness 1 → Improved Sunder Armor → Improved Taunt → Concussion Blow → Improved Shield Bash [Xudo (player), 2022-11-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=28808#p28808) — **pre-CC2**: Improved Shield Block and Improved Sunder Armor no longer exist; Improved Shield Bash became Gag Order; Concussion Blow is now the 51-point capstone (CC2 staff post). Use only the principle ("Focus on new buttons").
- Wilsonsds' HC full-prot recipe: "Get cruelty and piercing howl. Them go full prot. +one hand damage, +chance on rage on hit ... dual weapons in green mobs all the way. for yellow mobs 2 handers. for tanking use shield, or for orange mobs. Get spirit attribute. Get the stopwatch trinket and never remove it" [Wilsonsds (player), 2023-08-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=56444#p56444) (pre-CC2).
- Drazenexe: "If you're gonna use a 1h I would go arms till you max impale, and then lean heavily into prot" [Drazenexe (player), 2025-12-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164108#p164108).

sections.heading: Respec points
sections.markdown:
- Level ~30: Arms → Prot if you commit to dungeon tanking [Czasku (player), 2024-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106723#p106723); Zhilo tried Prot at 30 and went back [Zhilo (player), 2023-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37911#p37911).
- Level 40: Mortal Strike/Bloodthirst; Arms → DW Fury if you have crit (Eyeburn p=149483) or Fury → try the other spec (Morkahja p=167706); armsgirl's route ends at 40 and switches to a 60-style build.
- Level ~50: DW Fury becomes viable with hit gear even for Arms-leaning posters (armsgirl p=149087).
- 60: pick the raid build (`fury-melee-dps.md`, `arms-melee-dps.md`, `protection-tank.md`). Respec is cheap: "The respec cap is pretty cheap on Turtle" [Zhilo (player), 2023-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37911#p37911) (no number given; gap).

sections.heading: Skill training priority (what to skip when poor)
sections.markdown:
- "Warrior is an expensive class. Heavier armor costs more to repair. You have more weapon skills to train then anyone" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489).
- Rank-1-only list: "If you are short on gold, you can learn only first rank of following skills: Hamstring, Overpower, Thunderclap, Mocking blow, Intercept, Shield Bash, Pummel. Additional ranks add more damage, but don't increase utility" [Xudo (player), 2023-02-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=36342#p36342). Caveat: "caution when only learning rank 1 thunderclap for tanking. The reason why its so good for tanking is because it has a threat multiplier on its damage ... try to not skimp on tclap ranks" [Kairion (player), 2023-02-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=36357#p36357); Improved Thunder Clap increases its damage (101 → 123/141/162) [Redmagejoe (player), 2023-04-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=42540#p42540). Overpower ranks matter more now that Improved Overpower is in every Arms route — the rank-1 list predates CC2.
- Slam at 14 costs more than expected: "it's not a big loss if you don't train it, since it is worth using only with a very slow weapon to dump rage, heroic strike will do better in any case at lower levels" [Macbetto (player), 2025-01-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115543#p115543) (before the 2025-07 Slam buffs).
- Always train: Sunder Armor, Rend, Heroic Strike (max ranks), Battle Shout, Demoralizing Shout, Charge, Bloodrage, Berserker Rage, stances, Execute, Mortal Strike/Bloodthirst, Whirlwind, Cleave (dungeons). Shield Bash is the best low-level tank opener: "Shield Bash generates 180 bonus threat at all levels ... for only 10 rage" [Redmagejoe (player), 2023-05-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=47619#p47619) (drops off 34+).
- Weapon skills: train all; "anything other than Human, Orc, or Goblin will require weapon skill items at endgame" [Syrathegreat (player), 2023-05-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=47323#p47323) (pre-CC2; CC2 smoothed weapon skill — "these are subject to change in the upcoming major patch, so i would not choose a human warrior now for the weapon skill racial alone" [Zulnam (player), 2024-10-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103027#p103027)).

sections.heading: Playstyle
sections.markdown:
- Opener (2H Arms): "charge -> sunder amor (which is often better than heroic strike) -> rend and sunder armor again ... Overpower is very OP and it proccs really often ... keep your Battle Shout up" [Yasara (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108095#p108095); DW Fury: "Opening is Rend, Demoralizing Shout, Sunder Armor, and HS when you can afford it" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489); Execute is situational ("starting a new fight ... with 0 rage and charge on CD is lame" — Yasara).
- **Hamstring kiting — contested**: for: "Art of arms leveling is in hamstring kiting. You charge+hamstring, deal melee hit and run from slowed mob while your attack is recharging ... ~30% reduction of incoming damage" [Xudo (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108097#p108097); "Use a slow twohander, apply hamstring, kite the slowed mob until your next autoattack is ready, apply sunder armor as you deal the autoattack, bandage if needed, repeat" [Borefficz (player), 2023-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60465#p60465); [Turbosaxophonic (player), 2024-12-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113433#p113433) (Charge > Hamstring > auto > strafe > Rend). Against: "Hamstring kiting is great against higher level opponents but completely unsuitable for normal leveling ... combat duration x 3 but incoming damage - 20%" [Yasara (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108106#p108106). Note: written during the 6 s Hamstring cooldown era; the cooldown is gone since 1.18.1.
- Mob selection: "Try to do quests where the enemys are 2-3 levels below your own level ... And try to fight mobs 1 vs 1" [Yasara (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108095#p108095); "Choose mobs 2 or 3 levels lower than yours" [Tacticalnelf (player), 2023-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60467#p60467); "Do not fight more then one mob at a time or mobs that are 2+ levels above you" [Monmothma21 (player), 2022-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=15955#p15955); green quests to dodge the hit penalty (Xudo p=147440).
- Weapons: "keep your weapon up2date because they are everything for warrior. Make sure your weapons are as slow as possible. Also have a shield and a fast 1handweapon (speed 1,x) rdy" [Yasara (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108095#p108095); "Staves are actually most reliable 2h weapon during leveling. Almost every dungeon has a quest with staff in reward" [Xudo (player), 2023-04-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=40276#p40276); "If you can tank, then you get steady supply of blue swords in quest rewards since WC. 2h weapons have to be crafted or unreliably looted" [Xudo (player), 2025-08-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147440#p147440); Whirlwind Axe at 30 (Hctwowfan/Atreidon/Czasku above).
- Dungeon tanking while leveling: any spec, shield only for hard hitters ("On Edwin Van Cleef or Verdan the Everliving ... I would probably put on the shield, but trash mobs can mostly be tanked without" [Oomentaloo (player), 2025-09-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150752#p150752)); "Cast demo shout, spam sunder and don't rely too much on thunderclap" [SvenS2 (player), 2026-04-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173980#p173980) vs "spam tclap as your main aoe threat generator" [Syrathegreat (player), 2023-05-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=47322#p47322) — contested; taunt chain and keybinding advice in [Xudo (player), 2023-04-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=40901#p40901). Dungeon XP: "you get full xp with turtle glyph in dungeons" [Xudo (player), 2023-09-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60711#p60711); "They massively reduced the exp gain if you are grouped up with high level players" [Kairion (player), 2023-09-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60577#p60577).
- Level 20 is the turning point: "Suffer through until level 20 and you are golden" [Monmothma21 (player), 2022-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=15955#p15955).
- Macros: `/startattack` + ability macros [Yasara (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108095#p108095); weapon/shield swap and Shield Block-with-swap macros [Oomentaloo (player), 2025-09-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150752#p150752); repo wiki page `Warrior_Macros`.

sections.heading: Stat priority (leveling)
sections.markdown: - Stamina + Strength with a 2H [Yasara (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108095#p108095); Strength and a slow main hand for Fury (Armet p=84970); crit gates the Fury switch (Eyeburn p=149483); hit is the DW problem (Eyeburn p=147408, Grizb37 p=144945); Spirit for Troll/no-downtime styles ("Trolls have a very easy time leveling, since troll regeneration is buffed here. Stack spirit" [SvenS2 (player), 2026-04-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173980#p173980); [Eeeeeeeeeee (player), 2024-11-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=109908#p109908)).

sections.heading: Route and professions
sections.markdown:
- Route: the only zone-by-zone guide is generic Alliance (Elwynn → Westfall/Redridge → ...) [Rukopashka (player), 2023-02-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=35440#p35440) — weak source, no Turtle-specific zones. Dungeon-centric alternative: "You could try to level as tank inside dungeons. Dungeons don't suffer from overpopulation" [Xudo (player), 2023-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60480#p60480); "Grinding > Questing" [Tacticalnelf (player), 2023-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60467#p60467) (single). Hard spot: early 50s ("Maraudon and ZF stops giving meaningful XP and tanking Hateforge and ST is hard then" [Akos1896 (player), 2024-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=89977#p89977)).
- Professions: "First Aid and Cooking are absolutely essential ... Beyond that I like Alchemy and Herbalism ... anything except Enchanting is worth your time" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489); "Train first aid and buy health pots" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-09-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151373#p151373); "Alchemy or Blacksmithing will help you alot" [Monmothma21 (player), 2022-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=15955#p15955); Engineering for PvP at 60 (`arms-pvp.md`). Consensus: First Aid + Cooking.
- Race: Troll regen/spirit (SvenS2), Tauren for HC ("tauren might be your best option defensively. Warstomp gives some breathing room" [Bigsmerf (player), 2024-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=96765#p96765)); "Best - dwarf and orc" [Feomatar (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171481#p171481) vs looks-based picks [Turboman (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171516#p171516), [Springboards (player), 2026-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170772#p170772) — contested, mostly cosmetic.

sections.heading: Hardcore differences
sections.markdown:
- Escape tools are the issue: Hamstring "your only early game escape tool" and it could miss/was on cooldown [Zahnfee (player), 2025-02-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119855#p119855) (cooldown gone since 1.18.1); Piercing Howl as the no-cooldown AoE snare [Likaleo (player), 2025-02-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119858#p119858); "Running away is always better then dying ... strafe untill you are far enough. Otherwise they can Daze you" [Monmothma21 (player), 2022-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=15955#p15955); "Shit hits the fan, piercehown+stopwatch+run potions" [Wilsonsds (player), 2023-08-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=56444#p56444).
- Prot's Shield Wall/Last Stand as HC insurance (Bloodline1x9 p=37690); Tauren War Stomp (Bigsmerf p=96765).
- Dungeon-only HC: pick Horde because RFC opens earlier than Alliance's first dungeon at 18 [Darktifa (player), 2024-06-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=96590#p96590).
- Experience report: 8 HC warriors to 60, "fury to 60, arms to 60, mix and match", slow 2H + Slam [Hctwowfan (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157895#p157895); HC leveler's Defensive Tactics analysis [Taralej90 (player), 2025-08-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=146132#p146132).
- Save potions for emergencies; keep food and bandages (Monmothma21).

sections.heading: Common mistakes
sections.markdown:
- Dual wielding early without hit gear (Grizb37, Mazeperception, armsgirl).
- Going deep Protection before 60 for solo questing (Redmagejoe, Kairion, Zhilo).
- Fighting yellow/orange mobs or 2+ at once (Yasara, Monmothma21, Tacticalnelf).
- Letting the weapon fall behind (Yasara, Monmothma21).
- Skipping First Aid/Cooking (Berettadin).
- Copying pre-CC2 talent lists (Xudo p=28808, Kobemaru, Wilsonsds) into the CC2/CC3 tree.
- Forgetting Hamstring on runners ("besides forgetting to Hamstring things that run off and come back with friends there's not a lot to go wrong" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489)).

- No source lists a complete 51-point build for any spec talent by talent. - Blood Craze in raids (Atreidon "3 points down the drain" vs Abiozan "must take"), Unbridled Wrath for 2H, Defensive Tactics — contested, unresolved.

Numbers
- Stat weights: none published for any spec. WarriorSim (Ugoboom p=35760 / wiki link) and the rentry guide (Muck5955 p=156287) are named but not in the repo.

- Flurry's current attack-speed value (Bigsmerf "15%") — no staff line.
- Rage formula constants after CC2 ("90% gear / 10% weapon speed") — staff description without formula.
- PvP dampening per-class numbers for 1.18.1 — staff said "at a later date"; not in the repo.
- Respec gold cost — "cheap" only.
- Deep Wounds bug (Cromius p=149915: ticks ~35% instead of 60%) — unresolved in the extracted posts.

Rotation/mechanics
- AoE thresholds (when Whirlwind/Cleave beats single-target) — not stated for any spec.
- Whether post-CC2 fury-prot tanks in Defensive or Berserker Stance.
- Whirlwind with a shield equipped (asked, not answered).
- Whether absorb shields still give zero rage post-1.18.1 (Snoof complaint, pre-1.18.1).

- Slam/Flurry post-hotfix behaviour (2026-03-21 "Flurry will now properly be consumed") — no player follow-up.

Gear/consumables
- No enchant list beyond "stamina enchants" (PvP) and no consumable list beyond FAP/tea/sugar/reflectors; raid consumables are vanilla baseline, not from turtlecraft.gg.
- Pre-BiS/BiS lists: named threads (Bigsmerf p=134748, Noephix p=135325) point to Atlas Loot / external sheets, not itemized in the forum.
- The "Lionheart Helmet" stamina change in the 1.18.0 itemization post (p=137624) is the Paladin T3.5 set, not the warrior helm — do not conflate.

Era coverage
- Post-1.18.1 (2026-03-20 .. shutdown): Warrior forum has only leveling chatter, one PvP complaint thread, Berettadin's execute note, SvenS2's Unbridled Wrath suggestion and the Flurry hotfix. No post-1.18.1 raid parses, no re-evaluated tank ranking, no re-evaluated PvP after the Hamstring cooldown removal.
- Roles without sources: healer, ranged (not warrior roles); 2H Fury leveling after CC3 (one HC anecdote).

Unresolved citations
- None remaining: the two previously unresolved quotes in `protection-tank.md` are now attributed (Lavrute p=113482 for "thunder clap by default usable in defensive stance"; Ademar p=103539 for the CC2-launch prot build link).

gear.about: Gear recommendations for Warrior (Arms, Fury, Fury-Protection hybrid, Protection) by spec/role and level bracket, with where-to-obtain, built from the Warrior forum (f40), General forum BiS-request threads, the existing class playbooks' "Gear, enchants and consumables" sections, and the 1.18.1 itemization changelog. The forum's own repeated finding is that **no maintained Turtle-specific pre-raid or raid BiS list exists** for any Warrior spec; every slot table below is built from named-item fragments scattered across many threads, not from a single curated list. Treat ranks as directional, not a simmed BiS order.
caveats: No dedicated Warrior pre-raid or raid BiS list was found anywhere in the corpus. Every 'Pre-BiS/BiS list?' thread in the Warrior forum (t4804, t19772, t14987) and in General (t13556, t18604) ends with players saying no such list exists and pointing to AtlasLoot, a third-party sim (zebouski.github.io/WarriorSim-TurtleWoW), or 'scour the database' — [Philandros (player), 2022-11-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=28796#p28796); [Ugoboom (player), 2023-02-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=35760#p35760).

Warrior leveling has no itemized gear list in any source read for this guide (synthesis/classes/warrior/leveling.md covers talents and playstyle only, zero named items) — leveling-10-29/30-49/50-59 brackets are omitted entirely below; see gaps.

Raid-tier mapping used to bucket items below (inferred from repeated pairings in the sources, not stated as a table anywhere): raid-t1 = Molten Core, raid-t2 = Blackwing Lair, raid-t2.5 = Ahn'Qiraj 40, raid-t3 = Naxxramas, raid-t3.5 = Kara40 (Tower of Karazhan, Turtle-custom). This mapping is the synthesis agent's inference from context, not a direct source statement — flagged per item where it matters.

Item IDs are filled only where a source links database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=N (Turtle's own item database). Several posts link db.vanillagaming.org instead (a generic vanilla database, not Turtle's) — those IDs are NOT copied into item_id since they cannot be confirmed against Turtle's own numbering; source_type/source_place are still recorded from the post text.

gaps: No pre-raid-60 or raid-tier BiS list exists for Warrior Protection tank in the sources (unlike Paladin Protection, which has an old — explicitly outdated — vanilla list). This guide could not reproduce any item table for that bracket beyond the scattered mentions above.

No leveling gear (10-29/30-49/50-59) exists for any Warrior spec — synthesis/classes/warrior/leveling.md is talent/playstyle-only. Bots must fall back to "upgrade whatever quest/dungeon plate or armor of the appropriate armor type drops" with no Turtle-specific list to cite.

Runeblade of Baron Rivendare vs Dal'Rend's swords (a named 2H-vs-DW weapon question) got only trinket answers in the source thread (Hand of Justice, Rune of the Guard Captain, Blackhand's Breadth) — the weapon question itself is unanswered.

Item IDs referenced only as raw https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=N or https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=N links without an item name in the post text (e.g. the Ret Paladin-style pattern seen elsewhere) do not occur for Warrior in the threads read for this guide, but several Warrior threads (t4804, t19772) instead recommend third-party tools (AtlasLoot, a fan-made warrior sim) rather than naming items at all.

Kel'Thuzad mace, Dark Edge of Insanity and Severance are named only as "end weapons" with no slot/stat details beyond the fact they exist; Severance's custom-vs-vanilla status is not independently confirmed.
Dreadslayer (Kara40 mini-set) is named as part of a T3.5 BiS combo but no individual Dreadslayer item names or slots are given anywhere in the corpus.

"The best gloves for fury warriors are mail" (Balake, 2020-07-02) is a 5-year-old, one-line claim with no item name and no context on which patch/kit it describes; not usable as a current recommendation.

No enchant list exists for any Warrior spec/role in the Warrior forum; the only enchant fact found is Windfury Totem interacting with sharpening stones ("you don't get bonus attack power for extra attack", Xudo p=103287) and world buffs giving a 20-40% DPS increase (Abiozan p=112930), neither of which is a per-slot enchant recommendation.
No PvP-specific gear list exists for pure Fury or pure Protection; arms-pvp.md explicitly covers all three specs together because the forum does not split PvP gear discussion by spec.

gearMarkdown.heading: Gaps
gearMarkdown.markdown:
- No pre-raid-60 or raid-tier item list exists for Warrior Protection tank in the sources — only scattered stat-priority and set-bonus mentions.
- No leveling gear (leveling-10-29 / leveling-30-49 / leveling-50-59) exists for any Warrior spec. `synthesis/classes/warrior/leveling.md` covers talents and playstyle only — zero named items. A bot has to fall back to generic "best available armor of the right type" logic.
- Runeblade of Baron Rivendare vs. Dal'Rend's swords (a named 2H-vs-DW weapon question) got only trinket answers (Hand of Justice, Rune of the Guard Captain, Blackhand's Breadth); the weapon question itself is unanswered in the source thread.
- Kel'Thuzad mace, Dark Edge of Insanity and Severance are named only as "end weapons" with no slot/stat detail; Severance's custom-vs-vanilla status is unconfirmed.
- Dreadslayer (Kara40 mini-set) is named as part of a T3.5 BiS combo but no individual item names or slots are given anywhere in the corpus.
- "The best gloves for fury warriors are mail" (Balake, 2020-07-02) is an old one-line claim with no item name and no clear kit context — not usable as a current recommendation.
- No enchant list exists for any Warrior spec/role. The only enchant facts found: Windfury Totem interacts with sharpening stones but grants no bonus AP for the extra attack ([Xudo (player), 2024-10-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103287#p103287)); world buffs give a 20-40% DPS increase ([Abiozan (player), 2024-12-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112930#p112930)). Neither is a per-slot enchant recommendation.
- No PvP-specific gear list exists for pure Fury or pure Protection; the PvP section above is explicitly shared across all three specs because the forum does not split PvP gear discussion by spec.
- "Meph leather chest" (Kara40) is recorded exactly as written by the source; Warrior plate vs. this item's stated "leather" armor type is not reconciled anywhere in the corpus.

readme.heading: Official 1.18.1 Paladin changes used (Jamey p166071, 2026-01-23, revised 2026-03-19; hotfixes Torta p171608/p172139)
readme.markdown: Consecration +8% base and front-loaded ticks (156% → 44%); Holy Shield threat 30% → 50%; Righteous Strikes → Holy Strike +5..25% damage/threat and Crusader Strike grants Zealous Defence (next blocked attack −6..30%); Holy Strike reworked to weapon damage + Holy (R8 40% WD + 129–146) with 71% SP; Repentance tick +8% AP; Seal of Command 7 → 9 PPM; Crusader Strike R5 100% WD; Daybreak 289 → 248 base, 43% → 32% scaling; Ret T3.5 5-set Crusade 4%/20 s non-stacking; Holy T3.5 5-set no extra Holy Strike targets; Prot T3.5 5-set moved to 3-set, new 5-set Holy Shield −4% damage taken; Ret/Prot T2.5 3-set +15% JoR/JoC. Hotfixes: strikes grant benefits on miss; Holy Strike heal target count fixed; Mending Light triggers/scales; Libram of Ardour faction fix. The 26 Jan 2026 revision block contains no Paladin entries.

readme.markdown:

2. **Full point-by-point 60 builds**: every endgame build is a talent-calculator link (`talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=...`) that cannot be decoded from the text; only leveling orders are enumerated. Holy 31/7/13's Prot/Ret points are unknown.
3. **Pre-raid BiS lists** for all three specs on current itemization (the 2019 tank list is declared outdated; askers in 2025 were sent to Discord).
4. **Consumables** for Prot and Holy beyond mana oil; flask/elixir choices; Ret enchant choice per slot (AP vs SP).
5. **Holy downranking / spell-rank usage and emergency thresholds** (when to Lay on Hands, Hand of Sacrifice, bubble).
6. **Shockadin / Holy ranged DPS** rotation after 1.18.0 restored Holy Shock damage.
7. **Ret PvP** build and rotation post-CC2; Prot PvP.
8. **Crit-immunity defense value on Turtle** (only a hedged vanilla number: 440 / 420 with Anticipation) and the exact block needed for crush immunity after Righteous Strikes lost its block chance.
9. **Zone-by-zone leveling route** and dungeon-per-bracket list (only fragments: RFC at 38 for Lavadrenched Chainmail, Gilneas City ~48, Hateforge 54–55, ZF for Jang'thraze).
10. **Whether Crusader/Holy Strike proc Seal of Righteousness** (contested in Oct 2025; consensus says no, one tester says yes).
11. **Improved Seal of Righteousness** actual value (a 2025-09 dummy test measured 4.6% instead of 10%; staff listed a fix 2024-12-20; unresolved).
12. **Buff cap behaviour** (do hidden buffs still apply?) — contested.
13. **Ret T3.5 / Prot T3.5 / Holy T3.5 full set bonuses** (only the 1.18.1 deltas are in the sources).
14. **Strength's value for Prot threat** (contested: block value → Holy Shield damage vs "no scaling").
15. Whether the guide's Hogger class quest is required for Crusader Strike (staff: trained at 8 / High Elf trainer).

playbooks.title: Paladin — Protection tank (dungeons and raids)
playbooks.intro: Playbook for a sword-and-board Protection Paladin on Turtle WoW, built from the Paladin forum (f=41), the staff class-change posts and the 1.18.1 notes. Everything is cited; where the sources disagree or predate a change, it is marked. Post-1.18.1 sources (after 2026-03-20) are thin: the forum extraction ends in early April 2026, so most play advice is **pre-1.18.1** or **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** and is checked against the official 1.18.1 changes below.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: main tank or off-tank with a one-hand weapon and shield, Righteous Fury on, threat from Holy damage (Holy Strike, Consecration, Holy Shield blocks, Seal/Judgement of Righteousness) rather than weapon damage.
- **Strengths (consensus)**: best multi-target threat of all tanks and the easiest dungeon tank; near-infinite mana with Seal/Judgement of Wisdom and Shield Specialization blocks; a real taunt (Hand of Reckoning) that is talented to almost never miss. "Paladins have the best multi target threat + their taunt has an extremely low chance to miss if talented for it + they are also the highest in dps among all tank specs" — [Cheruscan (player), 2025-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123148#p123148). "Prot paladin is already extremely buffed. They are the best dungeon tanks and they are perfectly fine to tank all contents (except for some raid bosses who really punish mana using tanks)" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123046#p123046). "Paladin tanking is the easiest of all tanks, in my opinion. Consecration is your bread and butter ability and does 80% of the work for you" — [Captain4k (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165936#p165936).
- **Weaknesses (consensus)**: no ranged pull (use engineering, a friend, or consumables — see Role strategy); no defensive stance and weaker single-target scaling into late raids; caster mobs are the one thing solo Prot struggles with ("prot only struggles against caster mobs" — [Zulnam (player), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135007#p135007)); mana-punishing raid bosses.
- **Content**: excels at leveling by AoE grinding from ~30, 5-man dungeons, MC/BWL-era raids and Tower of Karazhan (staff: "Protection Paladins are thriving in Tower of Karazhan, with strong threat generation, consistent mitigation, and reliable utility" — [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159)). High-end raid scaling was the recognised weak spot until 1.18.1: "Protection Paladins were extremely strong during leveling and early endgame but scaled poorly in high-end raids. These changes slightly reduce early power while significantly improving late-game scaling" — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
- **Community standing**: **favored** for dungeons and mid raids (consensus above); **contested** for top-end raids in late 2025 — "A tank shaman in t2 gear out threats t3 pallys (in full naxx/some k40 bis threat gear) in both single target and aoe" — [Kord2998 (player), 2025-12-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162511#p162511); "Prot paladin threat is still bottom tier even with that set bonus" — [Escaton1 (player), 2025-12-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162493#p162493). Staff answer to that was the 1.18.1 scaling buffs (see below). Staff also state all three specs are raid-viable: "Paladins are seen in all three specs in raiding." — [Akalix (staff), 2025-02-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118876#p118876).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
No source gives a complete point-by-point 60 Protection build in text; the builds are shared as talent-calculator links. What the sources state:

- **11/40/0 "Threat Build"** (Unchallenged's guide, updated 2024-12-04 for 1.17.2): link `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=AoAoBAAAAAAAAAAoYFZbCAZoAoBAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` — [Unchallenged (player, guide writer: 49-post guide thread referenced across the forum), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457). **Single source; pre-1.18.1.** The 11 Holy points are not enumerated; his leveling orders (below) show what the 40 Protection points are.
- **Protection points named by the guide's leveling order** (dungeon variant, 0/31/20 by 60, then the raid variant): Redoubt 5, Precision 3, Toughness 5, Blessing of Sanctuary 1, Shield Specialization 3, Improved Righteous Fury 3, Holy Shield 1, Reckoning 5, Righteous Strikes 5 (called "4xRighteous Strikes"+1 in the text), Bulwark of the Righteous 1; Retribution: Benediction 5, Deflection 5, Pursuit of Justice 2, Improved Retribution Aura 2, Blessing of Kings 1; "If Raid Tanking: 2xImproved Hand of Reck, 3xRighteous Defense; or 2xImproved Judgement, 3xVindication" — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457). Note: "Improved Hand of Reckoning is not required to tank dungeons before the endgame. If need be can always BOP the target." (same post).
- **Jcarrill0's "Tankadin" (Dec 2025)**: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=-AoYFZbAAZoAoB-AoAoQI` — "Protection Paladin. Judgement of Justice, Blessing of Sanctuary, Improved-Retribution Aura" — [Jcarrill0 (player), 2025-12-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164036#p164036). Single source; 1.18.1-announced-pre-release; explicitly "designed only for the purpose of clearing all the end-game dungeons".
- **Holy/Prot hybrid for dungeons (21 Holy for Holy Shock as a ranged pull)**: "As of 1.18 using holy shock for range pull is also once again an option. While dungeontanking its not necessary to be prot to do your job as a tank, spending 21 pts in holy is totally worth trying out. I personally didnt spec out of holy shock until i was raidtanking" — [Atreidon (player, 90 posts in f41, frequently the answering voice), 2025-08-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147010#p147010). Azcron's Holy/Prot link for a level-56 asking for survivability: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=AoaAYSFApAAAAAFoAFBbAABAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` — [Azcron (player), 2025-06-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134913#p134913). Single source each.
- **Sanctity Aura at 20 for Consecration damage** (leveling dungeons): "Personally, I'd spec into Sanctity Aura in the holy tree at lv20 to increase the damage/threat from consecration. But if you choose not to, then stay in Ret Aura" — [Captain4k (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165936#p165936). Single source.
- **Precision (Protection row 2, +3% hit incl. spell hit)** is called "Genuinely one of paladins best talents" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-11-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160800#p160800).
- **Vengeance in a tank build is dead**: the old 21 Prot / 30 Ret "Holy Shield + Vengeance" dungeon build ([Getplucked (player), 2023-07-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52649#p52649)) "doesn't work anymore as Vengeance now decreases threat" — [Istavan (player), 2025-01-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115937#p115937). (Vengeance's threat reduction was later disabled under Righteous Fury — [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504) — but no source recommends a Vengeance tank build after that.)

**Did 1.18.1 change the build?** Righteous Strikes changed function (Zeal block → Zealous Defence) but is still the 5-point Protection strike talent; no source posts a revised build. Flag: builds above are **pre-1.18.1**; valid_for_1181 = unknown (talent positions unchanged in the 1.18.1 notes, values changed).

stats.heading: Stat priority (60)
stats.markdown:
Two stat sets, swapped per fight (consensus among the experienced posters):

> "You build sets based on caps: A set that guarantees full avoidance (every attack is dodged parried or blocked). A set of plate gear and as much spellpower as possible to maximize threat. And you change accordingly to fight. Usually, trash and weak hitting boses you go threat set while unknown bosses or hard hitting ones you go avoidance." — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166168#p166168)

Survival priority (single detailed source): "Stam until you can survive the tier you are in ... Defense is nice but not mandatory just imagine 5 defense is 1% mitig, its almost as good as 1% dodge ... 18 agi is about 1% dodge and 1% crit in raid scenario (coze of kings) so i usualy go 15 agi>5def ... block chance until you reach crush cap with holy shield is nice to have". Threat priority: "Spell power, agi because of crit, strength (but its the worst stat you can get at the moment and its only Attack power)" — [Everran (player), 2025-08-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143606#p143606).

- **Spell power** is the threat stat: "Spellpower is most important for pally tank right?" — [Snoodydood (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165977#p165977), answered with the two-set rule above. Consecration, Holy Shield block damage, Holy Strike, Seal/Judgement of Righteousness all scale with SP — [Azcron (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153809#p153809). 1.18.1 raised Holy Strike's SP coefficient from 43% to 71% — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
- **Strength**: contested. "Strenght wont improve your threat in the slightest. All your aggro comes from holy damage" — [Kerenis (player), 2025-10-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153860#p153860) vs. "It increases your block damage, and block damage directly boosts the damage from Holy Shield ... every block with Holy Shield hits harder when your block value is higher" — [Azcron (player), 2025-10-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153912#p153912). Since 1.18.1 Holy Strike also has a weapon-damage component (40% at rank 8), which no forum source has yet evaluated.
- **Crit-immunity defense cap**: "Vanilla Crit Cap is 440 Defense Skill (420 if you are running Anticipation) -- Which is often not worth reaching when you consider what you have to sacrifice" — [Jendaille (player), 2025-08-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148436#p148436) `(single source; the poster hedges "if my memory serves"; general vanilla numbers, not a Turtle-specific test)`. Anticipation gives 7/14/20 Defense — [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102969#p102969).
- **Crush cap**: staff intended Holy Shield (45% block) + a little block on gear to reach "crush immunity" — [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102969#p102969). Pre-1.18.1 Righteous Strikes' Zeal block chance helped; **1.18.1 removed that** (Zealous Defence instead), so block chance must now come from Holy Shield, Redoubt procs and gear. No post-1.18.1 source gives the new numbers (gap).
- **Weapon**: fast one-hander. "as a tankpaladin faster weapons generate much much more mana with wisdom. So slow weapons are generally avoided" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=138797#p138797). "always use fast weapons (with +spelldam as a nice to have)! Weapon Damage is not important for threat, only Crusader Strike scales with weapon damage. But try to keep Zeal up! Faster hitting=more Mana!" — [Schlaechter (player), 2025-10-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153945#p153945). Pre-1.18.1 Holy Strike was "weapon agnostic" — [Crake (player), 2025-08-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147650#p147650) — **superseded** by 1.18.1's weapon-damage component (fast weapons still favoured for mana; no post-1.18.1 source re-evaluates).
- **"Adds X damage to melee attacks" items** trigger Judgement of Wisdom an extra time per swing: "if you want to spam max rank consecration +dmg triggering JoW an additional time is a must if you dont want to sip teas on CD" — [Cheruscan (player), 2025-09-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150774#p150774); item list in [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457): Repaired Electro-Lantern (65030), Storm Gauntlets (12632), Fiery Plate Gauntlets (12631), Flameskin Gloves (81267), Lavadrenched Chainmail (80704), Incendosaur Skin Pauldrons/Gloves/Boots (60572/60582/60568), Fiery Retributer (19968), Crimson Spellblade (81018), Blazefury Medallion (17111), Leggings of Fiery Temper (61505), Ring of Electrical Binding (61332). Note: items whose extra elemental damage is white "+X–Y Fire Damage" on the weapon line (Smoldering Brand, Thunderfury) do **not** count — [Atreidon (player), 2024-09-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101314#p101314).
- **Leveling**: Stamina/armor first, Intellect ("...of the Eagle") welcome, Strength unimportant — see `leveling.md` ([Azcron (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153775#p153775), [Schlaechter (player), 2025-10-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153945#p153945), [Isvya (player), 2023-09-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=67010#p67010)).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation (boss / one mob)
rotationSingle.markdown:
Before the pull: Righteous Fury on ("If you died, first thing is to reapply it"), aura on (Retribution Aura for threat, Devotion if squishy), blessings up with ≥1 min left, Blessing of Sanctuary or Kings on self, Holy Shield cast while running in — [Akos1896 (player), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166176#p166176), [Getplucked (player), 2023-07-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52649#p52649).

Opener (consensus of the three tanking write-ups):
1. Seal of Wisdom up; **Judgement of Wisdom** on the target as it arrives ("Prepare the seal and judge your main target with it (usually wisdom so you have a passive mana battery on the battlefield)") — [Akos1896 (player), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166176#p166176).
2. **Holy Strike** immediately ("target skull and press Holy Strike so you hit it as soon as you're in range") — [Getplucked (player), 2023-07-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52649#p52649).
3. Re-seal (Wisdom on bosses; Seal of Righteousness for extra threat on bosses — "Bosses JoW, can use SoR for more threat, but high-rank consecrate+hs is generally enough" — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457)).
4. Boss pull with Bulwark of the Righteous if DPS open hard: "Currently I end up using it every Time at Pull when I fight a boss because DPS can't hold their feet still" — [Melfrato1 (player), 2025-06-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135289#p135289) (single source; the design intent is snap threat OR a defensive — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2025-06-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135285#p135285)).

Priority list:
1. **Holy Shield** whenever it is off cooldown ("Ensure holy shield is always on"; "keep Holy Shield on cooldown") — consensus.
2. **Holy Strike** whenever the shared 6-s strike cooldown is ready and Zeal is at 3 stacks with > ~6 s left ("Just press holy strike every 6 seconds and consecration every 8 seconds while maintaining seal of wisdom" — [excin (player), 2025-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123491#p123491)).
3. **Crusader Strike** instead of Holy Strike only to build Zeal to 3 stacks and to refresh it when it is about to fall off ("If you're in prot, then just check if zeal is at 3 stacks, if it's not use CS, if it is check if it has less than 6 seconds left, in which case refresh it, otherwise just use HS" — [Crake (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157229#p157229); "Right now, I just use Crusader Strike to keep Zeal up, and otherwise Holy Strike" — [Tankmeister (player), 2025-09-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150949#p150949)). Zeal lasts 30 s. Short fights: "For shorter fights you won't need to bother with it - just spam holy strike" — [Erhog (player), 2024-12-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113384#p113384). **1.18.1** adds a reason to weave Crusader Strike before a big hit: it grants Zealous Defence (next blocked attack −6..30% damage for 10 s, 5/5 Righteous Strikes) — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) (no player source on this yet).
4. **Judgement** on cooldown (every ~10 s) — re-judge Wisdom whenever it fell off or a new target is taken; re-seal after every judgement.
5. **Consecration** only if mana allows on single target; it is not needed to hold one mob ("Don't bother with Consecrate unless you're tanking 2+ mobs. I've seen people drop Consecrate for a single enemy, and that's where all their mana is going" — [Redmagejoe (player), 2022-08-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=23920#p23920), pre-CC2 but repeated by [Getplucked (player), 2023-07-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52649#p52649)). With Judgement of Wisdom plus +damage items, "you can use Consecrate more often without worrying about draining your mana" (same post).
6. **Exorcism** on Undead/Demon bosses for damage only — its threat is −70% since 2024-12-20 — [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460).
7. **Hand of Reckoning** when a mob leaves you (10-s CD); Hand of Protection on the DPS as an emergency alternative — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457).

Downranking: "dont forget you can cast low level versions of spells" — [Terrydavis (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165976#p165976); "Rank1 holy strike is usually just fine to keep threat, saves alot of mana" — [Isvya (player), 2023-09-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=67010#p67010) (pre-CC2 Holy Strike; still cited for low levels). With SP gear "you can eventually use different ranks of consec" — [Akos1896 (player), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166176#p166176).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **2 mobs**: mark skull; Holy Strike skull, Judgement of Righteousness/Wisdom + Seal auto-attack on the second, "Swap back and forth between autoattacking the two mobs, focusing more on skull"; no Consecration needed — [Getplucked (player), 2023-07-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52649#p52649).
- **3+ mobs**: Consecration is the AoE tool: "If there are 3+ mobs, consec makes wonders"; "consec anytime but mostly in case of 3+ mobs" — [Akos1896 (player), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166176#p166176); "I only ever used Consecrate with 3+ mobs" — [Getplucked (player), 2023-07-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52649#p52649). Keep Holy Shield up (every block is Holy damage + mana), Holy Strike the skull, tab through the rest to spread Judgement/Seal hits ("You can keep threat by tabbing between the mobs"). Big pulls when mana-rich: "Drop Highest Rank Consecrate, followed by R1" — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457). 1.18.1's front-loaded Consecration makes the first ticks the strongest ("On the first tick, Consecration deals 156% of the 1.18 base value") — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
- **AoE threshold** used by the sources: Consecration from 3 targets; 2 targets are handled by strikes + judgement + tabbing.
- **Solo AoE farming** (open world/Strat): Seal of Wisdom, body pull, Holy Shield, line-of-sight to bunch casters, Consecration, then Holy Light/Flash of Light on yourself under Concentration Aura, re-judge Wisdom when the judged mob dies — [Aeternusdoleo (player), 2023-06-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=51774#p51774); Spiritual Focus + Concentration Aura so self-heals are not pushed back — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2023-06-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49725#p49725), [Bryonus (player), 2023-06-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=50330#p50330). "Prot pally solo stratholme farm started with them doing only one boss and now they do like 4bosses" — [Snadileoboy (player), 2025-12-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164037#p164037).

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Bulwark of the Righteous** (5 min): either snap threat at a boss pull or hold it as a −30% damage cooldown for the dangerous phase; the 5-minute cooldown means most players "end up using it way less than I'd like" — [Glaive (player), 2025-06-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=136673#p136673). Decide per fight; a tank main says "Paladins threat is way too good as is. We dont need a low cd shieldslam" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-06-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=136693#p136693).
- **Divine Protection / Divine Shield**: Divine Shield now reduces your damage dealt by 60% instead of stopping attacks — [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159) — so a bubble no longer drops threat entirely but will cost threat; no tank-specific source on bubble use.
- **Hand of Protection** on a DPS who pulled — a standard emergency ([Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457)).
- **Mana**: Seal of Wisdom + Judgement of Wisdom on the main target, blocks (Shield Specialization 2% mana per block, 5-s ICD), Holy Strike's mana return, and +damage items. "With Seal of Wisdom and Judgement of Wisdom you never go out of mana so you just go without eating and drinking" — [Dissasster (player), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134989#p134989). Between pulls: "If only one enemy remains use it to regen mana by autoattack ... so next pull you have plenty of resource to go all out the first seconds" — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2025-01-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166451#p166451). Drink only when the group drinks; "Key as a tank is to keep threat using as few abilities as needed. That way you save mana for later and have a higher pace overall" — [Akos1896 (player), 2026-01-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166407#p166407). Emergency: a Human's Quel'dorei/High Elf racial mana is discussed for healers only; Prot relies on Wisdom.
- **Raid mana note**: some raid bosses "really punish mana using tanks" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123046#p123046) — bring mana consumables (Brilliant Mana Oil, mana potions/teas) for those.

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- **Marks**: keybind raid marks, put Skull on a healer/caster mob; DPS kill skull while you gather the rest — [Atreidon (player), 2026-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165826#p165826), [Reploidrocsa (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165909#p165909). Marks are hotkeyable in the keybind settings — [Atreidon (player), 2026-01-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166494#p166494).
- **Pulling** (no ranged pull): body pull, learn your body-pull range; or have a DPS pull to you through your Consecration; or consumables — Ez-Thro Dynamite, Explosive Rockets, Magic Candle (Elwynn kobolds, 1-min CD), Torch of Holy Flame from the Morbent Fel chain, engineering bombs — [Atreidon (player), 2025-08-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147010#p147010), [Jendaille (player), 2025-08-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147332#p147332), [Wolf of Rage (player), 2025-03-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123340#p123340). "If someone pulls for you, make sure you drop a consecration to intercept, and always hide behind a corner if the pull includes ranged mobs" — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165909#p165909). Holy Shock (21 Holy) works as a ranged pull since 1.18.0 restored its damage — [Atreidon (player), 2025-08-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147010#p147010).
- **Positioning**: turn mobs so DPS attack from behind ("mobs and players can't parry, dodge or block when attacked from behind") and so fleeing mobs run away from the pack — [SvenS2 (player), 2026-03-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171780#p171780).
- **Blessings**: Salvation on high-threat DPS (not on hunters who feign, not on low-threat classes); Kings on yourself, else Wisdom/Sanctuary by mana need — [Getplucked (player), 2023-07-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52649#p52649), [Akos1896 (player), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166176#p166176). Salvation is 25% since 2025-04-01 — [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504).
- **Threat meter** and don't over-spend: "In general, there's no point in pumping more threat on a mob if it's going to die before the DPS will pull threat" — [Getplucked (player), 2023-07-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52649#p52649).
- **Healer etiquette**: never pull with the healer out of range or low on mana ("Is your healer in range? Does your healer have a decent amount of mana? Do paladin buffs have at least 1 minute remaining?") — same post; "be mindful of time between pulls ... if you drink up between every pull, DPS can become restless" — [Akos1896 (player), 2026-01-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166407#p166407).
- **Off-tanking as Ret**: Vengeance's threat reduction is off under Righteous Fury — [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504); Ret "emergency tank capabilities" are cited as a Ret raid asset — [Atreidon (player), 2025-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122447#p122447).

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Pre-raid**: no current, complete list exists. The 2019 gear guide ([Jcarrill0 (player), 2019-02-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=2071#p2071): Deathbone set from Scholomance, Enchanted Thorium, DM West/North drops, Blackguard/Timeworn Mace, Draconian Deflector, Libram of Hope/Truth) is declared "outdated. Tankpaladin works vastly different now and requires other gear" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140261#p140261). Mentioned as still-robust pre-raid in 2025: "black morass exalt gears and deathbone set from scholo" — [Nectiusleo (player), 2025-09-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151424#p151424) (question, unanswered); Stormwind Vault "amazing tank gear" — [Arzong (player), 2025-07-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140858#p140858); a level-60 answer sends players to the Discord class channel — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-12-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161953#p161953). **Gap**: no verified pre-raid BiS list.
- **Progression**: "go for tier gear 1 after the other, and for some mitigation on the side like the helm of emerald sanctum for example. And if you realy want to be the chad, then you farm Wrath of cenarius in silithus, and you go every week to MC to get your thunderfury" — [Everran (player), 2025-08-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143606#p143606). Tier sets: Prot T2.5 3-set was "our best set bonus in the game atm ... pretty much our only way to somewhat scale our threat" pre-1.18.1 — [Escaton1 (player), 2025-12-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162493#p162493); 1.18.1 replaced both Prot T2.5 bonuses (3-set now +15% Judgement of Righteousness/Command) and moved the T3.5 5-set to 3-set with a new 5-set (Holy Shield −4% damage taken) — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). 8/8 T3 was judged worse than T2.5 + 3 hybrid pieces before 1.18.1 — [quetal (player), 2025-12-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162396#p162396) (contested with the staff rebalance; no post-1.18.1 comparison).
- **Weapons**: fast one-hander with SP; ZG one-hand mace preferred over the epic sword for farming ("procs a inferior thunderclap") — [Zulnam (player), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135007#p135007); Thrash Blade is a Reckoning synergy but too slow for Wisdom — [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=138797#p138797); Thunderfury is the long-term goal ([Everran (player), 2025-08-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143606#p143606)).
- **Enchants** (guide, pre-1.18.1, single source): Head/Legs Lesser Arcanum of Constitution (+100 HP) or Arcanum of Protection (1% dodge) / Syncretist's Sigil (ZG: 10 Sta, 7 Def, +24 healing); shoulder Zandalar Signet of Mojo (+18 dmg/healing); cloak Superior Defense or Dodge; chest Major Health or Lesser Absorption; bracer Superior Stamina or Deflection; gloves Greater Strength, Threat or Superior Agility; boots Greater Stamina; weapon Weapon Chain, Strength, Spell Power, Fiery, Crusader or Lifestealing; oil Brilliant/Lesser Mana Oil — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457). Shield spike (Thorium) and Enchant Shield Lesser Block/Greater Stamina from the 2019 list — [Jcarrill0 (player), 2019-02-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=2071#p2071).
- **Professions**: Engineering "100% no debate you want force reactive disk eventually and early on you can use the bombs for pulling" — [Terrydavis (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165976#p165976); Mining is needed to level Engineering; Herbalism suggested for gold — [Snadileoboy (player), 2025-10-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154394#p154394).
- **Consumables**: Brilliant Mana Oil, mana potions/teas; Elixir/flask not covered for Prot in the sources (gap).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes (what players criticise)
mistakes.markdown:
- Spamming Consecration on single targets and going OOM: "just mindlessly spamming consecrate and OOMing themselves" — [Getplucked (player), 2023-07-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52649#p52649).
- Tanking without a seal up / without Righteous Fury / without Holy Shield on cooldown — same post; [Akos1896 (player), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166176#p166176).
- Using Crusader Strike as a threat button; it is a Zeal maintainer (pre-1.18.1) — [Azcron (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153809#p153809); "I wouldn't recommend using it in a Prot build as it's a mana waste".
- Letting Zeal drop and rebuilding 3 stacks mid-fight — [Aalena (player), 2024-12-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113215#p113215).
- Pulling while the healer drinks / not letting the group recover — [Masklingt (player), 2026-01-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166405#p166405) (the other paladin in his group did this).
- Stacking Strength gear "because it's plate" instead of Stamina/SP (contested value, see stats).
- Not marking targets; not using Salvation on DPS.

sources.markdown:
