playbooks.title: Paladin — Holy healer (melee "Blessed Strikes" healer and caster variant)
playbooks.intro: Playbook for Holy on Turtle WoW after Class Changes 2 (1.17.2), the 1.18.0 Daybreak/Holy Shock rework (2025-07/08) and the 1.18.1 Daybreak nerf (live 2026-03-20). Holy on Turtle is a **melee-weaving healer**: Holy Strike heals 4 wounded allies within 10 yards, Crusader Strike resets Holy Shock, and Flash of Light / Holy Light fill the gaps. A pure ranged "Flash of Light spam" style still works and is what some raiders prefer; the forum treats the melee style as the stronger one in 2025–2026 (contested; both sides quoted).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: raid/dungeon healer in plate; tank healer by design ("Holy Paladin by design was meant as a healer excelling in single target, tank healing" — [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102969#p102969)) that became a strong raid healer through Holy Strike.
- **Community standing**: **favored (2026)**, **contested (mid-2025)**. "Holy paladins are the best healers in the server at the moment by a big shot thanks to their melee healing ability ... >30% of my healing in Kara40 comes from melee healing" — [Ellifta (player, self-described server #1 K40 healer, R13), 2026-03-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170300#p170300); "Our melee holy paladins do insane amounts of healing. It's very viable, just new" — [Gildark (player), 2025-07-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140787#p140787). Against (mid-2025, before the 1.18.0 buffs): "out of the top 30 healers for Kara40, only two are holy paladins" and Flash of Light's 42% coefficient loses to Chain Heal — [Soymage (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139025#p139025); "holy paladin is gonna have to stick with naxx gear ... paladin is in a very bad place" — [Nrgsa (player), 2025-07-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140751#p140751). Staff acknowledged the pre-1.18.0 gap ("The melee-focused Holy Paladin playstyle has been underperforming in terms of raw output, and we are introducing buffs" — [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460)) and then the over-correction ("the raw power of Daybreak—especially when combined with the Tier 3.5 set bonus—was significantly too high" — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)).
- **Strengths**: mana that never runs out (Seal of Wisdom melee, Illumination, Holy Strike's mana return: "It lets me keep my mana bar completely full" — [Beardozer (player), 2025-12-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161979#p161979)); half healing threat ("Paladin heals only deal half threat compared to any other healers" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139095#p139095)); one-GCD Cleanse; instant Holy Shock; blessings; plate.
- **Weaknesses**: melee mechanics (silences, stuns, cleaves) hit you; "Paladin is the single worst healer scaling with haste" and crit/mp5 are weak stats — [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139095#p139095), [Soymage (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139025#p139025).
- **Content**: dungeons, all raids incl. Kara40; strongest where the raid stacks and takes AoE (see the fight list in Role strategy).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
- **Guide build 31/7/13**: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=AoaAYSVQBAYABAFACAAAAAAAAAAAFAAoAKAAAAAAAAA%3D` — [Unchallenged (player, guide writer), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457). Points not enumerated in text. Pre-1.18.1, single source.
- **Jcarrill0 "Healadin"** (dungeon oriented): `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=AoaAZSdQpAYoB--FY` — "Judgement of Light, Improved-Blessing of Wisdom, Improved-Concentration Aura" — [Jcarrill0 (player), 2025-12-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164036#p164036). (Note: Improved Blessing of Wisdom is now the Retribution row-1 talent **Improved Blessings** — [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102969#p102969).)
- **Talents the raiders name as mandatory**: Blessed Strikes 5/5 ("I think you're severely underestimating how good Blessed Strikes are ... you need to use melee healing very liberally and also judge bosses on CD to have a 1.5 sec Holy Light" — [Ellifta (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139090#p139090)), Holy Judgement 3/3 (the 1.5-s Holy Light), Daybreak (the capstone whose T3.5 synergy was nerfed), Ironclad 2/2 (plate → healing), Divine Favor + Blessing of Light for Holy Shock, Spiritual Focus 2/2 + Concentration Aura when meleeing (pushback).
- **A no-crit "defensive/sustain" variant** was posted as a screenshot only — [Cosmico (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139100#p139100) (not reproducible here).
- **Holy/Prot dungeon hybrid** (Holy Shock + Holy Shield): `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=AoaAYSFApAAAAAFoAFBbAABAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` — [Azcron (player), 2025-06-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134913#p134913).
- **1.18.1**: Daybreak nerfed (numbers only), Holy T3.5 5-set no longer adds Holy Strike targets; talent layout unchanged. No post-release build posted (valid_for_1181 = unknown; the raiders say the nerf was deserved and the style remains: "nobody spoke against the massive nerf holy paladin is getting next patch, because we all know it deserves it" — [Ellifta (player), 2026-03-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170300#p170300)).

stats.heading: Stat priority (60)
stats.markdown:
- **Healing power** first ("No issues here. A great stat for everyone") — [Soymage (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139025#p139025); Holy Strike "scales with healing gear" — [Beardozer (player), 2025-12-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161979#p161979); Blessed Strikes "has absolutely crazy scaling with addheal. A large chunk of which comes from the weaponslot specifically" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139095#p139095).
- **Plate with item armor** because of Ironclad ("synchronizes with how your talents push you towards wearing plate" — [Ellifta (player), 2026-03-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170300#p170300)); only flat item armor counts — [Elisleris (player), 2025-06-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=136662#p136662).
- **Spell crit**: applies Daybreak, procs Illumination, and Mending Light uses spell crit; Holy Shock crit from Divine Favor. Valued but "Crit has never been that good for healers ... Overhealing is a huge problem" — [Soymage (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139025#p139025).
- **Haste**: nearly useless (Flash of Light sits on the GCD) — [Soymage (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139025#p139025), [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139095#p139095). Zeal (Crusader Strike) gives casting speed.
- **Mp5 / Spirit**: low value; "Spirit is almost useless as holydin" — [Metaalverf (player), 2025-09-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151262#p151262); but "we have %mana continues regenerating while casting as an item stat, and paladin healing t2.5 also grants 15% mana regen while casting. Human spirit bonus also grants 5% regen as well ... At the end of the day though, you probably aren't ooming as a paladin either way" — [Crake (player), 2025-09-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151365#p151365).
- **Hit**: not needed for the heals (see above).
- **Race**: High Elf (mana racial) vs Human (spirit/weapon skill) — contested: "Holy - High Elf" ([Gildark (player), 2025-09-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151263#p151263)) vs "Human Best for all roles" ([Snadileoboy (player), 2025-09-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151269#p151269)); guide: High Elf for "PvE Caster" — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457).
- **Levelling**: Intellect over Stamina for a self-healing class ("Potentially Intellect grants you more health than Stamina does") and Spirit to skip drinking — [Unangwata (player), 2020-10-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=8305#p8305) (old; Holy levelling is not recommended by later sources — see `leveling.md`).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target (tank) healing priority
rotationSingle.markdown:
Setup: Seal of Wisdom (mana on every swing/strike), Blessing of Light on the tank (also buffs Holy Shock), Concentration Aura when you are in melee and taking pushback, Retribution/Devotion otherwise (no source states an aura rule; Concentration is the guide's "Main Healing Aura 22+" — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457)).

1. **Judgement of Wisdom/Light on the boss on cooldown** — each judgement makes the next Holy Light 1 s faster (Holy Judgement 3/3): "judge bosses on CD to have a 1.5 sec Holy Light" — [Ellifta (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139090#p139090). Re-seal after.
2. **Holy Light (1.5 s after a judgement)** for big tank damage; Flash of Light otherwise ("Flash of Light: 428 - 494 (42%) ... It is the primary way of healing as a paladin" — [Soymage (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139115#p139115)). Example maths: Holy Light rank 9 with 1000 +healing, Healing Light 3/3 and the old Daybreak = 2.5/3.5×1000 + 1590×1.12×1.20 ≈ 2851 — [Aqdill (player), 2025-07-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139457#p139457) (formula illustration, pre-1.18.0 Daybreak).
3. **Holy Shock** whenever it is available and someone needs an instant heal; with Divine Favor 5/5 it crits 50% more often, applies Daybreak on crit, and can self-reset.
4. **Crusader Strike** when Holy Shock is on cooldown and you are in melee: it resets Holy Shock (Blessed Strikes) — "Timing Crusader Strike to refresh Holy Shock vs. using Holy Strike for healing/mana management feels meaningful" — [Tankmeister (player), 2025-09-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150949#p150949). Zeal stacks speed your casts.
5. **Holy Strike** on cooldown when 2+ people within 10 yd are wounded, or simply for mana ("I see HS as less of an AOE heal and more as a way to keep my mana topped off" — [Beardozer (player), 2025-12-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161979#p161979)).
6. **Lay on Hands** as the emergency ("it is possible to come back from 0 mana after a 'Lay on Hands'" — [Cosmico (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139100#p139100)); Hand of Sacrifice / Hand of Protection / Divine Shield as tank-saves and self-saves (no source gives thresholds — gap).
7. **Spell ranks**: sources do not give a downranking table for Holy; Flash of Light rank 60 (428–493, 180 mana) is the filler. Gap.

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / raid healing
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **Holy Strike on cooldown whenever raid damage goes out and you are stacked with melee** — the whole 1.18-era Holy playbook: "Cast HS on CD and fill the rest in with FoL" — [Azcron (player), 2025-07-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140887#p140887); "on some bosses like Anomolous and Kruul it's over 55% of their healing" — [Ellifta (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139090#p139090).
- **Where to use it** (Ellifta's fight list, 2026-03-07, single expert source): MC — Majordomo, Lucifron after curses, Sulfuron, Magmadar when fires hurt, Shazzrah after curses ("doesn't incur spell lock btw"), Ragnaros phase 2, trash AoE; BWL — Razorgore after stomp, Vaelastrasz on CD, trash on CD, Broodlord after stomp, Firemaw non-stop, Flamegor enrage; AQ40 — every trash pack, Skeram arcane explosion, bug trio/Viscidus poison bolts, non-stop on Sartura, Ouro popcorn; Naxx — Anub knockback, Faerlina fire/poison, Maexxna spiders, Grobbulus spew/slime, Gluth start, non-stop on Thaddius, Loatheb, Sapphiron and KT; Kara40 — Gnarlmoon after blood moon, Ley Watcher arcane rain and add explosions, on CD on Anomalus and Medivh, Bishop shadow-bolt AoE, non-stop on the Knight, Kruul between the 4-s melee timer, Sanv add phase, Mephistroth, Rupturan phase 2 — [Ellifta (player), 2026-03-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170300#p170300).
- **Where NOT to melee** (Atreidon's list, 2025-08-11, single expert source): MC Gehennas, Garr adds, Shazzrah, Sulfuron (AoE stun), Majordomo (fire novas), Ragnaros (knockback on mana users); BWL Razorgore (melee CC), Broodlord (knockback), Chromaggus, Nefarian (fear); AQ Bug Trio, Sartura, Twins, C'Thun — "know the boss mechanics and only go in if you know for certain its an upside because while it is better to have the option to use blessed strikes, if you do it in the wrong fights you kill yourself AND others" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144592#p144592). Note the two lists disagree on Shazzrah, Majordomo, Sartura and Ragnaros (**contested**; Ellifta's is the later post and from a top parser; Atreidon's is the safer default for a bot).
- Dungeons: melee healing "is a gamble that can backfire spectacularly" where mobs shield-slam, silence or fear — [Atreidon (player), 2025-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144592#p144592); Scholomance tutors' AoE silence as the example — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144559#p144559).
- AoE threshold: Holy Strike whenever ≥2 nearby allies are wounded (it heals 4); otherwise single-target casts.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- Mana: Seal of Wisdom + Holy Strike keep you full; use Illumination crits; Human/T2.5 regen-while-casting exists but is not needed; "Paladins only have Daybreak" as a burst tool — no long cooldown healing CD besides Lay on Hands and Divine Favor (now passive). Drink only with the group.
- Hand of Sacrifice: damage transferred no longer breaks CC — [Jamey (staff), 2025-08-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=145249#p145249). Hand of Freedom 24-s CD.
- Divine Shield: −60% damage dealt but heals are unaffected (the "bubble-heal" is the PvP staple, see `holy-pvp.md`).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Position behind the boss in the melee clump when the fight allows (lists above); swap to range for the disallowed fights.
- Judge on cooldown for the fast Holy Light; keep Seal of Wisdom up; keep Blessing of Light on tanks.
- Cleanse: one GCD removes magic, poison and disease — "dispell of most type of debuffs from a single target in one gcd" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139095#p139095) (Purify does not cleanse curses — [Make Purify clean curses too t16515](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=16515)).
- Support weapons: Nightfall / Dark Iron Sunderer in melee "for dps optimisations" at a healing cost — [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139095#p139095) (contested value).
- Blessings: Improved Blessings (Ret row 1) is where Improved Wisdom lives; assign with PallyPower (Turtle fork linked in the guide).

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Sets**: Holy T2.5 3-set gives 15% mana regen while casting — [Crake (player), 2025-09-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151365#p151365); Holy T3.5 5-set added Holy Strike targets until 1.18.1 removed it — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) ("So the 5 Set bonus is going to be borderline worthless for holy?" — [Overberk (player), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166086#p166086)); Holy T2 8-set proc is crit-only — [Torta (staff), 2024-11-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106599#p106599). Early complaint: "you are forced to use T1 for the melee healing build to actually work" — [Raxk (player), 2024-11-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108308#p108308) (Nov 2024; T1 Lawbringer 8-set proc later nerfed 30% → 12%, 2024-11-27).
- **BiS lists**: none Turtle-specific; "For a holy pally any classic guide will essentially work on Turtle WoW" (2022) — [Philandros (player), 2022-10-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27361#p27361). A 2026 raider asks whether to deviate from "the standard BIS gear curve" with 723 healing — [Nwhermit (player), 2026-03-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170505#p170505); answered only on hit (not needed). Gap.
- **Enchants** (guide): head/legs Lesser Arcanum of Rumination (+150 mana) / Arcanum of Focus / Syncretist's Sigil (+24 healing, 10 Sta, 7 Def); shoulder Zandalar Signet of Serenity (+33 healing); cloak Subtlety; chest Major Mana; bracer Mana Regeneration / Healing Power / Greater Intellect; gloves Healing Power (+30); boots Greater Stamina or Spirit; weapon Healing Power or Mighty Intellect; Brilliant/Lesser Mana Oil — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457).
- Consumables: not covered for Holy beyond mana oil (gap).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Standing at range and only spamming Flash of Light in AoE fights: "Spamming FoL is not the way to heal as a paladin" — [Ellifta (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139090#p139090).
- Meleeing on the wrong bosses (knockbacks, AoE stun/silence, fear) — [Atreidon (player), 2025-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144592#p144592).
- Forgetting to judge (loses the 1.5-s Holy Light) or letting Seal of Wisdom lapse (mana).
- Expecting Ironclad from Devotion Aura/enchants — only item armor counts — [Elisleris (player), 2025-06-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=136662#p136662).
- Stacking haste or mp5 gear.
- Trying to heal or buff warlock demons — it does not work (player report above).

playbooks.title: Paladin — Retribution melee DPS (raids and dungeons)
playbooks.intro: Playbook for Retribution on Turtle WoW after Class Changes 2 (patch 1.17.2, live 2024-10/11) with the 1.18.0 (2025-08) and 1.18.1 (2026-03-20) adjustments. Two gearing philosophies coexist and the forum treats them as different specs: **AP Ret** (Strength/crit/Seal of Command, two-hander) and **Spell/hybrid Ret** ("spelladin": Seal of Righteousness, spell power gear, Consecration spam). Both are covered; every claim is cited and dated.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: two-handed melee DPS with raid utility (blessings, Cleanse, Hand of Freedom/Protection/Sacrifice, emergency off-tank and off-heals).
- **Community standing**: **contested**. Staff: "Yes! Paladins are seen in all three specs in raiding." — [Akalix (staff), 2025-02-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118876#p118876). Top-end players: "I'm BiS in a high tier raiding guild and usually end up top 5 in overall dps on a good night, Definitely viable." — [Gildark (player), 2025-03-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123742#p123742); "one of my guild ret paladins ends up top 5 dps among other wars and one top mage" — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2025-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122449#p122449). Against: "If you look at the rankings for k40 dps, aside from the one obvious outlier ret dps isn't even in the top 350 spots" — [Kord2998 (player), 2026-02-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169085#p169085); "AP ret can pull MAYBE 1750 DPS as of now on Patchwerk which is quite a lot behind of other classes, and on multi target fights (Majority of Kara40) it is dumpstered hard" — [Ellifta (player), 2026-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169165#p169165). Staff acknowledged the AP side: "Retribution paladins that leaned into attack power have been underperforming for the last few patches" — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
- **Strengths**: respectable single-target damage, best-in-class utility ("Retpaladin offers respectable damage, emergency tank capabilities, dispell support and judgements for his raid ... Having the ability to transform into a healer on the spot" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122447#p122447)); threat is no longer an issue after CC2 ("Threat is finally fixed" — [Eulogy (player), 2024-11-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106958#p106958)) and Divine Shield drops threat ("he can drop threat with divine shield" — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2025-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122449#p122449)).
- **Weaknesses**: no cleave; long ramp-up (3 Zeal stacks + Holy Might ≈ 20 s, buffs last 30 s/20 s — [Kord2998 (player), 2026-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169188#p169188)); mana dependence on Seal/Judgement of Wisdom that punishes target swapping ("Ret paladin not only doesn't have cleave but it also can't afford to change target often because of needing wisdom to sustain mana, this goes double for AP ret" — [Ellifta (player), 2026-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169165#p169165)); buff-cap issues in raids (see Mistakes).
- **Content**: dungeons and MC–Naxx raids fine; Kara40 (cleave-heavy) is the weak spot per the 2026 threads above. Levelling: see `leveling.md`.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
All builds are talent-calculator links; no source lists every point in text.

- **Guide build 11/8/30 (+2)** — Unchallenged: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=FAAAAAAAAAAAAAAoYAAAAAAAAAAAAoTAFKAYdIFABAA%3D` with the two free points in "Guardian's Favor / Spiritual Focus", or, "You have Hit Through Gear": `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=FoCABQAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAoTAFKAYdIFABAA%3D` — [Unchallenged (player, guide writer), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457). Retribution talents named in his leveling order: Benediction 5, Deflection 5, Pursuit of Justice 2, Conviction 5, Improved Retribution Aura 2, Blessing of Kings 1, Seal of Command 1, Two-Handed Weapon Specialization 3, Vengeance 1–5, Vengeful Strikes ("Crusading Strikes") 5, Repentance 1; Protection: Redoubt 5, Precision 3; Holy: Divine Strength 5, Spiritual Focus 2, Holy Judgement 3, then Sanctity Aura / Improved Judgement / Improved Lay on Hands as the leftovers. Pre-1.18.1, single source.
- **Precision from Protection is standard**: a raider took "the PRECISION +3 hit from protection and equiped a few +HIT items ... DPS went up almost immediately" — [Scootiesana (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169915#p169915) (links: old `FoAABS--AoTAFIYYVIFAB`, new `FoAAB-AoY-AoTAFIYINIF`); "You miss out on precision in the prot tree. Genuinely one of paladins best talents" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-11-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160800#p160800).
- **Dungeon Ret with off-healing**: `https://talent-builder.haaxor1689.dev/c/1.18.0/paladin?points=FoaABAAQ--FoAAFKYAFIFAB` — [Ares81 (player), 2025-11-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160758#p160758); advice: "Go healing light 3/3 and divine intellect only 2/5 ... But that healing improvements are expensive in terms of talent points" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-11-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160800#p160800); alternative `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=FIaAZADQ--AoTAFKYAFIDAB` — [Maxe71 (player), 2025-12-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161161#p161161).
- **Jcarrill0 (Dec 2025)**: "Ret Pally" `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=FoAAB--FoTAVKYAFIFAB` (Improved Judgement of Crusader, Blessing of Kings, Sanctity Aura) and "DPS Pally" `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=Fg-FAY-FoTAFAYAFIF` — [Jcarrill0 (player), 2025-12-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164036#p164036) (dungeon-oriented, single source).
- **Sanctity Aura**: "not worth it until 60. Improved Retribution Aura helps you deal more damage overall since you don't have enough big numbers on Holy Damage" — [Aalena (player), 2025-08-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147231#p147231). At 60, spell Ret relies on it ("Outside of Crusader Strike and white hits, basically our entire kit deals Holy damage ... Sanctity Aura has been moved to the Holy tree" — [Novahiros (player), 2026-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169183#p169183)).
- **Improved Seal of Righteousness** for the spell build: "you need to switch to impr sor and consecrate spam" — [Icedcream (player), 2025-07-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=138117#p138117); "That used to be 15% base damage, now its 10% of all damage. This has been an overall buff" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-01-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165511#p165511). A 2025-09 dummy test measured only +4.6% instead of 10% — [Cuivienel (player), 2025-09-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151094#p151094) (bug report; staff had already listed "Corrected damage gain from Improved Seal of Righteousness" on 2024-12-20; status after 2025-09 unclear).
- **1.18.1 impact on the build**: no talent moved; SoC procs 7 → 9/min and CS rank 5 100% WD raise the AP build; no source posts an updated build (valid_for_1181 = unknown).

stats.heading: Stat priority (60)
stats.markdown:
**Contested between the two builds; both are current.**

- **Which build?** "With bonereavers edge go soc/ap route because hybrid needs different style weapon [a proc weapon scaling with spell power]" — [Snadileoboy (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169921#p169921); "Go Spelldamage with SoR. It will also improve Consecration, Exorcism, Hammer of Wrath, your heals ... AP will only improve SoC and white damage" — [Kerenis (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169927#p169927); "t2.5 is better for SP ret. t3 is better for AP ret, even without 8-piece" — [Noephix (player), 2025-07-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=138939#p138939); "Stacking Strength and crit is the strongest build for Ret atm" — [Cheruscan (player), 2025-03-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122789#p122789); "ret is on a spectrum and the devs are actively trying to make AP ret as good as SP ret" — [Cheruscan (player), 2026-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170671#p170671).
- **Hit**: "I think for 2hander DPS it's been lowered to 8% hit rather than 9%. Anyways, you'll want that before a lot of stuff" — [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-06-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=133826#p133826); "Get weapon skill 315 to reduce glancing damage. I would push for like 8-9% hit if possible" — [Snadileoboy (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169921#p169921). (Judgement of Command/Righteousness use melee hit — staff, above.) The guide's race note: Human "+3 weapons skill is equal to approximately 1% chance to hit" — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457).
- **AP build**: Strength > crit > hit to cap > haste; T3 gives "+55 AP, +2.46% Crit, +1% Hit, +2% Haste, +100 ArPen" over T2.5 — [excin (player), 2025-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122631#p122631). A community spreadsheet "for AP ret also recommends a lot of haste" — [Scootiesana (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169915#p169915) (unverified).
- **Spell build**: spell power and Intellect (spell crit), mana; "A supreme flask and all the sp elixirs you can get is the difference between 800 dps and 1200 dps on Tel'Abim" — [excin (player), 2025-03-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122792#p122792). Consecration ticks went 60 → 82 with Flask of Supreme Power in Naxx — [Ellifta (player), 2026-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170694#p170694).
- **Spirit on Ret tier gear is wasted** ("why the hell do we have spirit on our gear instead of stam or int?" — [Vidnar (player), 2024-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106083#p106083)).
- **Enchant question** (+8 Str vs +9 SP) was asked and not resolved — [Scootiesana (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169915#p169915) (gap). Weapon: "Crusader highest dps increase but spell power has has benefit of not taking buff slot" — [Snadileoboy (player), 2026-03-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170586#p170586).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown:
Opener and buff management (consensus across the rotation threads and the macro authors):
1. Pre-cast blessings; Sanctity Aura (spell build) or Retribution Aura; Seal up before the first swing; `/startattack`.
2. **Judgement** as you arrive (Judgement of Wisdom for mana on long fights; Judgement of Command/Righteousness when mana is fine — sources use Wisdom "for sustain" and swap only when full).
3. **Crusader Strike** ×3 (every 6 s) to reach 3 Zeal, then **Holy Strike** once for Holy Might (20 s), then Crusader Strike until Holy Might has < 6 s left, Holy Strike again — the pattern encoded in the macros: "This will use CS until you get 3 stacks of Zeal then HS for buff and continue CSing until your buff is less than 6s duration" — [Gildark (player), 2025-06-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134690#p134690); RoidMacros form `/cast [mybuff:Holy_Might<6] Holy Strike; Crusader Strike` — [Elisleris (player), 2025-07-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139413#p139413); castsequence form `/castsequence reset=17 Holy Strike(Rank 8), Crusader Strike(Rank 5), Crusader Strike(Rank 5)` — [Rindexxx (player), 2025-07-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139772#p139772); the ExAutoCSHS addon (`/AutoCS openHS prioZeal exorcism`) — [excin (player), 2025-07-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139403#p139403). Some open with Holy Strike ("open with hs for buff, then spam CS for max Zeal, throw in judgement in the meantime" — [Vidnar (player), 2024-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106111#p106111)).
4. **Judgement** on cooldown, re-seal immediately after; watch the swing timer so the re-seal lands before the next white hit ("You need to watch a swing timer, for Judging/reapplying the Seal" — [Siltrim (player), 2024-12-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111583#p111583)).
5. **Exorcism** on cooldown vs Undead/Demons (Naxx, Scholo/Strat): "in Naxx you at least get to throw Exorcism into the mix" — [Eulogy (player), 2024-11-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106958#p106958).
6. **Hammer of Wrath** below 20% (no swing reset since 2025-04-01).
7. **Repentance** on bosses for the "repent" tick (30 s; 1.18.1 makes it scale with 8% AP) — no player-side priority given; macro users put `/cast [nocooldown:Repentance] Repentance` in the strike macro ([Elisleris (player), 2025-07-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139413#p139413)).
8. Free GCDs: Cleanse/utility — "Use your extra GCDs while judgement and crusader strike are on CD to assist your raid (eg: dispel)" — [Steakhouse (player), 2024-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106418#p106418).

Spell/hybrid variant (T2.5 era): Seal of Righteousness + Improved SoR, max-rank **Consecration spam**, +damage-on-hit items (jewelcrafter cloth bracers "with 4 fire proc on hit. Triggers unlimited mana"), Wrath of Cenarius "procs with consecration for 80% up time" — [Icedcream (player), 2025-07-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=138117#p138117) (single source). "In K40, most spell rets wouldn't even touch [Holy Strike]" — [excin (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157278#p157278).

Which strike when: for Ret, "Crusader Strike is your go-to choice for damage ... you need to use Holy Strike purely for the strength buff" — [Aalena (player), 2024-12-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113215#p113215); the trade-off is explicit: "you need to check is it better to keep up the 20% str buff but losing some damage from crusader strike in favor of holy strike OR it's not worth it at all" — [Erhog (player), 2024-12-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113384#p113384). Low-level/dungeon exception: "Holy Strike party regeneration is too good to waste CDs on Crusader Strike" — [Kerenis (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157245#p157245).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **2–3 targets**: stay on one target for Wisdom; Judgement of Righteousness/Command on the secondary if it will live; Consecration only if mana is comfortable — "you dont use consecration cause you will run out of mana" — [Vidnar (player), 2024-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106083#p106083) (AP build).
- **4+ targets**: Consecration is the only AoE; 1.18.1 front-loaded its damage explicitly "to help with ... AoE damage capabilities of Retribution" — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). Spell build: max-rank Consecration on cooldown with Wisdom sustain ([Icedcream (player), 2025-07-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=138117#p138117)). Lower ranks to save mana: "keybind lower rank spell like consecration. Learn your guilds clear speed and understand when to use max rank and when low rank" — [Snadileoboy (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169921#p169921).
- Do not rebuild Zeal on trash that dies fast: "Totally useless on trash packs, since everything dies too fast to ramp up Zeal" — [Kerenis (player), 2024-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106096#p106096); use Holy Strike for party mana/health instead.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Mana**: Seal of Wisdom / Judgement of Wisdom is the engine; Blessing of Wisdom on self while levelling; "for ap retri you could use rank1 seal of command and save mana on trash/when low mana/ certain spots ranks only increase judgement damage not soc proc damage" — [Snadileoboy (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169921#p169921) (same advice in the guide: "ONLY USE/TRAIN Rank 1 [Seal of Command] To Conserve Mana till 60" — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457)). Fiery Plate Gauntlets on mana-heavy fights for extra Judgement of Wisdom procs — [Snadileoboy (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169921#p169921). Tel'Abim (no Windfury/mana totems) is mana-starved — [excin (player), 2025-03-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124368#p124368).
- **Divine Shield** to drop threat and keep DPSing at −60% damage — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2025-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122449#p122449).
- **Zeal / Holy Might** are the "cooldowns" to maintain; both fall off between pulls — plan pulls so they carry over when possible ([Kord2998 (player), 2026-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169188#p169188)).
- **Buff cap**: raid buffs + consumables + Zeal/Holy Might/Vengeance hit the visible cap (32 slots); some players report Holy Might not applying, others that buffs work but are hidden — **contested**: [Cheruscan (player), 2026-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170658#p170658) vs [Ellifta (player), 2026-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170694#p170694). Buff-texture macros break at the cap; use timer/combat-log based tracking ([excin (player), 2025-07-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=142117#p142117)).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Stand behind the target (no parry/dodge), keep the swing timer visible (SP_SwingTimer addon in the guide), keep both buffs up, judge on cooldown, and spend free GCDs on Cleanse/Freedom/BoP for the raid.
- Off-tank when asked: Righteous Fury on removes Vengeance's threat penalty — [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504).
- **PvP (weak, contested)**: pre-CC2 Ret burst was the forum's biggest complaint ("no reason to do 4,5k unmitigable burst damage in blue gear" — [Tibrintz (player), 2023-06-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=48938#p48938)); after CC2 Ret players call it nerfed ("retri was nerfed to shit ... when a retri on my team presses bubble all that happens is the pala does no damage" — [Terrydavis (player), 2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173359#p173359); "Paladin hits like wet noodle in pvp" — [Mccnl1ghtxx (player), 2025-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158321#p158321)) while opponents still call the class oppressive ("you put 5 bubbladins at flag/gy - they can defend it for over 2 minutes with bubbles, stuns, regenerating hp" — [Damso (player), 2025-10-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157515#p157515)). Staff nerfed Hand of Freedom (24 s) and made Divine Shield −60% damage because "Paladins have emerged as one of the top-performing classes in PvP, especially in arena formats" — [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159). Judgement range is 10 yd; boot enchant 8% replaces Pursuit of Justice — [excin (player), 2025-10-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157535#p157535), [Crake (player), 2025-10-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157610#p157610). Seals and blessings are easily dispelled (Sanctified Command removed) — [Kerenis (player), 2024-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106689#p106689), [Maxe71 (player), 2025-12-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161159#p161159). No current Ret PvP build or rotation is posted (gap); see `holy-pvp.md` for the spec the forum considers the PvP paladin.

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Pre-raid**: "Hit gear is obviously important" plus melee pieces from two Turtle dungeons: items 83440, 83462, 83463, 80674, 60550 ("I'd recommend the weapon in particular if you're human") — [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-06-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=133826#p133826) (single source, item names not given). Two Ring of Electrical Binding (61332) for extra Wisdom procs was the asker's plan — [Trogdor101 (player), 2025-06-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=133825#p133825). Soulforge "vastly superior" to Ret T1 — [Kerenis (player), 2024-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106689#p106689).
- **Raid gear (AP)**: Bonereaver's Edge + Crusader, Judgement Crown, Avenger's (T2.5) pieces, Zandalar Freethinker's, Girdle of the Fallen Crusader, Sacrificial Gauntlets, Zandalarian Hero Charm, Hand of Justice, Wrath of Cenarius planned — the 2026-03 kit in [Scootiesana (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169915#p169915); Sulfuras "really good weapon for both styles" — [Snadileoboy (player), 2026-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170007#p170007); Neretzek (21856) for the SP-scaling proc.
- **Spell Ret needs a specific kit**: "weapon with spell scaling proc, woc [Wrath of Cenarius], 3 x tier2, at least 5 x tier2.5/0.5x4/necrodin set. Extra consu like Dragonbreath chili" — [Snadileoboy (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169920#p169920). T2.5 5-set = +71 SP, T3 8-set = +91 SP — [excin (player), 2025-03-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122812#p122812). "Ret paladins currently perform great only when you have 8/8 t3 set" (Dec 2024, before the T3 6-set Exorcism nerf) — [Geojak (player), 2024-12-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113295#p113295).
- **Enchants** (guide): head/legs Lesser Arcanum of Voracity (+8 Str) or Arcanum of Focus; shoulder Zandalar Signet of Might (+30 AP); cloak Subtlety; chest Greater Stats; bracer Superior Strength; gloves Greater Strength / Superior Agility / Minor Haste; boots Greater Agility or Minor Speed; 2H weapon Agility, Strength, Fiery, Crusader or Lifestealing; Elemental Sharpening Stone (AP) or Shadow Oil (SP) when no Windfury — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457). Enchant choice per slot for AP vs SP is otherwise unresolved (gap).
- **Consumables**: Flask of Supreme Power and SP elixirs (spell build) — [excin (player), 2025-03-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122792#p122792); Dragonbreath Chili — [Snadileoboy (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169920#p169920); mana elixirs + Brilliant Mana Oil — [Scootiesana (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169915#p169915). Holy-damage protection potions are how Horde counters spell Ret ([Cheruscan (player), 2024-11-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106530#p106530)).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Going AP with hybrid gear or SP with an AP weapon ("hybrid needs different style weapon") — [Snadileoboy (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169921#p169921).
- Under hit cap / low weapon skill: glancing blows and misses were the diagnosed cause of "bottom of the damage done list" — [Scootiesana (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169915#p169915).
- Target-swapping off the Wisdom-judged mob and running dry — [Ellifta (player), 2026-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169165#p169165).
- Spamming Consecration as AP Ret — [Vidnar (player), 2024-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106166#p106166).
- Letting Holy Might / Zeal expire; relying on buff-icon macros at the raid buff cap — [excin (player), 2025-07-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=142117#p142117).
- Judging right before a white swing so the seal is not back up for the hit — [Unangwata (player), 2020-10-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=8305#p8305) (pre-CC2 but the seal/judgement mechanic is unchanged).
- Expecting Fiery Weapon or +damage items to proc Seal of Command — [Atreidon (player), 2026-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164504#p164504).

extraSections.heading: Turtle mechanics that define the spec (staff)
extraSections.markdown:
| Item | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Crusader Strike | X% weapon damage + flat; Zeal stack (3% attack/cast speed, ×3, 30 s); 6-s CD shared with Holy Strike; refreshes judgements; does not proc seals; normalised (3.3 for 2H) since 2024-12-20; 20% SP coefficient since 1.18.0; **rank 5 = 100% WD in 1.18.1** (was 90%) | [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102969#p102969), [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460), [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159), [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) |
| Holy Strike + Vengeful Strikes | Holy Strike gives **Holy Might** (+4..20% Strength, 20 s) with the 5-point Retribution talent (renamed from Crusading Strikes; CS bonus 2..10%, Zeal +2%/stack) | [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460) |
| Vengeance | row 5, +1..5% all damage per stack (×3, 30 s), −2..10% threat (not under Righteous Fury) | [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102969#p102969), [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504) |
| Seal of Command | small SP modifier; Judgement of Command gets an AP modifier and uses melee hit; **1.18.1: 7 → 9 procs per minute** | [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102969#p102969), [Jamey (staff), 2024-11-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108776#p108776), [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) |
| Seal of Righteousness | SP coefficient 0.092 × speed (1H) / 0.128 × speed (2H) since 2025-04-01, 2H reduced to 0.125 × speed in 1.18.0; Improved SoR = +10% of total damage; Judgement of Righteousness uses melee hit/crit | [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504), [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159) |
| Repentance | works on all creature types; immune targets take 160 Holy per attack/cast for 30 s (rank 3); **1.18.1: that tick scales with 8% of AP** | [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102969#p102969), [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) |
| Hammer of Wrath | no longer resets the swing timer (execute phase) | [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504) |
| Two-Handed Weapon Specialization / Eye for an Eye | swapped positions 2025-04-01 (2H spec lower in the tree) | [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504) |
| Exorcism | −70% threat; Ret/Prot T3 6-set only reduces its cooldown | [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460) |
| Divine Shield | −60% damage dealt (was −50%); Hand of Freedom CD 24 s | [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159) |
| Tier sets (1.18.1) | Ret T3.5 5-set: Crusade attack-speed bonus 2% → 4%, 15 s → 20 s, no longer stacks; Ret/Prot T2.5 3-set: +15% Judgement of Righteousness and Judgement of Command | [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) |
| Hotfix 2026-03-21 | Crusader/Holy Strike grant their benefits (Zeal/Holy Might) even when the attack misses | [Torta (staff), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608) |

Player-verified interactions: the strikes proc Seal/Judgement of Wisdom and Light but not Seal of Command/Righteousness ([Cheruscan (player), 2025-09-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150776#p150776); design rationale: "Giving crusader strike a ~40% chance with slow weapons for another 1k+ dmg from proccing a seal of command would be absurd" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-09-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150817#p150817)). Fiery Weapon and other yellow-number procs do not proc Seal of Command: "as a rule of thumb, if it produces a yellow number and paladin has access to it, it can't proc SoC" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164504#p164504). "+X damage to melee attacks" items still trigger Judgement of Wisdom and Vengeance but never on-hit procs; "The only ability that can trigger additional on hit effects is SoR" — [Cheruscan (player), 2025-09-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150774#p150774). Weapon procs that scale with spell power (Neretzek the Blood Drinker, Ashbringer) vs. fixed ones (Sulfuras) — [Snadileoboy (player), 2026-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170040#p170040), [ferundal (player), 2026-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170030#p170030) (single sources).

standing.source_quality: medium: rotation is consensus, gearing (AP vs SP) and viability are contested; builds only as links
standing.notes: Only Paladin DPS spec. Staff say all three specs raid; top-end players report top-5 finishes while log-readers report absence from the Kara40 top 350. 1.18.1 aimed at the AP build: Seal of Command 7 -> 9 PPM, Crusader Strike R5 to 100% weapon damage, Holy Strike reworked with 71% spell-power scaling.

patch_validity.notes: 1.18.1 buffed the AP build (Seal of Command 7 -> 9 PPM, Crusader Strike rank 5 90% -> 100% WD, Repentance tick +8% AP, Ret T3.5 Crusade 4%/20 s non-stacking) and front-loaded Consecration; T2.5 3-set became +15% JoR/JoC. No post-release DPS report.

playbooks.title: Paladin — Holy PvP ("bubbladin" flag/point defender and arena healer)
playbooks.intro: The forum treats PvP Paladin as its own topic and, after Class Changes 2, the spec it discusses is **Holy** (Retribution PvP is considered nerfed; Shockadin was removed in 1.17.2 and Holy Shock damage came back weaker in 1.18.0). Sources are few and partly hostile; this file is **medium/weak** quality and everything is marked.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Standing**: **contested, leaning strong**. "holy paladin is already mega OP in PvP, I'd know because I'm R13 with 46k HKS playing hpala 90% of the time. It doesn't need any offensive abilities to be good, it is already the best class in the PvP scene at the moment" — [Ellifta (player), 2026-03-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170300#p170300). "Paladins arent universally great in pvp, they're great in stationary engagements. Any time you need to start moving, suddenly paladins are terrible ... fairly well balanced for arena. Their biggest drawback is their kick vulnerability, one kick and theyre locked out of everything, including bubble" — [Crake (player), 2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173323#p173323). Horde view: "you put 5 bubbladins at flag/gy - they can defend it for over 2 minutes with bubbles, stuns, regenerating hp ... WSG - you cant kill paladin healers in bubble when FC carrying flag" — [Damso (player), 2025-10-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157515#p157515); "entire ally teams skipping around ... with permanent freedom on the flag carrier as soon as they hit a critical mass of 3 paladins" — [Solveit (player), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154176#p154176). Staff: "Paladins have emerged as one of the top-performing classes in PvP, especially in arena formats. Their combination of burst damage, defensive cooldowns, and utility makes them incredibly hard to counter when played well" — [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159) (with the Hand of Freedom 24-s CD and Divine Shield −60% damage changes).
- **Content**: Arathi Basin and Alterac Valley point/graveyard defence, WSG flag-carrier support, arena. Weak when kited/moving (Crake) and against dispel-heavy teams (Purge/Dispel on seals and blessings — [Maxe71 (player), 2025-12-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161159#p161159)).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: No Holy PvP build is posted. The pieces the sources rely on: Blessed Strikes 5/5 (Crusader Strike resets Holy Shock), Divine Favor (Holy Shock crit), Holy Judgement, Daybreak, and Spiritual Focus (uninterruptible heals). Pre-CC2 "Shockadin for solo PvP is nice" (screenshot build) — [Thol (player), 2022-10-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=26810#p26810) — is obsolete. **Gap.**

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown: Stamina is what opponents want removed from Holy PvP gear ("Currently its too difficult to take them down; a single dps needs to be able to take one down" — [Springboards (player), 2026-03-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170516#p170516)) — i.e. Stamina and healing power; no player-side stat list exists (gap). Rogue Dissolvent Poison (ignores armor) is the named counter — [Turboman (player), 2026-03-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170555#p170555).

roleStrategy.heading: Rotation / tactics (single source, Ellifta 2026-03-08)
roleStrategy.markdown:
> "You don't use holy strike in PvP, you use crusader strike to reset your holy shock so you can heal with no cast time + no risk of being silenced ... you do crusader strike to reset your holy shock, which can already reset itself, so you keep healing people with no cast bar. This also means the counter to holy paladins is disarm by warriors to prevent them from doing this." — [Ellifta (player), 2026-03-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170319#p170319)

Priority when defending a point:
1. Stay in melee of an enemy to keep swinging (Seal of Wisdom for mana) and to have Crusader Strike available; Holy Shock the ally who needs it; Crusader Strike as soon as Holy Shock is on cooldown to reset it; repeat ("I will see hpals in bgs use crusader strike to reset holy shock cd" — [Tortusenjoyer (player), 2026-03-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170314#p170314)).
2. Hammer of Justice on the enemy healer/DPS; Hand of Freedom on the flag carrier (24-s CD), Hand of Protection on a physical-focused ally, Cleanse constantly ("Paladins can cleanse and blessing of freedom every single Hunter debuff except Freezing Trap" — [FrankFankledank (player), 2025-10-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157532#p157532)).
3. Divine Shield when focused and keep healing inside it (bubble no longer stops you from acting; −60% damage dealt only); expect kicks — a kick locks Holy school including bubble (Crake, above), so avoid casting into a melee with an interrupt ready.
4. Holy Shock damage (1.18.0: rank 4 256–271, 43% SP) exists for finishing; opponents feared "holy shocks in pvp are going to be brutal" — [Soymage (player), 2025-08-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143311#p143311) — but no source builds around it.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Trying to out-range casters as a Holy Paladin instead of using the Crusader Strike → Holy Shock loop — [Ellifta (player), 2026-03-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170319#p170319).
- Casting with bubble on cooldown into an interrupt.
- Chasing: "kite them and win" is the accepted counter — [Gildark (player), 2025-10-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157476#p157476).

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: Sources are the Paladin forum's guide thread (Unchallenged, updated 2024-12-04 for 1.17.2), 2025 levelling threads, and the staff class-change posts for what is trainable when. Two viable paths: **Protection** (AoE grinding, dungeons, hardcore-safe) and **Retribution** (questing). Holy levelling is not recommended by any post-CC2 source.

sections.heading: Which spec
sections.markdown:
- **Consensus**: Ret for questing, Prot for grinding packs and dungeons. "If you want to mainly run around doing quests - ret. If you want to grind packs of mobs - prot." — [Noephix (player), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135039#p135039); "prot is a much better spec to level since it's more mana efficient than the other two specs ... you can easily fight 5 at a time" — [Zulnam (player), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135007#p135007); "Ret works pretty good but I've seen prot pallies lvl well with AoE grinding too" — [Thearturq (player), 2025-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144431#p144431); "technically prot is bis for leveling with shield spike/eagle gear and dmg reflect but thats is more advanced territory so i would go ret" — [Springboards (player), 2025-07-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140079#p140079).
- **When to go Prot**: "i think its best to wait until around lvl 30 and then respec into tanking its very weak early on!" — [Terrydavis (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165976#p165976); "Im leveling as holy/ret til 30, and respeccing as soon as I can get Holy Shield" — [Steakhouse (player), 2024-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106313#p106313); "I switched to Prot at lvl 30 and I have to say I really enjoyed it. Less waiting time for dungeons, for quests where you are asked to kill X mobs, just pull 3-5 of them" — [Dissasster (player), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134989#p134989). The guide's Prot orders start at 10 (Redoubt first) — [Unchallenged (player, guide writer), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457). **Respec points**: one respec around 30 (Holy Shield) if you levelled Ret/Holy first; a second at 60 for the raid role. Staff note that Prot was "extremely strong during leveling and early endgame" and 1.18.1 "slightly reduce[s] early power" — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
- Pallies "CAN'T tank until level 16 at the earliest. This is when you get Righteous Fury" — [Thefishyone (player), 2022-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=17965#p17965); Consecration is baseline at 20 — [Torta (staff), 2022-07-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=20251#p20251); "We already struggle on packs until level 20 when we get consecration" — [Catyngla (player), 2025-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156127#p156127).

sections.heading: Talent orders (guide, pre-1.18.1, single source)
sections.markdown:
From [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457); links: Prot no-dungeon `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAoYFBYAYBoAgBAAoQoQKAYAAAAAAA%3D`, Prot dungeon `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAoYFZYAAZoAgBAAoQoQKAAAAAAAAA%3D`, Ret `https://talent-builder.haaxor1689.dev/calculator/custom?t0=_pgv9YDGsH&t1=2uLmYNGgaP&t2=Sg8mfTVwpx&t=0500050001000000000000000000-0050300000000000000000000000-0050005005120020301205000100` (note: a reader points out the Ret link shows old talents — [Notemede (player), 2025-01-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=116787#p116787)).

| Levels | Protection 0/31/20 (dungeons variant) | Retribution 11/8/31 |
|---|---|---|
| 10–14 | Redoubt 5 | Benediction 5 |
| 15–19 | Precision 3, Toughness 2 | Deflection 5 |
| 20–24 | Blessing of Sanctuary 1, Shield Specialization 3, Improved Righteous Fury 1 | Pursuit of Justice 2, Conviction 3 |
| 25–29 | Improved Righteous Fury 2, Toughness 3 | Improved Retribution Aura 2, Conviction 2, Blessing of Kings 1 |
| 30–34 | Holy Shield 1, Reckoning 4 | Seal of Command 1, Two-Handed Weapon Specialization 3, Vengeance 1 |
| 35–39 | Reckoning 1, Righteous Strikes 4 | Vengeful Strikes ("Crusading Strikes") 5 |
| 40–44 | Bulwark of the Righteous 1, Benediction 4 | Repentance 1, Redoubt 4 |
| 45–49 | Benediction 1, Deflection 4 | Redoubt 1, Precision 3, Divine Strength 1 |
| 50–54 | Deflection 1, Pursuit of Justice 2, Improved Retribution Aura 2 | Divine Strength 4, Spiritual Focus 1 |
| 55–60 | Blessing of Kings 1, then raid: Improved Hand of Reckoning 2 + Righteous Defense 3, or Improved Judgement 2 + Vindication 3 | Spiritual Focus 1, Holy Judgement 3; 59–60 free: Sanctity Aura / Improved Judgement / Improved Lay on Hands / more Vengeance |

The no-dungeon Prot variant replaces Improved Righteous Fury with Toughness/Reckoning and ends with Vindication 3 + Improved Judgement 2 ("More Armor, NO RF Threat, More Stuns, No Taunt"). Other levelling orders: Aalena's Ret at 30 `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=--FoAAVCIAAI` and 50 `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin?points=F--FoAAVCYYFIF` with "Sanctity is -not- worth it until 60. Improved Retribution Aura helps you deal more damage overall" — [Aalena (player), 2025-08-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147231#p147231). Getplucked's 2023 Prot levelling links (20: `0-5IC1`, 40: `0-5IDL0J-5CI`) are for the pre-CC2 tree and "doesn't work anymore" — [Istavan (player), 2025-01-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115937#p115937). Older Holy-first advice ("Go holy until consecration, then go prot until 3/3 shield specialisation" — [Pfwg (player), 2022-03-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=17557#p17557)) predates Consecration going baseline and is obsolete.

Is the 1.18.1 tree different? Talent positions are unchanged; Righteous Strikes changed effect (Zealous Defence), Crusader Strike rank 5 100% WD, Holy Strike ranks reworked (see below). No source has posted a post-1.18.1 levelling order.

sections.heading: Skill training priority (guide + staff rank tables)
sections.markdown:
- **Seals**: Seal of Righteousness for weapons 3.4 speed or faster; Seal of Command (Ret talent at 30) "3.5 or Slower (ONLY USE/TRAIN Rank 1 To Conserve Mana till 60, Same Weapon DMG)"; Seal of Wisdom (ranks 18/28/38 — the level-18 and 28 ranks are Turtle additions [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102969#p102969)); Seal of Light at 28; **skip** Seal of Justice and Seal of the Crusader — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457).
- **Strikes**: Holy Strike rank 1 at 4 from the trainer (no quest), ranks at 12/20/28/36/44/52/60 (1.18.1 table: R1 25% WD + 11–13 … R8 40% WD + 129–146) — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071); Crusader Strike ranks 8/20/30/40/50 (35/50/65/80/100% WD after 1.18.1) — [Jamey (staff), 2024-11-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108776#p108776), [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). High Elf starting trainer Andalideth Suncaller teaches Crusader Strike rank 1 — [Torta (staff), 2025-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121678#p121678). One 2025 post says "get crusader strike (i think you need to kill hogger as a class quest)" — [Springboards (player), 2025-07-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140079#p140079) — **contradicted** by the staff post (trainer at 8); treat Hogger as a quest, not a requirement.
- **Hand of Reckoning** at 10 — [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102969#p102969) (a player recalls "between lvl 10-20" — [Azcron (player), 2025-08-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147006#p147006)).
- Train always: Judgement, Divine Protection, Hammer of Justice, Purify, Lay on Hands, Holy Light, Flash of Light, Divine Shield, Cleanse, Hammer of Wrath, Warhorse/Charger, Consecration (20), Blessing of Sanctuary (Prot), Righteous Fury (16, Prot/dungeons), Hand of Protection/Freedom, Blessing of Wisdom/Might; auras: Devotion until 16, Retribution Aura from 16, Concentration Aura from 22 for healing; skip resistance auras except situationally; **skip on Hardcore**: Redemption and Divine Intervention — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457).
- Rank skipping: Seal of Command rank 1 only (guide); lower-rank Holy Strike/Consecration for mana while tanking ([Isvya (player), 2023-09-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=67010#p67010), [Terrydavis (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165976#p165976)).

sections.heading: Playstyle by bracket
sections.markdown:
- **1–30 (any spec)**: Seal of Righteousness; Blessing of Might/Wisdom; max-rank Holy Strike ("It's FREE Recovers Mana Cost + JoW"); Consecration on 2+ targets; finish with Judgement of Righteousness; re-seal — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457). "Judging too often can speed kill time, but also eats more mana" (same). A judgement at 10 does ~25 Holy damage; Holy Strike about the same; Crusader Strike about double — [Oldenwisp (player), 2025-10-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156080#p156080) (he argues the strikes are overtuned for levelling; others disagree — contested).
- **Crusader Strike vs Holy Strike while levelling** (Ret): "If you're able to keep your killing streak going, it's great to have 3 stacks of CS, then keep using HS. CS will do more damage than HS will but ... drains mana. Just do CS once in a while to keep it up. If you feel like you run out of mana during it, don't sit down and drink. Pop Seal of Wisdom and spend time on one mob to get your mana back" — [Aalena (player), 2025-08-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147231#p147231). The asker found Holy Strike alone faster overall because of zero downtime — [Xqsme (player), 2025-08-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147228#p147228). Dungeon DPS at low level: "most pallies only use Holy Strike and stay right behind mages and rogues in dps" — [Kerenis (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157245#p157245).
- **20+ Prot open world**: Blessing of Sanctuary, max-rank Holy Strike, Seal of Righteousness (or Wisdom/Light on 3+ mobs), auto-attack, Holy Shield on Redoubt procs ("Blocks will Regen Cost of HS"), Judgement of Righteousness to finish — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457).
- **30+ Prot dungeons**: Seal of Wisdom 100%, judge Wisdom, re-seal, highest-rank Consecration then rank 1, Holy Shield on procs/cooldown, auto until low; bosses: JoW, optionally SoR for threat — same post; full dungeon routine in `protection-tank.md`.
- **30+ Ret**: Blessing of Might/Wisdom, Seal of Command rank 1, max-rank Holy Strike, auto-attack, Judgement of Command between autos; "A harder Target can be Stunned/Judged for more damage/burst" — same post.
- **AoE grinding (Prot, ~40+)**: it is "an endgame farming thing" before you have BRD/Strat/Scholo gear per [Werefox (player), 2023-06-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49784#p49784) (contested: others level with 4-mob pulls of mobs 2–3 levels below — [Getplucked (player), 2023-06-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49816#p49816)). Routine: Spiritual Focus + Concentration Aura, Seal of Wisdom with a fast weapon (Jang'thraze from ZF), shield spike, Holy Shield, body/LoS pull to bunch mobs, Consecration, self-heal at ~50% HP, re-judge Wisdom whenever the judged mob dies, Seal of Light when health matters — [Bryonus (player), 2023-06-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=50330#p50330), [Aeternusdoleo (player), 2023-06-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=51774#p51774), [Noephix (player), 2025-05-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130687#p130687). Farm spots named: WPL graveyard undead around 50 — [Dissasster (player), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134989#p134989); Stratholme at 60 (56 cadavers crit for ~300 without defense) — [Rindexxx (player), 2025-08-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148311#p148311). Consecration flags you for PvP if it hits enemy players — [Eithius16 (player), 2022-09-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=24307#p24307).
- **Downtime**: Seal/Judgement of Wisdom instead of drinking; Blessing of Wisdom on yourself; tents outside cities for rested XP — [Springboards (player), 2025-07-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140080#p140080); Divine Shield/Hand of Protection + bandages to heal for free — [Unangwata (player), 2020-10-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=8305#p8305).
- Use a swing timer and start-attack macros; the guide's macros: `/script if (not PlayerFrame.inCombat) then AttackTarget() end` + `/cast Crusader Strike`; seal-or-judge macros — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457); community wiki macro page (Consecration rank 1 out of combat, seal/judge toggles, Crusader Strike stack check): https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Paladin_Macros (community, not official).

sections.heading: Stats and gear while levelling
sections.markdown:
- **Prot**: "Prot pally is really all about stamina and strength. Once you hit level 20 and pick up Seal of Wisdom, mana just isn't the issue ... And if you happen to come across gear with spell damage, that's worth considering too" — [Azcron (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153775#p153775); "Go Mail/later Plate with Stam ... '...of the Eagle' Greens with Stam/Int, take them. But Stamina and high Armor is all you need ... allways use fast weapons (with +spelldam as a nice to have)" — [Schlaechter (player), 2025-10-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153945#p153945); "Doesn't matter at all during leveling. Just take whatever piece of equipment you can find that provides a lot of stats and armor" — [Idontcareatall (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153815#p153815); "use eagle gear (stam int) over stam str for a higher mana pool and larger return from shield block talent" — [Isvya (player), 2023-09-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=67010#p67010). Guide: Int/Stam (solo) or Stam/Int (dungeons). Strength for threat is **contested** (see `protection-tank.md`).
- **Ret**: Str/Stam/Agi (guide); "Buy a green or blue 2hander every 5-10 levels on the auction house. Buy 'bear' modifier gear with stamina and strength" and discount blues such as items 13041 and 2299 — [Springboards (player), 2025-07-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140080#p140080). Judge weapons by DPS/speed, not by white "+fire damage" lines — [Bigsmerf (player), 2024-09-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101311#p101311), [Atreidon (player), 2024-09-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101314#p101314).
- **Key upgrades**: "adds X damage to melee attacks" pieces for extra Judgement of Wisdom procs — Lavadrenched Chainmail (80704, Bazzalan in RFC, usable at 38, soloable), Incendosaur Skin Boots (60568, Hateforge Quarry, 51), Fiery Plate Gauntlets (12631, crafted, 54): "Wearing all three of them will effectively get you EIGHT chances to proc Judgement of Wisdom on every single melee swing" — [Getplucked (player), 2023-07-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52649#p52649); Gilneas City ring with "+3 Nature Damage" attack — [Aalena (player), 2025-08-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147231#p147231); "when struck" items such as item 17774 — [Schlaechter (player), 2025-10-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153945#p153945); Crescent Grove furbolg trinket (thorns), Naglering, Heart of the Scale for reactive damage — [Mekunekud (player), 2022-09-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=24400#p24400) (old).
- **Ret two-handers by level** (2019 list, updated to the Turtle DB 2021-11-08; pre-CC2 but item-only): 18–20 Smite's Mighty Hammer (7230); 20–29 Verigan's Fist (6953); 29–34 Corpsemaker (6687); 34–44 Bonebiter (6830); 44–50 The Rockpounder (9413); 50 Lightforged Blade (20504, paladin quest); 51–58 Ice Barbed Spear (19106); 58–60 Arcanite Reaper (12784); 60 The Unstoppable Force (19323) — [Jcarrill0 (player), 2019-02-13 (edited 2021-11-08)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=2079#p2079); plus item 6327 at 32 ("i usually dont replace it until 45+" — [Chlothar (player), 2019-05-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=2991#p2991)) and Pendulum of Doom (9425, BoE) — [Chlothar (player), 2020-04-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=5786#p5786).
- **Race**: Human for melee (weapon skill, Perception crit), High Elf for casters, Dwarf for PvP (guide); "Prot - Dwarf/Human, Ret - Human, Holy - High Elf" — [Gildark (player), 2025-09-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151263#p151263); contested ("Dorf for all purposes" — [Turboman (player), 2025-08-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144807#p144807)).

sections.heading: Route
sections.markdown:
- Zones: only generic advice exists — Elwynn/Westfall or Loch Modan at 10, tents outside Stormwind — [Springboards (player), 2025-07-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140080#p140080); Wetlands/Duskwood at 20–30 as favourite questing zones — [Sylveria (player), 2025-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123029#p123029). **Gap**: no full zone route.
- Dungeons: Prot makes group finding instant ("Less waiting time for dungeons" — Dissasster); RFC solo at 38 for the chest; Gilneas City around 48 (a player keeps an XP-frozen 48 Prot for it — [Sylveria (player), 2025-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123029#p123029)); Hateforge Quarry at 54–55; ZF for Jang'thraze; RFD/Uldaman gear "and it will come naturally" — [Werefox (player), 2023-06-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49850#p49850).
- Professions: Engineering + Mining (bombs for pulls, target dummy, goggles, trinkets; "100% no debate" for tanks — [Terrydavis (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165976#p165976), [Thefishyone (player), 2022-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=17965#p17965)); Blacksmithing for shield spikes/sharpening stones and Runed Copper → Green Iron → Steel Plate armor (43–45+), "Not as useful SC with access to AH, but on HC very useful"; Alchemy/Herbalism "Highly Recommended on HC" (swiftness, invisibility, Limited Invulnerability, Petrification potions) — [Unchallenged (player), 2022-10-18 (edited 2024-12-04)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27457#p27457); Herbalism for gold ("lasher farm") — [Snadileoboy (player), 2025-10-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154394#p154394).

sections.heading: Hardcore differences
sections.markdown:
- "Prot Paladins is the safer choice for HC Players. 20-30 is pretty straightforward you'll do just as much damage as a ret paladin, only will have a shield to block to regen mana per block, and can make your dungeon groups pretty quick" — [Unchallenged (player), 2024-04-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=92853#p92853).
- Artisan (crafted-only) + Hardcore: "Definitely go ret as Artisan. And remember that dead enemies deal no damage" (only one crafted shield exists) — [Noephix (player), 2025-05-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130687#p130687).
- Skip Redemption/Divine Intervention (guide); keep Divine Shield/Lay on Hands/Hand of Protection for escapes; Alchemy for invisibility/Limited Invulnerability potions; do not Consecrate near enemy players (PvP flag).
- A 2022 HC build (`https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/paladin/5U-5IV3U1Z6-50C`) is pre-CC2 — [Mrkrissatan (player), 2022-02-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=16846#p16846) (obsolete).

patchChanges: Consecration +8% base and front-loaded ticks (156% → 44%); Holy Shield threat 30% → 50%; Righteous Strikes → Holy Strike +5..25% damage/threat and Crusader Strike grants Zealous Defence (next blocked attack −6..30%); Holy Strike reworked to weapon damage + Holy (R8 40% WD + 129–146) with 71% SP; Repentance tick +8% AP; Seal of Command 7 → 9 PPM; Crusader Strike R5 100% WD; Daybreak 289 → 248 base, 43% → 32% scaling; Ret T3.5 5-set Crusade 4%/20 s non-stacking; Holy T3.5 5-set no extra Holy Strike targets; Prot T3.5 5-set moved to 3-set, new 5-set Holy Shield −4% damage taken; Ret/Prot T2.5 3-set +15% JoR/JoC. Hotfixes: strikes grant benefits on miss; Holy Strike heal target count fixed; Mending Light triggers/scales; Libram of Ardour faction fix. The 26 Jan 2026 revision block contains no Paladin entries.

gear.about: Gear recommendations for Paladin (Holy healer, Protection tank, Retribution melee DPS) by spec/role and level bracket, with where-to-obtain, built from the Paladin forum (f41), General-forum BiS threads, the existing class playbooks' "Gear, enchants and consumables" sections, and the Itemization forum's relic list and 1.18.1 changelog. Every "is there a Turtle BiS list" thread in the Paladin forum gets the same answer: no current one exists. The one detailed pre-raid list found (t393, Protection tank) is a 2019 repost of a generic vanilla guide, explicitly declared outdated by a player in 2025 — kept here only because it is the single most complete named-item list found for any Paladin spec, with that caveat attached to every item in it.
caveats: No Turtle-specific pre-raid or raid BiS list exists for any Paladin spec. t8738, t18785, t17662 (partial), t21851, t23183 and t19282/t4568 (Holy) are all unanswered or answered with "ask Discord"/"use a vanilla guide".

t393's pre-raid Protection tank list is a 2019 repost of a generic vanilla guide (item links go to db.vanillagaming.org, not Turtle's database) and was explicitly declared outdated: "Its outdated. Tankpaladin works vastly different now and requires other gear as a result. Additionally turtlewow has added many new better fitting items for palatanks" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140261#p140261). Every item from that thread below carries valid_for_1181: false for this reason, even where the item itself may still exist in Turtle's database.

A Retribution gearing thread (t19669) named 5 items only as raw https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=N links with no item name in the post text (ids 83440, 83462, 83463, 80674, 60550) — names could not be resolved without a live database/network lookup, which this guide is barred from doing. Not included below; see gaps.

Relic slot items (Librams) below are Turtle-added content per the staff relic-list post; drop locations for those are staff-stated and are Turtle-specific dungeons/bosses (Emerald Sanctum, Lower/Upper Karazhan, Scarlet Monastery trash for one, Gilneas City trash for one) added across patches 1.16-1.17.2, i.e. pre-1.18.1 content still current unless stated otherwise.
