| MM | Ranged Weapon Specialization | 5/5 | implied (pre-1.18.1 1–5%) |
| MM | Trueshot Aura | 1/1 | capstone |
| BM | Swift Aspects | 5/5 | "If you're always at range, I'd grab 5/5 predatory aspects for both leveling and DPS" (Steakhouse, above); haste is the best MM stat (Juzam, see Stat priority) |
| BM | Endurance Training / Thick Hide / Improved Revive Pet | filler to row 3 | leveling-style filler; SvenS2's endgame link `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/hunter?points=FQAYBoAoQCQQAAAoCoQBAoACAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` [SvenS2, 2025-05-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130862#p130862) (opaque link; he calls it "the build I'm rocking and I've seen other BM hunters use") |
| SV | Swift Reflexes (2% attack speed) | 2/2 (some) | "drop hawk eye 1/2 so I could nab the 2% attack speed in survival" [Rinarch (player), 2024-11-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108602#p108602) |

Other named pre-1.18.1 configurations: "if you want solo farm and dungeons better go 27/24/0. later for raids you can buy a brainwashing machine and have different builds" [Foteinos (player), 2025-05-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=133252#p133252) (single source); the **29/22 BM/MM** build reaching Spirit Bond + Improved Steady Shot [Skurridizo, 2026-03-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170517#p170517) (see BM playbook); opaque MM links posted for review: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/hunter?points=DoAAAAAAAAAAAAAoCoQBboLSAoBAYAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` [Kayframe (player), 2025-03-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124109#p124109) and `...?points=FQAYBoAAAAAAAAAoCoQBAoDSQoBAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` [ggotz (player), 2025-05-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132898#p132898) (judged "ok" for PvE by Foteinos).

### Post-1.18.1 MM raid build — **gap, partially derived**

No player posted a validated 1.18.1 PvE MM build ("have someone figured out good marksman pve talents?" got no reply [Ciroasav17, 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171570#p171570)). What the sources do say about the new tree:

- The tree is "5 required for 5 required for 5 into another layer of the same and then it actually has the gall to ask me how i want to spend 5 points across 7 raw damage talents stacked into the same late tier"; to keep the 20% Scorpid slow you must fill Improved Stings 5/5 ("no MM hunters will ever have 20% slow again") [Solveit (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171518#p171518).
- Steady Shot is baseline and Trueshot Aura is baseline (staff), so the 1.18.1 tree spends points on Aimed Shot (keystone), Experimental Ammunition (row 5), Lock and Load (row 7), Improved Marksmanship (+5/10% Steady/Aimed), Swiftshot (−6 s Aimed cd at 3/3 → 20 s), Ranged Weapon Specialization (now 2–10%), Barrage (Volley cast).
- BM side-tree for hybrids post-1.18.1: "mixed builds now dont have access to KC" [Tomogwarrior (player), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171530#p171530) (Kill Command is the BM capstone).

Bot default (labelled **derived from staff tooltips**, not a sourced build): MM 31+ with Lethal Shots 5, Efficiency 5, Improved Stings 5 (prerequisite), Aimed Shot 1, Hawk Eye 2, Mortal Shots 5, Swiftshot 3, Experimental Ammunition 1, Improved Marksmanship 2, Ranged Weapon Specialization 5, Lock and Load 1; remaining ~20 points in BM row 1–3 (Swift Aspects 5 for haste, Endurance Training/Thick Hide filler, Coordinated Assault keystone if reachable). Flag as **unknown validity** in the YAML.

stats.heading: Stat priority (60)
stats.markdown:
- **Hit**: 9% to cap on level-63 bosses at 300 weapon skill; **6% at 305 skill** (racial +5 bows/guns: Troll/High Elf bows, Dwarf guns) [Reptilewow (player), 2023-06-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49072#p49072); 305 → 6%, 313 → ~5.5%, 315 → 5% (Trueaim Gauntlets +8 skill, Sash of the Grand Hunt +2) [Condor22 (player), 2023-05-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=46292#p46292) (posed as a question, vanilla-baseline math; staff never published Turtle's linearized weapon-skill table); a BiS-list author uses 7% as the practical minimum "with the weapon skill book and changes to hit chance calculations on Turtle" [ajax_808 (player), 2024-12-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115058#p115058). "1% hit is always a (slightly more than) 1% damage increase until you reach hit cap" [Juzam (player), 2024-11-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107692#p107692). Do not over-cap: T3 set + Naxx hit gear already caps a High Elf bow user ("2hit + 4hit +5 Bows ... restricting me to never add any Ring, Neck or Trinket that gives +hit") [Alfonso (player), 2023-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=56809#p56809) (1.17.0 itemization thread).
- **Haste** (the Turtle-specific stat): "1% haste is around 0.9% damage increase on bosses (single target) and 0.85% damage increase overall"; no diminishing returns; "once you're in full naxx gear, because of your very high crit rate, 1% haste will become as good as 1% crit" [Juzam, 2024-10-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=104588#p104588). Quiver/pouch haste and Swift Aspects procs count [Skurridizo, 2025-11-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160791#p160791). Rapid Fire cuts Steady Shot cast "from 1.5 to 1.1" (same post). Haste does **not** shorten Aimed Shot from quiver haste (Juzam) — 1.18.1 explicitly made Rapid Fire cut Aimed/Steady cast by 40% (staff).
- **Crit**: ~0.9% damage per 1% for a raid-buffed Naxx hunter; slight diminishing returns as crit rises, "there is no such things as 'soft crit cap'" (Juzam, above). 53 agi = 1% crit, 1 agi = 2 RAP (same).
- **Attack power / agility**: measure your own AP-per-1%: unequip an AP item, read ranged DPS in the character panel, add hidden AP buffs (110 Hunter's Mark, 200 vs undead from stones); Juzam needed ~34 AP per 1% at 340 DPS [Juzam, 2024-11-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107692#p107692). Spreadsheet weights used by a BiS-list builder: 1 agi = 3 AP-eq, 1% crit = 30 AP-eq, 1 AP = 1 [ajax_808, 2024-12-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115058#p115058).
- **Haste vs AP enchants**: with mid gear the 23-agi enchant set beats 3% haste; in full T3 haste wins for auto-shot only; with the ZG/Naxx/15-agi enchant set vs 5% haste, AP wins even in BiS (auto-shot-only model) [Nurincarinun (player), 2023-11-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=74308#p74308) (pre-Steady-Shot model; single source). "2% Haste edges out 30AP in full T3, but can be worse with lesser gear" [Bgnome (player), 2025-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117570#p117570).
- **Armor penetration**: "generally weak" [Balake (player), 2023-04-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=43447#p43447); "does not yield good returns generally, so is largely ignored" (Bgnome, above).
- **Spell power**: irrelevant for MM (Serpent/Arcane/Volley scaled with SP pre-1.18.1 but "if you increase SP on your stuff, you'll lose RAP" — Juzam); T2.5 spell power is dead weight for MM.
- **Intellect/Spirit/MP5**: mana matters in long fights ("Surv Hunter already had problems with mana" is Survival; for MM "I've never run out of mana ... Efficiency + Steady Shot is just 77 mana" [Skurridizo, 2025-09-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150362#p150362)); Juzam calls T3 MP5 "useless" for itemization cost. Post-1.18.1 Aspect of the Viper replaces drinking between pulls (see Cooldowns).
- **While leveling**: agility/stamina and weapon DPS; see `leveling.md`.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown:
### Pre-1.18.1 (CC2/CC3 kit) — consensus

Core loop: **Auto Shot → Steady Shot → Auto Shot → Steady Shot**, never delaying the auto: "Steady Shot(it was Trueshot pre CC2) damage is normalized to 2.8 weapon speed ... That's why we had to pay attention to not clip Auto Shots" [Calli (player), 2025-07-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140872#p140872); "AA>Trueshot>AA>Trueshot ... depending on your weaponspeed" [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140730#p140730), confirmed [Bigsmerf, 2025-07-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140739#p140739); "Mana efficiency. Steady Shot deals good damage and costs far less than Arcane Shot or Aimed Shot" [SvenS2 (player), 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149801#p149801).

Ordered priority (raid boss, weapon speed ≥ 3.2):
1. Opener: send pet (attack key, not a combined macro), Hunter's Mark, Aimed Shot as the pull opener only if the tank has threat ("Aimed shot is now an opener just like Ambush" [Juzam, 2023-12-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83213#p83213); "You can use it as an opener, but once the fight starts, you're better off just using autoshots and Steady Shot" [Soulforged23, 2026-01-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165600#p165600)).
2. Serpent Sting once on long fights (≥ 30 s) if mana allows — "Serpent sting i used in longer fights" [Frantsel (player), 2024-01-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83443#p83443); skip on trash and when mana is short [Jinxes (player), 2025-11-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160638#p160638). Contested: Steakhouse says drop it once geared.
3. Multi-Shot on cooldown (10 s), placed right after a Steady Shot so it does not delay the auto: "AA>Steady>Multi>AA>... with crossbows, AA>Multi/Steady>AA>... with faster weapons" [Calli, 2025-07-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140872#p140872); "autoshot > trueshot > multi-shot > auto shot > trueshot > arcane shot > auto shot ... you need the slowest weapon. 3.20 or above" [Vimgreen (player), 2023-09-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=66802#p66802); with weapon speed < 3.3: AA MS AA SS AA SS; > 3.3: AA SS MS AA SS [Raypulsif (player) quoting a video, 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115771#p115771).
4. Steady Shot immediately after every Auto Shot; if a Steady would delay the next auto (fast weapon, Rapid Fire + Swift Aspects active), let the auto fire first — with 3.2 speed "you only have 29 miliseconds to not clip your autoattacks" under both haste buffs [Borefficz (player), 2023-08-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=56712#p56712).
5. Arcane Shot: only while moving or as a filler with spare mana in PvP; "for most cases it's fine to simply take Arcane Shot off your Action Bars" [Steakhouse, 2024-01-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83337#p83337).
6. Do not re-cast Aimed Shot mid-fight ("I removed my aimed shot completely from the action bar" [Vrag, 2025-11-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159412#p159412)).

Use a swing-timer addon: Quiver (`https://github.com/SabineWren/Quiver`, download the release not the repo zip [Ltxtwo (player), 2025-03-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122514#p122514)), YaHT Turtle fork with Steady Shot renamed [Chocobodx (player), 2025-01-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=116815#p116815), or BearCastBar [Deviator9421 (player), 2023-06-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49849#p49849). Spammable auto-shot macro (no toggle-off): `/run if not UnitCanAttack("player","target")then TargetNearestEnemy()end if not IsAutoRepeatAction(36)then CastSpellByName"Auto Shot"end` (36 = your Auto Shot action slot) [Cochise (player), 2024-09-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101994#p101994).

### Post-1.18.1 — **derived from staff descriptions; only fragments from players**

Player observations after 2026-03-20: "Steady Shot is one of your main sources of damage" [Lane13 (player), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171531#p171531); "Arcane Shot is pretty good now. You can use it freely if you have mana, as mobs will have armor and the damage will be similar or higher than steady. You can also use it while moving" [Lane13, 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171561#p171561); "after the test I realized that the autoshot is much more effective than pressing the button. ... The projectile is selected randomly (hold it for 1 minute for the next one ...)" [Baek (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171502#p171502) (the staff text says the ammunition types **cycle** Fire→Arcane→Nature; Baek and [Tomogwarrior (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171526#p171526) perceived it as random — **contested/unclear**); Lock and Load's line AoE has "an angle of only 5 degrees" and is hard to use in PvE except on a stationary tank target [Baek, 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171856#p171856); "Aimed Shot cast bar deleted since 1.18" thread title (t=21097) — no content extracted beyond the title.

Derived priority for bots (each line's basis in brackets):
1. Keep Auto Shot going; never clip it [consensus, unchanged].
2. **Aimed Shot on cooldown** (2 s cast, 20 s cd with Swiftshot 3/3; 1 s cast when Lock and Load is up) — cast it right after an auto, like Steady [staff tooltip; Rapid Fire −40% cast].
3. **Lock and Load proc** (Aimed cooldown reset): cast Aimed immediately, line up the target behind the boss/other mobs if possible [staff].
4. Spend the Experimental Ammunition buff before it cycles (1 min): **Arcane** → Arcane Shot; **Nature** → Serpent Sting (+100%, −240 armor for 15 s); **Fire** → Multi-Shot on ≥ 2 targets [staff]. Bots should read the buff name; treat the order as Fire→Arcane→Nature per staff but tolerate randomness per players.
5. Multi-Shot on cooldown when it fits between autos [pre-1.18.1 consensus].
6. Arcane Shot on cooldown when mana ≥ 40% (it now scales with weapon damage and is usable while moving) [Lane13 + staff].
7. Steady Shot as the filler after every auto [Lane13; consensus].
8. Serpent Sting only when Nature ammunition is up or the fight is long [pre-1.18.1 consensus; mana −30% in 1.18.1].
9. Volley (3 s cast, −2 s with Barrage 3/3) only on ≥ 4 targets [staff; pre-1.18.1 "less than 8 targets it's actually a loss of dps" — Juzam — for the old channeled version].

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE
rotationAoe.markdown:
- 2–3 targets: Multi-Shot on cooldown, keep the single-target loop otherwise; Serpent Sting spread only if mana is plentiful.
- 4+ targets, pre-1.18.1: Volley "is only decent for the packs of small spiders who patrol, few trashs groups before patchwerk and before Faerlina ... only increase your damage by like 20%" (Naxx-geared) [Juzam, 2024-10-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=104588#p104588); MM "has 0 aoe" [Jiav (player), 2025-07-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141842#p141842). Raids that valued cleave used Survival instead (see Survival playbook).
- 4+ targets, post-1.18.1: Volley cast (330 mana, 6% AP) plus Fire-ammunition Multi-Shot; no player has benchmarked it. **Gap.**
- The Explosive Trap / in-combat traps are Survival-only (Untamed Trapper); MM can only trap via Feign Death out of combat.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Rapid Fire**: use at the start of every boss and on cooldown when the fight lasts > 15 s; it speeds Steady Shot casts ("1.5 to 1.1") and, post-1.18.1, Aimed Shot by 40%; watch clipping with a fast weapon (Borefficz, above). Do not waste it while moving [Springboards (player), 2025-11-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159342#p159342).
- **Trinkets**: ZG trinket resets major hunter cooldowns (double Multi/Arcane) [Azuredrak0 (player), 2024-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=91303#p91303); Devilsaur Eye / Jom Gabbar windows (Nurincarinun); Arcane Infused Gem (BWL) is "worthless" outside cleave [Calli (player), 2023-09-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=66732#p66732); Sigil of Ancient Accord "for mm wortless" [Foteinos (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156533#p156533).
- **Mana**: five-second rule — "bundle your spells into bursts, and then just use your potent autoattacks for a bit when you need to regen" [Atreidon (player), 2026-01-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166255#p166255); raid regen from Blessing of Wisdom, mana totem, mana potions, tea, mana oil (Skurridizo, above). Post-1.18.1 **Aspect of the Viper** (56): 5% max mana / 5 s, no cost, but it replaces Hawk — "you need aspect of the hawk for good dmg ... the measily 5% mana reg wont do anything if you keep up your full dmg rotation" [Cheruscan (player), 2026-01-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166287#p166287); "The viper aspect does not have time to restore Mana if you inflict damage constantly" [Baek, 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171540#p171540); good between pulls / after Feign Death in BGs [Tomogwarrior, 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171553#p171553). Bot rule: Viper only when mana < 20% and no cooldown burst is planned, or out of combat instead of drinking; swap back to Hawk before the pull (aspect swaps cost mana and a GCD — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123634#p123634)).
- **Feign Death**: threat drop every 30 s; put the pet on follow/passive first (see `pets.md`); Feign Death + trap needs two presses [Vliqta (player), 2022-10-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=26783#p26783).
- **Drink** when out of combat below ~40% mana; hunters "have 40-50% less mana" than casters [Ragetto (player), 2024-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103865#p103865).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Stand at max range (35 yd baseline, +Hawk Eye) outside the 8-yd dead zone; move only between autos ("You can stand still for 0,5 sec at 40 yd distance, drop that 'rotation', kite rinse an repeat" [Staywhimsy (player), 2025-03-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122276#p122276)).
- Raid jobs beyond damage: "FD to give those valuable seconds to the healers... frost trapping the zombies on Gluth while watching when to tq shot... kiting jobs" [Calli (player), 2024-01-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83530#p83530); Tranquilizing Shot on MC/BWL/AQ frenzies ("intended to be used on certain mc/bwl/aq bosses" [Hctwowfan (player), 2023-08-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=58887#p58887)); pulling and Distracting Shot; CC "can be reliably done by 1-2 MM hunter if you don't get unlucky resists on FD" (Barwat1).
- Trueshot Aura is party-wide: raids may put the hunter in a melee group; "TO minmax hunter you have to put them in their own group with feral buff ... and 77 agi totem instead of windfury" [Ironfist13 (player), 2025-07-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141812#p141812). Post-1.18.1 the aura is baseline for every hunter.
- Pet in raids: contributes "4-6% dmg on single target" for a Naxx MM [Cabum (player), 2025-04-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126994#p126994) or "around 17% damage without Coordinated Assault and about 19% with" in instances [Ahinevich (player), 2026-03-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172610#p172610) (contested numbers); keep it alive with Take Position, or run petless with **Alone Against the World** (SV row 2, +3/6% damage with no pet, 1.18.1) — "intentionally weaker than actually doing the legwork and controlling a pet" [Atreidon, 2026-03-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172629#p172629); "Not having ur pet is never better for ur dmg in any raids, ever" [Sbingo (player), 2026-04-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173794#p173794). Bot rule: use the pet; take the petless talent only for fights where the pet dies at the pull.
- Threat: Piercing Shots' bleed generates no threat (staff, CC2); Aimed Shot openers create an "undesirable" threat spike [Atreidon, 2023-12-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83232#p83232).

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **No Turtle-specific pre-raid BiS list exists in the sources**: "Whatever gets you to hit cap. No one gives a shit about pre-bis here" [Bigsmerf, 2024-05-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95417#p95417); ajax_808's Turtle spreadsheet was never published; advice is "Get AtlasLoot for Turtle and check the loot in the new dungeons, adjust the vanilla BiS list accordingly" [Cheruscan, 2025-09-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151213#p151213). Named pre-raid pieces: Beastmaster's (T0.5) set with hit/crit/agi, Onyxia Tooth Pendant, Cloak of the Black Baron, Blackhand's Breadth, Shendralar trinket (48 RAP), Huntsman's Harpoon (35 agi), Revantusk Shadow Hunter's Longbow (Nurincarinun's gear list, 2023); the ring from Maraudon "is possible to solo and is quite good" [Biohazze (player), 2023-10-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=67958#p67958); Alterac Valley "ring ... bis" and free AV ammo [Baek (player), 2024-12-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115014#p115014).
- **Ranged weapon**: slowest is best for the Steady/Multi weave — Ashjre'thul "arguably the second best ranged weapon in the game for Hunters" (BWL) [Borefficz (player), 2023-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=66478#p66478); Blessed Qiraji Musket and Ashjre'thul "largely interchangeable", racial-skill weapon preferred [Kairion (player), 2023-09-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60949#p60949); Larvae of the Great Worm musket better than Blessed Qiraji Musket [Calli, 2023-09-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=66733#p66733); "Soulstring is BiS in PVE due to a turtle specific steady shot rotation" (Naxx) [mrkukucpuk (player), 2025-04-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=125914#p125914), Nerubian Slavemaker (57.2 DPS) for PvP; "Rain of spiders bis" (Kara40) [Likaleo (player), 2025-04-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=125971#p125971). Rhok'delar quest works ("Did it a few weeks ago, works and was pretty easy" [Gildark (player), 2025-02-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119620#p119620)); Star of Maras'ethil range bug hotfixed 2026-03-24 (staff).
- **Melee stat stick**: Eye of Nerub (Naxx) for MM; Kingsfall/Iblis or Hatchet of Sundered Bone if hit is wasted [FrankFankledank (player), 2025-04-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126982#p126982).
- **Enchants**: shoulders — Sapphiron AP/crit enchant "undoubtedly best-in-slot", else 2% haste (Hyjal) over 40 armor pen [Bgnome, 2025-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117570#p117570); head/legs ZG (24 RAP, 1% hit) for MM, Survival uses +8 agi instead [Cabum, 2025-06-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134728#p134728); gloves 15 agi, bracers 7 agi, 2H +25 agi, cloak +3 agi, chest +4 stats, belt +6 agi (Nurincarinun's list); scope: damage scope over Biznicks if hit-capped (Kairion).
- **Ammo**: Doomshot / Miniature Cannonballs (LBRS/Strat bosses) best, AV quartermaster second, engineer Thorium third [FrankFankledank, 2025-03-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121980#p121980); carry both arrows and bullets to a raid ("hunters kicked from raids ... for running out of bullets/arrows" [Justaddwater (player), 2025-06-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134695#p134695)); a 16-slot pouch holds 3200 rounds, "Easily enough to do a full raid" [Atreidon, 2025-03-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121975#p121975) vs "I take 26 stacks or more on a raid" [Baek, 2025-06-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135236#p135236); "Enchanted thorium ammo is coming" [Calli, 2026-02-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169334#p169334) (unverified). MetaHunt's Smart Ammo swaps to junk ammo for non-scaling shots [Metasploit, 2026-02-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169538#p169538).
- **Quiver**: the Sinew-Wrapped Lamina quest quiver is the max-level option; non-Survival hunters lose ranged attack speed by using a bag instead [FrankFankledank, 2025-01-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117859#p117859).
- **Set bonuses (staff, 1.17.2 itemization)**: T2 8-set = "Detect Weakness ... increases your Attack Power by 450 for 7 sec" (personal proc); T2.5 3-set = Serpent Sting 20% chance for 100 Nature + 40 mana; T3 6-set also from melee; T3 8-set reduces mana of Raptor Strike/Mongoose Bite/Carve; ZG 5-set = Serpent Sting ticks 20% faster [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105276#p105276). T3.5 (Ravenstalker) 5-set = +5% haste on Quick Shots and −1 s Carve/Multi-Shot cooldown, heavy +hit — "made for Melee hunter in mind" [Cabum, 2025-06-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134728#p134728); 1.18.1 T1 3-set / T3 4-set (+50 AP hunter and pet per Skurridizo) — full 1.18.1 tier text not in the extracted posts.
- **Consumables** (raid list): "Mana flask, Lesser mana oil x 2, Mongoose, Mageblood, Grilled squid, Ranged bananafood, Major mana pot, Demonic rune, Juju might (for pet), Juju power (for pet) + defensive consu" [Likaleo (player), 2024-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=91592#p91592); agility potions do not stack with each other, one food buff, scrolls stack [Bigsmerf, 2024-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=91590#p91590); Elixir of Demonslaying, sharpening stones and the engineering chicken do **not** affect ranged (Cabum, 2025-07-27); consecrated sharpening stones give 200 AP vs undead (Juzam, 2024-11-12).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes (bots must avoid)
mistakes.markdown:
1. Clipping Auto Shot with Steady Shot ("Autoshot never fires as the recast of Steady seems to match the cast time" [Carns (player), 2025-02-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119747#p119747)).
2. Casting Aimed Shot mid-fight pre-1.18.1 or standing still in Aimed casts while a boss cleaves.
3. Wasting mana on Serpent Sting/Arcane on trash that dies in 3 s (Jinxes).
4. Combined "pet attack + auto shot" macros in dungeons — pet body-pulls (Turtlebisque, Calli).
5. Forgetting the pet is out during pulls ("Raidlead yelling 'no pets'" — Cheruscan) or letting it die in cleaves/Shadowflame instead of using Take Position.
6. Running out of ammo, or carrying only one ammo type when a weapon swap drops (Justaddwater).
7. Needing on melee weapons/leather ("item sink that will roll need on all items" — Idontcareatall; "Hunters would primarily roll for stat sticks" [SvenS2, 2026-04-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173875#p173875)).
8. Feigning with the pet still attacking (stays in combat); FD/trap macro failures — "Stop using noob macros and learn to control your character" [Skurridizo, 2026-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169225#p169225).
9. Not feeding before bosses; sitting in Aspect of the Viper during burst.
10. Swapping aspects fluidly (each swap costs mana and stops regen for 5 s) [Solveit (player), 2026-01-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166243#p166243).

extraSections.heading: Official kit timeline (staff)
extraSections.markdown:
| Date | Change | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 2024-10-12 (CC2, live 2024-11-01) | Trueshot renamed **Steady Shot**, rank 1 = MM row-3 keystone (5% base mana, 1 s cast, 8–35 yd); Aimed Shot baseline at 20; Improved Stings (row 2, 6–30% Serpent, +1–5% Viper drain); Improved Scorpid Sting 2 pts; Hawk Eye 2 pts; Swiftshot (ex Improved Arcane Shot, 3 pts, also cuts Aimed cd); **Piercing Shots** (row 5, 2 pts: crit Aimed/Steady/Multi bleed 10/20%); **Improved Steady Shot** (row 5, 2 pts, 13/25%); **Endless Quiver** (row 6, 2 pts, 3/6% extra ranged attack); Trueshot Aura 55 AP + 5% AP at rank 3; Scorpid Sting one rank (−2% phys dmg, −10% attack speed, 20 s); Viper Sting −15% and 6 s cd; Wing Clip cooldown (6 s → 3 s on 2024-10-21) | [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102967#p102967) |
| 2024-11-01 | Hawk Eye back to row 3, Improved Hunter's Mark to row 4 | [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-11-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105804#p105804) |
| 2024-11-20 | Improved Steady Shot 13/25% → **8/15%**; Piercing Shots 10/20% → **15/30%** | [Jamey (staff), 2024-11-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108776#p108776) |
| 2024-12-20 | Steady Shot rank scaling 60%+10 / 70%+20 / 80%+30 / 90%+40 / **100%+50 at 60** | [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460) |
| 2025-07-25 (CC3) | Rapid Fire now increases melee and ranged attack speed; MM "in a good spot", no change; aspects on the stance bar; **no pet swapping in combat** | [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159) |
| 2026-01-23 (1.18.1, live 2026-03-20) | **Aspect of the Viper** (lvl 56, 5% max mana / 5 s); **Trueshot Aura baseline** at 40 (3% AP + 30); **Steady Shot baseline** at 20; **Volley** 3 s cast, 210/270/330 mana, 4/5/6% AP scaling; **Arcane Shot** +10..45% ranged weapon damage (base lowered 13→10 … 183→166); Rapid Fire −40% Aimed/Steady cast time; Aimed and Arcane on separate cooldowns; **Aimed Shot** = MM row-3 keystone, 2 s cast, 26 s cd; **Experimental Ammunition** (row 5): Aimed adds 5% as Fire/Arcane/Nature and grants Fire (next Multi-Shot hits explode 20% RWD in 5 yd) → Arcane (next Arcane Shot +100%, +3% magic taken 6 s) → Nature (next Serpent Sting +100% and −240 armor 15 s), 1 min each, cycling; **Lock and Load** capstone (Steady/Aimed/Arcane crits can reset Aimed and make it 1 s faster + line AoE, 10 s); Improved Stings absorbs Improved Scorpid Sting (+2–10% attack speed slow); Swiftshot −0.5/1/1.5 s Arcane, −2/4/6 s Aimed; Ranged Weapon Specialization 2–10%; Barrage also −1/1.5/2 s Volley cast; Improved Steady Shot → **Improved Marksmanship** (+5/10% Steady and Aimed) | [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) |
| 2026-03-19 revision | Aimed Shot, Arcane Shot, Serpent Sting mana −~30% | same post, revision block |
| 2025-10-03 | "Hunter shots now have a cast bar" — a player says they "don't actually seem to be working" | [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168); [Plagues2 (player), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171632#p171632) |

Rationale for 1.18.1: "Steady Shot has been a must-have ability for all ranged Hunters, while Aimed Shot was rendered almost useless by its existence"; "Trueshot Aura was a design-limiting ability and an uninteresting capstone"; Lock and Load "intended to make the rotation more interactive through procs, improve endgame scaling, and reduce the impact of slight auto-shot delays" [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).

playbooks.title: Hunter — Ranged PvP (Marksmanship, BM/MM hybrid, deep BM)
playbooks.intro:
Battlegrounds, world PvP and duels for the ranged hunter. The sources treat three ranged PvP builds as distinct: the classic **0/21/30 MM/Survival** trap-and-kite hunter (dead after CC2), the **30/21/0 BM/MM** "stun + Scatter Shot" hybrid (the recommended PvP build from Nov 2024), and **deep BM** after 1.18.1 (pets immune to CC under Bestial Wrath and unaffected by dampening). Survival melee PvP is a short section at the end. PvE playbooks: `marksmanship-ranged-dps.md`, `beast-mastery-ranged-dps.md`, `survival-melee-dps.md`; pets: `pets.md`.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). PvP-relevant kit dates: 2024-09-04 Freezing Trap/Scatter Shot shared DR; 2024-11-01 CC2 (Wing Clip cooldown, Viper Sting nerf, Counterattack and Wyvern Sting removed, Trap Mastery moved deep); 2025-08-15 CC3 (Kill Command pet CC-break, no pet swap in combat); 2026-03-20 1.18.1 (Bestial Wrath back, Kill Command rework, Aimed Shot 2 s, Aspect of the Viper).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Standing**: **niche and contested**, trending down until 1.18.1, then BM up. "hunters are complete bottom F tier in Turtle pvp" [Angelafarehart (player), 2025-01-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118488#p118488) vs "you took Half my Life with T W O instant shots while kiting from long range. What more you want" (an opponent addressing Baek) [Staywhimsy (player), 2025-01-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118367#p118367); "The diminishing returns change alone sent hunters from one of the worst classes in PvP to the absolute worst class in PvP ... I remain competitive as marksman hunter because im BIS" [Insanefool (player), 2025-11-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160362#p160362); "geared hunter 3 shot warlocks outside of sl spec" [Ataika (player), 2025-08-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149647#p149647); "Shaman, Pala, Rogues are good classes for PVP. Hunters and Warriors are probably the worst" [Tomogwarrior (player), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171638#p171638); post-1.18.1: "Hunters are strong now, BM pets aren't affected by dampening so BM + Survival are doing pretty well" [Froghijab420 (player), 2026-04-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175013#p175013), "BM Pets wrecking havoc on full auto left and right" [Bazbee (player), 2026-04-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175482#p175482), "my advice is to not touch the PvP scene here" [Insanefool, 2026-04-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173823#p173823). Bots: expect to be a kiter/support in BGs, not a duelist, unless deep BM post-1.18.1.
- **Strengths**: "frost trap is the strongest slow in the entire game and you get that as a range class" [Terrydavis (player), 2026-01-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165609#p165609); Viper Sting pressure on healers; ranged shots have no pushback and cannot be kicked [Xudo (player), 2026-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170036#p170036); counters ferals (Flare, Freezing Trap, Scare Beast) [Elesion (player), 2023-08-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=58909#p58909).
- **Weaknesses**: the dead zone — "Anyone can literally just walk up to the hunter and their dps drops by 90%" [Tortusenjoyer (player), 2026-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170027#p170027); "The trap combo is hunters only way to reliably get back to range" [Atreidon (player), 2024-09-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=100718#p100718); no burst/instant damage ("hunter has too little instant casts and is forced to stand still" [Springboards (player), 2025-11-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159342#p159342)); Deterrence is "Terrible in PvP" against stuns/blind [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-07-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=142264#p142264); Rapid Fire useless while moving (Springboards); Freezing Trap is dispelled by the PvP trinket on Turtle ("it is overwhelmingly common to get freezing trap dispelled by pvp trinket" [Tortusenjoyer, 2026-02-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169569#p169569)); rogues ignore freezes with Sweet n Crunchy Fruit Bread and slows with Sprint [Vrag (player), 2026-01-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164294#p164294).

talents.heading: Talent builds
talents.markdown:
### 30/21/0 BM/MM ("stun + Scatter") — recommended PvP build Nov 2024 – Mar 2026

- Author: Rank-13 PvP hunter Ragetto. Post-CC2 link: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/hunter?points=FYACBoAoJCQYAAFACoQBAoIAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` — "The 30/21/0 build I use ... The pet hits a bit harder now, even though I had to drop 2 points from Frenzy. And what's also interesting is Swift Aspect - it procs a lot ... And Spirit Bond gives you 2% HP regen every 5 seconds now" [Ragetto (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108124#p108124); earlier variant `...?points=CoAaBoAoJAQYAAFACoQBAoIAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` [Ragetto, 2024-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=104995#p104995). Explicit talents: Intimidation (pet stun), Scatter Shot, Hawk Eye 2, Mortal Shots 5, Swift Aspects, Spirit Bond, Frenzy 3 (not 5), Improved Stings for Viper drain. "before you reroll or give up on twow, I'd recommend trying the 30/21/0 spec. It's strong and fun" [Ragetto, 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108124#p108124). Confirmed as the PvP meta by a BM specialist: "Who in this world wouldn't expect that Intimidation + Scatter Shot, with the right pet in PvP, is the best build?" [Skurridizo (player), 2025-11-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160904#p160904). **Consensus** among the PvP posters (Ragetto, Skurridizo, Sbingo: "for pvp a full 31 point MM tree isnt as good as a BM/MM mix" [Sbingo (player), 2026-04-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173793#p173793)). Post-1.18.1 caveat: the hybrid loses Kill Command (BM capstone) and Bestial Wrath is row 5 (30 BM points reach it).
- Generic MM PvP advice: "if you pvp you must let down ps [Piercing Shots] and get imp slay [Improved Slaying]" [Foteinos (player), 2025-05-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=133252#p133252) (single source); grab Improved Concussive Shot for leveling/PvP [Steakhouse (player), 2025-03-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124134#p124134).

### 0/21/30 MM/Survival — obsolete after CC2

- The pre-CC2 trapper: 21 MM for Scatter, 30 SV for Deterrence/Counterattack/Trap Mastery/Improved Wing Clip. CC2 removed Counterattack and Wyvern Sting and moved Trap Mastery deep, so "in 1.17.2, [it] will become a stationary DPS turret in deep MM" [Ragetto, 2024-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103825#p103825); a post-CC2 approximation `...?points=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAFACoQBAoIAAAAAYQYYVBBAbAAgAAA%3D` "though we're still missing Counterattack" [Ragetto, 2024-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=104995#p104995); Xudo's alternative PvP link `...?points=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAFoAoAAAoIAAAAAdAYYVAAADAAAAAA%3D` [Xudo (player), 2024-10-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103588#p103588). "Taking Trap Mastery away from PvP spec is unfathomably bad design. Why do we need more trap resists?" [Dokkababecallme (player), 2024-10-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103549#p103549).

### Deep BM (post-1.18.1)

- "Let's start with the fact that MM has become more difficult in the pvp game. So my advice to you is to go to BM" [Baek (player), 2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173363#p173363); "BM hunters are very strong in PvP. Pet scaling, enrage mechanic, they hit really hard and cannot be CC ... especially if u got the set bonuses for T1 & T2" [Halfgeek9 (player), 2026-04-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175410#p175410). No link posted; use the BM raid build with Intimidation. Pre-1.18.1 counter-view: "You wouldnt go bestial wrath as a serious pvp player, as it locks you out of scatter and your pet didnt scale" [Atreidon, 2025-08-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143068#p143068) — superseded by the 1.18.1 pet-scaling/dampening situation. **Contested** (Insanefool: "PvP is also not about waiting for your BM pet to kill stuff").

stats.heading: Stat priority (PvP)
stats.markdown:
- Stamina and hit matter more than in PvE; weapon skill "has no impact for pvp" [amanagor (player), 2025-06-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137000#p137000); no armor penetration means plate/leather-druid targets are "nearly hopeless" [Angelafarehart, 2025-01-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118488#p118488).
- Ranged weapon: Nerubian Slavemaker "still generally superior" for PvP because "you don't get nearly as many chances to Steady in PvP" [FrankFankledank (player), 2025-04-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126982#p126982).
- Race (see table): PvP racials outweigh DPS racials.

| Faction | Best PvP race (sources) | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Alliance | **Gnome** — "Only 1 min CD, infinite times i escaped from dead zone" [Anadrol (player), 2024-02-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=86718#p86718); "Gnome is probably your best bet in regards to PvP" [Bigsmerf, 2025-03-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123657#p123657) | Escape Artist; Dwarf second (Stoneform vs Blind/poison — amanagor); Night Elf "by far is 1 of the worst hunter races for pvp" [Springboards, 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169859#p169859), Shadowmeld "does not negate traveling spells" [Ataika, 2024-01-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84096#p84096) |
| Horde | contested: Tauren/Undead ("Orc is bad since they lost their 25% stun resist" [Springboards, 2025-04-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=125497#p125497)); Orc ("Even 15% looks small, but it's the milliseconds you can spend to press potion" [Vargthar (player), 2025-04-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126604#p126604)); Troll for flag-carrier damage and Berserking stacking with Rapid Fire; "WOTF is useless for hunters, if you eat fears you are doing everything wrong" [Ataika, 2025-04-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=125507#p125507) vs "best race for pvp as hunter is undead for will of the forsaken" (amanagor) | — |

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- Feign Death 30 s: pet on follow+passive first or you stay in combat [Annoying (player), 2023-04-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=42584#p42584); do not rotate the camera during the FD animation (Achaelys, 2022 bug list [p=25543](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=25543#p25543)).
- Rapid Fire: only when the target is stationary/CC'd (Springboards); it stacks with Troll Berserking (Ataika).
- Mana: "hunters can also oom each other (and much faster than a priest or mage, as we have 40-50% less mana)" (Ragetto); Feign Death + Aspect of the Viper between fights post-1.18.1 [Tomogwarrior, 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171553#p171553); drink after FD.
- Trinket: keep the PvP trinket for stuns/blind; Deterrence + Aspect of the Monkey ≈ "43.75%" dodge, not 50% [Jiav (player), 2025-07-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=142285#p142285).
- Cheetah: dazes on damage ("The cheetah receives a stun from direct damage, and then the shaman's shield hangs the stun for 3 seconds" [Baek, 2026-02-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169052#p169052)); does not stack with boot speed enchants [Flexdraw (player), 2026-02-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169046#p169046) (contested by Solveit).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
1. Scatter → trap without Planning Ahead/pre-placed trap (half duration since DR).
2. Feigning with the pet attacking (stays in combat) or trying to Aimed Shot on a moving target.
3. Using Bestial Wrath/Kill Command for damage when it is needed as the pet's CC-break ("hold on to Kill Command for the CC break" [SvenS2 (player), 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143229#p143229)).
4. Standing in the dead zone; swapping to Wolf "to hit a mob twice" (mana) [Atreidon, 2026-01-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166262#p166262).
5. Spamming Viper Sting on one dispelling target.
6. Night Elf/Shadowmeld ambush builds — "Turtle gimped that" (Bigsmerf).
7. Trueshot Aura/cat pets in PvP (Skurridizo).

extraSections.heading: Core combos ("rotation")
extraSections.markdown:
1. **Opener / range control**: Hunter's Mark, pet attack (bat/spider/boar), Concussive Shot, Serpent Sting (rank 1 Viper Sting first on healers/dispellers: "using rank 1 viper sting ... to trap people into using more mana by dispelling than you would use to apply" [Nurincarinun (player), 2024-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=91290#p91290)), then Auto Shot + Multi-Shot + Steady/Arcane while standing still for "0,5 sec at 40 yd distance" between kites [Staywhimsy (player), 2025-03-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122276#p122276). Aimed Shot only from a Freezing Trap/Scatter or an unnoticed angle — casting on a target puts you on their target list [Atreidon, 2023-12-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83232#p83232); post-1.18.1 Aimed is 2 s and "you can theoretically ... pull a couple of big aimed shots" (Insanefool).
2. **Melee on you — the trap combo**: Scatter Shot → Feign Death (pet on follow/passive first) → Freezing Trap → walk out to range → Viper/Aimed. "a popular pvp manuoveur for hunters is scatter shotting the target, feign death to drop combat, then place a trap and the scatter shotted target wanders into the trap" [Grizb37 (player), 2024-09-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=100702#p100702). Since the DR fix the trap after a Scatter lasts "from 10 down to 5 seconds. For hunter with skilled trap duration from 13 to 6.5s" [Atreidon, 2024-09-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=100699#p100699), so **place the trap first when possible** (Planning Ahead) and use Scatter to walk them into it, or Scatter → run rather than Scatter → trap. "I use the combination of the 3 steps of my trap dancing manually ... I probably do it quicker manually than using a macro" [Skurridizo, 2026-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169225#p169225). Working macro (press twice): `/run PetPassiveMode()PetFollow()if UnitAffectingCombat"player"then CastSpellByName"Feign Death"end CastSpellByName("Immolation Trap")` [Spitfire33 (player), 2026-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170657#p170657); older: `/cast Freezing Trap` + `/script if UnitAffectingCombat("player") then CastSpellByName("Feign Death") end` + pet-passive line [Vliqta (player), 2022-10-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=26783#p26783). Macros broke repeatedly (Jan 2026) — bots should sequence the three actions themselves.
3. **In melee without cooldowns**: Wing Clip (3 s cd; Improved Wing Clip 40% root at 3/3), Raptor Strike + Mongoose Bite ("With good 2h weapon it is decent damage" — Xudo, 2026-03-01), Intimidation (pet stun, 30/21/0), Deterrence vs warriors/rogues without cooldowns, Escape Artist (gnome) after Scatter. "Scatter shot > EA > break distance without wasting trinket or trap" [Ataika, 2024-02-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=86678#p86678).
4. **Frost Trap** kiting after Feign Death; "Viper sting till you were oom" combos were nerfed (6 s cd, −15%) — apply Viper to several targets in big fights, do not spam it on one [Ragetto, 2024-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103865#p103865).
5. **Deep BM post-1.18.1**: pet on the target, **Bestial Wrath** when the pet is CC'd or for the kill window, Kill Command after every crit, Steady/Arcane from range; "let the pet do the work while you stay out of harms way ... if it dies, resummon in 5s, mend, send it back in" [Springboards, 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169860#p169860) (contested: "if you want your team to lose in a BG, this is how you should play" — Tortusenjoyer). Killing the pet ends Bestial Wrath (Mdzielak).
6. **Pet choice**: spider (Web) for non-BM; ZG bat (1.0 speed, vision block, −100 AP screech) or boar (Charge) for interrupts/burst; wind serpent vs paladins/druids [Springboards, 2024-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=91286#p91286); scorpid to block dispels is "pointless on twow" [Ataika, 2024-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=91287#p91287); "stop using True Shot Aura or Cats, specially if you are doing PVP" (Skurridizo, 2025-11-22).
7. **AB flag play**: Scatter+trap on a defender standing next to the flag, then cap — defenders should stand away from the flag [Atreidon, 2024-09-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=100783#p100783); "Blizzard, rain of fire and Hurricane do not stop captures" but Holy Nova/Arcane Explosion/sapper do [Shockoladetwo (player), 2024-09-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=100806#p100806).

extraSections.heading: Match-ups (player claims)
extraSections.markdown:
- Warlock/Shadow Priest: "nearly impossible. You can't escape DoTs" [Dimastasc (player), 2025-08-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149628#p149628) vs "geared hunter 3 shot warlocks outside of sl spec" (Ataika) — contested; "hunters need to be able to counter warlocks and mages and they just cant" [Terrydavis, 2026-02-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169033#p169033).
- Paladin: "we dont" (win) [Tacticalnelf (player), 2023-10-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=74705#p74705); dispels Viper instantly.
- Rogue: opener from stealth is "basically over"; Flare and traps are the counter; Sprint bypasses Frost Trap (Vrag); Dwarf Stoneform vs Blind.
- Feral: hunter is "one of the better counters" (Elesion); shapeshift removes slows (Dimastasc).
- Warrior: Wing Clip parries/dodges are lethal since the cooldown (Diablowjob, 2024-10-18); Deterrence vs charge; Scatter → range.
- Mage: Arcane Missiles pushback shuts casts down (Angelafarehart); "Shooting don't receive pushbacks" (Xudo) — contested detail.

extraSections.heading: Survival melee PvP (short)
extraSections.markdown: "melee fights right now is who smoke the other first, but harder for you without a stun ... Ranged: you are as crap as a warrior without charge / intercept" (Laysson, 2025-05-14); "On turtle wow when you play survival hunter the whole play style appears to be suicide dive-bombing into everything" (Insanefool); in-combat Freezing/Frost traps are the main asset ("at least i can spam traps in combat to survive bit longer" [Soulforged23 (player), 2026-01-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164296#p164296)); post-1.18.1 "BM + Survival are doing pretty well" (Froghijab420). No Survival PvP build link exists in the sources — **gap**.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown:
Covers the consensus Beast Mastery leveling path, the Survival-melee alternative, pet choice while leveling, talent order, skill training, playstyle, professions, farming and hardcore notes. Pet mechanics in detail: `pets.md`. Endgame respec targets: `marksmanship-ranged-dps.md`, `beast-mastery-ranged-dps.md`, `survival-melee-dps.md`.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). Talent names changed at CC2 (2024-11-01), CC3 (2025-08-15) and 1.18.1 (2026-03-20); every talent order below says which tree it was written on.

sections.heading: Which spec
sections.markdown:
- **Beast Mastery — consensus**: "BM is much better in my opinion for leveling" [Lavrute (player), 2024-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106293#p106293); "Definitely BM. Imp revive and Intimidation are incredible in particular. With the 8 first defensive talents you nearly double your pet's survivability. It's safer in HC, and also faster in terms of xp/hour" [Steakhouse (player), 2024-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106303#p106303); "BM is the best spec (across all classes) for leveling" [Ragetto (player), 2024-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106305#p106305); "BM Hunters are still the best at leveling imo, and most leveling hunters I see are BM" [SvenS2 (player), 2025-05-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130862#p130862); "Whatever the changes, pure BM for leveling is imo always the go to, with around lv50 being your respec threshold" [SvenS2, 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171464#p171464); "It's not about speed or power, it's about how chill you can play it. BM is the let me watch this video while I auto-attack and have my pet deal with the target" [SvenS2, 2025-08-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149103#p149103). Dissent: "you can level effectively in any spec" [Steakhouse, 2025-02-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118591#p118591); "paladins chain pulling 4-5 mobs at once, mages aoe level and warlocks are just equally as powerful killing machines" [Jiav (player), 2025-08-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149091#p149091). On the CC3 kit one player felt the pet "squishier" [Novelus (player), 2025-08-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148983#p148983) — Endurance Training/Thick Hide were nerfed in CC3 and restored in 1.18.1 (staff).
- **Survival (melee) — alternative, weak before 40**: "Leveling : Weak before 40, but still playable" [Laysson (player), 2025-05-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131127#p131127); "levelling is boring before level 40. At level 40 you get the 'untamed trapper' talent ... After lvl 40 survival melee becomes very fun" [Vladis (player), 2025-08-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143781#p143781); "My advice is to level as BM or Marksman instead and respec Survival at 40" [zer0g3 (player), 2025-05-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131122#p131122); "Just leveled from 1 to 45 as survival ... it feels amazing ... BUT! The spec only really starts to feel really natural past 40" [Upsetlobster (player), 2025-05-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131298#p131298); "Survival still isn't good for leveling, not until you get some much deeper talents" (post-1.18.1) [SvenS2, 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171498#p171498). Advantages listed: highest Agility/Stamina, in-combat traps to escape, Deterrence, Improved Feign Death, AoE, and "Their defense skills can always be kept at the maximum level" [Terryleelolorz (player), 2025-04-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=125145#p125145).
- **Marksmanship**: "go marks if you want strong ranged attacks" (Steakhouse); no one recommends it over BM for leveling; petless MM leveling is "completely useless ... During leveling, the pet (for any spec) is not just about damage, but also about tactics" [Ahinevich (player), 2026-03-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172610#p172610).
- Respec cost: "Your first two respecs are cheap, so don't worry about min-maxing" [SvenS2, 2025-08-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=146760#p146760) vs "If changing talents and buying skills wasn't so expensive ... I'd love to experiment but simply cannot afford it" [funeh (player), 2025-02-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118631#p118631).

sections.heading: BM talent order 10 → 60
sections.markdown:
### Written on the CC2 tree (Nov 2024 – Aug 2025) — most detailed source

Proposed order [Rukie (player), 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115782#p115782) with the corrections the thread made:

| Levels | Talent | Correction / note |
|---|---|---|
| 10–14 | Endurance Training 5 | **Swap with Swift Aspects**: "the are no reasons to pick endurance training over swift aspects, you are trading killing speed for what ? additional hp your pet does not need" [Ataika (player), 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115799#p115799); "Just use both, tier two provides nothing so useful" [Noyland1 (player), 2024-11-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108059#p108059); Endurance first if you want to solo elites early [Rinarch (player), 2024-11-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108602#p108602) — contested |
| 15–17 | Thick Hide 3 | |
| 18–19 | Improved Revive Pet 2 | Steakhouse: in-combat revive after a Concussive Shot / Scare Beast / trap |
| 20 | Bestial Swiftness 1 | "a no-brainer at 1 point" (pet haste, pet speed, +6% Cheetah/Pack) [Bob022 (player), 2024-11-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108662#p108662); removed in CC3 → take **Pathfinding** 2 or **Coordinated Assault** 1 instead |
| 21–25 | Unleashed Fury 5 | |
| 26–30 | Ferocity 5 | take 1/2 Improved Mend Pet "as soon as it's available because you'll run into plenty of nasty shifts ... silithid pox" [Hctwowfan (player), 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115787#p115787); Bob022: Mend Pet cure > Bestial Discipline for leveling |
| 31 | Intimidation 1 | pseudo-taunt/stun; "Send pet with intimidation on a baddie, and after one growl, send it to another" (Steakhouse) |
| 32–33 | Bestial Precision 2 | |
| 34 | Bestial Discipline 1 | Yasara: can move 1 point to Improved Mend Pet |
| 35–39 | Frenzy 5 | 3–4 is enough: "drop a point out of Frenzy (to 4/5) and it's alright" (Bob022); "2-3 points into Frenzy is generally enough" (SvenS2, 2026) |
| 40 | Bestial Wrath 1 | (removed CC3, back in 1.18.1 at row 5) |
| 41–45 | Efficiency 5 (MM) | Steakhouse: skip for leveling, "Just drink more" |
| 46–50 | Lethal Shots 5 (MM) | |
| 51 | Steady Shot (MM) | "the big choice for a leveling Beast Mastery hunter will amount to when he wants to go 11 into Marksman for Steady Shot" (Bob022) — **baseline at 20 since 1.18.1** |
| 52–56 | Swift Aspects 5 | (or earlier per Ataika) |
| 57–58 | Spirit Bond 2 | |
| 59–60 | Improved Mend Pet 2 | |

Troll: add Improved Slaying 3/3 (SV row 1) first (Hctwowfan). Opaque links: first 41 points `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/hunter?points=FAAaBoAoRBAoBAAoAoAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` [Yasara (player), 2024-11-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108359#p108359) (boar with Charge, Growl and Bite on autocast); Rinarch's mid-level `...?points=AoAaBoBoRAAYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D`, end-of-leveling `...?points=FoAaRoBoRAQoBAAoAoABAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` and early-raid `...?points=FoAARoAoRCQgBAAoAoABAAAAAAAAYQAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` [Rinarch, 2024-11-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108602#p108602); SvenS2 leveling `...?points=BoAaRoCoRCQgBAAoAoQBAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` or `...?points=AoAaRoCoRCQgBAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAYQCYCJAAAAAAAAA=` and cap `...?points=FQAYBoAoQCQQAAAoCoQBAoACAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` [SvenS2, 2025-05-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131377#p131377).

### CC3 tree (Aug 2025 – Mar 2026)
Leveling `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/hunter?points=AoAaRoSoJCQgB-AoAoQB-`, endgame BM `...?points=FYAQBoQoBCQQB-AoCoQBAo-` [SvenS2, 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149392#p149392). Melee-leaning: BM first "so your pet is tanky", then Survival; endgame `...?points=FoAABo--YQCYDJTAbIQoB` [SvenS2, 2025-08-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=146760#p146760).

### 1.18.1 tree (from 2026-03-20)
Drafts `...?points=FQAYAoAoZBCYB-AoAoJDAo-` (BM/MM Mortal Shots), `...?points=FQAYAoBoZBCoB-AoAoJDQ-` (BM/MM Endless Quiver), `...?points=FoAYBoCoZBSoB-AoAo-` (pure BM) [Sylvestro1 (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171462#p171462); replies: pure BM, Pathfinding + Bestial Discipline over Lethal Shots ("The more damage your pet does the harder it'll lose aggro ... Pathfinding is good if you don't have a pet with dash or charge, and switching to aspect of the cheetah is more optimal for going from mob to mob than mounting") [SvenS2, 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171464#p171464); Bestial Discipline "pretty much mandatory" with a scorpid; Lethal Shots regains value because Kill Command needs a hunter crit [Gorlocktheglock (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171478#p171478), [SvenS2, 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171480#p171480). Is Aimed Shot (MM keystone) worth it for leveling? Asked, not answered — **gap**.

sections.heading: Survival (melee) talent orders
sections.markdown:
- CC2/CC3 tree: BM rows 1–2 first (Endurance/Thick Hide/Improved Mend Pet), then Survival to Untamed Trapper at 40 with Lightning Reflexes; Lacerate (CC3) arrives "at level 30 I think" (Vladis). "In the end, you must go at least 34 points into the survival tree to deal good damage" (Vladis).
- Pre-CC2 melee order (obsolete talents, kept for history): 14 Improved Raptor Strike, 16 Savage Strikes, 21 Parry/Deflection, 22 Deterrence, 27–32 Improved Aspect of the Monkey, 34–39 Improved Wing Clip, 37 Surefooted, 40 Counterattack [Xudo (player), 2023-04-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=41903#p41903). Counterattack no longer exists.

sections.heading: Pet while leveling
sections.markdown:
- Boar: "Boars are a good go to. Boar Charge helps them quickly pile up some threat ... Boars also have a wide diet" [SvenS2, 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171447#p171447); "For leveling, Boars and Carrion Birds are generally your best choice" [SvenS2, 2025-05-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131377#p131377).
- Bird with Screech (owl/eagle/bat/carrion bird): "Owl/eagle/bat is the best pet for leveling simply due to Screech generating a disgusting amount of single target threat ... AoE threat for all mobs in pet's melee range ... once you're in your 50s, you're going to wish you got an owl" [Borefficz (player), 2023-08-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=55429#p55429) (boars have a 90% damage modifier vs cats 110%, owls/bats 107% — same post); "A bird with Screech has no match for nonstop pull and AoE aggro" [Kerenis (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171466#p171466); "Screech is still very powerful ... between eagle/screech and spider to run away in case you have to" (HC) [Jiav (player), 2025-08-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148017#p148017).
- Fast cat (Feral Mountain Lion, Hillsbrad): Dash, Bite + Claw (SvenS2, 2026-03-20). Scorpid Death Flayer (lvl 11 Durotar): "Tanky as hell, 1.2 attack speed and scorpid poison slaps" [Plagues2 (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171448#p171448) (Petopia says 1.6 — SvenS2). Raptor for damage [Hemphiz (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171441#p171441). "Literally any Hunter pet works well" [Daoc2001 (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171463#p171463). Early on "pets have stupidly OP damage at low levels so you won't have issues with threat" (Borefficz).
- Level-10 quest chain: "Taming the Beast" (three temporary tames) → "Training the Beast" in the capital teaches Beast Training, Feed Pet, Revive Pet [Maesus (player), 2023-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=39636#p39636); High Elves get it from Damilara Sunsorrow in Alah'thalas (misnamed "Taming the Beast"), turning in to Halduron Bringwing [Mekk (player), 2025-08-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143531#p143531) — one player still could not get it (Ghysal94); fallback: Goldshire/Kharanos/Dolanaar quest givers (Mekk). Keep Growl on autocast; feed to green; loyalty comes from XP while fed (`pets.md`).

sections.heading: Skill training
sections.markdown:
- Trainers: Steady Shot ranks at 20/30/40/50/60 (baseline from 1.18.1; talent rank 1 at 20 before), Aimed Shot at 20 (baseline since CC2), Aspect of the Wolf ranks track Hawk's levels and "The 7th rank ... is also acquirable out in the world" [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102967#p102967); Aspect of the Viper at 56 (1.18.1); Beast Lore at 24 (Kerbees). Bows for undead: Orgrimmar weapon master [Kairion (player), 2023-07-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=54919#p54919); hunters can learn every weapon except maces and wands [Qixel (player), 2021-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=9770#p9770).
- Ranks players skip: Arcane Shot ranks once Steady is available (pre-1.18.1: "stop learning new ranks of it as soon as you have access to Trueshot" [Steakhouse, 2024-01-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83337#p83337)); Aimed Shot ranks (pre-1.18.1: removed from bars — Vrag); keep rank 1 Arcane Shot as a cheap Coordinated Assault trigger ("always used lvl 1 arcain shot to trigger the pet buff" [Plagues2, 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171488#p171488)); rank 1 Viper Sting for dispel baiting. Post-1.18.1 Arcane Shot scales with weapon damage, so train it again (Lane13).
- Ammo: train the vendor ammo of your bracket; "Being in a zone cleaning up green elite quests felt rough when they didn't have the current level ammo" [Trollrayzac (player), 2025-02-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121131#p121131); a database search `https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?items=2.3` lists leveling bows/guns/crossbows [basednoob (player), 2025-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124714#p124714).

sections.heading: Playstyle
sections.markdown:
- Pull: pet attack (explicit key, not a macro), Hunter's Mark (skip on trash that dies fast — Jinxes), Serpent Sting, Auto Shot; a rank-1 Arcane Shot or Steady Shot to proc Coordinated Assault (CC3+); "Steady Shot is one of your main sources of damage. It's worth using if you won't pull aggro from the pet. Avoid spamming it too much though to prevent going oom" [Lane13 (player), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171531#p171531); Arcane Shot while kiting [Lane13, 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171561#p171561).
- Mobs at once: with BM defensive talents the pet holds 2 mobs while you Multi-Shot/Serpent spread (Steakhouse); "If you keep up your bite and charge ranks current they don't seem to have an issue" holding threat [Rinarch, 2024-11-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108602#p108602). Aggro problems only start "before you get MC weapons/gun" [Glavorli (player), 2022-11-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=28262#p28262).
- Movement: Aspect of the Cheetah between quest mobs — "When your clearing quest mobs you don't need hawk on for the AP keep up Cheetah and just mow them down" (Rinarch); Cheetah dazes on damage.
- Downtime/mana: five-second rule — burst spells then auto-shoot; "You can send pet and drink while pet kills mob" [amanagor (player), 2026-01-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166261#p166261); "of the falcon" gear (int+agi) if oom [Springboards (player), 2026-01-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166247#p166247); spirit gear ("Slap on some spirit gear, and you'll have 0 down time" — SvenS2, 2026-03-20); Aspect of the Viper only at 56 ("useless for leveling" [Grizb37 (player), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171558#p171558)). Contested: mid-level mana "substantially WORSE" [Solveit (player), 2026-01-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166243#p166243) vs "there is not much to use mana on a mid-level hunter" (Springboards).
- Damage curve: "Until midgame hunters are incredibly OP but pet becomes less and less relevant" [Akos1896 (player), 2025-11-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160216#p160216) (contested by Solveit); "your pet may be equal to or out dps you until your mid 50s" [SvenS2, 2025-11-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160692#p160692).
- Melee-Survival leveling rotation (2023, pre-CC2 but the structure survives): "Immolation Trap or Explosive Trap - Pull mob with pet and land him on trap - Raptor Strike on cd - Wing Clip ... Refresh trap => pet passive => feign death => immolation or explosive trap"; AoE: Explosive Trap first, iron grenades [Therrius4121 (player), 2023-04-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=41891#p41891); tank yourself with Aspect of the Monkey, use a slow 2H staff, "melee kite with Wing Clip like warriors do" (Xudo, 2023). After 40 (Untamed Trapper) traps drop in combat.
- Dungeons: pet on passive; Eyes of the Beast + Stay for ledges (SvenS2); Feign Death drops threat; do not need on melee weapons.
- Kiting elites in the open world is "much harder" than on retail but possible (Concussive Shot, Cheetah, Growl off) [Allwynd01 (player), 2022-09-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=26325#p26325).

sections.heading: Stat priority and gear while leveling
sections.markdown:
- Agility, stamina, then intellect/spirit for downtime; "of the falcon" pieces (Springboards). Weapon DPS of the ranged weapon is the main damage stat; e.g. a Hillsbrad quest crossbow at 16.6 DPS at level 38 [Throgmar (player), 2025-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124666#p124666). Melee Survival: slow 2H with agility/strength.
- Key upgrades named: Beastmaster's (T0.5) pieces at 60, Maraudon ring (soloable), AV ring, Rhok'delar quest (works). Quiver ranged haste from early on.

sections.heading: Route, professions, farming
sections.markdown:
- Route: the sources give no zone-by-zone hunter route (**gap**). Turtle custom zones with special pets: Thalassian Highlands (Mana Wyrm level 6–7, Crimson Lynx), Gillijim's/Lapidis Isle (48–53 crabs/cats/gorillas/serpents), Tel'Abim (53–60 cobras/gorillas), Gilneas (39–45 wolves/bats/spiders) — community wiki `https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Hunter_Pets`.
- Professions: Engineering + Mining for iron grenades as an interrupt/AoE ("at the end of a dungeon iron grenade are 7%-10% of my total damage") and Alchemy + Herbalism for HC healing potions; First Aid mandatory [Therrius4121, 2023-04-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=41891#p41891); "Alchemy for HC is important because of Swiftness potion" (Xudo); Engineering for Thorium ammo (a non-engineer "has to buy Thorium Shells from the AH" [Maesus, 2023-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=40458#p40458)); Skinning pairs with beast farming (Bigsmerf).
- Farming at 60: Silithus scorpids/worms near Cenarion Hold (rugged leather, buff-food meat, vendor greys) [Bigsmerf, 2024-04-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=92700#p92700); Naxx/ZG trash "way better gold" than DM tribute [amanagor, 2025-02-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118907#p118907); DM tribute solo works ("jumped down and FD (you need to be out LOS) and if Cho'rush is priest i just resetted" [Mecanno (player), 2023-10-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=71791#p71791)) but selling the chest loot "is 100% against TOS" [Drubarrymooer (player), 2023-10-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=68920#p68920) and Cho'rush's priest loadout cannot be drained (bug 8327, FrankFankledank); DME lashers from 54 as Survival (amanagor, 2025-05-14); Devilsaur/solo dungeons as on vanilla [Gelinho (player), 2025-08-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=145712#p145712).

sections.heading: Race (leveling/PvE)
sections.markdown: Troll "single handedly the best PvE choice for hunter overall. Berserking, bow skill and beast hunting" [Bigsmerf (player), 2023-09-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=66988#p66988); Orc for pets/Survival (Command, axes); High Elf +5 bows (hit cap 6%), Meditate; Dwarf guns + Stoneform; Night Elf Shadowmeld/1% dodge; Gnome Escape Artist and engineering [Jolikmc (player), 2022-06-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=19257#p19257), [Ishilu (player), 2023-02-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=33745#p33745). "For pve, racials are not that important" [amanagor, 2025-06-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137000#p137000). Human hunters were added Oct 2023 (Tendies); Goblins exist with their own taming quest (Mekk).

sections.heading: Hardcore differences
sections.markdown:
- Take the BM defensive talents first: "It's safer in HC" (Steakhouse, 2024-11-04); Improved Revive Pet for in-combat revives.
- Pet: bird with Screech for AoE threat, or a spider "to run away in case you have to" (Jiav, 2025-08-24).
- Alchemy for Swiftness Potions (Xudo); First Aid.
- Tracking is unreliable across custom map seams: "Just died as 42 HC attacked by 2 Org guards not showing at all on my detect humanoids" [Styopa1 (player), 2023-08-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=57979#p57979).
- Do not tame ZG bats/rare pets in HC ("it's just very difficult and risky if you're HC" [Steakhouse, 2023-11-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=78816#p78816)).
- Melee-hunter HC: asked in 2022, answered only with a link to the 2020 guide (t4098) — **gap**. Whether a pet tamed at 60 levels with HC or normal XP — asked, unanswered [Myth (player), 2020-04-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=5691#p5691).

sections.heading: Sources and validity
sections.markdown:

gaps:
1. **Post-1.18.1 PvE numbers for every spec**: no forum post benchmarks BM, MM, or Survival DPS after the 2026-03-20 release; the server closed 2026-05-15, leaving ~8 weeks for players to react. Rotations and talent builds for that era in every playbook are marked "derived" or "staff-tooltip-derived," not sourced.
2. **A validated post-1.18.1 51-point talent build for any spec** — only draft/asked-but-unanswered talent-calculator links exist (`t=22214`-adjacent threads such as p=171462).
3. **Survival PvP build and rotation** — no link exists; the section in `marksmanship-pvp.md` is two sentences and explicitly flagged as a gap in-file.
4. **Zone-by-zone leveling route** (dungeons/zones per level bracket) — only fragments of Turtle-custom zones with special pets (Thalassian Highlands, Gillijim's/Lapidis Isle, Tel'Abim, Gilneas) from the community wiki, no forum-sourced route.
5. **Melee-hunter hardcore mode** — asked in 2022 with no forum answer beyond a link to a 2020 guide (t=4098).
6. **Turtle's exact linearized weapon-skill/hit-cap table** — every hit percentage cited (9%/6%/5%) traces to vanilla-baseline math or single hedged posts, not a staff-published formula.
7. **Exact 2H vs dual-wield melee hit caps for Survival** — only a 2021 vanilla-era guide gives a number (12% DW), not re-verified on the CC2+ Survival kit.
8. **Pre-raid BiS lists** for any spec on current (post-CC2/CC3) itemization — players are repeatedly told "no one gives a shit about pre-bis here" and pointed to AtlasLoot instead of a maintained list.
9. **Whether the Experimental Ammunition cycle is deterministic (Fire→Arcane→Nature per the staff tooltip) or effectively random** — two players in the same thread describe it differently; unresolved.
10. **Current T1–T3.5 set-bonus text post-1.18.1** — only isolated deltas are quoted (e.g. T3 4-set +50 AP to hunter and pet); no full tier list was re-posted after the item changes.
11. **Kill Command's exact 1.18.1 numbers before vs after the 2026-03-19 revision in practice** (50% vs 80% of pet AP) — no post-revision parse confirms the live value.
12. **Whether pets truly skip PvP dampening as a permanent design choice or an unpatched bug** — only player observation, no staff confirmation, in the sources.
patchChanges:
- **Aspect of the Viper** (level 56): 5% max mana / 5 s, replaces Hawk on the bar.
- **Trueshot Aura baseline** at level 40 (3% AP + 30, no longer a talent capstone); **Steady Shot baseline** at level 20.
- **Aimed Shot** reworked into the MM row-3 keystone (2 s cast, 26 s cd, faster/resets with Lock and Load); **Experimental Ammunition** (row 5): Aimed Shot grants a cycling Fire → Arcane → Nature buff that empowers the next Multi-Shot/Arcane Shot/Serpent Sting; **Lock and Load** capstone resets Aimed Shot and speeds it on a Steady/Aimed/Arcane crit.
- **Bestial Wrath returns** (BM row 5: 18 s pet enrage, "cannot be stopped unless killed", 1.5 min cd, no GCD); **Kill Command reworked** to a TBC-style capstone (usable only after the hunter lands a crit; revised 2026-03-19 to 80% of pet AP, up from the announced 50%); **Baited Shot removed** ("the barbeque is over"); **Scent of Blood** added (row 5, chance on your attacks to enrage the pet).
- Survival: **Alone Against the World** (+3/6% damage with no pet out); **Surefooted** gains dual-wield hit; **Vicious Strikes** restored to also buff Raptor Strike/Mongoose Bite damage (2026-03-19 revision, undoing the CC3 nerf); **Lacerate** +5% AP and +15% from the side.
- Pets: Endurance Training and Thick Hide raised again ("Pets have been too fragile in open world content").
- Rationale (staff, quoted): "Steady Shot has been a must-have ability for all ranged Hunters, while Aimed Shot was rendered almost useless by its existence"; "Trueshot Aura was a design-limiting ability and an uninteresting capstone"; Lock and Load "intended to make the rotation more interactive through procs, improve endgame scaling, and reduce the impact of slight auto-shot delays."
- Hotfix 2026-03-24: Scorpid Poison stacking damage calculation fixed (a BM player reports a 300–400 DPS loss relative to the pre-hotfix bug).

Full kit timelines for CC2 (2024-10-12, live 2024-11-01) and CC3/1.18.0 (2025-07-25, live 2025-08-15) are in each playbook's "Official kit timeline" table, since Hunter's talent tree was rewritten three times.

Multiple threads (t14004, t16662, t21833) confirm no such list was ever published and point players to AtlasLoot/vanilla lists instead.
