readme.heading: Official 1.18.1 Rogue changes used (Jamey p=166071, 2026-01-23; revision blocks dated 2026-01-26 [no Rogue entries] and 2026-03-19)
readme.markdown:
Framing (staff): "We're generally happy with the recent changes to Rogue, and community feedback shows that the class is largely performing as intended... we've identified that Rogue is currently a bit overperformant in certain areas... making a few targeted numerical adjustments aimed at bringing performance back in line without changing how the class fundamentally plays."

- **Poisons** (all specs): Deadly Poison ranks 1–3 lose their 2%/tick (8% total) AP scaling entirely, rank 4 drops to 1%/tick (4% total); Instant Poison rank 1 loses its 5% AP scaling, ranks 2–3 drop to 1%, ranks 4–5 to 2%; Corrosive Poison rank 1 drops from 1.9%/tick (7.6% total) to 1%/tick (4% total); Dissolvent Poison rank 1 drops from 4.75% to 2%. Dev comment: "Early access to higher poison scaling was resulting in stronger-than-intended performance during leveling and early gearing... preserving endgame effectiveness."
- **Blade Flurry** (all specs): energy-regeneration penalty 30% → 20%.
- **Assassination**: Taste for Blood physical-damage bonus 1/2/3% → 1/1.5/2% and **no longer affects Corrosive/Dissolvent Poison damage**; Noxious Assault Attack-Power scaling 35% → 30%. Revision 2026-03-19 (same post): Taste for Blood becomes a **2-point** talent (+4/6 s duration, +1/2% damage — a partial reversal, still weaker than pre-1.18.1); **Corrosive and Dissolvent Poison now only apply to Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants and Undead** — first announced 2025-10-03 preliminary notes, confirmed here.
- **Combat**: Opportunity damage bonus 4/8/12/16/20% → 3/6/9/12/15%. Dev comment names the target directly: "Combat dagger rogues are performing tad better than with any other weapons, this nerf will bring them more in line."
- **Subtlety**: no changes in the 1.18.1 patch or either revision block.
- Post-release hotfix: "Fixed damage calculations for stackable spells (e.g., Scorpid Poison, Deadly Poison, etc.)" [Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139).

Player reaction is contested and split by role: several PvE poison-rogue players call the poison/Taste for Blood changes "the biggest nerf" to their spec and ask for the Physical-poison restriction to exempt low-content players (`assassination-melee-dps.md`); several non-rogue PvPers had spent the preceding months (2025-09/10) saying poison rogues were "melting thru Tanks like butter" in battlegrounds, which plausibly (but not explicitly, per any staff post in this corpus) motivated the numbers — see `assassination-pvp.md`'s Community standing section for both sides.

readme.heading: Gaps (not covered by any source — do not guess)
readme.markdown:
1. **Post-1.18.1 raid-parse data**: no forum post gives DPS numbers, logs, or a settled spec ranking after 2026-03-20; the one active post-patch thread (`t24364`) is players arguing, not measuring.
2. **Full 51-point talent builds**: every endgame build in the corpus is a `talents.turtlecraft.gg` opaque link plus a partial verbal list; no source enumerates all points for any spec. The exact split of the last 2–3 points in the Combat "20/31/0" Assassination sub-tree is unresolved.
3. **Talent-tree naming instability**: the Subtlety capstone is called "Exploit Vulnerability" in the original Class Changes 2 post and "Mark for Death" in the 1.18.0 post; unclear whether this is a rename or a replacement (`../../turtle-vs-vanilla-timeline.md` §Unclear, item 4).
4. **Rogue class weapon** (Timbermaw Hold questline, announced 2026-02-15, quest starter found 2026-04-06): item stats are not in the corpus.
5. **Zone-by-zone leveling route**: only fragments (Deadmines/Shadowfang Keep daggers, Hinterlands for a fresh-40 Assassination rogue); no dungeon-per-bracket table like some other class guides in this corpus have.
6. **Ability/spell-rank training priority**: which ranks of Sinister Strike, Eviscerate, Rupture etc. to train or skip is not discussed anywhere; only the weapon-skill book quest and the level-20 poison quest chain are documented.
7. **Leatherworking (and most non-Engineering/Alchemy professions) for Rogue**: asked once, never answered.
8. **Naxx-undead weapon buff**: whether Corrosive/Deadly poisons or Consecrated Sharpening Stone beat each other on undead-heavy Naxx trash — asked, never answered; made more urgent by the 1.18.1 restriction of Corrosive/Dissolvent to Undead (among others).
9. **Poison damage formula**: a direct "how is poison damage calculated, what stats affect it" question went unanswered; bots should rely on the piecemeal staff scaling numbers in `assassination-melee-dps.md` rather than a formula.
10. **Whether poison critical strikes exist**: players assert poisons cannot crit ("crit only works for white and yellow hits"); no staff confirmation either way is in the corpus.
11. **Post-Class-Changes-2 rogue-tank build**: every build/gear list for `combat-tank.md` predates 2024-10-12, which reshuffled the talent trees the old builds rely on (removed Setup from Subtlety, removed Sleight of Hand, removed Endurance); no post-CC2 practitioner has posted an updated build.
12. **Current PvP BiS**: the only PvP gear list is from 2024-12-16, pre-1.18.0; new "reducing dot and crit dmg" PvP items are mentioned once (2026-04-11) with no itemization.
13. **Numeric stat weights**: no source gives crit/haste/hit/agility weights as numbers for Subtlety (any role) or for either PvP build; Combat and Assassination PvE have qualitative priorities only ("hit first, then...") backed by one or two player measurements each, not simulation output.
14. **Whether the 1.18.1 poison/Taste for Blood nerfs were a direct response to the PvP "poison rogues melt tanks" complaints**: plausible from the timeline but never stated by staff; treat the causal link as the orchestrator's/synthesis's inference, not a sourced fact.

readme.heading: Top open questions for the orchestrator
readme.markdown:

playbooks.title: Rogue — Combat/avoidance — Tank ("rogue tank", niche and staff-curbed)
playbooks.intro:
Turtle added two custom rogue tools in 2022 (**Flourish** — a finisher giving +20% parry — and **Agitating Poison** — a level-60 threat poison), which created an avoidance-based rogue tank. Staff then curbed it (40-s cooldown on Flourish, 1.17.0). The sources are **contested** on whether it is viable today: a small group still tanks with it in 2026, most players call it a meme, and staff explicitly said rogues "are not going to be true tanks". This file records what the practitioners say so a bot can imitate one where a group tolerates it; it is not an endorsement of the role for raids.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). Nothing in 1.18.0/1.18.1 changed Flourish or Agitating Poison except charges (2026-03-03) and Blade Flurry becoming baseline.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: avoidance off-tank/dungeon tank; raid main-tank only on a handful of melee-only bosses (historically Patchwerk hateful strikes, Loatheb, Razuvious start, Twin Emperors, AQ40 trash — [Hodenmaik (player), 2023-08-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=55641#p55641); "our first kill of twins in aq 40 was saved by a rogue who took over aggro and tanked the boss to completion" [Terrydavis (player), 2026-02-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168122#p168122)).
- **How it works (practitioner)**: "With Flourish active I can easily keep myself at 75% or higher avoidance in T1-T2 equivalent gear ... Evasion can then be used as a cooldown that will make the rogue completely unhittable by melee attacks ... Riposte is usable by a tank rogue nearly on cooldown, meaning that targets will be disarmed for several seconds" [Trismegistos (player, tanks SM→BWL), 2023-05-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=45534#p45534). "Flourish ... not only reduces damage taken, it also grants the rogue Riposte procs ... and parry haste, which further increases auto attack damage and poison procs, allowing for Agitating Poison to build up threat" [Trismegistos (player), 2023-08-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=55820#p55820).
- **Weaknesses (consensus)**: no taunt, no on-demand threat, no spell mitigation, low armor/HP, stun-vulnerable, single-target combo points ("Rogue is absolutely not viable for crowd tanking because you need to build combo points on single target" [Xudo (player, warrior tank), 2022-09-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=25185#p25185)); "you either die instantly or do not require any healing at all" [Torta (staff), 1.17.0](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=32868#p32868); threat is a Nature poison so **poison-immune mobs cannot be tanked** ("a surprising number of enemies are immune to it ... comparable to Paladins suddenly losing Righteous Fury" [Lomikare1 (player), 2026-02-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167928#p167928)); a holy priest's single Smite pulls aggro from an AQ40-geared rogue tank [Valari (player), 2025-04-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128159#p128159).
- **Community standing**: **niche, contested**. Pro: "rogue tanking is on good spot. We dont need any new gear. You can gear in any phase and still have nice avoidance ... We just need a physical version of Agitating poison" [Lomikare1, 2026-02-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168126#p168126); "it's a fun and unique mechanic ... It's never going to be an entirely viable option, but it can definitely make group play more fun" [madferret (player), 2026-03-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169666#p169666). Contra: "Rogues should not be tanks" [amanagor (player), 2026-02-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167931#p167931); "Stop trying to make rogue tanking a thing" [Getplucked (player), 2023-06-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49193#p49193); "Rogue tank was gutted intently a long time ago ... all that avoidance gear ... rotting in the bank" [Gantulga (player), 2025-04-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128220#p128220); "hunters and rogues are not going to be tanks" (player summary of the CC2 staff posts, f63 2024-10).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
Links only (pre-CC2 tree, `talents.turtlecraft.gg/rogue/<code>` format; opaque): Trismegistos' build `0X36I-2UZD251UC6` and threat-focused `0X36IO-2UZ1051UC6` [2023-05-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=45534#p45534); Bloodphobos' "low gear" `0X26-2UZ105V-UE66`, "max TPS" `0X36IU-2UZ1051OC6`, "max DPS" `0X36U-2UZD051UC6`, "max CP/min" `0X38UV5-2UZ1021` [2023-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=34782#p34782); Jadowsofel's "Vengeance" BoED tank `2RF60U-2UZD021UC6` [2023-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=77673#p77673). Verbal content (Combat-heavy): Lightning Reflexes 5, Deflection 5, Riposte, Precision 5, Blade Flurry (now baseline), Improved Blade Tactics (extends Flourish duration — "Improved Slice and Dice work for Flourish as well" [Bloodphobos, 2023-02-15]; made explicit in CC2 by staff), Setup/Ghostly Strike synergy is "attractive" but Subtlety variants "seem to be severely lacking in threat" (Trismegistos). Roxanneflowers' 2020 "A Subtle Defense" 11/16/24 build (Lightning Reflexes, Deflection, Riposte, Setup, Ghostly Strike, Hemorrhage, Sleight of Hand) is the pre-Turtle-changes ancestor [Roxanneflowers (player), 2020-07-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=7021#p7021) — Setup/Sleight of Hand no longer exist in that form.

**Patch validity**: every build predates CC2 (2024-10-12), which removed Setup from Subtlety (moved to Combat row 3), Sleight of Hand, Endurance and reshuffled Combat; no post-CC2 tank build is posted. Gap.

stats.heading: Stat priority (practitioners)
stats.markdown: Avoidance (dodge, parry, defense) → stamina → threat stats (hit, agility, weapon skill for poison procs) → resistances for caster bosses. "A 60 rogue with some mediocre gear should sit at around 70% avoidance with flourish up and talented properly, and getting some good gear should bring you close to 85-90% avoidance and evasion being up bringing them well above the 102% avoidance requirement to not be crushed" [Ssai (player), 2022-09-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=25123#p25123) (theorycraft, pre-1.17.0 Flourish); a full-mitigation set is "about 0.8% above cap" [Derrurak (player), 2023-06-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49177#p49177). "There are two general situations of tanking ... You have to gear up from the blues and be viable option for chosen role all the time" [Xudo, 2022-09-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=25346#p25346).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation / threat
rotationSingle.markdown:
1. Pre-pull: Agitating Poison on the main hand (and off-hand, or Deadly Throw with TWS for a ranged pull); Slice and Dice and Flourish up from stealth if possible.
2. "I do not expect to get more than one or two combo points before I'm swapping targets, meaning that I will be using them exclusively to refresh Slice and Dice & Flourish, or to snap a two-second Kidney Shot to stop a runner" [Trismegistos, 2023-05-11]; on bosses "juggling Flourish and Slice and Dice uptime while trying to weave in one or two 5-combo Eviscerates" [Trismegistos, 2023-08-04].
3. Riposte on every parry (threat + disarm); Sinister Strike as builder; Ghostly Strike for +dodge windows.
4. Evasion as the "shield wall" (unhittable by melee for 15 s; 4-min cooldown baseline since CC2, 3.5 min with the old Endurance talent).
5. Engineering fills the gaps: "target dummies have an area taunt ... grenades are great for area threat during fights (though your parry and dodge chance drop to 0% for the duration of the cast)" [Trismegistos, 2023-05-11].
6. Poison-immune targets: cannot hold threat; hand off. Casters: resistance gear/engineering reflectors; "it is fully within the rogue's capabilities to tank bosses like Baron Geddon and Shazzrah" (Trismegistos).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target
rotationAoe.markdown: Not viable as a crowd/pull tank: "Rogue is absolutely not viable for crowd tanking because you need to build combo points on single target. If you switch the target then you lose acquired combo points" [Xudo (player), 2022-09-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=25185#p25185) — combo points persist per target since CC2, which softens this (Kick/Gouge on an add no longer wipes the main target's points), but a rogue tank still cannot build threat on several adds at once the way a Sunder/Consecration tank can. Practical compromise: change targets every 1–2 combo points to spread Agitating Poison procs across a pack, and toggle the baseline Blade Flurry (since 1.18.0) to hit a second target at −20% energy regeneration; do not expect to hold a full pull.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Flourish**: the core mitigation finisher, but capped at a 40-s cooldown since 1.17.0 specifically to stop permanent avoidance uptime (staff note above) — plan pulls around it, do not expect it up every fight.
- **Evasion**: unhittable-by-melee cooldown, 4 min baseline since CC2 (3.5 min with the old Endurance talent) — use it as the "oh-shit" button on a dangerous swing, not on pull.
- **Riposte**: not a cooldown but only usable after a parry; treat it as a bonus threat/disarm proc rather than something to plan around.
- **Preparation**: resets Vanish/Blind/Sprint if talented, not Flourish or Evasion; of limited use to the tank build (it is a Subtlety talent competing with tank-relevant Combat/utility points).
- **Vanish**: aggro reset only in genuine emergencies; it does not help hold threat.

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Take dungeon and off-tank roles, melee-only bosses, and emergency pickups; never volunteer for tank-swap or stun-heavy fights ("If the boss uses any form of stun or other hard crowd control, you can't tank. If taunting the boss is necessary, you can't tank" [Hodenmaik, 2023-08-03]).
- Expect party friction (amanagor/Sylveria replies) and healers who dislike spiky avoidance tanking (Kairion: "being completely irrelevant as a healer in a fight is unfun" [2023-08-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=55661#p55661)).
- Level 60 only: Agitating Poison has no lower ranks ("I'm leveling a rogue now and would like to experiment with tanking but I really can't because of the level 60 req." [Glaive (player), 2025-09-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151003#p151003)).

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: Ssai's initial avoidance list (2022, self-corrected as "no longer ideal"): Guise of the Devourer, Taut Dragonhide Belt, Mark of C'Thun, Maladath, Blackguard, Bloodfang pieces, Drake Fang Talisman, Onyxia Blood Talisman, Cryptfiend Silk Cloak, Hailstone Band, Ring of Binding, Shadowshifter Armguards [Ssai (player), 2022-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=24106#p24106) `(vanilla item names; no Turtle verification)`. Julie's Dagger ×2 with Lifestealing as a "drain tank" solo set (Roxanneflowers, 2020). Consumables: Agitating Poison, scorpok/agility elixirs, armor/stamina consumables (Derrurak), engineering grenades and target dummies.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Attempting raid bosses that stun, fear, taunt-swap or are poison-immune.
- Standing in front of casters expecting avoidance to help (it does not).
- Casting grenades while being hit (avoidance drops to 0 during the cast — Trismegistos).
- Relying on Flourish uptime: it has a 40-s cooldown; plan Evasion/Ghostly Strike around it.
- Believing the April-Fools "50% baseline threat" note.

extraSections.heading: Official history (staff)
extraSections.markdown:
- 2021-11-11, reply to "Flourish (20% Parry) is almost the exact amount of avoidance needed to reach a 100% avoidance Rogue tank": "İntentional, no clue who can pull off rogue tanking, but they should have the required mitigation tool now." [Dragunovi (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=13766#p13766).
- 1.16.1 batch 1 [Torta (staff), 2022-07-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=20251#p20251): **Agitating Poison** (60): "Each strike has a 20% chance of poisoning the enemy which instantly inflicts 67 to 85 Nature damage, and causes additional threat. 115 charges." Flourish (42, 25 energy, +20% parry 3–7 s by combo point — per the timeline digest).
- 1.17.0 [Torta (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=32868#p32868): "Flourish now has a 40 second cooldown to avoid cases where the Rogue would become avoidance capped. Developer Note: Rogue tanking, while a cool and unique concept, has one major flaw. With avoidance based tanks, you either die instantly or do not require any healing at all. It leads to some encounters being trivialised, such as Patchwerk. It has also been brought to our attention that some crafty rogues use flourish to farm some end game bosses alone or in a much smaller group than intended." Cooldown fixed 2023-10-03 [Torta (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=68406#p68406) (a player saw "6.67 min" before the fix [Scruffles (player), 2023-10-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=69755#p69755)).
- 2023-07-05: "Rogues can no longer dodge or parry attacks by Raid bosses if they are attempting to solo it." [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52323#p52323); players read this as an 80% avoidance cap "when 'solo'" that also hit small groups ("any group of 10 or less people can't reach avoidance cap ... can't tank anything in UBRS" [Bayanni (player), 2023-08-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=55692#p55692); "Your avoidance is capped at 80%" [Bayanni (player), 2023-09-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=64839#p64839)). Removed: "Removed a deprecated safeguard that would kick in when a Rogue attempted to solo a world boss." [Torta (staff), 2024-06-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=97844#p97844).
- 2024-04-01 (April Fools thread "2024 March 32"): "Rogues can now tank much easier with 50% increased baseline threat generation" [Akalix (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=91795#p91795) — a joke post; not a real change.
- Agitating Poison: no spell-power scaling [Torta (staff), 2025-06-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134147#p134147); "now correctly uses charges as intended instead of lasting indefinitely" [Shadowsong (staff), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169965#p169965); Throwing Weapon Specialization + Deadly Throw can apply an off-hand Agitating Poison at range [Torta (staff), 2025-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124967#p124967).
- The "3000 gold an hour" farming rumour used to justify the Flourish nerf is disputed by rogues: "At most you got 120g/h from HFQ disenchant boss runs" [Gantulga (player), 2023-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=70371#p70371); "You need a shaman and a paladin with you the whole time" [Bayanni (player), 2023-10-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=70147#p70147).

stat_weights.stamina: second priority, for the swings that do land
stat_weights.threat_stats: hit, agility, weapon skill (drives poison procs for Agitating Poison threat)

caps.avoidance_target: ~102% avoidance with Evasion up to avoid crushing blows (vanilla-baseline tanking convention, not a staff number); one theorycraft post estimated 70% avoidance at mediocre gear with Flourish talented, 85-90% at good gear
caps.agitating_poison_level: 60 (baseline poison, no lower ranks -- a frequently repeated player complaint)

rotation_single.action: Agitating Poison on main hand (and off-hand, or via Deadly Throw + Throwing Weapon Specialization for a ranged pull)
rotation_single.condition: pre-pull

rotation_single.action: Slice and Dice and Flourish up from stealth
rotation_single.condition: pre-pull, if possible

rotation_single.action: 1-2 combo points then spend on Flourish/Slice and Dice refresh, or a 2-second Kidney Shot to stop a runner
rotation_single.condition: single boss target; do not hoard combo points
threat + disarm proc

rotation_single.action: Sinister Strike as filler builder; Ghostly Strike for +dodge windows
rotation_single.condition: always
unhittable-by-melee cooldown for the most dangerous swing window (15s, 4-min cooldown)
Agitating Poison (Nature) generates no threat on poison-immune mobs

rotation_aoe.action: change targets every 1-2 combo points to spread Agitating Poison procs across the pack
rotation_aoe.condition: combo points persist per target since CC2, softening but not solving the crowd-tanking problem

rotation_aoe.action: toggle baseline Blade Flurry (since 1.18.0) for a second target

cooldowns.name: Flourish
cooldowns.use_when: the core mitigation finisher; capped at a 40-second cooldown since 1.17.0 specifically to prevent permanent avoidance uptime -- plan pulls around it

cooldowns.name: Evasion
cooldowns.use_when: 4-min baseline cooldown (3.5 min with the old, now-removed Endurance talent); save for the most dangerous swing

cooldowns.name: Riposte
cooldowns.use_when: not a cooldown, only usable after a parry; bonus threat/disarm

cooldowns.name: Vanish
cooldowns.use_when: genuine emergency aggro reset only

resource_rules: Threat comes from Agitating Poison procs (Nature damage + threat) and auto-attack/Sinister Strike weapon damage, not from a dedicated threat multiplier
Engineering grenades and target dummies fill area-threat gaps but drop the rogue's dodge/parry chance to 0% during the cast
No taunt and no on-demand threat cooldown exists for this build
consumables: Agitating Poison (both weapons where possible)
Scorpok / agility elixirs
Armor and stamina flasks/elixirs
Engineering grenades and target dummies
mistakes_to_avoid: Attempting raid bosses that stun, fear, taunt-swap, or are poison-immune
Standing in front of casters expecting avoidance to help against spell damage
Casting a grenade while being hit (avoidance drops to 0% for the cast duration)
Relying on Flourish being up constantly (40-second cooldown)
Assuming the April Fools 'baseline +50% threat' patch note was real
Volunteering for tank-swap fights or crowd-tanking packs (single-target combo points make this unviable)

playbooks.title: Rogue — Assassination — Melee DPS (raid / dungeon, "Noxious Assault / poison rogue")
playbooks.intro:
Covers the 1.18.0+ Assassination build built around **Noxious Assault**, **Envenom**, **Vigor** and fast daggers ("poison rogue", "NA rogue", "assa"). The pre-1.18.0 Assassination variants (Seal Fate/Backstab, "Envenom raiding" with Backstab) are covered as historical variants. Combat is a separate playbook (`combat-melee-dps.md`); the two are the raid-DPS alternatives and the forum argues about which is better, so both are written up.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). Within pre-1.18.1 the Assassination tree changed four times: Class Changes 2 (CC2, 2024-10-12 post, live 1.17.2), the 2024-12-20 poison-scaling round, the 2025-03-30 round (Vile Poisons/Envenom buffs, Deadly Throw rework) and 1.18.0 (2025-07-25 post, live 2025-08-15: Noxious Assault, Vigor rework, Dissolvent Poison, Blade Flurry baseline). 1.18.1 then nerfed the spec (poison scaling at low ranks, Taste for Blood, Noxious Assault) and restricted the Physical poisons. Every recommendation says which kit it was written for.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: melee DPS. The spec's identity per staff is "the Poison rogue": fast weapons, poisons on both hands, Noxious Assault as combo builder ("a new combo point generating abilities that constantly applies your poisons and works well with all weapon types" [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159)).
- **Strengths (sources)**: very high damage at low gear — "absurdly high dps even at low gear levels" [Crake (player), 2025-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152736#p152736); "Once you get noxious assault and the new poisons you feel so powerful" [Teerack (player), 2025-09-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150223#p150223); "Mobs are melting ... killing mobs about 75% faster than ... my Ambush/Backstab build ... topping DPS meters in every dungeon" [Sslushee (player), 2025-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158547#p158547). Not position dependent: "You don't need positioning to hit your attacks (not like backstab or ambush)" [Rachdingue (player), 2025-09-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152457#p152457). Physical poisons (Corrosive/Dissolvent) bypass armor and Nature immunity — but see the 1.18.1 restriction below.
- **Weaknesses (sources)**: flat gear scaling — "they start at 500dps in pure white gear, but only go up to about 700dps in full nax gear (around 1k dps in full nax gear + raid buffs and debuffs on boss). Meanwhile combat is running around with 700 agi and 1.3s energy ticks, dealing 2k dps" [Crake (player), 2026-03-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172282#p172282) (post-1.18.1); poison immunity/resistance of many raid mobs [Finpin (player), 2025-04-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=127477#p127477); the spec "needs a lot of setup before you can get to your full damage output potential. You need to have S&D and Envenom up" (Finpin, same post); burns poison charges very fast on 1.3-speed daggers [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149679#p149679); Blade Flurry is a poor cleave for it ("Blade Flurry can be use by Assassination and Sub but it seems to be a bigger energy drain for those 2 specs. I wont use it on my Assassination rogue" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-08-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148289#p148289)); few fast endgame daggers ("There are so few 1.3/1.4 speed daggers in the game" [Sslushee (player), 2025-12-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162338#p162338)).
- **Content**: dungeons and MC–AQ-tier raids — favored (see standing); Naxx/Kara40-geared raiding — contested vs Combat; leveling from 40 — favored (see `leveling.md`); PvP — a "zug" burst variant exists (see `assassination-pvp.md`); hardcore — no specific advice in the sources.
- **Community standing**: **favored for fresh/mid-geared raiders, contested at the top end** (consensus that this is the ordering, from 2025-09 to 2026-03). The gearing ladder given by an experienced PvPer/PvEer: "15 - 40 ambush or 1 cp evis spam. 40-60 noxious assault and envenom. Mc - AQ gear noxious assault and envenom. AQ + gear Combat backstab spec." [Grizb37 (player), 2025-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158295#p158295). Same ladder by Crake: "This is definitely the way to go until you get up to 40% crit or higher in end game raiding" (about dropping Seal Fate) [Crake (player), 2025-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159151#p159151). Counter-view from raiders: "noxious assault is terrible, backstab is way more dmg... you just can't really put that point anywhere else" [Edem (player), 2025-11-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161043#p161043); the 2025-09 "endgame meta build" posted with named top parsers is 20/31/0 Combat, not Assassination [Bayanni (player), 2025-09-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153716#p153716).
- **Post-1.18.1 status (contested)**: thread "Assa build is dead 4 raiding in patch 1.18.1?" — "im rock bottom at dps, im completely useless" [Microtwist (player), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171651#p171651); "Go COMBAT u n00bs ... throw out 1.3 speed mainhands" [Mdzielak (player), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171653#p171653); "Assaa with 1.3 felt fun to me, but with the poisons change, its too much messing about changing all the time" [Snkx (player), 2026-03-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172809#p172809); vs. "Noxious assault rogues got the biggest nerf in this patch ... Leave the entry level rogue spec alone" [Crake (player), 2026-03-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172282#p172282). A hunter complains rogues do "500dps+ with only white 1.30 daggers from vendors" post-patch [Topmoo (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172191#p172191), and a feral druid reports post-patch Instant Poison "hit me 220-250/hit ... its like 700dps from poisons only" in PvP [Wosator (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171992#p171992). Staff position: the class was "a bit overperformant in certain areas" and 1.18.1 makes "targeted numerical adjustments ... without changing how the class fundamentally plays" [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
- Reputation: before 1.18.0 the forum consensus was that Rogue was the weakest DPS on Turtle and Assassination "a meme"; from 1.18.0 (Aug 2025) the complaint flips to "rogues are broken" from other classes (see `README.md` gaps and `assassination-pvp.md`). Bots should expect both framings depending on date.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
The forum gives builds as opaque `talents.turtlecraft.gg` links plus partial verbal lists; no post lists all 51 points talent by talent. The union of explicit statements:

### Noxious Assault raid/dungeon build (1.18.0 tree; 1.18.1 changes marked)

| Tree | Talent | Points | Source / note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Assassination | Malice | 5/5 | "Malice (Increase your crit chance by 5%) Yes please!" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149395#p149395) |
| Assassination | Ruthlessness | 3/3 | needed for the 1-point finisher refresh trick (below); "Slice & Dice (off the Ruthlessness point)" [Sslushee (player), 2025-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158547#p158547) |
| Assassination | Improved Blade Tactics | 3/3 | Shananagans' rotation assumes 28-s Envenom and 30-s 5-point SnD (implies 3/3) [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149679#p149679) |
| Assassination | Relentless Strikes | 1/1 | consensus (all builds) |
| Assassination | Lethality | 5/5 | includes Noxious Assault since 1.18.0 (staff, above); Shananagans levels it 36–40 |
| Assassination | Vile Poisons | 3/3 | "50%+ of your damage is coming from your poisons" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-09-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151001#p151001) |
| Assassination | Improved Poisons | 3/3 | "Grab all the poison talents + Efficient Poisons" [Sslushee, above] |

Post-1.18.1 it no longer boosts Physical poisons (Crake calls that "the biggest nerf"). |

Seal Fate is a crit based talent. It requires improved backstab, which you don't take in a Noxious Assualt based build" [Sslushee (player), 2025-11-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159106#p159106); "Seal fate is not worth it on a noxious assault build ... until you get up to 40% crit or higher" [Crake (player), 2025-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159151#p159151) |

Build links (opaque; not decoded): main `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/rogue?points=YoYDIoDYZIQoB-AoAoC-` and Rupture variant `...?points=AoYDIobYZIQoB-AoAoC-` [Shananagans, 2025-09-01]; level-40 build `...?points=AoYCIgDYZIQQB--` [Sslushee, 2025-11-06]; full-Assassination BoED variant `...?points=AoaDIobYZIQoB-AoAo-` [Phere (player), 2025-11-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160510#p160510).

### Variants

- **Envenom + Backstab hybrid (pre-1.18.0 and still used)**: "24/27/00 Backstab build with Envenom is performing quite better regardless" [Kerenis (player), 2025-08-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148700#p148700); "At 60, spec assa up to Envenom, rest in Combat for backstab PVE build. Use Backstab to build CP, Keep Envenom, SnD and Rupture up" [Kerenis (player), 2025-09-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152188#p152188). Since 1.18.0 Envenom is at row 5, so this hybrid needs 20+ Assassination points and keeps Improved Backstab from Combat. Single source; where the raid meta lands post-1.18.1 is a gap.
- **Envenom raiding, pre-1.18.0 (historical)**: "the best DPS comes from 4 or 5 point Envenoms and 4 or 5 point Slice and Dices, which doesn't leave much room to push Rupture or Evsicerate ... Assassination lags behind combat in DPS especially in cleave" [Bigbosc (player), 2025-03-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122847#p122847) — written for the CC2 kit (Envenom capstone, Vigor with 8-s ICD); superseded by 1.18.0.
- **"Demon Hunter"/Blade of Eternal Darkness proc build**: full Assassination with BoED main hand, Distracting Dagger off-hand and +spell-damage-on-hit items (Thunder Lizard's Hide 81308, Ring of Electrical Binding 61332, Sizzling Pyrestone Aureole 58209, Flamestring Bow 80825, Incendosaur set) on top of 4-piece Darkmantle + 4-piece Stormshroud; a Majordomo parse of 1,091 DPS with Dissolvent Poison II 41%, Engulfing Shadows 19%, auto attack 19%, Noxious Assault 13% [Phere (player), 2025-11-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159969#p159969); "Raiding is also viable but you have to be careful with resistances of Bosses" [Phere, 2025-11-24]. Original write-up [Jadowsofel (player), 2023-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=77673#p77673); "This has been nerfed subtly but hard" [Kerenis (player), 2025-11-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159527#p159527) (contested). Pre-1.18.1; the Dissolvent restriction in 1.18.1 removes its top damage line on non-Undead/Elemental/Giant/Mechanical bosses.

### Patch validity

Builds above are 1.18.0 (Aug–Dec 2025). 1.18.1 changed: Taste for Blood (2 points, weaker, no Physical-poison scaling), Noxious Assault 30% AP, Blade Flurry −20% energy, and the poison target restriction. No post-1.18.1 source posts a revised full build; the thread t24364 only argues whether to switch to Combat. Treat the talent allocation as still valid except Taste for Blood (now 2 points, and its value is contested), and treat the DPS ranking as **contested post-1.18.1**.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- **60, Noxious Assault build (Shananagans, 2025-09-01, 1.18.0)**: "Assassination isn't your combat swords mentality of piling on the attack power. It is a balance between dagger speed, armor haste and crit. Attack power is at the bottom of my list" — i.e. **weapon speed (1.3–1.4 daggers) > hit to cap for the content > crit / agility > haste on gear (diminishing) > AP**. "Just my Humble 2 cents: Speed of Daggers, + to Daggers, Critical Strike" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162667#p162667). Reason: "weapon speed doesn't matter for noxious assault, but it DOES matter for how frequently you can apply poisons through auto attacks. More swings = more procs = more damage. And assa is like 50%+ poison damage" [Jinkarasu (player), 2025-08-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148372#p148372) (Noxious Assault "doesn't use weapon damage values at all. It's a % of your total attack power"). Consensus among the 1.18.0 posters (Jinkarasu, Kerenis, Shananagans, Sslushee, Crake). Post-1.18.1 counter-claim: "throw out 1.3 speed mainhands" [Mdzielak, 2026-03-21] — single source, no numbers.
- **Weapon skill**: "+6 to daggers helps push glancing blows lower, which means more poison procs that turns into energy return" (Distracting Dagger, Mugger's Belt); "The weapon skill is capped at 315" [Shananagans, 2025-09-01] — the cap number is the poster's belief, not a staff statement.
- **Hit**: 5% from Precision plus gear; "you only need 4-5%, you are doing dungeons not raiding" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-11-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161013#p161013); for raids the forum uses the vanilla 9% special-attack cap ("9% hit cap can be reach" [Nightmonster (player), 2023-05-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=43985#p43985)) `(vanilla baseline, not a staff number)`.
- **Haste**: "Be careful of stacking armor haste due to diminishing returns. Right now I feel like I'm in the sweet spot dagger speed with gear at 1.25, with slice and dice up is .97 and with the Stormshroud Set proc it's .87. I tried adding a ring that gave 3% haste to melee and barely budged the needle at .86" [Shananagans, 2025-09-01].
- **Crit vs poisons**: poisons do not crit and crit does not help them — "crit only works for white and yellow hits, but those are not crucial for envenom spec" [Frantsel (player), 2025-06-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135716#p135716); this is why Sslushee drops Seal Fate. Crit still feeds Seal Fate/Relentless when high.
- **Crit cap**: "1% crit is = to 29 agility" and the cap "100% - (base miss % - your hit %) - (base dodge %) - (base parry %) - (glancing blow %)" via the BetterCharacterStats addon [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-09-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151559#p151559) — player arithmetic, unverified.
- **Leveling**: same priorities, but Precision can wait (see `leveling.md`); Sslushee at 40: "This build isn't crit-dependent in the slightest".

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation (1.18.0 kit; unchanged by 1.18.1 except Taste for Blood)
rotationSingle.markdown:
Opener and priority as written by the two guide-style posters (consensus between them, dummy-tested by Shananagans):

1. **Opener**: any combo-point opener — "I'm not worried about which opener I use. I want a combo point, period ... you wont garrote a stone elemental for example" [Shananagans, 2025-09-01]. In dungeons/solo: Cheap Shot (Sslushee) or Garrote/Ambush. On bosses immune to stun: Garrote if it bleeds, else Noxious Assault.
2. **Envenom at 1 combo point immediately** ("I hit envenom to get the poison buff going") — "You're not supposed to wait for full combo points to pop it - I cheap shot -> pop envenom immediately, and refresh when needed" [Tankmeister (player), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154255#p154255).
3. **Slice and Dice at 1 point** off the Ruthlessness combo point ("since it is a finishing move it has 100% of the time so far, granted me another combo point, I hit slice and dice").
4. **Noxious Assault** as the only builder until 5 combo points; "it takes using Noxious Assault 10-12 seconds to acquire 5 combo points".
5. **Keep Envenom and SnD desynchronised by 10–12 s**: refresh the one with 1–2 s left at 5 points, then use the Ruthlessness point on the other; "the next 5 combo points as you can probably guess will go to slice and dice ... it just flip flop back and forth". Rule: "THEY HAVE TO STAY UP".
6. **Only when both buffs have >10 s** and you have 3–5 points: **Eviscerate** (Shananagans' default, keeps CC usable) or **Rupture** (his raid/dungeon variant; "Some have mentioned Rupture does more damage"); Crake's raw-Lua rotation macro uses **Rupture at 5 points** when Envenom and SnD are up, otherwise Envenom (if missing) → SnD (if missing) → Noxious Assault [Crake (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157229#p157229).
7. **Pool energy; do not mash**: "Pool your energy and don't mash buttons. You will gain more dps having patience" [Shananagans, 2025-09-01]. Expect ~50% of damage from poisons, 25–27% autos, 15–17% Noxious Assault, 6–7% Eviscerate (dummy test, same post).

Opener for short fights (level 40 dungeon version): "Cheap Shot → Envenom → Slice & Dice (off the Ruthlessness point) → Noxious Assault twice → Dead" [Sslushee, 2025-11-06]. Trash: "you basically use one mob to acivate each since they just die to quick" [Finpin, 2025-04-19] — accept that the first mob of a pack is spent setting up Envenom/SnD.

Expose Armor: only if no warrior sunders (Shananagans, 2025-09-09); Bigbosc (pre-1.18.0) warns that using Expose Armor in this spec means you "simply can't ever push a damaging finishing move".

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE
rotationAoe.markdown:
- 2–3 targets: **do not toggle Blade Flurry** in this spec by default — it costs 20% energy regeneration (30% before 1.18.1) and 20% damage, which starves Vigor/Noxious Assault: Shananagans won't use it on his Assassination rogue [2025-08-25]; "Dont use blade flurry while leveling, it is absolute trash until you get like 800 agility" [Exaltus (player), 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149418#p149418); "In the multi-target scene, it used to be 200%, but now it is estimated that it can only be 170% or lower" [killend (player), 2025-07-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141570#p141570). Single-source counter: Combat rogues use it freely (see `combat-melee-dps.md`). Instead: tab-swap Noxious Assault between two targets only if both live long enough to keep poisons ticking; otherwise stay on one.
- 4+ targets: no rogue AoE exists ("They've said they won't add true AoE to rogues. The best we'll get is Blade Flurry" [Bayanni (player), 2025-06-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134713#p134713)). Consumable padding: Oil of Immolation ("250 damage over 15 seconds ... for each mob in a 3 yard radius") and Dragonbreath Chili [Shananagans, 2025-09-01]; engineering grenades (see PvP/tank files). Bots should not chase AoE parses on this spec.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Energy**: baseline "20 energy every 2 seconds" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-09-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151497#p151497); Vigor +2 per poison application (staff), Relentless Strikes 20 energy on 5-point finishers, Darkmantle 4-piece 35-energy proc and Stormshroud 4-piece 30-energy + 10% haste proc (Shananagans, 2025-09-01; itemization not staff-verified in the corpus). Thistle Tea for energy ("We have thistle tea :P" [Aulisia (player), 2025-06-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=136129#p136129)); a player claims it shares a cooldown with Healthstones [Bloodphobos (player), 2023-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=34782#p34782) (single source).
- **Vanish** offensively for a second opener/trinket swap (Shananagans p149464) — but "don't use Vanish offensively when solo, it will rest the mob back to full health" [Shananagans, 2025-10-27]; absorbed damage (Cloaked in Shadows) still breaks stealth [Tankmeister (player), 2025-09-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153426#p153426).
- **Adrenaline Rush / Blade Flurry**: not in this build (deep Combat) — the spec has no burst cooldown; its "cooldown" is keeping Envenom up.
- **Downtime**: reapply poisons when charges run out (watch the weapon buff), bandage between pulls; the spec has no self-heal.
- Trinket swapping between pulls with TrinketMenu (Shananagans p149464) is a common habit, not a requirement.

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Stand behind the target anyway (glancing/parry avoidance; Ambush/Backstab openers), though NA itself has no positional requirement.
- Threat: the class's threat management "is only surpassed by hunters" [Atreidon (player), 2025-02-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120497#p120497); Feint when a threat addon (TankPlates/SuperWoW) shows yellow, Vanish on green [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149464#p149464).
- Interrupts: Kick; Deadly Throw is a ranged 3-s interrupt sharing Kick's cooldown (staff, 2025-03-30) — use it when the caster is out of reach.
- Poison-immune or resistant bosses: swap to Dissolvent/Corrosive only if the target is Elemental/Mechanical/Giant/Undead (post-1.18.1), otherwise the spec is weak there: "ALL Elementals and other partly magic immune creatures/bosses (e.g. emperors, 50% of mc bosses) will just eat your poisons" [Finpin, 2025-04-19]. Fire-immune targets ignore Alcor's Sunrazor procs (Shananagans, 2025-12-13).
- Stealth is unreliable on Turtle (mobs detect from further than expected; see `leveling.md` and Atreidon's tips) — do not rely on Sap pulls in pugs ("Tanks won't wait for your little show anyway" [Akos1896 (player), 2024-10-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103039#p103039)).

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Weapons (consensus among the 1.18.0 posters: fastest daggers, stats secondary)**: Julie's Dagger ×2 (1.30, world drop, BoE) as the entry pair [Shananagans, 2025-09-01; Hellyo's question 2025-11-25]; **Distracting Dagger** (18392, DM West, +6 daggers) as pre-raid BiS off-hand; **Alcor's Sunrazor** (14555, world drop, not unique — two can be used); The Ripper (60422; drop location disputed between Damian (Booty Bay) and Damien in Stormwind Vault — unresolved [Sslushee (player), 2026-01-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164826#p164826)); Fang of Venoxis (19903, ZG); Ornate Bloodstone Dagger (65004, crafted); **Sorcerous Dagger** (18878, MC, 1.3, +1% attack/casting speed, "Highly Recommend"); Harbinger of Doom (23044, Naxx trash, 1.6 — "Pretty slow for an Assassination rogue"); Gutgore Ripper "did less damage than Julie's Dagger on the test dummies" [Sslushee, 2025-12-10]. All [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162667#p162667). Flurry Axe ×2 was examined and rejected ("To compensate the 0,2s slower axes and reach the same hits per minute number, you need a procc chance extra attack of 15%" [Schlaechter (player), 2025-10-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155580#p155580)).
- **Armor**: **Stormshroud set** (itemset 142, crafted, ~400 g on Nordanaar in Oct 2025, "updated for 1.18 patch", 4-set = 30 energy + 10% haste proc, 2% hit on the set) → mix **4-piece Darkmantle** (35-energy proc) + 4-piece Stormshroud ("very hard for any set to beat 2x energy procs") → **Bonescythe** or **Trickster (T3.5)** [Shananagans, 2025-09-01 and 2025-12-13]. Pre-raid fillers: Nightslayer Bracers (16825, AH), Mongoose Boots (18506), Mugger's Belt (18505, +5 daggers), Tarnished Elven Ring (18500, 1% hit), Blackstone Ring (17713, 1% hit), Rune of the Wildhammer Clan (51755, 1% hit trinket, Hinterlands quest) [Shananagans, 2025-11-28 and 2025-09-29]. Devilsaur is out: "no more Devilsaur Armor". Band of Ancient Lethality's poison bonus stacks with Improved Poisons (staff, 2025-06-03).
- **Enchants**: +15 Agility on both weapons preferred over Crusader ("Agility would have better synergy with assassination due to the Seal Fate talent and raid buffs") [Shananagans, 2025-09-01]; Lifesteal vs Agility discussed for leveling in `leveling.md`.
- **Consumables**: Instant Poison VI ×2 (plus spares), Dissolvent II for the four allowed creature types, Thistle Tea, Oil of Immolation, Dragonbreath Chili (Shananagans); Mongoose, jujus, food are what a struggling combat rogue lists as standard [RecenRogue (player), 2025-04-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128007#p128007); Sweet 'N Crunchy Fruit Bread is credited with rogue burst by a hunter [Vrag (player), 2026-01-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164294#p164294) and got a 5-min shared cooldown with Poisonous Mushroom [Shadowsong (staff), 2026-01-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165755#p165755).
- **New class weapon**: 1.18.1 adds a Rogue class-weapon questline via Timbermaw Hold [Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272); the quest starter (quest 42029) is item 42307 dropping from Peroth'arn [Sleeptime (staff), 2026-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174120#p174120). Weapon stats are not in the corpus (gap).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes (bots must avoid)
mistakes.markdown:
- Using slow "purple" daggers because of the Combat mindset: "we see these beautiful Purple, slow Daggers drop and we drool ... Assassination as we know now is all about the speed" [Shananagans, 2025-12-13].
- Letting Envenom or Slice and Dice drop, or refreshing both at the same time so they expire together (Shananagans' 10–12 s separation rule).
- Waiting for 5 points before the first Envenom (Tankmeister).
- Running Deadly/Corrosive with fast daggers: "the 5 stack cap on deadly ends up hindering your dps" (Sslushee); post-1.18.1, running Dissolvent/Corrosive on anything but Elemental/Mechanical/Giant/Undead (they do not apply).
- Toggling Blade Flurry on and forgetting it (energy starvation).
- Running out of poison charges mid-fight (carry spares; weapon-swap macro).
- Using DoT poisons/Rupture on a target you intend to Gouge/Blind/Sap.
- Ignoring hit: "if you are missing more because you don't have Precision, you damage is going into the toilet".
- Spamming at low energy instead of pooling.
- Expecting AoE parses or top single-target parses in Naxx gear (Crake's 700 vs 2k).

extraSections.heading: Official kit (staff) — what the build is made of
extraSections.markdown:
Read `../../1.18.1-master-changelog.md` (Classes → Rogue) for the 1.18.1 entries; the pre-1.18.1 chain is:

- CC2 [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102971#p102971): **combo points persist across targets** ("reset when applying combo points on a new target"); One-Handed Axes; Sinister Strike 40 energy; **Corrosive Poison** (Physical DoT, 30% chance, 100/128 dmg over 12 s, 5 stacks, 105 charges, R2 from Handbook of Deadly Poison V); Sprint/Evasion 4 min; Wound Poison −5% healing/stack; Crippling R2 60%; Assassination: Remorseless Attacks 40 s, Ruthlessness 33/66/100%, Improved Blade Tactics (SnD/Flourish +15/30/45%), Vile Poisons and Improved Poisons 3 points, **Taste for Blood** (new, Rupture-triggered damage buff), **Efficient Poisons** (−4/8/12% resist, 15/30/45% chance not to consume a charge), Vigor 2 points, **Envenom** capstone (finisher, +25% poison chance/effect for 12–28 s, 25 energy; "Effectiveness means ... damage for damage dealing poisons, slow amount for Crippling Poison and healing reduction for Wound Poison").
- 2024-12-20 [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460): "The damage output of Rogue hasn't quite met our expectations ... we'll be adding scaling to class-specific poisons"; **Relentless Strikes: 20 energy (was 25) and +5% finisher damage per stack, 5 stacks, 30 s**; **all finishers −5 energy**; **Instant Poison +5% AP; Deadly and Corrosive +2% AP per tick (8% per full stack)**; Adrenaline Rush 3 min.
- 2025-03-30 [Torta (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504): Vile Poisons 10/20/30%; **Envenom 30%** (was 25%); Deadly Throw reworked (no combo points, 40 energy, 100% weapon damage, shares Kick's cooldown, 3-s interrupt); Throwing Weapon Specialization = 50/100% chance to apply the **off-hand** poison with Deadly Throw. Hotfix: with TWS "Deadly Poison" on the main hand now correctly lets the throw apply Agitating/Instant from the off-hand [Torta (staff), 2025-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124967#p124967).
- 1.18.0 [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159): baseline **Quickfooted** (+7% speed at 30), **Blade Flurry baseline at 30 as a toggle** (−30% energy regeneration, −20% damage, 4-s cooldown), **Dissolvent Poison** (instant Physical, ignores armor, 20% chance; R1 lvl 52 88–113, R2 lvl 60 106–142, 4.75% AP), Blind is Physical; Assassination: Remorseless Attacks and Lethality include Noxious Assault/Surprise Attack (revision: "Combo Point generating ability"), **Corrosive AP scaling −5%** ("the original poison variant now pulls ahead by a noticeable amount"), TWS row 3, **Taste for Blood row 4: +1/2/3% Physical damage per combo point and Rupture +2/4/6 s** (fixed to scale with combo points on 2025-08-15 [Torta (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=145822#p145822)), **Envenom row 5**, **Vigor: no cooldown, 2 energy per poison application** ("this still equals a big increase in energy gained"), capstone **Noxious Assault** (both weapons, 35% AP + 30/55/85/105, applies both poisons, 1 combo point, 45 energy, no cooldown; ranks at 40 (talent), 48, 56, 60 via book — the Handbook IV was fixed on 2025-08-15). Revision 2025-08-14: Opportunity to Combat row 1; Improved Gouge and Improved Expose Armor to Subtlety row 1.
- **1.18.1** [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071): low-rank poison scaling removed/reduced (Deadly R1–R3 none, R4 1%/tick; Instant R1 none, R2–R3 1%, R4–R5 2%; Corrosive R1 (56) 1%/tick; Dissolvent R1 (52) 2%) — "smooths out that curve while preserving endgame effectiveness"; **Blade Flurry energy penalty 30% → 20%**; **Taste for Blood 1/2/3% → 1/1.5/2% and no longer increases Corrosive/Dissolvent damage**; **Noxious Assault 35% → 30% AP**. Revision 2026-03-19 (same post): **Taste for Blood is now a 2-point talent, +4/6 s duration, +1/2% damage**; **Corrosive and Dissolvent Poison only apply to Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants and Undead** (first announced in the 1.18.1 preliminary notes [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). Post-release hotfix: "Fixed damage calculations for stackable spells (e.g., Scorpid Poison, Deadly Poison, etc.)" [Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139).
- Poison plumbing fixes worth knowing: "Poisons at max stack now properly take Envenom into account" [Torta (staff), 2024-11-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106599#p106599); Deadly and Corrosive "no longer mutually exclusive when applied by different Rogues" [Torta (staff), 2024-12-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111130#p111130); Band of Ancient Lethality's poison bonus stacks with Improved Poisons [Torta (staff), 2025-06-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134147#p134147); Eviscerate and Rupture "now also correctly scale with Attack Power bonuses against specific creature types" [Torta (staff), 2025-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159221#p159221); Corrosive could bypass invulnerability, fixed [Torta (staff), 2025-07-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140939#p140939); Dissolvent vs elementals fixed 2025-08-15.

extraSections.heading: Poison choice (the spec's central decision)
extraSections.markdown:
Poison charges/ranks (community wiki, not official): Instant VI 112–148 Nature 20% 115 charges; Deadly IV 108 over 12 s ×5 stacks (V at 60 from the Handbook); Crippling II slows to 30%; Mind-numbing III +60% cast time; Wound IV — [Poisons](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Poisons) (revision 2024-10-29, predates Corrosive II/Dissolvent numbers, which are in the staff posts above). Poisons come from the level-20 class quest chain (Alliance SI:7 / Westfall tower; Horde Cleft of Shadow / Barrens tower) — same wiki page.

| Situation | Poison (main / off) | Sources | Validity |
|---|---|---|---|
| Default PvE, any target that is not Elemental/Mechanical/Giant/Undead | **Instant / Instant** | "double Instant poison ... trumps both instant/deadly and deadly/deadly. Instant poison is hitting so fast that the 5 stack cap on deadly ends up hindering your dps" [Sslushee (player), 2025-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158547#p158547); "Deadly corrosive dps is really weak with Evenom compared to instant since it procs so much" [Boeuff (player), 2025-05-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131537#p131537); "You HAVE to use 2x instant poisons or your damage just tanks" [Snkx (player), 2025-10-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154789#p154789) | consensus; post-1.18.1 this is the only choice vs most targets |
| Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants, Undead (Naxx, MC elementals, Kara40 constructs) | **Dissolvent / Dissolvent** (or Dissolvent + Corrosive for a stacking DoT) | "Right now everyone is just rolling with dissolvent because it is simply by far the best choice" [Tankmeister (player), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154255#p154255) (pre-restriction); Phere's Majordomo profile 41% Dissolvent II | since 2026-03-20 these poisons **do nothing on other creature types** [Jamey (staff), 2026-03-19]. Whether Dissolvent still beats Instant on the allowed types is a gap ("Naxx consecrated sharpening stones vs poisons ... undead bosses" asked with no answer [Equilibria (player), 2026-01-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164396#p164396)) |
| Bosses, long fights (pre-1.18.0 advice) | Deadly on bosses, Instant on trash | "Rogues I know use deadly poison for bosses and instant for trash" [Balake (player), 2024-01-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83413#p83413); no debuff-limit concern on Turtle [Borefficz (player), 2024-01-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83414#p83414) | pre-1.18.0; superseded for the NA build by the double-Instant consensus |
| Solo/farming | Instant (no DoTs) | "Instant for soloing is for the best. Last thing you want is a DoT breaking a timely Gouge or Blind" [RAGEAHOLIC (player), 2025-03-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121831#p121831); "Use 2 fast daggers and don't use any damage over time poisons ie. (Deadly, corrosive)" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157385#p157385) | consensus |
| Humanoids that run | Instant / Crippling | Shananagans, 2025-10-27 (same post) | single |
| CC'd mob | never a DoT poison on it | Borefficz, 2024-01-02 | consensus |
| Tanking | Agitating (threat), see `combat-tank.md` | | |

Mechanics the bot must model: poisons last 30 min and have charges; with 1.3-speed daggers under SnD "Assassination goes through a lot of poisons ... I have had to revert to keeping an extra set of daggers in my bags and making a weapon swap macro" [Shananagans, 2025-09-01] — carry spare poisons and reapply between pulls (addons EasyPoisons `https://github.com/Cinecom/EasyPoisons` / EzPoison `https://github.com/wierdthing/EzPoison`, "Also work with the new poisons, Dissolvent and Corrosive" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158306#p158306)). Off-hand procs are reduced: "the proccchance off of effects originating from your offhand is reduced quite substantially ... Thats intentional" [Atreidon (player), 2025-04-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=127459#p127459). Poisons and Windfury stack on Turtle: "WF has been changed to be an 'aura' that stacks with any weapon modifier (poisons, stones etc)" [Idontcareatall (player), 2025-09-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150451#p150451) (staff: Windfury Totem became an aura in CC2). Deadly Poison does not do anything extra beyond 5 stacks [Atreidon (player), 2025-03-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121820#p121820). Envenom no longer buffs Wound Poison per a player ("wound poisonwas nerf now evenom does not buff wound poison" [Boeuff (player), 2025-05-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131534#p131534)) — single source, contradicts the CC2 staff text; unresolved.

standing.source_quality: strong on poison mechanics, rotation and the 1.18.1 nerf chain; medium on the build; post-1.18.1 raid ranking contested and thinly sourced
standing.notes: Favored for fresh and mid-geared raiders (MC-AQ tier) and contested at the top end; flat gear scaling is the stated reason. 1.18.1 cut low-rank poison AP scaling hard, reduced Noxious Assault AP scaling 35% -> 30%, weakened then partly reverted Taste for Blood, and restricted Corrosive/Dissolvent Poison to Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants and Undead.

patch_validity.notes: 1.18.1 (2026-01-23, revised 2026-03-19) cut poison AP scaling at low ranks, weakened and reworked Taste for Blood (no longer buffs Corrosive/Dissolvent, now a 2-point talent), cut Noxious Assault AP scaling 35%->30%, and restricted Corrosive/Dissolvent Poison to Elementals/Mechanicals/Giants/Undead only. No post-1.18.1 build or rotation revision exists in the corpus; the thread 'Assa build is dead 4 raiding in patch 1.18.1?' is unresolved argument, not a fix.
