rotation_aoe.action: do not toggle Blade Flurry in this spec by default
rotation_aoe.condition: costs 20% energy regen (30% pre-1.18.1) and 20% damage, starving Vigor/Noxious Assault

rotation_aoe.action: tab Noxious Assault between two targets
rotation_aoe.condition: only if both targets will live long enough to keep poisons ticking

rotation_aoe.action: no rogue AoE exists; pad with consumables (Oil of Immolation, Dragonbreath Chili)
rotation_aoe.condition: staff has said true AoE will not be added

cooldowns.name: Vanish
cooldowns.use_when: offensive re-opener / trinket swap; never use offensively while solo (resets the mob to full health)

cooldowns.name: Thistle Tea
cooldowns.use_when: burst energy when both buffs need refreshing at once

resource_rules: Baseline energy: 20 per 2 seconds
Vigor: 100% chance to gain 2 energy per poison application (no internal cooldown since 1.18.0)
Relentless Strikes returns 20 energy on 5-point finishers
Darkmantle 4-piece and Stormshroud 4-piece set procs both restore energy; stacking both is the guide-writer's stated gearing goal
Fast daggers burn poison charges quickly; carry spare poisoned weapons and a weapon-swap macro, or reapply between pulls
consumables: Instant Poison x2 (default vs any target that is not Elemental/Mechanical/Giant/Undead)
Dissolvent Poison x2 (or Dissolvent+Corrosive) vs Elementals/Mechanicals/Giants/Undead only, post-1.18.1
Deadly Poison on bosses / Instant on trash (pre-1.18.0 advice, superseded by the double-Instant consensus for the Noxious Assault build)
Thistle Tea
Oil of Immolation, Dragonbreath Chili for AoE padding
mistakes_to_avoid: Using slow, high-damage-range daggers out of Combat-spec habit instead of the fastest available
Letting Envenom or Slice and Dice drop, or refreshing both at the same time so they expire together
Waiting for 5 combo points before the first Envenom
Running Deadly/Corrosive with fast daggers (the 5-stack cap on Deadly wastes procs)
Running Dissolvent/Corrosive on anything but Elemental/Mechanical/Giant/Undead post-1.18.1 (they do not apply)
Toggling Blade Flurry on and forgetting about the energy drain
Running out of poison charges mid-fight without spares
Using DoT poisons or Rupture on a target you intend to Gouge/Blind/Sap
Ignoring hit chance (missing negates poison-application chances)
Spamming abilities at low energy instead of pooling

playbooks.title: Rogue — Combat — Melee DPS (raid / dungeon; daggers and swords)
playbooks.intro:
Covers Combat as the geared raid-DPS spec: the **Combat Daggers / Backstab** build (the forum's "endgame meta" 20/31/0 as of late 2025) and the **Combat Swords/Axes/Maces (Sinister Strike)** variant. Assassination ("Noxious Assault") is the alternative raid spec with its own playbook (`assassination-melee-dps.md`); the sources rank them by gear level and disagree at the top end.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). Kit milestones inside pre-1.18.1: CC2 (2024-10-12), 2024-12-20 round, 2025-03-30 round, 1.18.0 (2025-07-25 post; live 2025-08-15).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: melee single-target DPS with the class's only cleave (Blade Flurry) and burst (Adrenaline Rush). Staff: "This specialization is the bread and butter of all Rogues in the original Vanilla and in the current iteration of class changes" [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102971#p102971).
- **Strengths (sources)**: scales with gear far better than Assassination — "combat is running around with 700 agi and 1.3s energy ticks, dealing 2k dps" [Crake (player), 2026-03-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172282#p172282) (post-1.18.1); "20/31/0 is the endgame meta build atm for pve dps ... reach out to Premium, Perceptionz, Hedonist, or Xiaowaifu. They're all pretty solid dudes and regularly top the charts" [Bayanni (player), 2025-09-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153716#p153716); physical damage "always works" against poison-immune raid mobs [Finpin (player), 2025-04-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=127477#p127477); reliable cleave and simple rotation ("Combat should be the easiest one" [Rachdingue (player), 2025-09-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151387#p151387)).
- **Weaknesses (sources)**: gear- and hit-dependent; behind Fury/Arms warriors at every gear tier pre-1.18.0 ("around an 18% DPS difference with Warriors beating Rogues at all tiers of play" [Bigbosc (player), 2025-03-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122845#p122845)); Backstab needs positioning ("Combat dagger/sub is a bit more a pain in the ass cause you have to front backstab" [Rachdingue (player), 2025-09-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152024#p152024)); weak while leveling since 1.18.0 (see `leveling.md`); the 1.18.1 Opportunity nerf specifically targets "Combat dagger rogues ... performing tad better than with any other weapons" [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
- **Content**: raids at AQ40/Naxx/Kara40 gear — favored; dungeons at 60 — fine (cleave); leveling — contested (Combat Swords was the classic default, now called "Easily the weakest option I've tried" by one 1.18.0 leveler [Sslushee (player), 2025-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158547#p158547)); PvP — not used ("nobody uses combat rogue in pvp" [Crake (player), 2025-10-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154534#p154534)).
- **Community standing**: **favored at high gear, alternative below it** (consensus late 2025 → 2026): "AQ + gear Combat backstab spec" [Grizb37 (player), 2025-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158295#p158295); post-1.18.1 "Go COMBAT u n00bs, and learn rotations" [Mdzielak (player), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171653#p171653) vs "combat is not harder or more complex ... combat rogue has been overplayed for years" [Thesuperwitch (player), 2026-03-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172799#p172799). Earlier (2025-05): "Combat is actually still stronger than assass. Somehow" [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-05-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130645#p130645); "Around 90+% of Rogues players play Combat Spec" [Finpin, 2025-04-19]. Raid-log claim: "Rogues are among the top parsers of any single target boss in naxx, except for the ones where the mechanics handicap melees" [Kibuum (player), 2025-02-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120498#p120498) (Patchwerk excluded; "Posting parses and removing trash AND warriors is peak dishonesty" [Gantulga (player), 2025-02-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120733#p120733) — contested).
- Reputation: warriors and paladins are seen as the favored classes; rogues "bring nothing to the table" for raid buffs (consensus 2023–2025; e.g. [Exaltus (player), 2025-05-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132748#p132748)) — Improved Expose Armor is "our best buff" [Bigbosc (player), 2025-03-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122847#p122847).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
No post lists the full 51 points. Sourced allocations:

### Combat Daggers (Backstab) raid build — "20/31/0" (1.18.0 tree; 1.18.1 only lowered Opportunity)

Link (opaque): `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/rogue?points=AoYDIoY-FADoCAAoRCCYB-` [Bayanni (player), 2025-09-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153716#p153716), described as the current PvE meta and including Improved Sprint ("It's entirely to remove CC, but honestly it's not make-or-break if you put those points elsewhere in combat" [Bayanni (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153721#p153721); Akos1896 suggested 2% dodge instead).

| Tree | Talent | Points | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Assassination (20) | Malice 5, Ruthlessness 3, Improved Blade Tactics 3 (or Improved Eviscerate), Relentless Strikes 1, Lethality 5, Remorseless Attacks 2 / Murder | 20 | Bayanni's link is 20 in Assassination; the standard sub-tree is the leveling list "Malice ... Ruthlessness ... Lethality ... Relentless Strikes" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149395#p149395); "Pick up all backstab talents after (Opportunity, Lethality)" [Hctwowfan (player), 2023-08-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=55498#p55498). Exact split of the last 2–3 points is a gap. |
| Combat | Opportunity | 5/5 | moved here in 1.18.0 rev.; "Opportunity is simply too good to pass up" [Gaz (player), 2025-09-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151060#p151060) (contested value after the 1.18.1 nerf to 15%) |
| Combat | Improved Backstab | 3/3 | "improved backstab is a must" [Nightmonster, 2023-05-01]; extra-CP chance (staff) |
| Combat | Precision | 5/5 | "Pick up Precision asap ... +5% hit is a huge damage boost, especially for your offhand" [Hctwowfan, 2023-08-01]; Shananagans: "Precision and Malice (IMHO) are got to haves" |
| Combat | Dual Wield Specialization | 5/5 | "50% more off hand damage" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149434#p149434) |
| Combat | Close Quarters Combat | 2/2 | "+5% crit putting 2 points into Close Quarter Combat" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-09-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151559#p151559) |
| Combat | Blade Flurry / Blade Rush | baseline / 2/2 | Blade Rush "a must have talent for combat, regardless if you go swords, maces or daggers ... the only way (not including gear) to get more energy regeneration back" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-09-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151497#p151497) |
| Combat | Weapon Expertise | 2/2 | +3/+5 dagger skill (Nightmonster); the 20/31/0 discussion assumes it |
| Combat | Aggression | 3/3 | "Boost to main ability" [Edgarek (player), 2024-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103870#p103870) |
| Combat | Adrenaline Rush | 1/1 | burst; "rewards you an average of 150 energy in a 15 second window" [Kairion (player), 2023-09-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60554#p60554) |
| Combat | Surprise Attack | 1/1 (5th-row keystone) | "Actually good filler button to press" [Edgarek, 2024-10-19]; "surprise attack hits for like 500=550 dmg ... and have an extra combo point quickly" [player quoted in f63, 2024-12] |
| Combat | Combat Expertise (row 5) / Deflection / Lightning Reflexes / Riposte / Improved Sprint | filler | Deflection+Riposte "5 points for only 5% increase on parry ... Don't rely on a 10% chance RNG" [Shananagans, 2025-08-30] (solo context); Bayanni takes Improved Sprint |

Shananagans' own PvE combat-daggers link (leveling/dungeon, "Higher crit percentage with daggers, 50% more off hand damage, lower crit damage on backstab and ambush"): `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/rogue?points=Co-FADoCAAoQC-FAY` [2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149434#p149434).

### Combat Swords / Axes / Maces variant (Sinister Strike)

Sourced only as leveling/"tried and true" builds: 31-point PvE sword build link `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/rogue?points=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAaAoYIBAoBSCYBAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` and "Try to get Riposte asap. It's very strong while leveling" [Yasara (player), 2024-11-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108703#p108703); "Many dungeons feature good blue sword from quests. So I think that going combat+sword is most reliable option" [Xudo (player), 2025-03-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123674#p123674); "Easiest to gear - combat swords" [Noephix (player), 2025-05-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132954#p132954). Replace Opportunity/Improved Backstab/CQC with Hack and Slash 2/2 (swords+axes) or Concussive Blows (maces; "mace spec, is useless in PvE, as the boss cant be stun" [Nightmonster, 2023-05-01]) and Improved Sinister Strike is baseline. No raid-parse source for swords after 1.18.0; the "endgame meta" post is daggers. Human sword/mace racial and Orc axe racial matter for weapon skill (Nightmonster; Shiniestskritt's question [2024-12-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113405#p113405) unanswered).

### Patch validity

1.18.0 builds; 1.18.1 changed Opportunity (weaker, still taken — no source says to drop it) and Blade Flurry's energy penalty (better). Bayanni's link is dated 2025-09-29 and predates the 1.18.1 announcement; no post-1.18.1 full build is posted.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- **Hit first**: 9% special-attack cap ("the 9% hit cap is easy to be reached with some +hit gear" [Nightmonster, 2023-05-01]; "warriors & rogues dont go for the insane 27% hitcap for dualwielding" [player in f63, 2024-11]); "if you're above hitcap, but not pushing crit cap, then hit is effectively a near nil increase ... Inversely if you're at the crit cap, Crit is now useless and Agility loses a huge chunk of its value, but Hit is now a premium" [Poxfox (player), 2024-06-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=96625#p96625).
- **Weapon skill 305/315**: "with raical bonus (300+5) ... 9% hit cap is easy to be reached"; "you can get lv1 weapon mastery for 308 weapon skill (optimum)" [Nightmonster, 2023-05-01]; "The higher the skill the more you push misses and glancing blows off the hit table" [Shananagans, 2025-10-13].
- **Agility / crit / AP**: agility now also drives energy regeneration through Blade Rush — measured "With 165 agi a tick took aprox 1,7-1,8 seconds. So I'd say 100 agi = 0.1seconds" [Rachdingue (player), 2025-09-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151549#p151549) (single measurement; Shananagans' earlier guess "1 agility = 1 ms" was withdrawn as a guess [2025-09-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151509#p151509)); Crake's post-1.18.1 "700 agi and 1.3s energy ticks" matches ~0.1 s per 100 agi. Crit cap must be watched: "Going over crit cap has to be monitored more closely than combat (unless your are running close to BIS gear)" [Shananagans, 2025-09-12]; "I was at my crit cap of 28%,( without buffs)" at 57 in dungeon gear (Shananagans, 2025-09-13) — player figure.
- **Haste**: "The general consensus for most melees seems to be that an equal amount of crit outperforms an equal amount of haste, as haste only affects autohits" [Atreidon (player), 2024-04-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=92096#p92096); for rogues "its worse than bhb [Blackhand's Breadth], since you have flurry up all the time ... and neither energy regen nor style dmg is impacted by haste" [Atreidon, same day](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=92099#p92099). A Turtle-updated rogue DPS spreadsheet is pinned in the Rogue section of the Turtle WoW Discord [Likaleo (player), 2024-05-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=94963#p94963) (not in corpus).
- **Armor penetration**: "ARP is a wild card stat that doesn't even do anything in many cases" [Gantulga (player), 2024-05-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95023#p95023).
- **Leveling**: Precision first, then whatever; see `leveling.md`.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation (daggers)
rotationSingle.markdown:
1. Opener from stealth if the pull allows: Garrote ("Garote is normal boss opener" [ValiantBV (player), 2025-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122337#p122337)) or Ambush/Cheap Shot; in raids usually none ("Nowadays players must wait out of stealth for tank to pull" [Artashir (player), 2025-11-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160776#p160776)).
2. **Backstab** is the only filler: "You are combat DAGGER. Ghostly strike and Sinister strike are absolutely awful while using daggers. Your filler ability is backstab!" [Atreidon (player), 2025-04-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128331#p128331). Stay behind the target.
3. **Slice and Dice** up at all times (first finisher, 2–5 points; "I don't see a mention of slice and dice... you are using slice and dice, yes?" [Stealiebones (player), 2025-04-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128330#p128330)); "their damage in PvE is built mostly on boosting their white damage by Expose Armor and Slice&Dice. Eviscerate is used when (de)buffs from those finishers are up and not going to fade soon" [player in f63, 2024-12].
4. **Expose Armor** (Improved) if no warrior keeps Sunder up; otherwise skip (consensus).
5. **Rupture** at 5 points on long fights ("I know you are using Rupture and not Eviscerates" [Shananagans, 2025-12-13]; "keep up Rupture on boss and Eviscerate for spare combo points" [ValiantBV, 2025-03-12]); **Eviscerate** at 5 when the target will die before Rupture pays off or it is bleed-immune.
6. **Surprise Attack** whenever it lights up (after a dodge) — macro it ahead of the builder: "/cast Surprise Attack /cast Sinister Strike ... It will cast SA if available, otherwise cast SS" [madferret (player), 2025-07-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141662#p141662); Roid-Macros buff-conditional version by [Elisleris (player), 2025-03-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123951#p123951).
7. Poisons: Instant on both hands by default (raid mobs are often poison-immune anyway); Dissolvent/Corrosive only on Elemental/Mechanical/Giant/Undead post-1.18.1 (see `assassination-melee-dps.md` for the poison table); the Naxx question "consecrated sharpening stones or some combination of poison" has no answer in the corpus (gap).

Swords variant: Sinister Strike replaces Backstab; everything else identical (Yasara; Roxanneflowers' 2020 build discussion). A typical wrong rotation that under-performed (275 vs 350–425 DPS in similar gear): "BS, S&D, Ghostly Strike/SS, Evisc" [RecenRogue (player), 2025-04-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128007#p128007) — the fix was "backstab only" and better macros ("Something that seperates good dps from bad most of the time comes down to optimal macros" [Gildark (player), 2025-04-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128334#p128334)).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE
rotationAoe.markdown:
- 2–3 targets: **toggle Blade Flurry on** — it is the class's cleave and "imho has changed in 1.18 for the better for combat rogue. no cool down and you can toggle it on and off" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-08-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148289#p148289); toggle it **off** as soon as only one target remains (−20% damage, −20% energy while active, staff). Spam-safe macros: "/cast [nomybuff:Blade_Flurry] Blade Flurry" (on) and "/cast [mybuff:Blade_Flurry] Blade Flurry" (off), Roid Macros required [Snkx (player), 2025-11-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160336#p160336). Pre-1.18.0 habit "/cast blade flurry /cast adrenaline rush" [Balake (player), 2023-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60501#p60501) still applies for burst windows.
- 4+ targets: still only Blade Flurry (hits one extra target); rogues "are the only class without any baseline aoe" [Derrurak (player), 2023-06-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49203#p49203) — accept low AoE parses; grenades/Oil of Immolation are the only pad.
- Combat is "the AoE spec" only relatively: "If you really, really want some form of AoE, play combat" [SvenS2 (player), 2025-05-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132963#p132963).

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Adrenaline Rush** (3 min): on pull after SnD/Expose are up, and on every cleave pack with Blade Flurry; "you rely much on Blade Flurry and Adrenaline Rush to pump out damage for a short period of time" [Finpin, 2025-04-19].
- **Blade Flurry**: a toggle, not a cooldown — see AoE; keep it off on single target.
- **Energy**: 20 per 2 s baseline, faster with agility via Blade Rush (above); Relentless Strikes returns 20 on 5-point finishers; Darkmantle 4-piece "lets you actually press buttons more often" [Sagabal (player), 2025-05-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132721#p132721); Thistle Tea; T3.5 Trickster 5-set proc measured at "15% instead of 20% as description" post-1.18.1 [Hcyd (player), 2026-03-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172499#p172499) (single report, unanswered).
- **Vanish** = second trinket set/opener in raids ("we can access 4 trinkets on a fight with vanish" [Bigbosc, 2025-03-18]); Evasion/Sprint 4 min (staff CC2); Preparation is not in this build.
- **Threat**: Feint; Vanish as an aggro reset (Shananagans' TankPlates colour rule).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Behind the target at all times (Backstab); on fights that force front positioning switch to Sinister Strike or expect a big loss.
- Interrupt casters with Kick (Deadly Throw as ranged backup, shares Kick's cooldown).
- Raid utility rogues do bring: Improved Expose Armor ("largest armor drop in the game" [Jinkarasu (player), 2025-08-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148542#p148542)), Distract for skips, disarming traps (BWL Suppression Room: "Only time you might want more is suppression room in BWL" [Bayanni (player), 2023-10-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=70147#p70147)), Vanish to avoid mechanics ("avoid certain mechanics like Webspray on Maexxna" [Bigbosc, 2025-03-18]).
- Riposte in dungeons when tanking-adjacent (needs a parry and an armed target).
- Combo points persist per target since CC2; "Combo points are kept on Target A when you switch to Target B ... if you apply a Combo Point to Target B, your points on Target A will be lost" [Redmagejoe (player), 2024-11-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107038#p107038) — so Kick/Gouge on an add costs nothing, but a builder on the add wipes the boss's points.

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **BiS lists**: "It's basically the same, world buffs or not. The only difference is probably the Sandstalker's Shroud simming a tiiiny bit higher ... Dagger goblins also do a bit better with Claw of the Frost Wyrm instead of another dagger" [Gantulga (player), 2024-05-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95023#p95023) — i.e. the vanilla Naxx BiS `(vanilla baseline, not from turtlecraft.gg)` with the Turtle spreadsheet from the Discord as the reference. Post-Naxx: Trickster (T3.5, Kara40) pieces appear in the PvP BiS list [Brisspvp (player), 2024-12-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112831#p112831) (see `subtlety-pvp.md`); Bonescythe/Trickster are Shananagans' end targets.
- **Weapons**: Naxx trash Harbinger of Doom (23044) and item 23221 "Both are better than r14 counterparts", plus chest 23226 [Erhog (player), 2024-04-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=93059#p93059); "If you don't want to farm naxx trash then just get a Teebu's" [Gantulga (player), 2024-04-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=93061#p93061); rep weapons: The Lobotomizer (19324, AV exalted), Glacial Blade (19099, AV revered), WSG revered blades/swords [Xudo (player), 2024-04-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=92998#p92998); crafted BoE swords 17015/65008 exist but are "terrible" (Elisleris/Gantulga); Distracting Dagger off-hand, Alcor's Sunrazor (pre-raid, Likaleo's fresh-60 list [2024-01-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=86159#p86159): "farm AV for that epic dagger + epic ring. Then buy alcor sunrazor dagger"); pre-1.18.0 "We rock perditions blade or maladath, with Felstriker or Thunderfury" [Thesmugsilence (player), 2023-08-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=57276#p57276) `(vanilla baseline)`. Fast off-hand for poison procs is the classic layout.
- **Sets**: Darkmantle 4-set (energy proc) "used so much for so long" [Sagabal, 2025-05-23]; Shadowcraft 6-set proc discussion [Poxfox, 2024-06-09]; "5/8 T1 and 4/9 T3" or "D1 + T3" for PvP [S4rs (player), 2024-12-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113880#p113880).
- **Enchants**: +15 Agility on weapons (Shananagans) or Crusader (contested by spec; no combat-specific ruling in the corpus).
- **Consumables**: Instant Poison ×2 (or stones — unresolved for Naxx undead), Thistle Tea, Mongoose, jujus, food, Oil of Immolation/Dragonbreath Chili for packs, Free Action/Restorative for mechanics. Engineering is "the best for rogues" per players [B3tabob (player), 2022-08-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=23187#p23187) (unanswered question about Leatherworking — gap).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes (bots must avoid)
mistakes.markdown:
- Using Sinister Strike or Ghostly Strike with daggers (Atreidon).
- Forgetting Slice and Dice (Stealiebones).
- Leaving Blade Flurry on during single target, or toggling it off/on with a spam macro (Snkx's separate on/off macros).
- Applying a builder to an add (wipes the boss's combo points) — use Kick/Gouge only.
- Not being hit-capped before stacking crit (Poxfox); ignoring crit cap with world-buff-free raids is not an issue, but with raid buffs at Naxx gear it is (Shananagans).
- Expecting to top Patchwerk-style meters against warriors pre-1.18.1 (Bigbosc's 18%); bragging about parses that exclude warriors (Gantulga).
- Using Blade Flurry to level (energy starvation: "1.18 absolutely fucked blade flurry ... only ever gets better very much later on when you got agility based increase in energy reg ticks" [Hctwowfan (player), 2025-09-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151505#p151505)).

extraSections.heading: Official kit (staff)
extraSections.markdown:
- CC2 [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102971#p102971): Improved Sinister Strike baseline (SS 40 energy) → Swift Strikes (removed in 1.18.0); **Improved Backstab also gives 15/30/45% chance of an extra combo point**; Setup moved to Combat row 3; Blade Flurry moved to row 3 without 20% haste; Mace Specialization → **Concussive Blows** (stun only); **Close Quarters Combat** 2 points, daggers/fists/maces +2/5% crit; **Surprise Attack** keystone (after a dodge; 2024-12-20: instant, 25% AP, 10-s CD, 10 energy; cannot be blocked/dodged/parried since 2024-11-01); **Hack and Slash** (swords+axes, 2/5% extra attack, 2 points); **Blade Rush**; Weapon Expertise includes maces; Aggression 3/6/10% incl. Riposte/Surprise Attack; Endurance removed (Sprint/Evasion 4 min baseline); Sword/Dagger Specialization → Hack and Slash / CQC.
- 2024-12-20 [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460): Relentless Strikes 20 energy + stacking 5%/stack finisher damage (5 stacks, 30 s); finishers −5 energy; **Adrenaline Rush 3 min**; Blade Rush −15/30 s BF cooldown and +10/20% attack speed (pre-1.18.0 version).
- 1.18.0 [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159): **Blade Flurry baseline at 30 as a toggle** (no duration, 4-s cooldown, −30% energy regeneration, −20% damage while active); Swift Strikes removed; Improved Expose Armor → Combat row 1 (revision 2025-08-14: **Opportunity → Combat row 1**, Improved Gouge and Improved Expose Armor → Subtlety row 1); **Blade Rush → row 6: "+2/5% melee attack speed and reduces the time between your Energy regeneration ticks by an amount equal to your Agility"**; Combat Expertise → row 5; Lethality/Remorseless include Surprise Attack.
- **1.18.1** [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071): **Opportunity 4/8/12/16/20% → 3/6/9/12/15%** ("Combat dagger rogues are performing tad better than with any other weapons, this nerf will bring them more in line"); **Blade Flurry energy penalty 30% → 20%**; poison low-rank scaling reduced (Instant VI unchanged at 5% AP).
- Hotfixes: Riposte no longer works on unarmed enemies after a January 2025 change per a player ("does not work for me, on all enemies who 'do not have a weapon in the main hand'" [Dzikcrakehall (player), 2025-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117517#p117517), bug report 11334) — player report, no staff line in the corpus; "Weapon Expertise" gives +3/+5 weapon skill, not 3/5% — confirmed by a GM in-game per the poster after the website calculator showed % [Nightmonster (player), 2023-05-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=43985#p43985).

playbooks.title: Rogue — Subtlety — Support melee DPS (raid / dungeon, "sub support")
playbooks.intro:
Turtle rebuilt Subtlety in CC2 (1.17.2) as "a specialization that focuses on supporting their allies" [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102971#p102971). This playbook covers that PvE support role. Subtlety's PvP use (Hemorrhage/Preparation) is in `subtlety-pvp.md`; the Ambush/Backstab leveling use of the early Subtlety talents is in `leveling.md`.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). Kit milestones: CC2 2024-10-12; 2024-12-20 (Tricks of the Trade 12 s); 2025-03-30 (Hemorrhage 110%); 1.18.0 2025-07-25 (Shadow of Death, Cloaked in Shadows, Blackjack, Mark for Death rework, Preparation 7 min). 1.18.1 made **no Subtlety changes** [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: melee DPS whose value is party/raid buffs (Hemorrhage +2% physical damage taken debuff up to 50 charges/15 s, Tricks of the Trade party crit, Mark for Death party AP/SP, Improved Expose Armor) plus defensive utility (Cloaked in Shadows shield, Blackjack/Blinding Haze damage/hit debuffs, Smoke Bomb, Improved Ghostly Strike party speed).
- **Strengths (sources)**: "the largest, most consistent benefit is the 4% physical damage increase that hemorrhage grants the raid. As long as you're spamming hemo, that should never really fall off. Additionally the improved access to Improved Expose Armor means you have the largest armor drop in the game" [Jinkarasu (player), 2025-08-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148542#p148542) (his "4%" is the CC2-era Bloody-Mess-boosted value; the current staff text is 2% base ×2 with Bloody Mess); "The defensive options make it crazy good for progression and any buff to a warr tank means better threat gen while maintaining high mitigation" [Cheruscan (player), 2025-08-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148648#p148648); "fire shaman and fire mage especially flipping love the support rogue buffing their dps" [Atreidon (player), 2025-11-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160348#p160348).
- **Weaknesses (sources)**: personal damage "equal to fucking tanks" [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-05-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130645#p130645); "the dps loss for the benefits of sub comparing to other classes/speccs is definetly too high" [Asystol (player), 2025-09-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152935#p152935); buffs are **party-wide only** ("locked into melee grps or he himself is loosing a lot of punch" [Atreidon, 2025-11-22]); Tricks of the Trade uptime is nearly impossible without high gear ("you're asking sub pve rogues to spend 160-170 energy with an energy income of 140" [Jinkarasu (player), 2025-08-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=146058#p146058); "It's impossible to get the stack permanently" [Rachdingue (player), 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152399#p152399)); Cloaked in Shadows' absorb still breaks stealth [Tankmeister (player), 2025-09-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153426#p153426); Smoke Bomb "affects ALL within the area, not just allies ... FIVE MINUTE cooldown" [Tankmeister (player), 2025-10-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153929#p153929).
- **Content**: raid progression melee groups — niche/alternative; dungeons — playable but not needed; leveling — not recommended solo ("I do not recommend going full sub if you are solo leveling some big talents rely on your party" [Rachdingue (player), 2025-09-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152174#p152174)); PvP — a different build (see `subtlety-pvp.md`).
- **Community standing**: **niche and disliked by most rogues, occasionally demanded by raid leaders** (consensus on both halves). "I run a rogue only guild a no rogue I talked to in or out of it likes the sub tree" [Blindtongue (player), 2024-12-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112978#p112978); "It's merely a humiliation spec now" [Gantulga (player), 2025-04-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126500#p126500); vs "guildmaster said sub specced rogs would have prior for raid spot over a Assa rog or survival hunter because they add buffs to the raid" [Boomcat (player), 2025-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152774#p152774); "I don't really agree in calling it a 'support' spec in a general sense. It's like calling feral druid a support spec because it has leader of the pack" [Crake (player), 2025-08-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148397#p148397). A raider's summary: "Sub should perform below combat but should way outdo tanks" (does not, in his view) [Akos1896 (player), 2025-02-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120488#p120488).
- Contested claim: "some sub dude pushed higest dps on patchwerk" — dismissed as "either badly informed or manipulate you for buffs" [Akos1896 (player), 2025-09-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152698#p152698); "Sub has the biggest damage increase of all the specs if you factor in utility" [Snadileoboy (player), 2025-09-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152706#p152706). Sub rogues do appear on Patchwerk logs [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-05-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=133341#p133341).

Patch validity: all 1.18.0; 1.18.1 changed nothing in Subtlety.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown: Only indirect statements: **hit cap first** ("If a single hemo fails for any reason (miss, block, dodge, parry), or the finisher does for any reason, you drop the stacks" [Jinkarasu, 2025-08-16]), then **crit** (feeds Honor Among Thieves) and **agility/AP** ("Deadlines (NEW): It increases attack power, which is the best stat for Subtlety rogues" in a rework proposal [Lomikare1 (player), 2026-01-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165103#p165103) — proposal, not a measurement). Mark for Death scales with the rogue's AP (staff). Weapon: "With non-dagger sub" slow main hand is implied by hemo normalisation ("normalized hemo speed by the way which will kill it for both PvP and solo boss farming" [Gantulga (player), 2024-10-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103938#p103938)); no source gives weights. Gap.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown:
Derived from Jinkarasu's energy accounting and Atreidon's description (both 2025):

1. Opener (if any): Garrote (Serrated Blades) — or nothing in raids.
2. **Hemorrhage** as the only builder; keep the debuff on the boss (50 charges/15 s; a melee-heavy raid eats charges fast).
3. **Improved Expose Armor** first (if the raid relies on it), then **Slice and Dice**, then **Tricks of the Trade** procs: use 4–5-point finishers every ≤12 s to keep the 2 stacks ("the timer requires you to spend 4 Hemos and 1 finisher (160-170 energy) every 12 seconds"). Finisher choice: Expose Armor when it needs refreshing, else Slice and Dice, else Rupture/Eviscerate.
4. **Mark for Death** on cooldown, aligned with the party's cooldowns (8 s); with Preparation (7 min) a second use.
5. **Shadow of Death** at 5 points when the party is bursting (it stores a percentage of damage taken by the target); costs 30 energy, "means dropping the tricks stacks" (Jinkarasu) — accept the trade in burst windows.
6. Distract (with Blinding Haze) and Blind (Blackjack) for the −hit / −damage debuffs only on hard-hitting adds; both cost Tricks uptime.
7. Cloaked in Shadows: Vanish when the party takes a predictable raid-wide hit (6/12% max-HP shield for 20 s) — do not expect to stay stealthed.

Alternative "bleed" rotation: "There is also a possibility for a good rotation with Garrote/Rupture/Slice and Dice, but even if you force full concentration on this - the dmg output itself is too low" [Asystol, 2025-09-24].

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE
rotationAoe.markdown: Blade Flurry is baseline but costs energy the spec cannot spare (see `assassination-melee-dps.md`); Hemorrhage on each add helps the melee group; no other AoE. Tricks stacks drop during target swaps.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- Energy is the binding constraint: baseline income ~140 per 12 s vs 160–170 spent; Honor Among Thieves "increases your energy income to 180" only "in a hyper optimized environment" (Jinkarasu); Relentless Strikes 20 per 5-point finisher; Shadowcraft/Darkmantle energy procs recommended (Jinkarasu); Thistle Tea.
- Preparation (7 min) resets Vanish (Cloaked in Shadows), Mark for Death, Blind, Sprint — "allowing you to re-apply all support effects instantly" (staff, 1.18.0).
- Vanish is a support cooldown here, not an aggro drop; Feint for threat as usual.

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Be in the melee party that benefits most (warriors/rogues; or the fire caster group if the raid prefers Mark for Death's SP) — the buffs are party-only (Atreidon).
- Keep Hemorrhage on the raid's kill target at all times; re-apply immediately on target swaps.
- Improved Sap (Blackjack) makes some dungeon pulls easier (Jinkarasu); Distract for skips.
- Expect raid leaders to ask for this spec on progression and rogues to resent it (both sides sourced above); bots should not volunteer it as "top DPS".

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown: No Subtlety-specific gear source beyond "shadowcraft's energy proc bonus" being nearly required [Jinkarasu, 2025-08-27] and generic hit/crit gear. Consumables as for Combat (Thistle Tea, poisons: Instant/Instant; Blind needs Blinding Powder; Vanish needs Flash Powder). Gap.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes (bots must avoid)
mistakes.markdown:
- Playing it solo/leveling ("Sub is terrible right now. It has never been a PvE spec" is the PvP-side view [SvenS2 (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157944#p157944)); the tree's support talents "rely on your party" (Rachdingue).
- Letting Hemorrhage fall off; using Sinister Strike/Backstab instead of Hemorrhage.
- Trying to Vanish-stealth mid-fight with Cloaked in Shadows (absorb breaks stealth).
- Wasting Tricks stacks by spending energy on Distract/Smoke Bomb/Gouge without a reason.
- Smoke Bomb on top of the raid's melee: it reduces the hit chance of everyone inside, enemies and allies.
- Reapplying Mark for Death from a second rogue expecting stacking (it only refreshes; staff CC2 note on Exploit Vulnerability).

playbooks.title: Rogue — Assassination — PvP ("Noxious/poison zug" build)
playbooks.intro:
The 1.18.0 Assassination kit produced a PvP variant that trades control for raw poison damage. Sources agree it is strong against plate/armor and weak against players who survive the opener; it triggered the loudest "nerf rogues" threads of late 2025. See `subtlety-pvp.md` for the control builds and shared PvP material (races, BG roles, gear).

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: burst/pressure melee in BGs and world PvP; "Poison rogues are a pve spec. They pump damage, but are terrible at control. It is the equivalent of getting beat up by a combat spec rogue back in vanilla. If they outgear you, they will destroy you, but if you can survive the burst, they will flop instantly" [Crake (player), 2025-10-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153979#p153979).
- **Strengths (sources)**: "poison works perfect against plate characters. If you are horde you will be fighting paladins 90% of the time so it's worth it" [Rachdingue (player), 2025-09-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152457#p152457); "Rogues are (outrageously) melting thru Tanks like butter" [Manletow (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153725#p153725); "Now they're actually a threat to me in bear form. Before I jus laughed at them with 14k armor" [Grizb37 (player, feral), 2025-10-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153923#p153923); "good damage against plate, but no prep and slows. I guess for BG's it's viable" [Gottabe (player), 2026-04-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174771#p174771) (post-1.18.1); gear-agnostic ("fresh 60s should not be completely cucked out of participating in pvp" — Crake defending it).
- **Weaknesses (sources)**: "as an assassination rogue, I sacrifice control (won't get a max kidney shot, won't get slow from crippling poison)" [Tankmeister (player), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154255#p154255); "Assassination rogues are just glass cannons without much control, and still do less damage than arcane mages, and they need to be in melee range ... good luck Pvping with no crippling, and mind numbing for casters. its just a zug spec that dies to anyone with half a brain cell" [Snkx (player), 2025-10-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154789#p154789); fast attacks "suffer heavily from thorns effects" and can be blocked to 0 damage so the poison cannot proc [Crake (player), 2025-10-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154550#p154550).
- **Community standing**: **contested — "broken" to non-rogues, "zug spec" to rogues**. Non-rogue: "Rogues are totally broken atm" [Aristany (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156423#p156423); "One or two dissolvent rogues and your holy pal is done for" [Turboman (player), 2026-03-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170555#p170555); "No rogue nerf yet? ... A plain -30% damage should be ok" [Manolothegreat (player), 2026-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173527#p173527) (post-1.18.1). Rogue side: "the only difference between instant and dissolvent is nature vs physical, at the expense of less damage. People in pvp don't stack tonnes of nature resist, so instant poison is 100% the better option" [Crake, 2025-10-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154534#p154534). Staff reaction: 1.18.1 poison low-rank scaling cuts, Noxious Assault 30% AP, Taste for Blood nerf and the Physical-poison creature restriction (see `assassination-melee-dps.md`), plus PvP dampening referenced by players ("Everyone give up playing rogues in pvp after adding pvp dampening?" [Gottabe (player), 2026-04-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175159#p175159), unanswered).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
Same as the PvE Noxious Assault build (`assassination-melee-dps.md`): deep Assassination to Noxious Assault, Precision, Dual Wield Specialization; no Preparation, no Dirty Deeds ("if a rogue is specced into noxious assault, that means they DONT have dirty deeds OR preparation. This means their cheap shot is 60 energy, not 40" [Crake, 2025-10-02]). "for pvp you want Seal of Fate" [Kerenis (player), 2025-09-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152446#p152446) (single source; contradicts the PvE advice to drop it at low crit). Gottabe's post-1.18.1 description: "Noxious assault build, with fast daggers, both Instant poisons"; a hybrid "Hemo/Evenom ... like classic hemo, but with evenom (cripling + instant poison), have prep ... Using slow weapon on mainhand and fast offhand. I belive this build better against clothies" [Gottabe, 2026-04-11] — the hybrid needs Envenom at Assassination row 5 plus deep Subtlety; no link given.

Patch validity: 1.18.0 builds; 1.18.1 nerfed the numbers (NA 30% AP, Taste for Blood) and restricted Dissolvent/Corrosive to Elementals/Mechanicals/Giants/Undead, so the "dissolvent vs plate" advice is **superseded** (players are plate, not giants) — post-patch, Instant is the only damage poison vs players, and a feral reports Instant hitting "220-250/hit" [Wosator (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171992#p171992).

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown: Fast daggers (1.3) for proc rate; hit; crit/agility; stamina. Same reasoning as PvE (Jinkarasu, Shananagans); no PvP-specific weights. Gap.

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target
rotationAoe.markdown: None; the build has no cleave use in PvP; combo points persist per target (CC2).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Pick fights against plate/high-armor targets and healers who cannot kite; avoid casters that can root/kite and ferals that survive the opener.
- BG objectives as for any rogue (see `subtlety-pvp.md`).
- Expect insignia/trinket plays: with no Preparation, one trinket ends the control — commit only when the opener can kill.
- Duel etiquette in the sources: warriors complain about "acid poison"; players advise Blessing of Sanctuary, blocking fast hits to 0 and thorns as counters (Crake, 2025-10-06).

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: As PvE Assassination plus PvP stamina pieces; Brisspvp's PvP BiS list is dagger-oriented (Kingsfall MH, Harbinger of Doom OH) but written before 1.18.0 — for this build the sources prefer 1.3-speed daggers over slow Naxx daggers (Shananagans). New 1.18.1 PvP items with DoT/crit reduction exist (Gottabe) — untested in the corpus.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Spending combo points on Envenom then expecting a full Kidney (Crake).
- Using Dissolvent on players post-1.18.1 (it no longer applies).
- Fighting a target with thorns/Retribution Aura/Blessing of Sanctuary with 1.3 daggers (Crake).
- Staying in melee at 0 energy instead of resetting.

extraSections.heading: Opener and kill sequence (Crake's energy accounting, 1.18.0, pre-PvP-dampening)
extraSections.markdown:
"60 energy 4 second stun cheap shot -> 4 second stun = 2 energy ticks, so they get to 90 energy (sin rogues have 110 energy) meaning they can pop 2 noxious assaults, however then they wouldn't have any energy left over for a kidney, so they need to cheap shot -> noxious assault -> kidney shot at 4 combo points, meaning they lose out on a 6 second kidney, and instead only get a 4 second. That's 2 more energy ticks, with an 80% chance to refund the kidney, so they get at most another 40 energy ... giving another 2 noxious assaults ... each noxious assualt does approximately 300-400 armor-affected damage, plus two lots of 250ish poison damage ... about 800 damage total against an armored opponent ... That's 2400 damage, plus auto attacks ... 12 autos at 30% proc chance ... So you'll end up taking ~3150 - 3400 damage total. Yes that's a lot. Except the rogue is now at 0 energy. And you're not stunned" [Crake (player), 2025-10-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153979#p153979).

Practical sequence (union of Crake and Tankmeister):

1. Cheap Shot from stealth (60 energy).
2. **Envenom at 1–2 points immediately** ("I cheap shot -> pop envenom immediately, and refresh when needed" [Tankmeister, 2025-10-03]) — Crake notes this "will completely cuck your combo points and make your kidney do jack all" (4–5 s Kidney instead of 6): choose Envenom for damage vs Kidney length for control.
3. Noxious Assault ×2 → Kidney Shot at 4 points → Noxious Assault ×2 → Blind if trinketed (no Preparation to redo it).
4. Thistle Tea for one more Noxious Assault in the stun.
5. If the target survives at 0 energy: Sprint/Vanish out — "if you can survive the burst, they will flop instantly".

Poisons: Instant/Instant (Crake, Snkx); Dissolvent only vs Undead/Elemental/Giant/Mechanical after 1.18.1 (players are none of these); Crippling in the off-hand costs damage but restores a slow — Gottabe's hemo/envenom hybrid does this.

playbooks.title: Rogue — Subtlety — PvP (Hemorrhage/Preparation and Ambush/Backstab dagger builds)
playbooks.intro:
The forum treats rogue PvP as its own topic with two Subtlety-based builds (the classic **Hemo/Prep** control build and the **Ambush/Backstab dagger** burst build) and one Assassination build (`assassination-pvp.md`). This file covers the two Subtlety builds, battleground roles, matchups, races and PvP gear.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). Kit milestones affecting PvP: CC2 (Hemorrhage normalised/2%, Crippling II 60%, Wound Poison rework, Sprint/Evasion 4 min, combo points persist), 1.18.0 (Quickfooted +7%, Blind is Physical, Blackjack, Preparation 7 min, Cloaked in Shadows), and the server-side "PvP dampening" / battleground damage-reduction debuff and Insignia changes referenced by players (not in the rogue sources as staff text).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: control-and-burst duelist and objective player (flag rooms, ninja caps, EFC hunting).
- **Strengths (sources)**: "You have far more ability to control and lock down with pvp spec rogue, the energy management is better, you can build up to a full 5 combo point kidney with 100% reliability ... you have all of your cooldowns TWICE" [Crake (player), 2025-10-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154550#p154550); "a bis rogue will bring a bis geared ele with tank talents down to 30% health in the first stunlock and with a blind follow up, only way to not die in cc chain is to use trinket + lip on second stunlock, or LAP" [amanagor (player), 2025-02-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119488#p119488); "as a rogue you have the benedit of not needing to take bad matchups" [Atreidon (player), 2025-06-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137578#p137578).
- **Weaknesses (sources)**: no DoT removal ("rogue is way too vulnerable to dots in PvP" [Gantulga (player), 2023-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=79632#p79632)); loses to paladins, ferals (bear), and orc stun resists; stealth is janky on Turtle ("It feels like the tick rate for noticing other players in stealth is like 1 second" [Crake (player), 2025-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158381#p158381); mobs see through stealth [Grizb37 (player), 2025-11-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158386#p158386)); pets keep chasing after Vanish ("Stealth will not get rid of pets chasing you. But vanish will" [Kairion (player), 2023-03-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=36946#p36946)); Insignias remove Blind/stuns.
- **Community standing — contested over time**: 2023–early 2025 "rogue is the worst class for pvp on twow" [Feomatar (player), 2023-12-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=80230#p80230), "Rogue is lower mid tier in PvP here" [Gantulga (player), 2023-12-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=80259#p80259) vs "rogue is actually quite good in pvp currently. Its just a skill issue with most rogues not understanding their role in bgs" [amanagor (player), 2025-02-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119499#p119499). From 1.18.0 (Aug 2025) the outside view flips: "rogue was also buffed into total faceroll territory" [Terrydavis (player), 2025-10-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156307#p156307); "Shaman, Pala, Rogues are good classes for PVP" [Tomogwarrior (player), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171638#p171638) (post-1.18.1). Rogues themselves say the real killers are hemo/prep players, not poison rogues: "Every time I've died to a semi competent rogue in pvp in the last week or so, it's been a hemo rogue, not a noxious assault rogue" [Crake, 2025-10-06].

talents.heading: Talent builds
talents.markdown:
### Hemo/Prep control build (1.18.0 tree)

"The pure vanilla pvp sub rogue talent build is still perfectly doable, with a few bonus extras" — link `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/rogue?points=YoaAKADYYI--FLCYYBCARC` [Crake (player), 2025-10-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153977#p153977). Verbal content from Crake's matchup posts: **Hemorrhage** ("a 35 energy combo point builder when fully talented" — 40 base −5 Bloody Mess), **Dirty Deeds** ("reduces your cost of cheap shot by 20 energy"), **Initiative** ("increases the number of combo points that cheap shot generates from 2 to 3"), **Blackjack/Improved Sap** ("the ability to remain stealthed when sapping"), **Preparation**, plus Improved Sprint from Combat and Elusiveness. Muffanzo's older advice (CC1 tree): "if you don't take master of deception for pvp you are going to have a bad time" (now Camouflage); "Setup could be dropped and put into serrated blades giving you the ability to pick up hemo which costs less energy then sinister strike and combos very well with dirty deeds"; "I don't understand the point of going that deep into combat if you are not going to pick up riposte as well which can be very good in pvp"; links `talents.turtlecraft.gg/rogue/KXC6U1-I-U2X02K86` (enough hit) / `CX06O-IC5-U2X02K86` (needs hit) [Muffanzo (player), 2023-05-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=46112#p46112) (pre-CC2 codes). Other named PvP talents: Improved Gouge (5-s gouge = restealth or bandage window) and Elusiveness in the leveling PvP path [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149395#p149395); "improve throwing instantly applying crippling is really solid improve sap prep is really solid combat silence on kick or just reposte when you parry disarming is solid since 90 % of the PVPer don't use a chain" [boeuf (player), 2025-05-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=129671#p129671). Weapons: "Using slow weapon on mainhand and fast offhand" [Gottabe (player), 2026-04-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174771#p174771).

### Ambush/Backstab dagger build

"For PVP I think this is what I would probably run. Ambush/Backstab - Oh ya!" link `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/rogue?points=-FQDYCDQAQB-FDaYDISABIQ`; "you could take out the 3 points in precision and put them in to lightening reflexes if you have some hit gear" [Shananagans (guide writer), 2025-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162679#p162679) (self-declared theory). "At BGs Go for ambush/backstab dagger spec instead of hemo build ... if you are in a duel with a druid, try hemo spec for more control" [Caesa (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139302#p139302). "for pvp you want Seal of Fate" [Kerenis (player), 2025-09-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152446#p152446). "backstab builds can easily spec into prep as well, AND they can pick up improved sprint" [Crake (player), 2025-10-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153979#p153979).

Patch validity: Crake's and Shananagans' links are 1.18.0 tree (Oct–Dec 2025); 1.18.1 changed no Subtlety talent and only Opportunity (−5% at max) for the dagger build. Gottabe's post-1.18.1 report (2026-04-11) still describes hemo/envenom and noxious builds, so the split is unchanged.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown: Not stated numerically anywhere. Implicit: stamina (PvP BiS list is T3/T3.5 heavy), hit to not miss openers, crit for Ambush, agility; stealth level items for the opener war (Boots of Displacement, Cloak of the Dark Veil, X-52 Stealth Ocular Implants) and stealth-detection items (Catseye Ultra Goggles "gives 18 points of stealth detection while Sightless Leather Hood only gives 10" [Thisisreallydumb (player), 2025-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123159#p123159)). New 1.18.1 PvP items with "reducing dot and crit dmg" stats exist (neck, cape, belt, rings) — whether to swap T3 for them is an open question [Gottabe, 2026-04-11]. Gap.

rotationSingle.heading: Opener / kill sequence (single target)
rotationSingle.markdown:
Consensus shape across Crake, Shananagans and amanagor:

1. **Approach in stealth from behind**; Distract to turn the target; Sap on a second enemy first if Blackjack (restealth) is taken. "Never stealth close to a mobs face ... Approaching from behind yields better results ... Use distract" [Atreidon (player), 2025-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158352#p158352) (about mobs; the same detection jank applies to players per Crake).
2. **Cheap Shot** (40 energy with Dirty Deeds; 3 CP with Initiative) → **Hemorrhage** ×1–2 → **Kidney Shot** at 5 points (Crake's "full 5 combo point kidney with 100% reliability"). Dagger build instead: **Ambush** (near-100% crit with talents; "Ambush deals 2x your Backstab damage, and if it doesn't crit you get an energy refund" [SvenS2 (player), 2025-12-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162071#p162071)) → Gouge → Backstab → Kidney/Eviscerate; Shananagans' Mark-for-Death fantasy line: "Mark for Death - Gouge - Vanish - Ambush - Kidney shot - Thistle tea - Backstab - Backstab - Gouge".
3. **Thistle Tea** in the stun for the extra builder.
4. If the target trinkets: **Blind** (Physical now, "not easily cleansable" — staff 1.18.0), bandage or restealth (Improved Gouge window), re-open; Preparation to redo Blind/Vanish/Sprint/Cold Blood ("if blind gets trinketed, you can re-apply it" — Crake).
5. **Keep DoTs off targets you plan to CC**: "Do not use a DOT, damage over time effect ie rupture, deadly poison or a weapon or trinket that puts a dot on your target ... Use double Instant poison or Instant main hand and crippling off hand" [Shananagans, 2025-08-30]; "bleeds may work but you cant hold him at cc(blinds,gouge,grenade etc.) while your bleeds up" [Caesa, 2025-07-14].
6. **Cleanse before Vanish**: "restorative potion, anti venoms, elixirs of poison resistance, and jungle remedy to cleanse as much debuffs off yourself as possible then vanish" [Balake (player), 2023-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=79624#p79624); Dwarves get Stoneform for poison/disease/bleed [Dannyp92 (player), 2023-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=79623#p79623).
7. Note "Vanish is also useless when in melee range. If I'm being attacked and vanish, I get broken out immediately" [Madmane (player), 2025-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158351#p158351) — Sprint/Gouge distance first.

Poisons for PvP: Instant main hand + Crippling off hand (Shananagans; Gottabe's "hemo/envenom ... crippling + instant"), Mind-numbing vs casters, Wound vs healers ("We might finally able to penetrate bear druids" [Edgarek (player), 2024-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103870#p103870)); off-hand procs are rarer by design (Atreidon); Deadly Throw + Throwing Weapon Specialization applies the off-hand poison at range ("improve deadly throw with crippling is one of the most cheesy thing you can use in PVP" [Boeuff (player), 2025-05-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131536#p131536)).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target
rotationAoe.markdown: Combo points persist per target since CC2 (Kick/Gouge/Blind on a second target no longer wipes them — the old loss was the class's main PvP complaint [Huma (player), 2023-04-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=42912#p42912)); "It's always good to have Blind on a mouse over macro" (Shananagans; roid-macros needed for @mouseover [Werefox (player), 2023-04-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=41265#p41265)). Smoke Bomb is "extremely situational at best" (Tankmeister). Engineering: grenades, Goblin Rocket Helm, Thornpod/Siege Bomber AoE stuns on the BiS list.

gear.heading: Gear (PvP BiS list, pre-1.18.1)
gear.markdown:
From [Brisspvp (player), 2024-12-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112831#p112831) (8/9 Naxx + AQ40 belt as BiS, Kara40 Trickster as BiS where listed): Head Trickster Helmet / Bonescythe; situational Sightless Leather Hood, X-52 Stealth Ocular Implants, Goblin Rocket Helm. Neck Trickster Choker / Stormrage's Talisman of Seething; Zandalari Shadow Mastery Talisman (Kick CD). Shoulder/Chest/Legs/Feet Trickster (alt Bonescythe); situational Boots of Displacement, General's/Marshal's Leather Treads (+3 s Sprint), Windwalker Boots, Gnomish Rocket Boots. Waist Belt of Never-ending Agony; Spider Belt, Gnomish Harm Prevention Belt. Wrists/Hands Bonescythe; Bloodfang Gloves (disarm immunity). Rings Bonescythe Ring, Master Dragonslayer's Ring. Trinkets Insignia, Slayer's Crest; Renataki's Charm of Trickery (+60 energy), Glimmering Mithril Insignia, Luffa, Arena Grand Master, Thornpod, Dark Iron Hooked Net. Back Shadow-Weaver's Cape; Cloak of the Dark Veil. Ranged Soulstring; Siege Bomber. MH Gressil / Misplaced Servo Arm / Kingsfall (Thunderfury optional); OH Harbinger of Doom / Claw of the Frost Wyrm / The Hungering Cold. Alternative: "5/8 T1 and 4/9 T3 ... Or bonus from D1 + T3" [S4rs (player), 2024-12-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113880#p113880). Fresh 60: AV epic dagger + ring, Alcor's Sunrazor, arena rep epics, engineering "if you plan to play pvp seriously" [Likaleo (player), 2024-01-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=86159#p86159); 10/19 twink list spreadsheet [Brisspvp (player), 2024-06-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=97258#p97258).

Consumables: Free Action Potion, Insignia, Restorative Potion, Catseye Elixir, Thistle Tea, Sweet 'N Crunchy Fruit Bread (5-min shared CD with Poisonous Mushroom since 2026-01-20), grenades; "Only thing could help - consumables, but many players not willing spent money on them" (Gottabe).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Fighting in the mid-field zerg instead of objectives (amanagor/FrankFankledank).
- Opening on ferals/paladins/geared warriors with cooldowns up (Atreidon).
- DoTs or DoT poisons on a target you need to Blind/Gouge/Sap (Shananagans, Caesa).
- Vanishing with DoTs on and in melee range (Balake, Madmane).
- Playing a Noxious/zug build and expecting control: "They're super predictable, they have no means of locking me down" [Crake (player), 2025-10-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154788#p154788).
- Assuming stealth hides you at short range (detection jank).

extraSections.heading: Battleground roles (amanagor, consensus with FrankFankledank)
extraSections.markdown: "In av rogue is good at harassing, recapping bunkers/ or capping towers in advance. In ab they are good at getting ninja caps, especially if 2 rogues play together. In warsong they are good at defending the flag room and making the efc pop cds to get out. They are also necessary to catch an enemy efc ... Rogues are not made for a mid fight" [amanagor (player), 2025-02-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119499#p119499); "Rogues get piled on the moment they show themselves anywhere near the bulk of the group and so are relegated to flag room sapping and attacking AV towers" [FrankFankledank (player), 2025-02-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119497#p119497). "competitive pvp in vanilla and turtle wow is not 2V2, its bgs. Specficaly wsg and AB ... i much rather face a premade comp without a rogue than a premade comp with 1 rogue" [amanagor (player), 2025-02-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120802#p120802).

extraSections.heading: Matchups
extraSections.markdown:
- Feral druid: avoid; "You wont win fights against feral druids (and paladins) unless they play it pisspoor ... stall out the fight until someone with magic damage can come help you" [Atreidon, 2025-06-30]; fight indoors "where their roots, travel form, and cat passive speed doesn't come into play" [Bayanni (player), 2025-06-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137625#p137625); Catseye goggles/elixir to catch cat form, Restorative Potion for Faerie Fire, "they just need a Faerie fire" (Caesa). Post-1.18.0 counter-view: "Rogues MELT druids. Even in bearform" [Frantsel (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156428#p156428) (poison build).
- Warrior: "Rogue is warrior's one particular 1v1 'counter'" [Bigsmerf (player), 2024-12-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=114197#p114197); "the go-to for killing a prot warrior was garotte into hemo to rack up 5 stacks of deadly poison into rupture ... while you sit in their deadzone with your 80% poison slow" (pre-CC2 crippling values) [Crake (player), 2025-10-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153991#p153991).
- Paladin: bad matchup (Atreidon); "Only thing could help - consumables" vs stuns [Gottabe (player), 2024-07-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=99343#p99343).
- Priest: with the BG damage debuff a "4.3k HP ... Naxx gear" priest survived a Cheap Shot→Kidney combo before 1.18.0 but not after [Zvyrhol (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153745#p153745).
- Hunters/pets: pets follow you through Vanish (bug; ticket 2891); "Hunters are super strong vs rogues specially if your orc" [Donall (player), 2023-08-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=56666#p56666).

extraSections.heading: Races
extraSections.markdown: "As Horde rogue. most people choose undead or orc ... orc for stun resist and bloodrage ... Undead rogue, of course WOTF ... Cannibalize also very underestimated ... As Aliance rogue most people choose human, dwarf or gnome. Being human is easier to detect stealth ... Dwarf - good racial ability to remove bleeds, poisons and diseases, including blind from other rogues. Gnome - good ability to escape slows" [Gottabe (player), 2024-07-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=99343#p99343); "IF you like pvp go orc rogue" (Hardiness) [Geojak (player), 2024-07-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=99502#p99502); Night Elf +1 stealth level, +1% dodge, Troll Berserking costs energy but bursts with SnD/poisons, Regeneration heals in stealth [Dunaly (player), 2024-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=99449#p99449). "surely pick undead to flex at alliance priests and locks" [Ataika (player), 2025-05-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=129414#p129414). Human Perception is a stealth-detection cooldown but "it feels like popping perception is useless" with the detection tick jank (Crake, 2025-11-04). Goblin: Weapon Expertise's +3/+5 (not %) undercuts the dagger-racial idea (Nightmonster).

standing.source_quality: medium-strong on BG roles, matchups and races; weak on numeric stat priorities; the PvP BiS list is a single unchallenged Dec-2024 player list
standing.notes: The control build: full 5-point Kidney reliability and every cooldown twice via Preparation. Rogues themselves say hemo/prep players, not poison rogues, are the real PvP killers.

patch_validity.notes: 1.18.1 changed no Subtlety talent and only lowered Opportunity (used by the Ambush/Backstab dagger PvP variant) at its max rank; a post-1.18.1 report (2026-04-11) still describes the same hemo/envenom and dagger builds, so the split documented here is unchanged.
