readme.heading: Official 1.18.1 Shaman changes used (Jamey p166071, 2026-01-23, revised 2026-01-26 and 2026-03-19; hotfixes Torta p171608/p172139/p173490)
readme.markdown: Convection/Concussion now cover all offensive Fire/Frost/Nature spells including Earthquake and Molten Blast; Earthquake gained a new capstone rework in 1.18.0 (replacing Elemental Mastery) then +15% base damage and CD 20 → 18 s in 1.18.1 (bug reports of it under-hitting/losing the Elemental Fury bonus were still open 2026-04-07); Elemental Weapons reworked all four imbue effects — Windfury: gaining extra attacks now grants +1%/stack attack speed (2/4/6 stacks, 5 s) instead of a next-swing bonus; Flametongue: +10/20/30% Fire totem/spell damage for 5 s *after a melee hit* (was passive) explicitly to keep spell-oriented Enhancement and pure-Fire Elemental in melee range; Rockbiter: the old flat damage-reduction became **Earthen Bulwark**, an absorb shield built from physical damage (tripled while shielded), explicitly to stop non-Enhancement specs using the old passive as a PvP defensive layer — reported not stacking correctly from special attacks (Stormstrike, Lightning Strike) through the 03-25 hotfix and still contested 2026-04-07; Windfury Weapon 20%/0.5-s ICD → 25% per hit; Flurry reworked to trigger off any critical strike (spell or melee) rather than only physical crits, "especially for spell-oriented Enhancement" (hotfixed 03-21/03-25/04-01 for consumption, trigger conditions and Rushing Winds stacking — still reported buggy/overwritten by Elemental Weapons' haste as of 2026-04-07); Lightning Strike's Water Shield ratio changed to 18:1; Lightning Shield mana −25%; Call of Earth added (Earth Shield +1/2 charges, +35/70% pushback avoidance, replenished by offensive Nature spells per the 03-19 revision); relic swapping now costs a GCD; Enh T2.5 5-set reworked to boost Earthen Bulwark (not applied at release, fixed 03-21); Resto T1 8-set replaced with a 25%-chance absorb proc on Healing Wave/Lesser Healing Wave (Resto's only 1.18.1 change); PvP dampening became class/spec-dependent (Shaman's specific values were never published in the sources).

readme.heading: Gaps (not covered by any source — do not guess)
readme.markdown:
1. **Post-1.18.1 re-evaluation of any spec** beyond scattered forum complaints: no guide author re-tested and republished a build, rotation, or stat priority after 2026-03-20 for any of the five playbooks. Treat every rotation/stat section as pre-1.18.1 unless a flagged delta says otherwise.
2. **Full point-by-point 60 talent builds for Elemental and Enhancement DPS**: every "endgame" build is a `talents.turtlecraft.gg` calculator link or a named-core list; only the tank and leveling paths have an explicit level-by-level order.
3. **Earthquake's true post-1.18.1 behavior**: player reports (only 2 hits, missing Elemental Fury bonus on the second hit, "highly underperform" even with Totem of Distant Tremors) were never confirmed or denied by staff beyond the original "fixed multiple issues" note and an unrelated 04-01 Aftershock hotfix.
4. **Restoration PvP**: only one contested claim (deep-Resto Chain Heal support viable "at least in AV") exists; no build, rotation, or standing discussion — not written up as its own file.
5. **Elemental PvP after 2026-03-20**: no source describes actual play once per-class PvP dampening, resilience-bearing PvP sets, Call of Earth and the reworked Earthquake all landed together.
6. **Pre-raid BiS lists on current itemization** for Enhancement DPS and Elemental (Elemental has a maintained spreadsheet from one author; Enhancement does not) and any Resto BiS-by-phase list (asked in 2024-12, never answered).
7. **PvP resilience values and set bonuses for Shaman** in the 1.18.1 PvP gear (mentioned as existing, no numbers given).
8. **Zone-by-zone leveling route**: only the dungeon-per-bracket path and gear-upgrade waypoints are covered; no quest-by-quest questing route exists in the sources.
9. **Hardcore-specific Shaman play**: only two fragments (a pre-CC2 hardcore Elemental impression, and a tank guide's general "avoid red dungeons" rule) — no hardcore-specific Shaman thread was found in the extracted forums.
10. **Totem of Distant Tremors and other 1.18.1 relics**: named once by a player as underperforming with Earthquake, never otherwise described.
11. **Exact Resto T3.5 (Stormhowl) full set text**: only the 1.18.1 T1-8-set delta and general standing quotes exist for Restoration tier; Elemental's T3.5 5-set text is captured in detail (Atreidon), Restoration's and Enhancement's are not.
12. **Spell/talent/item IDs**: no source in this crawl gives numeric spell IDs for Shaman abilities; every `spell_id` field in the structured YAML is `null`.

readme.heading: Top open questions for the orchestrator

- Any post-1.18.1 raid logs, Discord class-channel archives, or a maintained Turtle-specific database for exact Earthen Bulwark/Flurry/Earthquake numbers — the forum shows these as open bug reports with no resolution before the 2026-05-15 server shutdown.

playbooks.title: Shaman — Enhancement tank ("warden shaman")
playbooks.intro: Turtle-specific role: shield + one-hander + Rockbiter Weapon, built on the CC2 (1.17.2) tanking talents (Ancestral Guardian, Spirit Armor, Totemic Alignment, Shield Specialization), the baseline taunt **Earthshaker Slam**, the elemental shields and Lightning Strike. Sources: Mimiwarmini's guide (2024-12-02, edited 113 times to 2026-03-22, title "Shaman Tank Guide 20/03/2026 v1.18.1"), Akos1896's leveling/2-tank write-ups (2024-11/12), Skegg's compiled guide (2025-09), the 1.18.1 tank threads, and the staff posts. Eras are marked.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: dungeon tank (all levels) and off-tank / alternative main tank in raids; highest threat among tanks in the guide's view, weakest mitigation.
- **Community standing**: **niche and contested**. Staff design intent: "The Enhancement tank builds also got some new tools to help them properly fulfil a tank role in levelling and early end-game content" — [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102972#p102972); 1.18.0: "Enhancement Tanks often struggle with threat generation, sometimes to the point some of them opt in to use a two-handed weapon instead of the conventional shield ... improvements to threat generation from Rockbiter Weapon and Spirit Armor" — [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159); the 1.18.1 post says "Tank Enhancement and spell-power–focused Enhancement ... are getting more meaningful updates to their core talents" — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). Players: "Shaman tanks are designed to be 100% viable tanks during leveling. They can be used at raids, too but they are less optimal there. The lack of a defensive CD becomes a pain point" — [Akos1896 (player), 2024-11-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107678#p107678); "As a tank shaman you can't expect raid spots ... in practice they are objectively the weakest tank at raiding level" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117662#p117662); "the strength of the shaman tank allows it to generate a greater threat than any other tank, whether in AoE or single-target situations" — [Mimiwarmini (player, guide writer), 2024-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110875#p110875); "Shaman already tanked KT on tel abim get good" — [J0rsche (player), 2024-12-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113255#p113255); "myself have tanked content all the way through Naxx" — [Azuredrak0 (player), 2025-05-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130226#p130226); hostile: "The best guide for shaman tank, is to not play it" — [amanagor (player), 2024-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110876#p110876); "Full P1 paladin will be better than bis geared shaman tank in threat/surv" — [Dezhan (player), 2024-12-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112407#p112407).
- **Strengths** (guide, consensus): huge single- and multi-target threat, ranged pulls, the best anti-magic toolkit (Elemental Warding, resistance totems, T2.5), two interrupts (Earth Shock, Grounding), kiting via Earthbind/Frost Shock, Ankh, same damage as a DPS.
- **Weaknesses** (consensus): no defensive cooldown ("You will never have a defensive CD. Nearest thing you can get is swapping in the Hakkar trinket" — [Akos1896 (player), 2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112575#p112575)); mana; mail and almost no defense gear ("If you sort the database for 'Mail' armor and enter the filters 'Stamina 1,' 'Agility 1,' and 'Defense 1,' you get a mere 5 items displayed (excluding the T2.5 Set)" — [Crabsi (player), 2025-10-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156833#p156833)); crit/crush immunity effectively unreachable ("even we say they gave shaman 20 in talent and unlock ZG buff, you wont get capped (440) but around 425 in bis" — [Dezhan (player), 2024-11-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=109832#p109832)); the Windfury dilemma (below); early levels are "extra squishy ... until around early 30s" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123022#p123022).
- **Content**: leveling dungeons (strong from ~33), 60 dungeons and Lower Karazhan / MC / Onyxia (Mimiwarmini's tested pre-raid and "T1 BiS" lists), AQ40+ "you def can but it's really hard" (Akos1896 2024-11-12). Black Morass needs ~6k armor / 4k HP unbuffed (Skegg).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
All builds are images or links; the point-by-point orders come from Akos1896 and Skegg.

- **Endgame (Mimiwarmini's "Recommended talent", image only)**: the guide lists two archetypes — "Threat generation oriented talent tree with Auto Attack" and "Talent tree oriented towards Threat generation with Shock and Totem" — and a mana build; talents that matter per tree: Elemental — Concussion (shocks, LS), Elemental Devastation (all), Reverberation, Call of Flame (fire totems, Flame Shock), Elemental Focus; Enhancement — Ancestral Knowledge, Thundering Strikes, Totemic Alignment, Lightning Strike, Flurry, Enhancing Totems, Stormstrike, Element's Grace, Bloodlust; Ancestral Guardian, Spirit Armor, Elemental Weapons for survival — [Mimiwarmini (player, guide writer), 2024-12-02 .. 2026-03-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110875#p110875). The guide "used" Flurry 5/5 (image `Talent4.jpg`) — [Mimiwarmini, 2024-12-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111972#p111972).
- **Skegg's dungeon-tank order (consensus with Akos1896, pre-1.18.1)**: to 33 — 24 Enhancement: Shield Specialization 5 > Totemic Alignment 2 > Stable Shields 3 > Ancestral Guardian 3 (before LS for mitigation) > Lightning Strike (first if threat is a problem) > Thundering Strikes 1 > Spirit Armor 2 > Thundering Strikes 4 > Elemental Weapons 3 (first if squishy) > Stormstrike (first for threat): `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman?points=-AoUYALAQDI-`. 34–44 — 11 Elemental: Convection 5 > Concussion 2 (or Elemental Warding 2 for Maraudon) > Elemental Devastation 3 > Elemental Focus: `...?points=FQAYI-AoUYALAQDI-` / `FACYI-AoUYALAQDI-`. 44–50 — Thundering Strikes 5, Element's Grace 5. 51–60 — respec Shield Specialization → Ancestral Knowledge 5; Bloodlust; Reverberation 3 ("take this before Flurry for more QoL in managing threat + more frequent spell interrupt"); Flurry 5; Concussion 3 or Elemental Warding 3: `...?points=FYAYL-FAVYALFQDIAoB-` / `FADYL-FAVYALFQDIAoB-`, or with cheaper totems `FACYL-FAVYALBQDIAoB-Ao` — [Skegg (player, guide writer), 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149715#p149715). "Spell AoE tank" variant: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman?points=FQDYLAADAC-FAVYALBQDIAY-` (Skegg). Lasher-farm build with Flametongue Elemental Weapons, totem-threat talents and 12 Resto points for pushback: `https://talent-builder.haaxor1689.dev/c/1.18.0/shaman?points=FAAQ-AoUYALAQDI-FoAAC` (Skegg).
- **Akos1896's talent notes** (2024-12-02/13, single source but the other guide author agreed on parts): "Shield spec. is overrated since we won't cap defense and have no added benefit from blocks ... Picking ancestral knowledge instead might be a weird but valid choice" then, after leveling a test tank, "I underestimated how bad early-shaman mitigation is ... I agree with you that shield spec is needed" — [Akos1896 (player), 2024-12-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111475#p111475); Mimiwarmini keeps Shield Specialization ("avoidance is still important to avoid crushes") and computes Ancestral Knowledge at only +9 Str/+5 Agi/+10 Sta on base stats — [Mimiwarmini (player), 2024-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110930#p110930) — written before the 2024-12-20 change to total stats (**contested, partly superseded**). "Once geared enough, threat talents are usually better than def talents which are better than mana sustain talents. But during leveling, I'd say def > mana sustain > threat" — [Akos1896 (player), 2024-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110890#p110890). "Never take tidal focus when done leveling" (same). Reverberation lets every second Stormstrike cycle fit two Earth Shocks — [Akos1896 (player), 2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112575#p112575). Imonobor's 2024-11 build link: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman?points=FADYNAADAAAAAAAoVYALBQTIAQBAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` with "if you use even ONE '+3 nature damage on attack' item, Stormstrike is essentially useless" — [Imonobor (player), 2024-11-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107710#p107710) (single source; refers to the old Stormstrike debuff being eaten by on-hit Nature damage — the buff is now on the shaman, so **outdated**).
- **1.18.1 impact**: Elemental Weapons' Rockbiter changed from a passive −10% to the Earthen Bulwark absorb (and is reported bugged); Enh T2.5 5-set reworked; nothing else moved. No post-release build was posted.

stats.heading: Stat priority (60)
stats.markdown:
- **Tankiness**: "Stamina>Agilty>Dodge>Defense"; **threat**: "Hit>Agility>PowerSpell>Critical>Strength" — [Mimiwarmini](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110875#p110875) (2026-03-22 edition). Guide targets for pre-raid: def min 20, hit min 5%, Sta min 160 (Tauren → 4,000 HP; 7,500 buffed), Agi min 100, armor min 6,000 ("aiming for a 55% reduction on boss lvl 63 in full buff and enchantment, i.e. 7050 armor").
- Guide caps: physical hit cap 8%, spell hit cap 17% (boss 63), 5 weapon skill = 1% hit; 1 Str = 2 AP and 20 Str = 1 block value; 20 Agi = 1% crit = 1% dodge, 1 Agi = 2 armor; 1 Sta = 10 HP (10.5 Tauren); 1 defense = 0.04% miss/dodge/parry/block and −0.04% crit chance (cap 140 defense above base for level 63); crush = 150% damage, avoidance 102.4% to push it off — [Mimiwarmini](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110875#p110875). Wiki `Shaman guide`: crush/crit immune = 440 defense (vanilla-baseline link).
- **Agility vs Strength**: "With the Rockbiter buff which gives us 653 Ap, it's as if we had 326.5 Strength, plus the Agi increases our threat and our tankiness, so I think the agi is more interesting" — Mimiwarmini; Skegg: "tanking while leveling: +stam > +agi > +str > +int (when tanking at 60, +str becomes 2nd most important and +agi third)"; Akos1896: "stam>agi>melee crit>haste> dodge/parry>strength>int" (2024-07, pre-CC2) — **contested** (Agi vs Str second).
- **Spell power is not negligible**: "the SP is not a negligible statistic and that it is close to the gain obtained with the AP ... SP CAN become a better statistic if we integrate it into a rotation with Lightning Shield" — Mimiwarmini (section IX). Hybrid tank weapons were buffed in 1.18.1 for exactly this (Dragunovi above).
- **Int**: only until mana is under control ("At the start int can almost be as important as stam ... As people learn what to use when or even downrank here and there, int falls behind agi/str" — [Akos1896, 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149742#p149742)).
- Leveling: "focus on +stam and armor gear, ignoring defense beyond 15 ... 10 armor is roughly equal to 1 stamina" (Skegg; the obsidian brooch / JC +11 Sta trinkets at 33 — [Akos1896, 2024-12-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111623#p111623)).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown:
**Consensus (Mimiwarmini, Akos1896, Skegg):**

Pre-pull: Rockbiter on a slow one-hander, shield equipped; Lightning Shield (or Water Shield if mana is the constraint); Mana Spring or Healing Stream, Grace of Air or Windfury, Stoneskin or Strength of Earth ("Before pull Lightning Shield > Mana Spring Totem > Grace of Air Totem > Stoneskin Totem > regenerate your mana" — Mimiwarmini boss pull).

1. **Pull**: Lightning Bolt R1 ("warrior arrow", near-zero mana) for a plain pull; **max-rank Lightning Bolt ×2 or Chain Lightning** for maximum initial threat; optionally Molten Blast (2-s cast) while they run in; against Nature-resistant mobs "Molten Blast > Molten Blast > Molten Blast > Flame Shock" — [Mimiwarmini](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110875#p110875), [Akos1896, 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149742#p149742). Boss: "Pull > Searing Totem > BloodLust > Lightning Bolt > Chain Lightning > Stormstrike > Earth Shock > Lightning Strike > Water Shield" (Mimiwarmini).
2. **Stormstrike** as the first melee action ("Just greet them folks with a stormstrike for initial threat" — Akos1896 2024-11-12).
3. **Earth Shock max rank** under the Stormstrike buff — "has a hidden effect which multiplies the threat it generates by 1.5"; "use max rank almost always" post-CC2 (Akos1896 2024-11-12). Use Frost Shock instead if the target resists Nature; Flame Shock "gives a 'long term threat' on a target ... the dot portion is useful on enemies that reset threat" — [Akos1896, 2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112610#p112610).
4. **Lightning Strike** on cooldown with the shield that fits the moment: Lightning Shield = threat, Water Shield = mana, Earth Shield = survival ("Are my defensives high enough? -> If no, use earth shield ... Is threat okay? -> If no, go for lightning shield ... confident in survival and threat? -> Go for water shield" — [Akos1896, 2024-11-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107678#p107678)).
5. Loop "Stormstrike > Earth Shock > Lightning Strike > Earth Shock > refresh shield" (Mimiwarmini "Rotate Spell of a normal target"); with Reverberation 3/3 a second Earth Shock fits every other Stormstrike cycle (Akos1896).
6. **Do less when ahead**: "never generate more threat than needed to maintain aggro ... whenever possible, skip using the rotation below and just do auto-attacks + taunt. Or downrank your shocks" — Skegg; Bigsmerf: max-rank Earth Shock as "pseudo taunt", second-highest rank as the steady generator, rank 1 for interrupts — [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123019#p123019).
7. **Lightning Shield for silence-heavy mobs**: "rush there with a lightning shield on. Silence is preventing eating up too much mana anyway" — [Akos1896, 2024-12-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112289#p112289).
8. **Taunt (Earthshaker Slam)** only when a mob attacks someone else; follow with Earth Shock ("For effectively taunt => Earthshaker Slam > Earth Shock" — Mimiwarmini). It "Has no effect if the target is already attacking you" (staff).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **2–3 targets** (consensus): mark skull/cross; run in and "Stormstrike on target 1, tab switch to Earth Shock target 2, and Lightning Strike target 3 ... Tab switch between targets giving each of them an Earth Shock and melee auto attack" — Skegg; "Up to 3 mobs, you are fine without threat totems" — [Akos1896, 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149742#p149742). Chain Lightning pull establishes threat on all three.
- **4+ targets**: **Stoneclaw Totem** (best AoE threat, 30-s CD; "When in doubt, place a Stoneclaw Totem ... Drop an Earthbind after Stoneclaw expires, if needed" — Skegg) then **Fire Nova Totem** timed to explode as the pack arrives (LOS pulls: "Chain Lightning > Fire Nova Totem"), then **Magma Totem**; Mimiwarmini's AoE sequence: "Stoneclaw Totem > Fire Nova Totem > Magma Totem > Recal Totemic > Stoneskin Totem > Fire Nova Totem > Magma Totem"; pulling an extra pack while Magma is up: "Earth shock (pack sweater) > Recal Totemic > Fire Nova Totem > Magma Totem". Fire-resistant packs: "Stoneclaw is your only AoE threat" (Skegg). Magma is the biggest mana burner — downrank it when threat is safe (Akos1896 2024-12-02).
- **Emergency**: "Fire Nova - huge snap threat, but mana intensive"; save Earthshaker Slam for a mob on the healer; "When a mob gets loose or runs towards a sheeped target, use max rank Lightning Bolt for high threat or Earth Shock for big snap threat" (Skegg). Ally pulls a pack: "Earthbind Totem > Nova Fire Totem > Chain Lightning" (Mimiwarmini).
- **AoE threshold**: totems from 4 mobs ("Casters shouldn't really aoe unless there are 3+ mobs. In case of three mobs only, marking skull and using your shocks, SS and LS on tabbed targets should do the trick" — [Akos1896, 2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112575#p112575)).

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Bloodlust**: "As a tank, this ability is for you. Use it when you immediately need a threat spike" — Akos1896 2024-11-12; Troll Berserking is the second haste button (Akos1896 2024-12-13).
- **Mana**: Water Shield by default; Mana Spring only if you stay > 20 s in place and always while the party drinks; Totemic Recall after every fight; Judgement of Wisdom on skull; 2 Clearcasting charges from every crit; Nordanaar tea; Major Rejuvenation Potion; the guide's rule "It's much safer to make sure you have the resources (mana) to save a pull that goes south than to spend everything trying to shorten the encounter" (Skegg). Drink when you cannot open the next pack safely — Akos1896: "you confidently pull a pack with 20% mana" once frugal.
- **Survival buttons** (no CD exists): Earth Shield + Grace of Air + Stoneskin + Healing Stream ("defensive toolset"), Healing Potion / Healthstone, Whipper Root Tuber, defensive weapon swap ("keeping at least two (enchanted) weapons. One for threat, one for survival" — Akos1896 2024-07-10), Juju Escape (5% dodge 10 s), Hakkar trinket, Ankh. "never start casting while taking hits" (Skegg: avoidance is 0 while casting — Mimiwarmini).
- **Racials**: Tauren (+5% HP, War Stomp, Totemic Slam −25% attack speed 8 s) or Troll (Berserking) recommended; Orc "probably the worst choice" for tanking though axe skill helps melee threat — [Akos1896, 2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112575#p112575) (consensus with Akos 2025-09-01; Skegg says all three are fine).

roleStrategy.heading: Threat model (guide numbers, Rockbiter 653 AP, no gear)
roleStrategy.markdown: TPS per source, single target (Mimiwarmini, 2025-08 edition): auto-attack ~154 (slow and fast weapon equal); Earth Shock max 212; Flame Shock 126; Frost Shock 129; Lightning Shield 96; Lightning Strike 25–40 base, 83–98 with Lightning Shield, 38–53 with Water Shield, 33–48 with Earth Shield; Stormstrike 35–56; Stoneclaw 98; Magma 49; Fire Nova 36–40; Searing 17–23; Water Shield 31; Earth Shield 18; Healing Stream 2.5; Mana Spring 3.6. Conclusion: "a slow weapon will give us more Threat than a fast weapon" and "playing a dagger for speed is a nonsense" (Rockbiter no longer adds flat threat per hit) — [Mimiwarmini](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110875#p110875). Threat rules used: 1 damage = 1 threat, healing 0.25, mana gained 0.5; melee needs 110% / ranged 130% of the tank's threat to pull. Mana per second at full rotation: 143.5 untalented, 61.4 with Elemental Focus/Convection/Tidal Focus, **−26.3 (net positive) with Water Shield + Mana Spring**; "Any AP point above 936 will cause us to generate mana" with Lightning Strike under Water Shield (18:1 ratio). Elemental Focus availability at 38% melee crit ≈ 85% per rotation.

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Pre-raid set (Mimiwarmini, tested for Lower Karazhan/MC/Onyxia, 2025-12-10)**: Timeloop Headguard (61053), Pauldrons of Elusiveness (60792), Royal Decorated Armor (11820), Slashclaw Bracers (13211), Voone's Vice Grips (13963), Imbued Planar Belt (61041), Leggings of Alacrity (60503), Greaves of the Elusive (61024), Shard of Eternity (61012), Redoubt Cloak (18495), Naglering (11669), Ring of Authority (50189), Hatereaver Cog (60559), Counterattack Lodestone (18537), Vault's Defender (40003), Blackthorn's Blackjack (84600), Totem of the Calming River (61698) / Totem of Rage (22395) / Totem of Tides (58146) — [Mimiwarmini](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110875#p110875). Alternatives per slot are tagged Threat / Avoidance / Mitigation in the guide (Helm of the Great Chief, Helm of Narv, Towerforge pieces, Force Reactive Disk, Draconian Deflector, Bonewall, Time-Shifting Wheel, Persuader, Mass of McGowan, Hurley's Tankard, Hand of Justice, Corrosive Core, Mark of Tyranny ...). Skegg's leveling shield chain: Compendium of the Fallen reward → SM Cathedral shield → Gilneas / Mara goblin / SWV shield; Totem of Tides (Stormwrought, 35–41).
- **"T1 BiS" (2026-03-05, pre-1.18.1 release)**: Blackstone Crown (83565), Shoulderpads of True Flight (81264) / Earthfury Pauldrons, Cryptbone Hauberk (51786) / Earthfury Breastplate / Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, Wristguards of True Flight, Rune Infused Gauntlets (61266), Stoneslate Belt (51785), Outrider's Chain Leggings (22673), Sabatons of the Flamewalker (19144), Shard of Eternity, Dragon's Blood Cape (17107), Ring of Binding / Heavy Dark Iron Ring / Ring of Authority, Onyxia Blood Talisman / Araxxna's Husk (61816) / Shawl of the Castellan, Earthen Guard (20688), Deathbringer (17068) — Mimiwarmini. T2.5 (AQ40) is the only tank tier set ("Tier 2.5 is specialized for tanking builds" — [Dragunovi (staff), 2023-10-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=71059#p71059)); "shaman tanks are not really a thing until T2,5 at raiding" — [Akos1896, 2025-10-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156746#p156746). No T3/T3.5 tank set (gap; requested in t=17097).
- **Enchants** (Mimiwarmini list): head/legs Invocation of Greater Protection (2% dodge, Kara) or Arcanum of Protection (1%); shoulders Fortitude of the Scourge / Zandalar Signet of Tenacity; chest Greater Stats / Major Health / Core Armor Kit; bracers Greater Deflection (5 def) / Superior Stamina / Greater Agility; gloves Superior Agility or **Threat 2%** (Akos1896: "Threat enchant on gloves is a must"); belt buckles Bloody (−1% crit taken) / Arcanite (5 def) / Mithril (6 agi); boots Superior Stamina (15) (never speed — Akos1896); cloak Dodge / Superior Defense; rings via JC gemstones (1% block, 3 stats, 6 sta); shield Lesser Block / Greater Stamina, thorium spikes (Akos1896); weapon Crusader / Spell Power / Icy Chill / Unholy.
- **Consumables** (Mimiwarmini 2026-02-10, consensus with Akos1896): Major Rejuvenation or Major Healing Potion; Flask of the Titans (or Supreme Power for threat, Chromatic Resistance); Elixir of Greater Nature Power, Greater Firepower, Brute Force, Concoctions (Arcane Giant, Dreamwater, Emerald Mongoose), Greater Intellect/Sage, Gift of Arthas; Hardened Mushroom (25 Sta) / Power Mushroom; Spirit of Zanza; R.O.I.D.S. / Lung Juice Cocktail; Juju Ember / Juju Escape / Juju Power; Rumsey Rum / Medivh's Merlot; Whipper Root Tuber. Engineering (sappers, target dummies) for emergencies (Akos1896 2024-07-10; Yutilk 2019). Buffs to request: Devotion/Sanctuary, Fortitude, Champion, Blood Pact, Thorns.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
1. Over-threating and going oom (both guides).
2. Casting (Lightning Bolt, heals) while being hit — no avoidance during casts (Mimiwarmini; Skegg).
3. Dropping Windfury for melee who then out-threat you, or using Flametongue Totem at the cost of a fire threat totem (Akos1896).
4. Fast daggers — pre-CC2 habit (Akos1896 2024-12-13; Mimiwarmini).
5. Using Stormstrike expecting the old debuff (Imonobor); taunting the first mob instead of Stormstriking it (Akos1896).
6. Tanking red/high-orange dungeons or SM before the level-33 stamina trinkets (Akos1896).
7. Taking Tidal Focus / Call of Flame / Flame Guidance into raids (Akos1896).
8. Searing Totem near CC or patrols (Akos1896, pagu).
9. Trying mid-combat 2H swaps for Stormstrike (Atreidon).
10. Post-1.18.1: relying on Earthen Bulwark from strikes — reported not working through 2026-04-07 (Travoltino).

extraSections.heading: Role strategy
extraSections.markdown:
- **Overthreat**: the guide's central concept — threat needed = mob HP / total DPS × highest DPS − highest DPS / 1.1; anything more is wasted mana; "If this happens, don't hesitate, ask the weakest dps to make an effort, and ask your strongest dps to calm down" — Mimiwarmini.
- **Marks**: keep one skull up at all times, re-mark immediately; mark patrols while drinking — Akos1896 2024-12-13.
- **Pull types** (Akos1896 2024-12-13): LOS pull with a ranged spell for caster packs; run-in with Shock/SS/LS on three targets; chain-pull the next pack while the current one dies; walk packs toward the next pull with Earthbind/Frost Shock so melee mobs alternate walking and attacking.
- **Totem policy for tanks** ("what totems are absolutely needed" not "what is best"): Grace of Air by default for dodge/crit; **Windfury only if ≥ 2 melee DPS and they accept threat responsibility** ("Just tell them if they rip threat, they tank that mob as a deal" — Skegg; "With a pala, Blessing of Salvation ... can also be placed on the melee DPS in exchange for Windfury"); Strength of Earth when you want mobs dead fast; Stoneskin only for many small hitters; Tremor when fear/sleep/charm; Grounding for nasty instant casters (Hakkar, Kara Crypt mobs); Tranquil Air left behind for over-eager casters; Searing only when no CC/patrol nearby; Flametongue "just say no" — [Akos1896, 2024-11-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107678#p107678), [2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112575#p112575). The rule that Windfury Totem gives the shaman nothing while Rockbiter is on is staff (imbue priority); Imonobor's claim that it now stacks ([2024-11-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107710#p107710)) contradicts the staff post and Akos/Taralej90 — treat as wrong.
- **Interrupts**: Earth Shock R1 and Grounding Totem; Hex (Troll) on a Black Morass phase-2 dragon spawn (Akos1896 2024-12-06).
- **Kiting**: Earthbind + Frost Shock R1 and run circles around the totem; "if your healer is dead or oom" (Imonobor 2024-11-12; Mimiwarmini "For Kites").
- **Raid role**: off-tank/utility ("Their niche" = magic damage: Elemental Warding 20%, T2.5 25%, resistance totems — Mimiwarmini 2024-12-18); one experienced raid leader's rule: "Only use totems for threat in 5 man, in raid they are absolut useless, you need all St threat you can get" — [Dezhan (player), 2024-12-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112407#p112407) (single, hostile source). Grace of Air groups for tank shamans: [Mimiwarmini, 2026-02-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168008#p168008).
- **Weapon swaps**: mid-combat 2H swap for Stormstrike "costs you too much time to be worth it" — [Atreidon (player), 2024-07-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=98964#p98964); "You can keep a two-hander in your bag and occasionally switch to 'no shield tanking' ... only to catch up at bosses" — Akos1896 2024-12-13.
- **Group buffs to ask for** (Akos1896 2024-12-13/2024-07-10): Judgement of Wisdom, Salvation on the problem DPS, Devotion Aura pre-33, Blessing of Freedom, Power Word: Shield (you have no rage), Champion buff, imp out, warlock threat stone, mage water.

standing.source_quality: strong on mechanics/threat/rotation; medium on stats (single-source numbers); weak on post-1.18.1 viability
standing.notes: A Turtle-specific role built on CC2's dedicated tank talents (Ancestral Guardian, Spirit Armor, Totemic Alignment, Shield Specialization) plus Earthshaker Slam. Consensus that it is a fully viable levelling and dungeon tank; contested and generally called the weakest raid tank (no defensive cooldown, almost no mail defence gear, crit/crush immunity unreachable). Earthen Bulwark was reported bugged through 2026-04-07.

patch_validity.notes: 1.18.1 replaced Elemental Weapons' Rockbiter passive -10% damage taken with Earthen Bulwark (an absorb shield); the Enh T2.5 5-set was reworked to boost it; both are reported bugged/not stacking from special attacks through 2026-04-07. No post-1.18.1 guide update was posted (Mimiwarmini's promised explanation never came). Talent point allocations and the threat rotation are unaffected.

Pulling without checking whether the mob resists Nature (use Frost Shock/Molten Blast instead)

playbooks.title: Shaman — Restoration healer (raids and dungeons)
playbooks.intro: Playbook for Restoration on Turtle WoW after Class Changes 2 (1.17.2: Chain Heal 3-s cast, Improved Chain Heal, Healing Way/Tidal Surge/Undertow/Improved Water Shield, Mana Tide removed, Spirit Link capstone), 1.18.0 (Chain Heal coefficient 71.42% → 61.42%, Spirit Link instant/35 yd/20 s/10 min, Improved Healing Wave, Healing Way via Lesser Healing Wave, Totemic Mastery rework) and 1.18.1 (Resto T1 8-set replaced by an absorb proc; T1 3-set text fixed; no talent changes). Eras are marked.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: raid AoE healer built on Chain Heal, tank healer with Healing Wave, damage-prevention via Spirit Link; totem provider for the melee group.
- **Community standing**: **consensus** that Resto is the most wanted shaman spec and a strong raid healer; **contested** whether it is boring / whether 1.18.x nerfs hurt. "Resto is close to being broken. Huge mana pool, spammable, quick chain heal ... Raids love them, they are a bit too OP probably" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117662#p117662); "most guilds couldn't care less if they did not have a single ele /enha shaman, but they would be seriously annoyed if they had less than 3-4 resto shamans" — [amanagor (player), 2025-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115605#p115605); "resto shamans are the most wanted class/spec combination in the game" — [Grubi450 (player), 2024-05-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=94005#p94005); "Chain heal still uber OP and not running out of mana ever" — [Templar85 (player), 2025-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117470#p117470); "btw resto shaman is the best healer in the game for many years now" — [1.18.1 thread poster, 2025-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=22214) (attribution in thread). Critics: "resto being a glorified totem bot, while priests, druids and paladins heals like in TBC" — [Travoltino (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172162#p172162); "on the topic of resto being an absolute snoozefest - unfortunately true" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-01-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166553#p166553); "Nope, its still exactly the same rotation" (post-1.18.0) — [amanagor (player), 2025-08-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147242#p147242). Staff: "We are satisfied with Restoration's identity as an effective AOE healer and tank healer" — [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102972#p102972); "The bouncing healing of Chain Heal has been dominant ... we're pulling slightly back on its scaling" — [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159).
- **Strengths**: Chain Heal on clumped melee, mana sustain via Water Shield talents, Spirit Link ("basically shieldwall on a target of your choice" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-06-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134240#p134240)), totems, Ankh, cleansing totems (Decursive-free poison/disease handling).
- **Weaknesses**: single-target heals weaker than other healers ("No healing wave changes this patch. Its straight up worse than all other classes heals" — Travoltino 2026-03-24); no wand/ranged damage filler; healing sniped by Holy paladins' Holy Strike splash ("their heal tends to leave targets at 95% hp, so they eat a bounce of cl" — Atreidon 2026-01-26); Chain Heal bug/nerf complaints ("Chain heal being worse in 3 ways than vanilla is 'intended behavior'" — Travoltino; staff: "That interaction is intended" — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166084#p166084)).
- **Content**: raids (all tiers), dungeons; PvP as deep-resto Chain Heal support in AV (Manletow) — thin sourcing, see `elemental-pvp.md`.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
- **Standard 0/8/43 (consensus)**: "Usual resto setup is 0 8 43. Get ancestral knowledge and stable shields from enh (stable shields synergize with improved water shield talent). At the resto tree, pick most things, what 5tp to leave empty is mostly your personal decision. F ex I'd skip nature's grace and improved reincarnation" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115603#p115603); "the only viable way to spec as resto the just dump it all into the Resto tree" — [Voodoochile (player), 2025-06-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134190#p134190); Winckler91's image build ("standard resto spec", 5/5 Improved Healing Wave, Spirit Link) — [Winckler91 (player), 2025-06-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134238#p134238); Yourik5 instead takes Improved Reincarnation 2/2 and Nature's Grace 3/3 over Improved Healing Wave for raids — [Yourik5 (player), 2025-07-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=142251#p142251) (**contested filler**). Skegg's 51–60 resto path: rush Improved Water Shield with Stable Shields (`https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman?points=-FAAY-FoDoYIEYQC`), then "finish every talent in resto except imp Reincarnation, Healing Focus and Spirit Link" (`...?points=-FAAY-FoDoaIFYQKFAB`) — [Skegg (player, guide writer), 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149715#p149715).
- **Spirit Link is not optional** (consensus among raiders): "Improved chain heal is an absolute must have talent, as its 33% of your healing output in the majority of raid encounters. So you arent getting any of the capstones from another tree if you forgo spirit link" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-06-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134265#p134265); Skegg's dungeon-farming path skips it only while gearing.
- **1.18.1 impact**: none on talents ("No changes for resto shamans in 1.18.1" — [Burunduk (player), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166121#p166121); the T1 8-set rework is the only change).

stats.heading: Stat priority (60)
stats.markdown:
**Contested between "+healing/Int, ignore mana regen" and "mana-regen gear until T2/T2.5".**

- "Ignore MP5, spirit, and %mana regen gear and stack intellect and +healing, mana regen is a not worth it on shaman. For mana regen farm tea and gold, and buy stacks of major mana potions ... Downranking will solve your mana issues" — [Grubi450 (player), 2024-05-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=94005#p94005).
- "I advise having at least +10% normal mana regen while casting gear on you until you are restricted with T2,5+T2. That plus oranges takes care of most of the mana problems ... make sure that you always have some spirit of zanza" — [Akos1896 (player), 2024-04-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=92081#p92081) (pre-CC2 Improved Water Shield; superseded in part by the 2024-12-20 Water Shield regen talents).
- Skegg (2025-09): "Get as much +healing and +int as you can ... on a badly geared resto shammy, int is pretty important; around a 4k mana pool is recommended - or if your guild clears raids fast enough, you can just drink more pots/tea and oranges between pulls"; enchants "enchanted armor kits that give +9 spell power. 2% haste to shoulder enchant, and then 1% haste vs +12 spellpower to helm/legs; ring/neck enchants (+12 healing) from JC. Belt buckle for +10 intellect"; weapon "the weaker +healing enchant" pre-raid.
- Haste: the T1 8-set needed "a full pump of haste to work" (Travoltino 2026-03-09); with the set gone no haste target exists (gap).
- Leveling/dungeons: "For healing: +int = +hp" (Skegg); "You will be able to heal any dungeon below level 50 quite comfortably in any spec as long as you have int gear" — [Healingrain (player), 2023-03-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37141#p37141).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target healing
rotationAoe.markdown: Chain Heal is the multi-target tool (3 targets, +1 with 1.18.0 T2.5-style bonuses? — no Resto set adds targets in the sources); Healing Stream Totem is "the most mana efficient heal in Shaman's kit by a massive margin" per [Voodoochile (player), 2025-04-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126350#p126350) but "Healing stream totem is still bad" per Akos1896 (**contested**; only "usable with naxx totem" — Travoltino 2026-03-24). Poison/Disease Cleansing Totems are "an absolute beast in ES" (Akos1896 2025-04-10) — drop them instead of clicking Decursive for your own party.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Spirit Link**: 10-min CD (1.18.0), 20 s, 30% redistributed among three linked allies; positioning no longer matters (instant, 35 yd) — Akos1896's 2025-06-04 caveat about 15-yd/2-s casts is superseded.
- **Ancestral Swiftness**: on cooldown in raids unless a hard phase is imminent (Akos1896).
- **Ankh**: wipe protection; do not use instantly, coordinate with the raid leader (Akos1896).
- **Mana**: Water Shield always; Mana Spring while the party drinks and in place; Nordanaar tea; Major Mana Potion; Spirit of Zanza; Dark/Demonic Runes (share CD with tea); "your biggest challenge is to heal just enough while downgrading as much as possible" (Akos1896). Fresh 60 mana gear: Totem of the Calming River (BM), Kara5 "5% mana regen items", Dreambreeze Cowl / Verdant Dreamer's Breastplate BoEs (Akos1896 2024-04-04; pre-CC2 talents, gear still exists).
- **Consumables** (Skegg; Mimiwarmini 2026-02-10): Dreamshard Elixir, Mageblood, Spirit of Zanza, Brilliant Mana/Wizard Oil ("Wizard for stronger heals"), Major Mana Potion, Nordanaar Herbal Tea, Greater Fire Protection; Flask of Distilled Wisdom; Elixir of the Sage; "you need to be somewhat serious with consumables from BWL and really serious from AQ40" — Akos1896 2024-02-12.

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- **Positioning**: ~30 yd from the group so totems (30 yd) and heals (40 yd) reach; near the tank when Spirit Link is planned (now 35 yd).
- **Group**: melee group for Windfury; "If there is an enhancement shaman in your party, let them use WF and strength totems because they have advanced versions. But insist on using manaspring totem, since yours is better" (Akos1896).
- **Totem twisting**: "I'm usually against it ... only worths it if your primary air totem is not windfury for a fight" (Akos1896); Fire Nova/Grounding are on the GCD since 2025-03-30.
- **Triage** (Akos1896): tank first; in dungeons let life-tapping warlocks manage themselves; sacrifice the least useful player if a pull is unsalvageable; bandage casters, not melee.
- **Threat**: Nature's Grace optional; R1 shocks for interrupts; Totem of the Calming River generates no threat at full mana.
- **Loot**: "if you want a cloth healing item and a mail healing item, usually SR the cloth one" (Akos1896); Resto T1 shoulders/8-set were contested loot in 2020 (raid-loot threads).
- **Warlocks**: agree beforehand or let them die (Blaketj/Akos1896) — bots should heal them anyway in raids ("I heal everything in raid").

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Pre-raid** (Skegg 2025-09): DM West legs; BRD gloves (Emperor/Moira), Mantle of Lost Hope, Soot Encrusted Footwear, Guiding Stave of Wisdom, Second Wind; Rivendare's Robe (Strat UD); Royal Seal of Eldre'Thalas (DM); crafted cloak and chest; Black Morass totem ("BiS totem until Naxx") and Kara Crypts pieces; AH greens 54+ with healing (Created Cape "you won't need to replace it until the cape from AQ40's final boss"), Corehound Belt; AD helm/trinket, Mindfang (AB), AV offhand, BM shield/totem/ring, UBRS trinket, Strat vs BM chest. Akos1896 (2024-04): Totem of the Calming River (BM) or Totem of Sustaining (Scholo10); Memento of the Lost (Kara5 neck) → Jindo's Evil Eye / Amulet of the Shifting Sands; Loop of the Forgotten; Shroud of Haunted Torment (cape) or Hide of the Wild; Dreambreeze Cowl (150 bright dream shards), Verdant Dreamer's Breastplate; Zandalarian Hero Charm and Hakkar's Heart (ZG), Sliver of Hope (Kara10); avoid buying Lady Maye's, Remains of the Lost, Dawnstone Hammer.
- **Tier**: "T2 T2.5 T3 - every resto shaman would replace those set bonuses with just more 'green text' stats" (Travoltino 2026-03-09); T3.5 "better than those for paladins" ([Evilchocolate (player), 2025-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117487#p117487)); T3 8-set "is good" (Travoltino). No Resto BiS list by phase exists in the forum (asked 2024-12-10, unanswered — [kalimore (player)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112057#p112057)).
- **Enchants**: see stats section (Skegg).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
1. Overhealing / not downranking ("Whenever you overheal, you threw out mana on the window" — Akos1896).
2. Chain Heal on an isolated target (Akos1896).
3. Skipping Spirit Link or Improved Chain Heal (Atreidon).
4. Totem twisting in raids; re-dropping totems every pull now that range is 30 yd (Skegg).
5. Using Ankh immediately on a boss wipe (Akos1896).
6. Healing Wave spam in raids / expecting the T1 8-set spread after 2026-03-20.
7. Mana-regen gear over +healing once geared (Grubi450) — contested for fresh 60s.
8. Casting Earth Shield in Ghost Wolf (not possible since 2024-11-20).
9. Max-rank Earth Shock to interrupt as a healer ("you are basically taunting a mob onto you" — Gdawg45).
10. Searing Totem near CC (Akos1896).

extraSections.heading: Healing priority ("rotation")
extraSections.markdown:
**Raid (consensus: Skegg, Akos1896, amanagor):**

1. Totems before the pull (30 yd): Windfury / Strength of Earth / Flametongue / Mana Spring in a melee group, Grace of Air for hunters/druids, Tranquil Air in a caster group; Tremor/Grounding/Poison/Disease/Fire Resistance by encounter. Water Shield on. Totemic Recall after every fight ("Some mana for you, nullified chance your left-behind totem pulls a pack" — [Akos1896 (player), 2024-02-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=87618#p87618)).
2. **Spirit Link on the tank at pull or before a known burst** ("If you dont wanna use it during the fight just throw it on at pull and see the tank take significantly less damage for the first 30 seconds" — Atreidon 2025-06-04; Skegg: "use on Maexxna before web wrap"); instant and 35 yd since 1.18.0, 10-min CD.
3. **Chain Heal** as the default raid heal: "Once you're raiding, all you really need is Chain Heal rank 1 besides dropping totems within range of your group" — Skegg; "Until you are geared enough, use r2 chain heal for raids to have enough healing power. Once you are better geared, r1 is your base one for mana saving" — Akos1896 2024-02-12; "always make sure that your target has allies nearby where chain heal can jump. If you target a melee, that's usually not a problem" (same). Max rank when the raid is low.
4. **Lesser Healing Wave** for quick patch-ups where "life totals change so fast that a slower healing wave either leads to death or overheal"; downranked LHW for mana-efficient patching (Akos1896). Since 1.18.0 LHW applies Healing Way 100% at 3/3 and benefits from it.
5. **Healing Wave** for tank healing / steady single-target damage; R1 Healing Wave on the tank before a pull "to make sure he runs in with an ancestral fortitude buff" (Akos1896; Skegg: "use r1 Healing Wave sometimes just to trigger Healing Way procs and fish for +armor on tanks").
6. **Ancestral Swiftness (3-min CD)**: "someone is about to die -> NS into max level healing wave ... Big aoe damage happened -> NS into max rank chain heal" (Akos1896).
7. **Berserking (Troll) on cooldown** when heavy healing is expected; "use a rune, get some mana, lose a bunch of life, activate berserking" trick (Akos1896).
8. **Dare to be lazy**: "If there is nothing to do in a raid fight, sit back for 5+ seconds for mana regen" (Akos1896); interrupt your own heal when someone else landed theirs.
9. Filler damage: Flame Shock / Searing Totem only if mana allows and no CC nearby; Earth Shock R1 to interrupt (Akos1896; [Gdawg45 (player), 2023-12-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=82330#p82330)).

**Dungeon (Skegg, Akos1896)**: "use the latest rank of Healing Wave and Lesser Healing Wave, and -2 downranked Healing Wave, eg. r5 HW and LHW + r3 HW"; Chain Heal when cleave damage; Hex a mob when the pull is too big ("the 'pull was a bit too big, let's try to make it manageable' button" — Akos1896); Earthbind/Frost Shock to escape mobs; Fire Nova/Magma for damage in dungeons only.

**Spell ranks on bars** (Akos1896 layout, 2024-02-12): Chain Heal max / R1 / R2; LHW max / R3 / R5; HW max / R5 / R7; HW R1 as a "buff"; Earth Shock R1 (interrupt) / Flame Shock max / Earth Shock max.

**Pre-1.18.1 T1 8-set playstyle (obsolete 2026-03-20)**: HW/LHW spam with haste to spread 20% of the heal to two nearby allies, chaining Healing Way mana returns; "T1 was another way to play resto shaman but it was another one button spam" — [Kokuyoo (player), 2026-03-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170419#p170419); staff: "This nerf is necessary or your gear progression for 8gearslots ends in molten core!" (Atreidon paraphrasing intent, 2026-01-26); Jamey: "That interaction is intended."

standing.source_quality: strong: wide consensus on standing, healing priority and mechanics; gear/BiS-by-phase is the weakest part
standing.notes: The most-wanted class/spec combination in the game per multiple sources; Chain-Heal-centric raid AoE healing plus Spirit Link. Contested only on whether it is boring and whether 1.18.x nerfs hurt. Its only 1.18.1 change was the T1 8-set becoming a 25%-chance absorb proc on Healing Wave / Lesser Healing Wave.

playbooks.title: Shaman — Enhancement melee DPS (raids and dungeons)
playbooks.intro: Playbook for two-handed Windfury Enhancement on Turtle WoW after Class Changes 2 (patch 1.17.2, live 2024-10/11), the 1.18.0 adjustments (2025-08-15) and patch 1.18.1 (2026-03-20). A second, minority playstyle — **"spellhance"** (one-hander + shield, Frostbrand/Flametongue, spell power gear, Electrify/Elemental Fury) — is documented where the sources cover it. Every claim is cited and dated; **pre-1.18.1**, **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03..2026-03-19) and **post-1.18.1** are marked.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: two-handed melee DPS whose damage is auto-attacks + Windfury procs + three instants (Stormstrike, Lightning Strike, a Shock) with Lightning Shield charges as a fourth damage source; brings Windfury / Strength of Earth / Flametongue / Mana Spring totems and self-Bloodlust.
- **Community standing**: **contested** between "very viable" and "far behind warriors". For: "nummerically speaking enhancement is one of the big winners of the patch what pve is concerned" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121471#p121471); "sub 2 hour naxx clears ... with enhancement shaman near the top" — [Drubarrymooer (player), 2025-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115650#p115650); "Enhancement shaman is better in terms of dps, can be in upper half" — [pagu (player), 2026-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174156#p174156) (post-1.18.1); "Enh has simple rotation with huge dps compared to elemental" — [Mdzielak (player), 2026-04-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173707#p173707). Against: "a bis warrior does over 30% more dps than a bis ele and 38% more dps than a bis enha" — [amanagor (player), 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115753#p115753); "Enh Shaman remain relatively weak in the grand scheme of DPS'ers, particularly on Nordanaar with late-game scaling" — [Phx (player), 2026-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173678#p173678). Staff view: "Enhancement, thanks to a steady supply of cautious buffs, the class is rising as a top contender for high single-target damage-dealing during its windows of power, namely Bloodlust ... Future efforts will be devoted to carefully tuning the class and bring it on par with other melee single-target damage-dealers" — [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460).
- **Raid spot**: always available because of Windfury Totem, but guilds prefer Restoration: "Most guilds want shamans but they'd prefer said shaman to be resto. Still, you can easily find raid spots as ele or enh" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115603#p115603); "Raids really like to see 1 WF totem in every melee party" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115643#p115643); "They are designed as mostly single-target focused, burst DPS, meaning that in shorter windows they can output disgusting damage. Very good for farmed contents, not really effective for progression" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117662#p117662).
- **Strengths**: WF procs that scale with gear ([Taralej90, 2025-04-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126159#p126159)), self-Bloodlust burst window, cleave via Fire Nova / Chain Lightning ("shamans has some of the best cleave damage assets in his kit. Both chain lightning as well as fire nova totem" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-04-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173712#p173712)), party utility.
- **Weaknesses**: RNG ("Very RNG-dependent — some fights, you top the meters, others, you don't" — [Franktank (player), 2025-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124808#p124808)); threat ("your damage output doesn't match the threat output ... it's not difficult to pull threat even if you're, say, not even top 3 on the meter" — [Phx (player), 2026-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173678#p173678); "Threat Magnet - beg for salv" — Franktank above); mana outside raids ("an interesting build now built around being oom" — [Akos1896 (player), 2024-12-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113240#p113240)); the Windfury Totem you drop does nothing for you while an imbue is active (staff rule below); Enhancement has no real AoE of its own ([Phx, 2026-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173678#p173678), contested by Atreidon above).
- **Content**: raids MC–Naxx/Kara40 and dungeons; leveling — see `leveling.md`; PvP — see the PvP section below.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
No source lists a full 51-point endgame Enhancement DPS build in text; the builds are calculator links. Use them as-is.

- **Atreidon's raid build (2025-03-03, pre-1.18.1, single source, widely referenced author)**: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman?points=FQAYNAAAAAAAAAFAFaAIFADIAoAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` — "Grab lightning strike and stormstrike first, get elemental focus afterwards for better manamanagement, finish by grabbing the remaining talents. The remaining 5 points allocate as you see fit. Bloodlust is extremely manahungry and requires some crit rating to be useful so not needed till raiding" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121471#p121471).
- **Konstanten's leveling/dungeon build (2025-02-03)**: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman?points=FQAYIAAAAAAAAAFAFaAIFADIAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` — "With the first 11 points, get the elemental focus talent from the elemental tree ... When you get elemental weapons, use the frostbrand imbue paired with frost shock" — [Konstanten (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118793#p118793).
- **Toxo's "Dps talents" (2025-05-10)**: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman?points=DoAYNAAAAAAAAAFAFYYIFATIAoBAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` with the note "Dps side only needs Calming Winds as a mandatory talent if you have high gear, Enhancing Totems is optional" — [Toxo (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130412#p130412).
- **Named talents the sources agree are core (consensus)**: Elemental Focus (11 Elemental points: Convection 5 + Concussion or Elemental Warding + Elemental Devastation 3), Thundering Strikes 5, Stable Shields 3, Lightning Strike, Flurry 5, Elemental Weapons 3, Stormstrike, Element's Grace 5, Bloodlust; Ancestral Knowledge 5 once gear has stats ("You are bulky enough now that shield spec is not mandatory ... ancestral knowledge, despite its description, gives the 10% after the stat bonuses are added" — [Akos1896 (player), 2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112575#p112575); the talent became 1–5% total stats on 2024-12-20). Calming Winds 3 for raids (Toxo above; "1/3 Calming Winds for lower threat ... I'd go for less threat when raiding" — [Franktank (player), 2025-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124808#p124808)).
- **Spellhance variant (single source)**: Franktank's Electrify build `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman?points=FgAYNQAABAAAAAFAFYIIFALIAoAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` — Convection 5, Concussion 5, Ancestral Knowledge 5, Elemental Devastation 3, Thundering Strikes 5, Stable Shields 3, Elemental Focus, Reverberation 5, Call of Thunder 1, Calming Winds 1 or Ancestral Guardian 1, Lightning Strike, Flurry 5, Electrify (now Elemental Fury 2 pts), Enhancing Totems 1, Elemental Weapons 3, Stormstrike, Weapon Mastery 5 — [Franktank (player), 2025-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124808#p124808). Written for the 2-stack Electrify era (2024-12-20 .. 2025-08-14); 1.18.0 turned Electrify into a 2-point passive Elemental Fury and Reverberation into 3 points, so the exact point count no longer fits — treat as a template, not a build.
- **1.18.1 impact**: no Enhancement talent moved; Flurry, Elemental Weapons (all four imbue effects) and Water Shield's LS ratio changed. No source posts an updated 1.18.1 build (valid_for_1181 = unknown).

stats.heading: Stat priority (60)
stats.markdown:
**Consensus** (Skegg's compiled guide, Taralej90, Atreidon, Akos1896, wiki `Shaman guide`):

1. **Weapon skill to 315** ("If you're a melee class, then you want to go for the hard cap of 315, period" — [Taralej90 (player), 2025-08-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147005#p147005); "the +5 weapon skill got nerfed to +3, and the weapon skill glancing damage cap is now 315, not 308" — [Crake (player), 2025-09-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151912#p151912)). Sources: Orc racial +3, the 250 g weapon-skill book quest (+5, `t=16790`), items (+6/7/8). Glancing per the tank guide: 35% proc, −35% damage, "We can reduce Glancing damage reduction by a maximum of 30% or 15 weapon skill points" — [Mimiwarmini (player), 2024-12-02 (edited to 2026-03-22)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110875#p110875).
2. **Hit to 8%** — "The hit cap on T-WoW is 8 instead of 9 because the useless hidden 1% from vanilla has been removed" — Taralej90 above; "Aim for 8% hit for melee. You'll get 3% from talents, and another 1% from Weapon Skill book ... So usually, you'll only need to get 4% more from gear/weapon skill" — [Skegg (player, guide writer), 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149715#p149715). Spell hit for shocks comes from Elemental Devastation procs; the tank guide measured "the devastation talent increases the hit spell by 12% under proc" — [Mimiwarmini (player)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110875#p110875).
3. **Crit** — "At early gear levels, you severely lack crit to keep Flurry and Clearcasting up, which are the bread and butter of your DPS. Beyond T2 you should just go for Str" — Taralej90 above; "the rule of thumb is to get 30-35% crit, then start stacking AP and +haste (the more haste you get the better)" — Skegg above.
4. **Strength > Agility** at 60 ("Str > 2 AP due to it scaling with talents and buffs" — Taralej90; "shamans get 0 AP per agi, 2 AP from str and 1% dodge and 1% crit per 20 agi" — Skegg).
5. **Haste** after crit (Skegg above).
6. **Stamina before Int/Spirit/mp5** — "Pretend mp5 doesnt exist ... Spirit intellect and mp5 should all never prioritized over stamina. You are still a relatively flimsy melee if you rock a twohander" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-08-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147011#p147011); Akos1896 disagrees only for levelers: "LS does AP scaling and before having a good-enough gear (most levelers) it costs mana, doesn't recharge it" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-08-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147014#p147014).

Equivalence table (Skegg, compiled from the Discord #shaman channel; "1 X = AP / SP" — single source, pre-1.18.1): 1% phys hit ≈ 29.09 AP (to the 8% cap); 1% phys crit ≈ 20.69 AP (cap 54%); 1 weapon skill ≈ 16.66 AP; 1% haste ≈ 10.64 AP; 1 Str = 2.3 AP; 1 Agi ≈ 1.13 AP; 1 spell hit ≈ 9.13 AP; 1 spell crit ≈ 2.70 AP; 1 SP ≈ 0.54 AP; 1 armor pen ≈ 0.34 AP; 1 spell pen ≈ 3.12 AP; 1 Int ≈ 0.05 AP — [Skegg (player, guide writer), 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149715#p149715) (also on the community wiki `Shaman guide`, revision 2026-07-03).

**T3 hit overcap**: "Why do we have 6% hit on our enhance t3? ... assuming we're using t3 and our talents, no jewelry or trinkets, we're at 9% hit ... things like the t2 Chest, Boots, and Gloves are better than the t3 versions because they have haste. Only the t3 helm has haste" — [Tipper (player), 2025-08-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=145460#p145460); "6 piece is useless ... no one cares about t3 anymore, t3.5 is where its at" — [Therlx (player), 2025-08-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=146036#p146036).

**Spellhance stats** (single source): "Attack Power > AGI > Spell Power > Hit/Crit% ... AP seems king after the Shaman rework" — [Franktank (player), 2025-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124808#p124808).

While leveling: "+str = +agi > +stam > +int (+str & +agi roughly on par, at 60 +str is more valuable than +agi)" — Skegg above.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown:
**Consensus (Skegg's guide = Discord #shaman compilation, Franktank, Atreidon):**

Pre-pull: Windfury Weapon on the 2H (1 h duration), Lightning Shield (9 charges with Stable Shields), totems down (Strength of Earth, Windfury, Flametongue, Mana Spring — Skegg). Do not pre-Bloodlust; it is a 30-s self buff (see cooldowns).

1. **Running in: Flame Shock** (30 yd range via Call of Flame only if talented; otherwise 20 yd) "or Earth Shock if immune" — "Don't use Flame Shock on targets that won't live more than 9-15 seconds ... At max level it's always at least 3 ticks (9 seconds)" — [Skegg (player, guide writer), 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149715#p149715). Flame Shock lasts 15 s since 2024-12-20.
2. **Stormstrike** on cooldown (8 s) — grants the +25% Nature buff (2 charges) that Earth Shock and Lightning Shield charges consume.
3. **Lightning Strike** on cooldown (9 s) with Lightning Shield up.
4. **Shock on cooldown (6 s; 5 s with Reverberation 3/3)**: Earth Shock while the Stormstrike buff is up; re-apply Flame Shock when it has < 3 s left or has dropped ("Earth Shock (or Flame Shock to reapply debuff), repeat. TL;DR: FS/ES -> SS -> LS, repeat" — Skegg). Staff intent for 1.18.0: "We're slightly buffing Stormstrike's bonus effect to move Earth Shock higher in priority" — [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159).
5. **Never hold Stormstrike or Lightning Strike for a Windfury window**: "If you hold a stormstrike until wf is ready, you on average get 0.2 autoattacks worth of damage. Every time you cast the ability you gain ~1 auto attacks worth regardless of wf cd. So its never worth holding your stormstrike or lightning strike for more than 1/5 of their cooldown" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141835#p141835). Taralej90's contrary tip (delay strikes to just after the auto-attack because a WF proc on a strike resets the swing timer) is **contested**; Atreidon's post is later and addresses DPS, Taralej90's is a mechanics note.
6. **Clearcasting**: with Elemental Focus every crit (melee or spell) gives 2 charges of −60% mana; since 2025-03-30 they also discount Stormstrike and Lightning Strike, so simply keep casting on cooldown — no source recommends fishing for procs at 60.
7. **Re-cast Lightning Shield** when charges run out (Lightning Strike eats one per use); swap to Water Shield below roughly the mana you need for the rest of the fight (no source gives a %).

**Spellhance/Electrify variant (single source, Franktank)**: "1. Chain Lightning or Lightning Bolt opener for Electrify stacks ... You can also cast 2 Rank 1 LBs to build 2 stacks in 3 seconds. 2. Frost Shock for guaranteed Frostbrand crits (or Earth Shock if running WF). 3. Spam auto attacks, Lightning Strike, Stormstrike. 4. If using Hand of Edward the Odd, spam CL when it procs" — [Franktank (player), 2025-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124808#p124808). Since 1.18.0 Electrify is a passive Elemental Fury, so step 1 is obsolete; the Frost Shock + Frostbrand core still applies only to non-boss targets.

**Spell ranks**: Earth Shock R1 is the interrupt (0.5× threat vs max rank per the tank/resto guides); Lightning Bolt R1 (~0.5 s cast per Manletow) was the Electrify stack builder — irrelevant after 1.18.0.

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **2–3 targets**: keep the single-target loop on the kill target; the sources give no spread rotation for DPS. Chain Lightning is "worth considering even as a melee" ([Atreidon (player), 2026-04-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173712#p173712)) but costs a 2.5-s cast (1.5 s per Mdzielak on Ele) and 490 mana.
- **4+ targets**: run in, drop **Fire Nova Totem** (triggers GCD, 15-s CD; 413–459 base, +30% fire with Elemental Weapons Flametongue after a melee hit) then **Magma Totem** (650 mana), plus Chain Lightning; "We wanna run into the pack to drop firenova and afterwards magma totem" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-04-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174801#p174801). Both totems now inherit the shaman's spell hit/crit (staff 2025-07-25/08-26). Recall totems (Totemic Recall, 25% refund per totem, +15% with Totemic Mastery) after the pack.
- Fire totems scale with spell power, not AP: "There's no scaling on your Fire totems unless you're Elemental or some Spellhance hybrid" — [Phx (player), 2026-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173678#p173678).
- Threat: Fire Nova is "huge snap threat" (Skegg's tank notes) — do not open with it on trash when the tank is a shaman or paladin without Salvation.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Bloodlust** (300-s CD, 395 mana per the tank guide): 20% haste for 30 s on yourself; your melee crits give the party +8% for 6 s. Use it at the start of a boss fight once Flame Shock/Stormstrike are up, and again on cooldown; "top contender ... during its windows of power, namely Bloodlust" — [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460). With Troll Berserking it is "an almost bloodlust on a smaller CD" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149742#p149742).
- **Racials**: Orc Blood Fury (+AP, +SP, −25% healing 25 s; staff 2024-10-12 batch) and axe skill — "Orc is still a decent choice for Enhance PvE (axe skill helps + Blood Fury)" — Skegg; Taralej90 ranks Orc first for WF glancing reasons; estebanmgn's tests put Orc ahead of Troll in short fights, Troll ahead only past ~22 s with a hypothetical racial buff — [estebanmgn (player), 2025-04-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126341#p126341) (single source). Feral Spirit (Orc, 5-min CD) wolves scale with the shaman's damage since 2023-05-24 and no longer with AP since CC2; Manletow's "equip a Rockbiter 2H before summoning" trick ([Manletow (player), 2024-06-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=96568#p96568)) predates that removal — **outdated**.
- **Mana**: "be ready to chug mana pots and tea on CD to max damage to sustain Lightning shield longer otherwise you swap to Water shield when you're low on mana. Your mana consumption will also go down in raids, especially if you have ferals around. Blessing of Kings, Mark of the Wild, elixirs like Mongoose and Dreamshard" — Skegg. Mana Spring Totem for the party; Judgement of Wisdom from a paladin if available. Water Shield + Lightning Strike math (tank guide): LS costs 0 mana with Water Shield at 936 AP ("Any AP point above 936 will cause us to generate mana") — [Mimiwarmini (player)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110875#p110875) (18:1 ratio; written for tanks, applies to DPS with Water Shield).
- **Drink** between pulls in dungeons when below the mana for one full pack; in raids use Nordanaar Herbal Tea and Major Mana Potions on cooldown (Skegg).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- **Positioning**: behind the boss (parries/dodges waste WF procs — [Voodoochile (player), 2025-07-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141504#p141504)); in the melee group so your Windfury/Strength of Earth/Flametongue totems (30 yd) cover them.
- **Threat**: take Calming Winds 3/3 (25%) and ask for Blessing of Salvation; Earth Shock keeps its 1.5× threat modifier and is not covered by Calming Winds ("Calming Winds ... ours doesn't include Earth Shock" — [Phx (player), 2026-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173678#p173678); "Many fights i cant even use frostshocks on cd without taking aggro (without Salvation)" — [Dezhan (player), 2024-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106681#p106681)). Never use Rockbiter in a raid as DPS (+35% threat).
- **Interrupts**: Earth Shock R1 (6-s/5-s CD) and Grounding Totem (20-s CD, GCD, breaks on CC); Purge has an 8-s CD since 1.18.0 (revision) — plan purges, do not spam.
- **Totem duty**: Windfury + Strength of Earth (+ Flametongue, Mana Spring) in the melee group; "At 60 you're gonna use Windfury imbue, but you're still gonna drop Windfury Totem (and Flametongue Totem) for your party even if you don't benefit from it" — Skegg. Grace of Air instead of Windfury only for hunter/druid/tank groups — see [Mimiwarmini (player), 2026-02-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168008#p168008) vs [Elesion (player), 2026-02-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168045#p168045) (bears prefer WF for rage) — **contested**.
- **Relic**: Totem of the Stonebreaker (ES) over Totem of Crackling Thunder (Kara10): "Crackling thunder used to be really good, now its numbers are pathetic ... 1.6% haste on LS ... stonebreaker is probably the better choice" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-06-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135891#p135891). Relic swapping in combat now costs a GCD ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)).
- **PvP tactics (Enhancement)** — sources treat it as burst-then-kited: "Enhance sham has gotten a few new skills/combo that increased their burst but are easily kited in pvp. If you are able to get to the target you have a fair shot and with gear can 1 shot clothies with a lucky WF proc" — [Evolve (player), 2025-05-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=129436#p129436); "They seem to be dependant on Stormstrike though so they do huge damage on their first global then have to wait 8 sec for CD. Very predictable burst" — [Forumdweller (player), 2025-05-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=129441#p129441); "Enh shaman with 2h is the squishiest melee ... Tank shaman with a shield is good, but dont have burst ... Maybe B" — [pagu (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130405#p130405); "2H ehna has the same weakness as before: no hard CCS, no defensive cds, no way to properly reset a fight, extremely weak to kiting. If you feel edgy you can play the ehna 1h + shields, decent in duels" — [Staywhimsy (player), 2024-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110894#p110894). Lightning Strike "can also be used while silenced" — [amanagor (player), 2025-05-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131960#p131960). Race for PvP: Tauren (War Stomp, +5% HP) per Skegg and [Springboards (player), 2025-05-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130038#p130038). Post-1.18.1 the 25% WF is expected to make Enhancement stronger ("this change alone will completely ruin pvp" — [Terrydavis (player), 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171418#p171418)); PvP dampening is class/spec-dependent from 1.18.1 ([Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169701#p169701)) — values for Shaman not stated. See `elemental-pvp.md` for the ele/enh hybrid.

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Pre-raid** (Skegg, 2025-09-01, pre-1.18.1): Skyfury Helm (level-58 shaman trainer quest, Scholomance, `database.turtlecraft.gg/?quest=7667`) or Strat mail helm / BRD or UBRS eyepatch; Hateforge Armor set (Blacksmithing, `itemset=615`) then Towerforge Battlegear (`itemset=630`, Kara10); pre-BiS mace `item=83440`; chest options `quest=5166`, `item=60008`, `item=14611`, `item=13090`; BM +2% hit shoulders or Kara5 shoulders; Arcanite Reaper / Bonecrusher / Treant's Bane / Unstoppable Force; Stormshroud shoulders and hands (LW, ~50) and Devilsaur hands/legs (53/55); +5 weapon-skill book. Pre-raid list video linked by Winckler91 ([2025-08-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144749#p144749)). Other askers were sent to Discord or told "Go do Bgs and get TUF, and stam/str gear" — [Springboards (player), 2025-11-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157996#p157996). Post-1.18.1: "getting into kara10, zg & mc is easy often even in just questing greens. And that gear is much stronger than many dungeon items" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-04-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174001#p174001).
- **Tier**: T1 5-set buffs Flametongue vs Flame Shocked targets by 45% (reported as bugged/negative in 2024-11: [Boeuff (player), 2024-11-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107840#p107840)); "t2 seems quite underwhelming compared to t3 and t1 and there is a drought when aq comes out because there is no enhancer set in that phase" — [Ninetyone (player), 2025-09-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150426#p150426); "For AQ40 what you tend to do is stick with T2 set and go for the better 2h, trinkets, rings and neck" — [Toxo (player), 2025-09-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151884#p151884); T3 overcapped on hit, T3.5 (Stormhowl) is the target (Tipper/Therlx above). No T3.5 bonus text for Enhancement is in the sources (gap).
- **Enchants**: Crusader on the 2H (Skegg's tank list; no DPS-specific enchant thread); 2% threat gloves are for tanks. Gap: full DPS enchant list.
- **Consumables** (Skegg, consensus with Mimiwarmini's per-spec list [2026-02-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167850#p167850)): starter — Elixir of the Mongoose, R.O.I.D.S., Juju Power, Dreamshard Elixir, Greater Arcane Elixir, Nordanaar Herbal Tea; full — Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose, Concoction of the Arcane Giant, Concoction of the Dreamwater, Elixir of Greater Nature Power, Elixir of Greater Firepower, R.O.I.D.S., Flask of the Titans/Supreme Power, Spirit/Swiftness of Zanza, Mageblood, Elixir of Superior Defense, Danonzo's Tel'Abim Medley, Rumsey Rum Black Label / Medivh's Merlot, Juju Flurry, Nordanaar Herbal Tea, Major Mana Potion, Goblin Sapper Charge, Potion of Quickness. Mimiwarmini's Enhancement list adds Elixir of Brute Force, Power Mushroom, Juju Ember. "Paladins and Shamans (both melee types) benefit from the newer(ly) added concoctions that boost melee and spell damage" — [raid consumables thread, 2025-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162593#p162593).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
1. Using Rockbiter or Earth Shock spam as DPS without Salvation — threat (Dezhan, Phx above).
2. Holding Stormstrike/Lightning Strike for Windfury (Atreidon above).
3. Flame Shock on targets that die in < 9 s (Skegg).
4. Wearing 8/8 T3 for the bonuses while overcapping hit (Tipper).
5. Expecting Windfury Totem to buff yourself while an imbue is on (staff rule); or using Flametongue imbue instead of WF + Flametongue Totem + oil at 60 (Atreidon 2026-04-11).
6. Frostbrand on bosses (immune to Frost Shock's slow, so no guaranteed crits) — Taralej90.
7. Bloodlust before Flame Shock/Stormstrike are set up, or before you have crit to feed its party effect (Atreidon 2025-03-03 on mana/crit).
8. Chasing mp5/Int/Spirit gear (Atreidon 2025-08-19).
9. Dropping totems every pull while soloing ("They're not often worth dropping since you'll be killing faster than the mana is worth" — Skegg).
10. Post-1.18.1: assuming Flurry works from white crits — as of 2026-03-24 players still reported it did not, and Elemental Weapons' Windfury haste may override it (Splitsec, Travoltino).
