| Sets | Enh T3 6-set duration 5 → 10 s (2025-03-30); Enh T2.5 5-set reworked for Earthen Bulwark (1.18.1, fixed 03-21) | [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504), [Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272), [Torta (staff), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608) |

Player-verified interactions (pre-1.18.1, single-source tests by Taralej90 on a dummy with 308 weapon skill, 31.22% crit, 758 AP): "FT and FB use spell crit and only crit for 50% dmg; FT and FB crits can proc Clearcasting but not Flurry; FB is the only weapon imbue that interacts with WF totem; WF attacks can proc Flurry but do not consume Flurry stacks; During a WF proc, you have a small window of about 1 sec where you gain the increased 323 AP ... Any attacks (or last-rank shocks) done during that 1 sec window will benefit; WF can proc off strikes, but doing so resets the AA timer ... it is best to delay your strikes for just after your AA" — [Taralej90 (player), 2025-04-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126159#p126159). "lightning strike procs FT ench twice" — [pagu (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130407#p130407). The Stormstrike tooltip showing "1%" is a typo, the buff says 20% — [Studbucket (player), 2025-03-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121897#p121897). Post-1.18.1 bug reports: Flurry "Only triggers from critical strikes made with either directly damaging spells, or critical strikes from Stormstrike and Lightning Strike. Does not trigger on melee swings or imbues. It also currently gets overwritten by the Windfury effect from Elemental Weapons" — [Splitsec (player), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171655#p171655); "Flurry and elemental weapons are broken at the moment" — [Volth (player), 2026-03-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171740#p171740); after the 03-25 fix a player still asks whether Elemental Weapons' Windfury haste overrides Flurry — [Travoltino (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172153#p172153) (unanswered; the 04-01 hotfix only says Rushing Winds and Flurry stack).

extraSections.heading: Weapon imbue and shield choice
extraSections.markdown:
- **Windfury Weapon at 60 for raids (consensus)**: Taralej90's 10-min dummy test (pre-1.18.1): vs level-60 dummy Rockbiter 178 / **Windfury 220** / Flametongue 178 / Frostbrand 178 / Frostbrand+WF totem 230 DPS; vs boss dummy Windfury 167 / Flametongue 138 / Frostbrand 151 / Frostbrand+WF totem 167. "Windfury comes out on top in almost every situation. It also scales with the rest of your gear, unlike all other weapon imbues" — [Taralej90 (player), 2025-04-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126159#p126159). "Windfury is preferred for raiding" — Skegg. In 1.18.1 WF went to 25% per hit ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) — no post-release imbue test exists.
- **Frostbrand + Frost Shock** for dungeons/soloing and for one-hand builds ("Nope for 1h damage FB ench + Frost shock still the best, but with wf and ft totem it is even better" — [pagu (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130407#p130407)); useless on bosses because "bosses are immune to the effect of Frost Shock" — Taralej90 above; "Frostbrand utterly pointless once you stop leveling" — [Travoltino (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172162#p172162).
- **Flametongue** only with Elemental Weapons and fire-totem play; after 1.18.1 the +30% Fire bonus needs a melee hit first: "you usually want to apply Flame Shock while running in to your target. But you loose 30% of it's potential damage if you didn't wait for a hit to proc it. Similarly, if you get parried or dodged, the buff might fade ... it's peak comedy, that using a weapon oil and WF + FT Totems is now outperforming Flametongue imbue" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-04-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174801#p174801) (post-1.18.1).
- **Rockbiter never as DPS** ("anything but Rockbiter - at 60 WF" — Skegg) except leveling (Taralej90: "Rockbiter remains the best weapon imbue for leveling").
- **Shield**: Lightning Shield for damage, Water Shield when mana is low: "use Windfury imbue + Lightning Shield; swap to Water Shield when low on mana. Keep up Lightning Shield" — Skegg; "chug mana pots and tea on CD to max damage to sustain Lightning shield longer otherwise you swap to Water shield" — Skegg. Water Shield with Lightning Strike returns "130 mana (without attackpower) 20 attackpower gives 1 mana" (18 AP per mana since 1.18.1) — [Dezhan (player), 2024-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106681#p106681); Atreidon: "You can generate thousands of mana per minute with watershield and lightning strike" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-08-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147011#p147011) (contested by Akos1896 for low gear, same thread).
- **Weapon**: slowest 2H with the highest top-end ("After getting Lightning Strike, try to have as slow of a 2H as possible ... enhance prefers slow weapons with high top-end dmg" — Skegg). Pre-raid: Arcanite Reaper or Bonecrusher, Treant's Bane, Unstoppable Force (AV exalted), Boneshatter Maul (Kara Crypts), Dreadforge Retaliator (BRD), Sleeping Willow (UBRS) — Skegg; [Toxo (player), 2025-09-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151884#p151884). Nightfall as "a signature Enh weapon" — Taralej90. Hand of Edward the Odd for spellhance ("was made for this build — fast attacks = more Frostbrand procs + instant CLs" — Franktank).

standing.source_quality: medium: rotation and imbue interactions are consensus; standing contested; no full text talent build exists
standing.notes: Two-handed Windfury DPS with a minority 'spellhance' (1H + shield, Frostbrand) variant. Always has a raid seat because of Windfury Totem, but contested on raw output against warriors, and threat-prone. 1.18.1 reworked every imbue via Elemental Weapons and made Flurry trigger off any critical strike; rotation impact unconfirmed.

patch_validity.notes: 1.18.1 changed Windfury Weapon (25% per hit), Flurry (any crit, 3 swings, reworked trigger), Elemental Weapons' Windfury/Flametongue effects, and the Lightning Strike Water Shield ratio to 18:1; no talent points moved. No source posts an updated build or rotation after 2026-03-20, and post-release bug reports (Flurry not triggering correctly, overwritten by Elemental Weapons' haste) were still open on 2026-04-07.

playbooks.title: Shaman — Elemental ranged DPS (raids and dungeons)
playbooks.intro: Playbook for Elemental on Turtle WoW after Class Changes 2 (1.17.2), the 1.18.0 rework (Electrify → Elemental Fury, new Elemental Mastery, Earthquake, Molten Blast, Improved Molten Blast; live 2025-08-15) and patch 1.18.1 (2026-03-20: Call of Earth, Earthquake +15% / 18 s, Elemental Weapons Flametongue now needs melee hits, relic-swap GCD). Two sub-styles existed in the sources: **Nature ("lightning") Elemental**, the baseline, and **Fire Elemental** (Molten Blast spam with Elemental Weapons Flametongue), which 1.18.1 deliberately weakened. Eras are marked.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: ranged caster in the melee group (for Windfury), single-target Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning with a Flame Shock maintained by Molten Blast, strong cleave (Chain Lightning, Fire Nova/Magma, Earthquake), off-heals, Purge, Earth Shock interrupt.
- **Community standing**: **contested**; consensus that Elemental is taken but bottom-half single-target. "Mana issues are there only early on when your gear is bad. I dont need to use mana pots in most fights in nax/kara40. Dps wise you are middle of the pack. We just lack some useful caster totem. Due to this most guilds will only have 1-2 max ele shamans" — [Agentsmith (player), 2025-06-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134625#p134625); "Ele is okay. You really want a thunderfury tank. You're probably forced to use WF totem" — [Akos1896 (player), 2025-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117662#p117662); post-1.18.1: "elemental unfortunately is a very weak spec in raid environments ... Only elemental shaman and to an extent boomkin lack this support [Curse of Elements/Shadow] ... in aoe encounters, we can mostly hold our own. But when it comes to single target dps, you will never be in the top 10 if your raid knows what they are doing" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-04-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174001#p174001); "1.5k dps seems to be where the ceiling is. Meanwhile rogues top end is a cool 1.1k dps higher" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172156#p172156); "your damage in raids will be in bottom half of dps meters ... In cleave/aoe situations you can show good numbers" — [pagu (player), 2026-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174156#p174156); "As ele shaman I'm in bottom dps table, behind me it's usually balance druid" — [Mdzielak (player), 2026-04-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175015#p175015). Staff (2024-12-20): "We are generally satisfied with how elemental has risen among the other classes as a very capable and efficient multi-target damage-dealer while not falling behind on its single-target capabilities" — [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460).
- **Strengths**: cleave/AoE, utility (totems, Purge, Grounding, off-heals), "You can play any DPS spec you want" — [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-06-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135886#p135886).
- **Weaknesses** (consensus): no raid debuff amplifies Nature ("Elemental shamans DPS is roughly 66% nature damage ... we deal about 18.4% less damage compared to someone using only fire or shadowspells" — [Atreidon, 2026-04-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174801#p174801)); crit-dependent mana ("clearcasting needs crits to work ... in a very bad situation i had almost 0 crits on onyxia and was oom in the middle of 2nd phase" — [pagu (player), 2025-09-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151552#p151552)); pushback ("Shaman has no guaranteed pushback immunity for Molten Blast. The best we have under realistic situations is 80%" — Atreidon 2026-04-11); totems give the caster nothing ("our totems do nothing for us" — [Kokuyoo (player), 2026-03-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170416#p170416)); Earthquake nerfed/bugged in 1.18.1 (below).
- **Content**: raids (cleave fights best: Gnarlmoon, Incantagos per Atreidon), dungeons, farming (Lasher farm — see `leveling.md`); PvP — see `elemental-pvp.md`.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
No source lists a full point-by-point 60 Elemental build; the standard is deep Elemental with Enhancement filler.

- **Named core (consensus)**: Convection 5, Concussion 5, Elemental Devastation 3 (needed toward the 17% spell-hit cap), Elemental Focus, Call of Thunder 5, Reverberation 3, Call of Flame 3, Improved Fire Totems 2 (Searing), Improved Molten Blast 2, Elemental Fury 2, Elemental Mastery, Lightning Mastery 5, Earthquake; Enhancement: Ancestral Knowledge 5, Thundering Strikes / Stable Shields as reachable. Skegg's leveling Elemental filler shows the 11-point Elemental Focus path; Aluevera's PvP 31/17/0 (see `elemental-pvp.md`) is the only explicit split in text.
- **Fire Elemental (pre-1.18.1 only)**: Elemental Weapons 3 in Enhancement + Call of Flame, Molten Blast spam; "Now fire elemental shaman with molten blast is top DPS" — [Elisleris (player), 2025-09-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152498#p152498); "Fire spec ele ... has good 1 target dps ... dont need to track fire shock duration ... hard to oom ... disadvantage - alot of fire immune bosses in mc/bwl+ony" — [pagu (player), 2025-09-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151552#p151552). Fire-immune/resistant list for MC/Ony/BWL (Duids: Ragnaros, Onyxia, Vaelastrasz, Firemaw, Ebonroc, Flamegor, Nefarian immune; Lucifron 93, Gehennas 186, Shazzrah 93, Sulfuron 93, Golemagg 186, Majordomo 95 fire resist) — [Duids (player), 2025-09-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153164#p153164). 1.18.1 made the +30% conditional on melee hits, so "in 1.18.1 ill go back to nature for sure" — [pagu (player), 2026-01-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166819#p166819) (**superseded**).
- **Talents the sources say to skip**: Eye of the Storm/old pushback talent ("the worst antipushback for pve" — pagu 2025-09-13; replaced by Call of Earth in 1.18.1 — Atreidon still rates it 80% at best); Nature's Grace (Resto) only for over-aggro.
- **1.18.1 impact**: Call of Earth added (Earth Shield charges + pushback; ES stacks replenished by offensive Nature spells per the 03-19 revision), Earthquake +15% / 18 s (then reported broken), Elemental Fury covers Frost. No post-release build posted (valid_for_1181 = unknown).

stats.heading: Stat priority (60)
stats.markdown:
**Consensus** (Skegg/Discord, Duids' spreadsheet, Atreidon, Kokuyoo):

1. **Spell hit to 15–17%** — "Basically need 15% hit on spells, as much int and crit as possible and spd, hit > crit > spd > int" — [Skegg (player, guide writer), 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149715#p149715); the tank guide states "Magic hard cap ... = 17% hit (on boss lvl 63)" — [Mimiwarmini (player)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110875#p110875); Elemental Devastation gives 3%; T3 4-set +3% overcaps ("Full T3 has 6% + 3% from setbonus. Combined with the Elemental Devastation we are at 12% without Jewelry" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-04-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175219#p175219)).
2. **Crit** — mana engine; "for a crit based class, what's the point of a tier that give mostly haste? Haste can be bad if your crit is not high enough" — [Kokuyoo (player), 2026-04-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174964#p174964).
3. **Haste**, capped: "Haste is an incredibly powerful stat on elemental shaman for single target ... 17% is all we need to gain 25% more Damage. Unfortunately, that also marks the Hardcap of how much haste is Useful to us. More haste will just make our Lightning Bolts faster than global cooldown" — Atreidon 2026-04-14 (Lightning Mastery interaction; T3.5 5-set gives 10%).
4. **Spell power / Int** ("as much int and crit as possible" — Skegg; "around a 4k mana pool is recommended" for resto applies to fresh Ele too per pagu).
5. **Attack power** is a real but tiny stat for Flame Shock: "roughly 0.012 dps per attackpower or 0.02 if you snapshot ... it's easily justified to drop those consumables" — Atreidon 2026-04-11.
6. Spell penetration / −resistance items: Don Rodrigo's Band "does apply to all five schools of magic ... non-immune bosses have 15 default nature res ... it also helps with glancing (half-resisted) hits. This is something you need up to the point Lower Karazhan enchants are available or you have a Thunderfury tank" — [Duids (player), 2025-09-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153069#p153069) (single source).

Set choices: "All endgame eles ive seen dont run 8 pc t3. Some do 6pc. But most are 4pc ... searing totem despite having buffed range it is still very weak" — [Agentsmith (player), 2025-06-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=136616#p136616) (pre-totem-hit/crit change). Atreidon's tier review (2026-04-14, post-1.18.1): T1 bonuses "largely irrelevant" and haste-loaded; T2 3-set (+6 s Flame Shock) and 8-set (20% free half-damage Lightning Bolt, ~8% LB DPS) good, 5-set outdated; T2.5 (Stormcaller) 5-set makes Chain Lightning worth using single-target ("deals 15% increased damage if it hits only one target"); T3 2/4/6 fine, 8 poor; **T3.5 (Stormhowl) 5-set is the real power** ("Elemental Mastery infuses you with the Stormwolf's Cunning, increasing your casting speed by 10% for 12 sec. This effect is refreshed when you critically hit an enemy with a nature spell ... it will likely remain the set to wear if you can keep the buff going") but "you rather let MB drop than this Setbonus" and "The 5 Piece T3.5 Setbonus is overstatted and suggests Elemental is actually serviceable, which is only true with exactly 5 pieces T3.5" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-04-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175219#p175219) (single, detailed source).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown:
**Consensus (Skegg/Discord, Atreidon 2026-04-11, pagu, Mdzielak):**

Pre-pull: totems (Strength of Earth, Windfury, Flametongue for the melee group; Mana Spring; Searing Totem on the boss), Water Shield (mana) or Earth Shield (pushback; with Call of Earth in 1.18.1), Brilliant Wizard Oil.

1. **Flame Shock** on the boss (snapshot it: "Good shamans use active trinkets, elemental mastery and time it with nightfall procs on the boss for maximum DOT damage. If it falls off, your cooldowns remain, forcing you to reapply a much weaker Flame Shock" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-04-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174801#p174801)). Flame Shock lasts 15 s (+6 s with T2 3-set). Use the Totem of Rage relic for the application if you own it; swapping back now costs a GCD (Atreidon; Jamey 2026-01-23).
2. **Lightning Bolt** as filler; **Chain Lightning on cooldown** when mana allows: "rotation for max dps on single target should look like 3LB+CL or 4LB+CL depending on your haste (and ofc keeping flameshock on with MB). CL is 1.5s cast and has higher dmg output than LB. That's the theory - quite mana hungry one i'd say. Spamming LB is more mana conservative but your dps is lower" — [Mdzielak (player), 2026-04-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175273#p175273). Without T2.5's 5-set, CL single-target is marginal (Atreidon).
3. **Molten Blast when Flame Shock has ≤ 3 s left** ("Ideally, you want to hit the target with MB in the last 3 seconds before the Flame Shock DOT expires ... Refreshing Flame Shock to early with Molten Blast is a DPS loss"); it is "a relatively slow traveling projectile", can be pushed back and can miss (1% even at cap), so "either cast 2 Molten Blasts back to back towards the end of the DOT duration ... or accepting it might fall of and manually reapply a weaker Flame Shock" — Atreidon 2026-04-11. Track the DoT with Cursive + SuperWoW ("It should work with Cursive - make sure you have the latest update and use it with SuperWoW" — [Skegg (player), 2025-09-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150999#p150999)). With 5/5 T3.5 skip Molten Blast entirely ("once you reach your full 3.5 set, You don't use Molten blast cause it doesnt refresh the 3.5 bonus" — Kokuyoo 2026-04-12).
4. **Earthquake** on cooldown only when it will not delay the T3.5 buff and the target will live > 4 s (post-1.18.1 sources call it worse than a Lightning Bolt; pre-1.18.1 it was "worth it I guess" — Kokuyoo 2026-02-16).
5. **Elemental Mastery** on cooldown (3 min, 10 s +15% / −20% mana): "using it on cooldown, you save about 120 mana and deal 0.75 times a Lightning Bolts worth of damage every 3 Minutes" — Atreidon 2026-04-14; align it with the Flame Shock application and with T3.5 (it starts the 10% haste).
6. **Movement**: Earth Shock (20 yd) or Flame Shock (30 yd with Call of Flame) while moving; "In fights that have a movement element to them, we need to be within 20 yards range, so we can use Earth Shock while moving, as using Flame Shock while moving replaces a likely better snapshotted DOT" — Atreidon 2026-04-11.
7. **Nature-immune targets** (Dragons of Nightmare, Chromaggus/Incantagos per Kokuyoo): Molten Blast spam + Flame Shock + Searing/Magma.
8. **Pre-1.18.0 note**: the Electrify opener ("cast 2 Rank 1 LBs to build 2 stacks in 3 seconds") is obsolete since Elemental Fury became passive on 2025-08-15.

Elemental Fire (pre-1.18.1, superseded): Flame Shock → Molten Blast spam; "has 1 spell, shocks, totems ... no rotation, just spam 1 button" (pagu 2025-09-13).

Spell ranks: Lightning Bolt R1 for pulls/threat control; downrank Lightning Bolt when oom in bad gear ("be carefull with chain lightning and sometimes downrank lightning bolt" — pagu 2026-04-06).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **2–3 targets**: Chain Lightning on cooldown (3 targets, −30% per bounce; +1 target with T2.5 5-set), Flame Shock on the longest-lived, Lightning Bolt filler; Fire Nova only if you can stand in melee.
- **4+ targets**: "We wanna run into the pack to drop firenova and afterwards magma totem" — Atreidon 2026-04-11; Earthquake "has a place" for hard packs or packs you cannot approach, but "our primary target dying too early cancels the spell, our primary target running out of the pack places the AOE away ... and should the primary target resist, the entire damage from this ability is 0!"; "for most content, you are better off just running in, dropping a firenova, maybe a sapper and dont waste time trying to cast EQ" — Atreidon 2026-04-11. Fire totems now use your spell hit/crit (staff 2025-08-26) and Elemental Fury doubles their crit bonus (1.18.0). pagu's pre-1.18.1 warning: "if your target dies before cast finished, its canceled" (EQ) — [pagu, 2025-09-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151552#p151552).
- Lasher farming (DM East, level 52+): Fire Nova > Magma > Fire Nova with Water/Earth Shield swaps and Totem of Tides — see `leveling.md`.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Elemental Mastery** (3 min): on cooldown, aligned with Flame Shock snapshot / T3.5 (above). Its old guaranteed-crit form is gone (1.18.0).
- **Ancestral Swiftness** (Resto, if taken): instant Chain Heal/Healing Wave for emergencies, or an instant CL at −25% (PvP mostly).
- **Mana**: Water Shield by default; "Both fire elemental and regular elemental shaman can easily sustain their mana-needs with manaspring totem, potions and tea even in the longest of fights without usage of watershield ... Being oom after a fight is not an issue. Being oom in a fight is" — [Atreidon (player), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168359#p168359); low gear: "Until you get good gear and alot of spell crit mana will be main issue. So you have to use alot of potions and tea" — pagu 2026-04-06; "leveling as ele shaman means drink half of you life" — pagu 2025-09-13. T3.5 3-set raises Clearcasting to 70% (Atreidon: irrelevant that late). Drink after every pack in dungeons ("Ele needs a lot of drinks" — [Ironbob (player), 2025-11-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159080#p159080)).
- **Racials**: Troll Berserking ("the best min-max race for PvE (quasi-Bloodlust haste racial for PvE" — Skegg); Orc Blood Fury also adds spell damage (staff batch); Hex is PvP/utility only.
- **Relics** (pre-1.18.1 swapping now GCD-gated): Totem of the Storm vs Crackling Thunder — "if you deal ~625 dps or more with straight lb casting, crackling thunder starts to overtake storm. But beware this only works to its fullest effect if you have 9% or less combined haste" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-06-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135891#p135891); post-1.18.1 "ele bis totem is still a blue boe" and Eruption/Rage are moot without swapping (Kokuyoo 2026-04-12); Atreidon uses Storm or Rage over Eruption/Crackling Thunder (2026-04-11).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- **Group**: the melee group for Windfury ("As ele i always just wf totem bot for tank party" — [pagu, 2025-08-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=146924#p146924)); if the raid has spare shamans, a caster group with Tranquil Air (Akos1896 2025-09-13).
- **Totems**: Windfury + Strength of Earth + Flametongue + Mana Spring for the group; Searing on bosses only ("with extended range so much risk it pull extra pack, so i use it very rare, only on bosses" — pagu 2025-09-13); Tremor/Poison/Disease/Fire Resistance as needed; Grounding on Hakkar near the boss (Akos1896 resto guide).
- **Threat**: Nature's Grace (Resto) reduces Nature threat; Chain Lightning openers on trash pull threat off shaman/paladin tanks — wait 1–2 s (Akos1896 tank notes).
- **Pushback**: Earth Shield (30%, +70% with Call of Earth 2/2 in 1.18.1; T1 5-set +10%) on raid-wide-damage fights; "there are alot of packs and bosses where all raid gets damage. and shaman casts constantly pushed back" — pagu 2025-09-13.
- **Purge** (8-s CD): plan it for known buffs (Black Morass first boss, AQ20 second boss adds — Akos1896).
- **Off-healing**: Chain Heal R1 when nothing to nuke; Ancestral Swiftness emergency heal if talented.
- **Positioning for Flametongue-Elemental Weapons (1.18.1)**: only in melee range does the +30% Fire apply — staff intent; Atreidon calls it "the incredibly sweaty playpattern of imbue switching".

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Pre-raid / BiS by phase**: Duids' spreadsheet (phase 1 through pre-Naxx, includes enchants and consumables) `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10ZknXEpNUiMorP3ZP7o694bLSeXlLpdYLh0D0Ni2UKU` — [Duids (player), 2025-09-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151369#p151369); fire variant: "changing the ring/neck enchants to 5 spell power, the belt buckle to 9 fire damage" — [Duids, 2025-09-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152504#p152504). Skegg: two crafted cloth gloves (crit / haste), T1 belt/wrist from AH, blue Bloodvine set, 2% crit quest trinket + DM trinket, Onyxia head/ring, UBRS trinkets + cloth head, Gloves of Unwinding Mystery, Black Morass mp5 totem, Hateforge Corrosive Core (hit), Stormwind Vaults Whip of Encouragement (haste when hit-capped); Mindfang (AB exalted) "BiS one-handed weapon up to Nefarian's Lok'amir" (Duids 2025-09-25). Post-1.18.1: "Go kara10 every cd, alot of geared pugs and good epics. Also aq20 set is nice" — pagu 2026-04-06; "kara has plenty of good caster items (minds key especially) and from zg you can get a great cloak and reputation for your shoulder enchants and zanza" — Atreidon 2026-04-04.
- **Enchants**: ring/neck +5 SP (JC), belt buckle +9 fire (fire build) — Duids; Brilliant Wizard Oil (Mimiwarmini's Elemental list).
- **Consumables** (Mimiwarmini 2026-02-10 Elemental list): Major Healing Potion / Potion of Quickness; Flask of Supreme Power; Elixir of Greater Nature Power (55), Greater Firepower (40), Greater Arcane Elixir (35), Dreamshard Elixir (15 SP 2% crit), Dreamtonic (35 SP 20 min), Elixir of the Sage; Danonzo's Tel'Abim Delight (22 SP); Spirit of Zanza; Cerebral Cortex Compound; Juju Ember, Juju Flurry; Rumsey Rum / Medivh's Merlot Blue; Whipper Root Tuber; Brilliant Wizard Oil — [Mimiwarmini (player), 2026-02-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167850#p167850). Firewater/Juju Might for Flame Shock AP are optional (Atreidon). Nordanaar Herbal Tea + Major Mana Potion on cooldown (pagu, Atreidon).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
1. Letting Flame Shock drop and re-applying an unsnapshotted one; refreshing it early with Molten Blast (Atreidon).
2. Casting Earthquake on a target that will die or move; casting it at all in most 1.18.1 AoE (Atreidon, pagu).
3. Spamming Chain Lightning in bad gear and going oom mid-fight (pagu).
4. Over-capping hit (8/8 T3 + Devastation) or over-capping haste past ~17% with T3.5 (Atreidon).
5. Using Searing Totem near CC or patrols (pagu, Akos1896).
6. Relying on Eye of the Storm (pre-1.18.1) instead of Earth Shield on pushback fights (pagu).
7. Fire Elemental into MC/Ony/BWL fire-immune bosses (Duids/Boomcat).
8. Molten Blast while wearing 5/5 T3.5 (Kokuyoo).
9. Casting from outside 20 yd on movement fights so no shock is available (Atreidon).
10. Expecting Windfury/Flametongue totems to help you — they buff the party only (Kokuyoo, pagu).

standing.source_quality: medium-strong: one prolific near-BiS theorycrafter with deep post-1.18.1 detail, backed by staff mechanics notes and a BiS spreadsheet
standing.notes: The class's caster spec. Structural weakness: no raid debuff amplifies Nature, costing roughly 18.4% versus fire/shadow casters, so single-target output is bottom-half while cleave is strong. 1.18.1 gave Earthquake +15% damage and an 18 s cooldown and extended Convection/Concussion to it, but its live behaviour is contested and unconfirmed by staff.

patch_validity.written_for: 1.18.0 rework (Electrify -> Elemental Fury, Earthquake, Molten Blast; live 2025-08-15)
patch_validity.notes: 1.18.1 added Call of Earth, buffed Earthquake base damage +15% and CD to 18 s, made Elemental Weapons' Flametongue conditional on a melee hit (deliberately weakening the Fire-Elemental playstyle), and added a relic-swap GCD. Players report Earthquake broken/underperforming (only 2 hits, no Elemental Fury bonus on the second) through 2026-04-07 with no staff confirmation of a nerf beyond 'fixed multiple issues'. playbooks.title: Shaman — Elemental PvP (battlegrounds, with the ele/enh "battle caster" hybrid)
playbooks.intro: The PvP sources treat Elemental separately from PvE because the CC2 talent Electrify (2024-10 .. 2025-08) and the 1.18.0 Elemental Mastery / Ancestral Swiftness changes removed the guaranteed-crit burst opener; the resulting meta build is a **31/17/0 Elemental/Enhancement hybrid** (Lightning Strike, Ancestral Guardian, Spirit Armor, Improved Ghost Wolf) that trades Nature's Swiftness for armor and a silence-proof melee hit. Enhancement PvP notes are in `enhancement-melee-dps.md`; deep-Resto PvP has one favourable source (Manletow) and is not written up. Source quality: **weak–medium** (one detailed playstyle post, many standing arguments).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Community standing**: **contested** in the extreme. Pro-nerf voices call shamans the strongest PvP class ("1.18.0 was golden patch for Shamans. In my opinion it was the most powerful class in PvP" — [Zvyrhol (player), 2026-03-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171249#p171249); "Current ele is significantly stronger than current enha" — [amanagor (player), 2025-05-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130008#p130008); "ele and enh are godtier. they are able to 2shot anything if properly geared" — [Volkyte (player), 2025-08-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147963#p147963)); Elemental mains call pure Ele "cooked" ("Ele sucks, you have no way of healing yourself through hunter+pet barrage ... They removed the guaranteed crit. You can't get natures swiftness comfortably anymore" — [Thelwald (player), 2025-11-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158461#p158461); "Ele: not that great and honestly just a downgrade from vanilla" — [ForumGentleman (player), 2025-05-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130102#p130102)). The hybrid is the meta both sides describe: "the point of the spec is to be a high dmg caster that also happens to have 9k armor and a big hp pull in full t3" — [amanagor (player), 2025-05-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131960#p131960); "Tanky shaman are fire one, enh/ele hybrid with hilarous tank talents and high % dogde. Normal elemental build (ele/resto) with shield have just ~50%dr from armor" — [Mdzielak (player), 2026-03-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171242#p171242).
- **Staff direction**: Electrify was "to mitigate the overall burstiness Elemental Shaman has in PvP"; 1.18.0 restored Elemental Fury's crit bonus but reworked Elemental Mastery "to deal its overall damage over a longer period of time instead of in one giant burst", made Purge 8-s CD, Grounding break on CC with a 20-s CD, and Nature's Swiftness → Ancestral Swiftness with −25% on damaging spells — [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25 (+ revision)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159). 1.18.1: PvP dampening "will now have dynamic reductions of Magical and Physical damage based on your class / spec" — [Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169701#p169701) (Shaman values not published); Earthquake +15%; Elemental Weapons' Rockbiter turned into Earthen Bulwark explicitly to stop "non-Enhancement specializations from using the effect as a passive benefit which led to them being more durable, especially in Player vs Player environments" — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
- **Strengths**: Chain Lightning burst (a BiS feral reports "2k Chain lighting with 1.5second cast, and another 1000+ Shock" — [Wosator (player), 2026-03-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171236#p171236)), Earth Shock interrupt every 5–6 s, Grounding, Purge, Frost Shock/Earthbind slows, heals, mail + shield + Ancestral Guardian armor/dodge, Ghost Wolf.
- **Weaknesses**: no hard CC (Hex 5-min CD, 4 s — "Honestly i wasted my money" — [Grinched (player), 2026-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169946#p169946)), no defensive cooldown, Nature school lock = death ("shaman is the least counter-spell protected caster with only grounding as a defence mechanism" — [Ataika (player), 2024-11-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=109178#p109178)), hard-countered by warlocks ("Play a warlock" — [Voodoochile (player), 2025-06-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137448#p137448)), arcane mages ("If you do not ground Arcane Rupture he will delete 80% of your health" — Ataika).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
- **Aluevera's 31/17/0 hybrid (single detailed source, pre-1.18.0 Electrify era, 2025-05-21)**: Elemental Mastery ("for those big crits" — old version), Reverberation ("short CD on shocks 6s->5s"), no fire-totem talents, Lightning Strike, "all the armor i can get" (Ancestral Guardian, Spirit Armor), Improved Ghost Wolf; "u go for 31/17/0. u skip talents like call of flames and improved nova and dump all points into improved shocks" — [Aluevera (player), 2025-05-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132316#p132316), [2025-06-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134228#p134228). Since 1.18.0 Elemental Mastery is a 10-s +15% buff and Electrify is passive — the point list still fits (Elemental Fury 2 pts replaced Electrify 1 pt; Reverberation dropped from 5 to 3 pts).
- **Stable Shields is contested for PvP**: "Stable shields is an awful talent for pvp ... only after 18 seconds in combat do you gain any value ... you should only ever skill it if you grab it for lightning strike. And lightning strike want you to wear slow weapons" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-05-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131896#p131896); "Stable Shields is good for PVP. Constantly getting hit by stupid things that waste those few precious charges Such as AV NPC archers" — [Manletow (player), 2025-05-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131910#p131910); Aluevera: "improved elemental shields are really nice for push back reduction as well 3 charges are gone asap".
- **Ancestral Guardian is the talent the other side wants nerfed**: "a Shaman spends only three points to gain 6% dodge plus 15% increased armor from items ... roughly equivalent to 8–10 talent points worth of stats" — [Sylbrosa (player), 2026-01-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165721#p165721); "tanking talents should be deeper in Enhancement tree" — [Kerenis (player), 2026-01-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165723#p165723). Not changed in 1.18.1.
- **Ele/Resto** (Nature's Swiftness → Ancestral Swiftness at −25% damage) is the "support" variant: "If u want to heal most of the bg stay back and be support play ele/restro. if u find ur self alone on the BG or just want to play more offensive go ele/enhance" — Aluevera. "if you are really serious about PVP, you should still grab nature swiftness anyways" — ForumGentleman 2025-05-07 (pre-rename).
- Earthquake is "not a useful PvP Capstone, yet the game actively punishes us for wanting to spend the talentpoints effectively for PvP" (Ancestral Swiftness −25%) — [Atreidon (player), 2026-04-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174801#p174801).

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- "u are still ele so u prio SP"; stamina pieces from quest rings/necks ("up to 5.4k HP" in full T2.5); swap to the Kara10 reflect shield against casters; Blood Guard boots + Improved Ghost Wolf "almost at 60% mount speed" — Aluevera 2025-05-21 (single source).
- Spell penetration matters against Nature-resist gear (Don Rodrigo's Band applies to all schools — Duids, see `elemental-ranged-dps.md`); pagu asks for "more spellhit, because amount of resists kills me" (PvE) — no PvP hit target stated (gap).
- "we also have resi - it lower %dmg from crits. But there's not much source of it yet" — Mdzielak 2026-03-18 (1.18.1 PvP sets add resilience; values not stated for shaman).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target "rotation" (Aluevera's playstyle, single source)
rotationSingle.markdown:
1. "stay back as far as u can and cast as much as possible like normal ele does" — Lightning Bolt / Chain Lightning; Flame Shock at 30 yd (Call of Flame) to open on approach.
2. Against a class with a silence/kick: "get in shock range and only rely on ur shocks and LB R1"; keep Grounding Totem down before the enemy's key cast (Ataika: Arcane Rupture).
3. Melee reaches you before you have cast: "stay with earth shield and cast 2 LB r1 swap to Lightning shield can shock lightning strike till u get away or (more likely) target dies" — Aluevera. Lightning Strike works while silenced (amanagor 2025-05-19) and "ignores silence and most of its dmg armor" (Aluevera).
4. Earth Shock to interrupt heals/nukes (5-s CD with Reverberation); Frost Shock + Earthbind to peel/kite; Purge buffs (8-s CD — plan it: "Purge spam was so bad" is why the CD exists, per 1.18.1-thread posters).
5. Heal yourself with Earth Shield up (30% pushback, +70% with Call of Earth in 1.18.1); Water Shield when oom.
6. Pre-1.18.0 Electrify management ("Lightning Bolt R1 is ur favorite spell u press it every time to keep ur electrify stacks up" — Aluevera; "Use Rank 1 LB to get Electrified easily (less than .5 sec cast time)" — [Manletow (player), 2024-11-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=109183#p109183)) is **obsolete** since 2025-08-15.
7. Elemental Mastery (1.18.0+): a 10-s +15% window — pop it before a Chain Lightning + shock combo; no PvP source post-1.18.0 describes its use (gap).

Support role when undergeared: "Avoid 1vs1, assist your strong teammates ... Dispel enemy buffs, heal allies if needed" — [Xudo (player), 2023-11-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=76808#p76808); Manletow's "conservative supporter" list: Purge, emergency heals, interrupts, Grounding, Chain Lightning on weakened groups ([2024-11-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=109183#p109183)).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target
rotationAoe.markdown: Chain Lightning "on groups (especially weakened groups)" (Manletow); Earthquake's slow patch is "entirely irrelevant" (Atreidon) but its splash/aftershock hit clumps; Fire Nova at flags/graveyards (no source).

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- Grounding Totem: 20-s CD, breaks on the first CC it eats (1.18.0); "Grounding needs to be used strategically" (Akos1896).
- Ancestral Swiftness (if Ele/Resto): instant max-rank heal or a −25% instant CL.
- Racials: Tauren War Stomp "the best PvP racial" (Skegg) and "gigantic tauren leeway" (Springboards, disputed by Atreidon: "Twow has almost no melee leeway. 5 yards"); Troll Hex "decent for PvP" (Skegg) vs "terrible" (Grinched); Orc Blood Fury + Feral Spirit wolves "seem great for any spec" ([Gladeshadow (player), 2025-05-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130013#p130013)).
- Mana: Water Shield; Mana Spring at a held node; potions.
- PvP set bonuses (1.18.1): "+15% movespeed in wolfform that is tied to the boots" — [PvP 1.18.1 thread poster, 2026-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=24132) (from the staff post's discussion; exact set text not extracted).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Kiting: Earthbind + Frost Shock, Ghost Wolf; against melee "Trying to melee a shaman as a cat is a big mistake ... They are tanky, they can heal faster and more efficient than you, purge your heals and dish out insane bursts" — [Turboman (player), 2026-03-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171254#p171254).
- Interrupt priority: healers and arcane mages (Ataika).
- Objective play: hold nodes with Grounding/Tremor/Earthbind; Chain Heal support in AV ("Deep Resto is now viable (at least in AV) as you can be a proper Chain Heal master" — [Manletow (player), 2024-11-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108342#p108342), contradicted by amanagor in the same thread).

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: Full T2.5 (Stormcaller) with stamina jewelry (Aluevera); T3 for "9k armor and a big hp pull" (amanagor); Kara10 reflect shield vs casters; Blood Guard boots; 1.18.1 PvP sets with resilience (values not in sources). No shaman PvP BiS list exists (gap; the 10-59 twink spreadsheet by Brisspvp — [2023-10-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=68018#p68018) — covers Enhancement twinks only).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
1. Free-casting Lightning Bolts into a kick/silence class instead of shock range (Aluevera).
2. Missing Grounding on Arcane Rupture / big casts (Ataika).
3. Leaving Earth Shield off when melee arrives (Aluevera, Thelwald).
4. Spamming Purge into the 8-s CD; wasting Grounding (breaks on CC).
5. Outranging your own totems (30 yd) when playing far back (Aluevera's "Downsides").
6. Using Hex as a CC opener (5-min CD, 4 s, pushback still applies — Grinched).
7. Trying to burst from zero as pure Ele without Elemental Mastery/Fury planning (Bjorn88: "Electrify effectively means you start every combat at 50-66% of your power level" — obsolete but the burst-window logic remains).

standing.notes: The 'battle caster' both sides of the argument describe: Chain Lightning burst on a mail-and-shield frame with Ancestral Guardian armor/dodge. 1.18.1 turned Rockbiter's passive mitigation into Earthen Bulwark explicitly to stop non-Enhancement specs using it as a PvP defensive layer, and made dampening class/spec-dependent with Shaman values unpublished.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: Built from Skegg's "Shaman Leveling & Pre-BiS Guide" (2025-09-01, compiled from the Discord #shaman channel, preserved on the community wiki), Akos1896's warden-shaman leveling diary (2024-12-13), Mimiwarmini's dungeon-by-level tank chapter, the older "Spellhancement" guide (2023-10, pre-CC2), and Q&A threads through 2026-04. All talent orders use Turtle talent names after CC2 (1.17.2). Eras are marked; nothing here changed in 1.18.1 except Lightning Shield mana (−25%), Flurry, Elemental Weapons and Water Shield's Lightning Strike ratio.

sections.heading: Spec choice
sections.markdown:
- **Enhancement (tank-capable build) is the consensus leveling spec**: "Enha going faster. Ele needs a lot of drinks" — [Ironbob (player), 2025-11-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159080#p159080); "Elemental is viable but it won't feel very good. You'll definitely be better off going enhancement, which is a pretty decent proper tank for dungeons too" — [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117631#p117631); "With this build, you can fill any role in dungeons: tank, DPS or heal. We'll be picking tanking talents, but even if you solely want to DPS, this is arguably still the best build because you do practically the same DPS ... If you want to skip the tank talents, you could swap out Shield Spec. for Ancestral Knowledge. For healing, all you'll need is some +int gear" — [Skegg (player, guide writer), 2025-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149715#p149715).
- **Elemental Focus (11 Elemental points) is the single most important leveling talent** (consensus since 2023): "The most impactfull talent for leveling is the 11th point in elemental that proc clearcasting. Pair this with a fast weapon and a shield or a fast 2h" — [Kargal (player), 2023-08-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=57082#p57082); "Try speccing 11 point into elemental while leveling. It proccs off of physical crits too and if you only shock with the cost reduction, shamans actually has very few manaproblems" — [Kairion (player), 2023-08-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=55561#p55561). Post-CC2 the order flipped for many: "Grab lightning strike and stormstrike first, get elemental focus afterwards" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121471#p121471); "You just need to decide whether you want to rush for Stormstrike first or go into Elemental for Elemental Focus and your 3% hit first since both are extremely good" — [Mekunekud (player), 2024-12-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112209#p112209).
- **Race** (Skegg, consensus): Troll = best PvE min-max (Berserking, Hex ok in PvP); Tauren = best PvP and tankiest (+5% HP, War Stomp, Plainsrunning at 40 "saves us 2 talents on imp Ghost Wolf"); Orc = decent Enhancement (axes, Blood Fury). For tanking Akos1896 rates Orc lowest, Troll/Tauren best ([2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112575#p112575)).

sections.heading: Skill training priority
sections.markdown:
- "You can skip all but 1st rank of Resurrection. Can technically skip Flametongue imbue. Totems: you likely won't use the nature/frost/fire resistance totems during leveling enough to justify getting those. If you want, you can probably skip all totems besides the Poison/Disease cleansing totems, though for tanking you might want the strength/agi/WF totems. Water totems are optional ... If you don't plan to tank or play ele, skip the ranged damage spells (but never shocks). Everything else you need no matter the spec" — Skegg.
- Water Shield at 26 (R1), Earth Shield at 40 (R1); Totemic Recall at 10; Lightning Strike ranks at 20/38/56 (talent + trainer, ranks were missing from trainers until the 2026-03-25 hotfix); Stormstrike single rank at 30; Fire Nova R5 at 52 unlocks Lasher farming (Skegg). Molten Blast ranks from 20 (staff 2025-07-25). Bloodlust talent; Spirit totem quest at 50 ("the Vultures have a higher chance of dropping the Spider Eye and the Black Claw" — Skegg); racial quests at 40 (Feral Spirit / Hex / Totemic Slam — staff batch).
- Keep several Earth Shock ranks on the bars (max, mid, R1) — Akos1896/Bigsmerf.

sections.heading: Playstyle 10–60
sections.markdown:
- **Imbue and shield**: "Rockbiter + Lightning Shield until level 41/42. Then Frostbrand becomes better with Elemental Focus + Elemental Weapons talents. At 60 you're gonna use Windfury imbue" — Skegg; "Rockbiter remains the best weapon imbue for leveling due to its consistency and raw output. The 10% dmg reduction from Elemental Weapons is also always active" — [Taralej90 (player), 2025-04-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126159#p126159) (that −10% became Earthen Bulwark in 1.18.1 — the "always active" part no longer holds). "the Water Shield helps you solo faster than Lightning Shield or Earth Shield. (However, test it for yourself because the Water Shield was nerfed slightly in 1.18.1)" — [Riiya (player), 2026-04-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174099#p174099).
- **Weapon**: "until Lightning Strike, a high dps dagger is just as good as a slow 2H; after Lightning Strike, a slow 2H is best" (Skegg, solo); "Use 2h once you get windfury weapon imbue ... Most important is keeping your 2hander up to date" — [amanagor (player), 2026-04-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173827#p173827); **contested**: "I found myself and other shamans prefer 1H + shield for soloing all the way up to 60. The better damage just does not compensate the time lost for getting mana back" — Riiya 2026-04-05.
- **Kill rotation** (Skegg): to 44 "Rockbiter + Lightning Shield, using Lightning Strike -> Storm Strike -> Earth Shock -> Lightning Strike. You spend your mana at the beginning, then melee the mob down because you want to start the mana regen ASAP"; from 44 "Frostbrand + Water Shield, using Frost Shock -> Stormstrike -> Lightning Strike". Pull with Lightning Bolt R1. "Using totems isn't recommended, though Searing is probably fine if you're sticking in the same location" (Skegg); "Searing totem is very nice in itself. It's mana efficient ... but you'd move on to new targets before you reap the benefits" (Riiya).
- **Mobs at once**: one at a time solo; "you can kill 10+ mobs with a rest" with on-hit Nature/Fire items feeding Clearcasting — [Terryleelolorz (player), 2023-12-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=81505#p81505) (pre-CC2 spellhance).
- **Downtime**: "Earthbind weaving with a Swing timer is worth doing if you care about reducing the damage you take fighting mobs 1v1": Earthbind > Searing > Flame Shock, strafe out during the swing reset, re-enter to swing (Skegg). "Mana will be a problem, only put down totems you really wanna use" — [Akos1896 (player), 2024-07-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=99781#p99781). Carry water; Water Shield from 26 "gets easier" (Riiya).
- **Threat while grouped as DPS**: Rockbiter and Earth Shock "give increased threat. If you aggro mobs too often, consider using other shocks" (Akos1896 2024-07-18).
- **Old spellhance path (2023-10, pre-CC2, single source, partly obsolete)**: fast 1H + shield, Flametongue, Elemental Focus first, Shield Spec/Improved Ghost Wolf/Thundering Strikes, Improved Lightning Shield + Thunderhead (both removed in CC2), Call of Thunder/Elemental Devastation/Elemental Fury; items with "+3 Nature damage" / "+2 Fire damage" on hit (Thunder Lizard's Hide 81308, Flameskin Gloves 81267, Leggings of Fiery Temper 61505, Lavadrenched Chainmail 80704, Repaired Electro-Lantern 65030, Storm Gauntlets, Incendosaur set); Hand of Edward the Odd at 57; Blade of Eternal Darkness — [Hartmut (player), 2023-10-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=69447#p69447), [Imonobor (player), 2023-12-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=81617#p81617). The on-hit-item Clearcasting trick still works mechanically (Elemental Focus procs from any Fire/Frost/Nature crit — staff), the talents named do not.

sections.heading: Stat priority while leveling and key upgrades
sections.markdown:
- "Stats for tanking while leveling: +stam > +agi > +str > +int ... For DPS: +str = +agi > +stam > +int ... For healing: +int = +hp"; "A shield with high armor is always a top prio ... 10 armor is roughly equal to 1 stamina" — Skegg.
- Upgrades by level (Skegg, Akos1896, Mimiwarmini): level 15 quest shield (`quest=40390`, Mimiwarmini) and Cobalt Buckler (5302); Deviate Scale Belt / Deviate Hide Pack (WC quests); Seal of Sylvanas (SFK quest); Triprunner Dungarees (Gnomeregan "Rig Wars"), Marbled Buckler and Monkey Ring (RFK quests); Compendium of the Fallen (28, Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff 34.7,47.8, SM Library) → SM Cathedral shield → Gilneas / Maraudon goblin / SWV shield; Chain of the Crusader set or Tough Scorpid (LW) from SM; Divino-matic Rod (ZF quest); **level 33: two Jewelcrafting +stam trinkets** (obsidian brooch, ~5–6 g each, non-unique — Akos1896 2024-12-06); **35–41: Totem of Tides** (Stormwrought orc boss, "phenomenal for tanking dungeons + farming Lashers"); level-40 racial quests and Plainsrunning; ~50 axe `item=51892`; Stormshroud shoulders/hands (LW ~50), Devilsaur hands/legs (53/55), Hateforge set (BS ~50) then Towerforge (Kara10); 58+ Skyfury Helm quest (`quest=7667`, Scholomance); Thunder Lizard's Hide (Sparkwater Port vendor, ~8 g, limited stock) for on-hit Nature procs (Hartmut).
- Enchants/consumables while leveling: armor kits, fortitude/armor potions and health potions before Black Morass (Skegg).

sections.heading: Common leveling mistakes (from the sources)
sections.markdown:
1. Dropping every totem every fight (Skegg, Akos1896, Riiya).
2. Tanking SM/oranges before 33 without the stamina trinkets (Akos1896).
3. Taking Elemental first when you intend to tank early, or skipping Elemental Focus entirely (both camps agree it arrives by ~44).
4. Windfury imbue before you own a real 2H; Rockbiter on a DPS at 60 (Skegg, Taralej90).
5. Casting Lightning Bolts instead of meleeing (mana) — "Most of damage was melee. LB used only to pull enemies" — [Xudo (player), 2023-08-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=58176#p58176).
6. Buying every spell rank (skip Resurrection ranks, resistance totems — Skegg).
7. Ghost Wolf with Earth Shield expectations (not castable in wolf).

gaps:
1. **Post-1.18.1 re-evaluation of any spec** beyond scattered forum complaints: no guide author re-tested and republished a build, rotation, or stat priority after 2026-03-20 for any of the five playbooks. Treat every rotation/stat section as pre-1.18.1 unless a flagged delta says otherwise.
2. **Full point-by-point 60 talent builds for Elemental and Enhancement DPS**: every "endgame" build is a `talents.turtlecraft.gg` calculator link or a named-core list; only the tank and leveling paths have an explicit level-by-level order.
3. **Earthquake's true post-1.18.1 behavior**: player reports (only 2 hits, missing Elemental Fury bonus on the second hit, "highly underperform" even with Totem of Distant Tremors) were never confirmed or denied by staff beyond the original "fixed multiple issues" note and an unrelated 04-01 Aftershock hotfix.
4. **Restoration PvP**: only one contested claim (deep-Resto Chain Heal support viable "at least in AV") exists; no build, rotation, or standing discussion — not written up as its own file.
5. **Elemental PvP after 2026-03-20**: no source describes actual play once per-class PvP dampening, resilience-bearing PvP sets, Call of Earth and the reworked Earthquake all landed together.
6. **Pre-raid BiS lists on current itemization** for Enhancement DPS and Elemental (Elemental has a maintained spreadsheet from one author; Enhancement does not) and any Resto BiS-by-phase list (asked in 2024-12, never answered).
7. **PvP resilience values and set bonuses for Shaman** in the 1.18.1 PvP gear (mentioned as existing, no numbers given).
8. **Zone-by-zone leveling route**: only the dungeon-per-bracket path and gear-upgrade waypoints are covered; no quest-by-quest questing route exists in the sources.
9. **Hardcore-specific Shaman play**: only two fragments (a pre-CC2 hardcore Elemental impression, and a tank guide's general "avoid red dungeons" rule) — no hardcore-specific Shaman thread was found in the extracted forums.
10. **Totem of Distant Tremors and other 1.18.1 relics**: named once by a player as underperforming with Earthquake, never otherwise described.
11. **Exact Resto T3.5 (Stormhowl) full set text**: only the 1.18.1 T1-8-set delta and general standing quotes exist for Restoration tier; Elemental's T3.5 5-set text is captured in detail (Atreidon), Restoration's and Enhancement's are not.
12. **Spell/talent/item IDs**: no source in this crawl gives numeric spell IDs for Shaman abilities; every `spell_id` field in the structured YAML is `null`.
patchChanges: Convection/Concussion now cover all offensive Fire/Frost/Nature spells including Earthquake and Molten Blast; Earthquake gained a new capstone rework in 1.18.0 (replacing Elemental Mastery) then +15% base damage and CD 20 → 18 s in 1.18.1 (bug reports of it under-hitting/losing the Elemental Fury bonus were still open 2026-04-07); Elemental Weapons reworked all four imbue effects — Windfury: gaining extra attacks now grants +1%/stack attack speed (2/4/6 stacks, 5 s) instead of a next-swing bonus; Flametongue: +10/20/30% Fire totem/spell damage for 5 s *after a melee hit* (was passive) explicitly to keep spell-oriented Enhancement and pure-Fire Elemental in melee range; Rockbiter: the old flat damage-reduction became **Earthen Bulwark**, an absorb shield built from physical damage (tripled while shielded), explicitly to stop non-Enhancement specs using the old passive as a PvP defensive layer — reported not stacking correctly from special attacks (Stormstrike, Lightning Strike) through the 03-25 hotfix and still contested 2026-04-07; Windfury Weapon 20%/0.5-s ICD → 25% per hit; Flurry reworked to trigger off any critical strike (spell or melee) rather than only physical crits, "especially for spell-oriented Enhancement" (hotfixed 03-21/03-25/04-01 for consumption, trigger conditions and Rushing Winds stacking — still reported buggy/overwritten by Elemental Weapons' haste as of 2026-04-07); Lightning Strike's Water Shield ratio changed to 18:1; Lightning Shield mana −25%; Call of Earth added (Earth Shield +1/2 charges, +35/70% pushback avoidance, replenished by offensive Nature spells per the 03-19 revision); relic swapping now costs a GCD; Enh T2.5 5-set reworked to boost Earthen Bulwark (not applied at release, fixed 03-21); Resto T1 8-set replaced with a 25%-chance absorb proc on Healing Wave/Lesser Healing Wave (Resto's only 1.18.1 change); PvP dampening became class/spec-dependent (Shaman's specific values were never published in the sources).

caveats: Raid tier mapping used below (per structured/glossary.jsonl): T1=Molten Core, T2=Blackwing Lair, T2.5=AQ40, T3=Naxxramas, T3.5=Karazhan 40. Kara10 (Lower Karazhan Halls, a Turtle-exclusive 10-man) sits below T1 in the sources' own usage and is treated as pre-raid-60/raid-t1-adjacent content here.

The Enhancement-tank 'Pre Raid' and 'T1 BiS' slot lists below both come from one long guide post by Mimiwarmini (2024-12-02); item IDs are exact (the post links database.turtlecraft.gg by item ID) but the post does not state where most of these items drop, so source_place is unknown-in-sources except where the entity-index or another source confirms it (Araxxna's Husk and Totem of Tides are confirmed Lower Karazhan Halls / Stormwrought Ruins drops).

Skegg's Shaman Leveling & Pre-BiS Guide is the single richest leveling source for all three roles (tank/DPS/heal share one build to level 33); item-by-level claims below are almost entirely from that one post plus Akos1896's reply in the same thread.
T2.5 (AQ40) is explicitly the only shaman tank tier set (staff); Enhancement DPS has no T2.5 set at all ('a drought when AQ comes out').

gearMarkdown.heading: Caveats
gearMarkdown.markdown:
- Raid tier mapping used below (per structured/glossary.jsonl): T1=Molten Core, T2=Blackwing Lair, T2.5=AQ40, T3=Naxxramas, T3.5=Karazhan 40. Kara10 (Lower Karazhan Halls, a Turtle-exclusive 10-man) sits below T1 in the sources' own usage and is treated as pre-raid-60/raid-t1-adjacent content here.
- The Enhancement-tank 'Pre Raid' and 'T1 BiS' slot lists below both come from one long guide post by Mimiwarmini (2024-12-02); item IDs are exact (the post links database.turtlecraft.gg by item ID) but the post does not state where most of these items drop, so source_place is unknown-in-sources except where the entity-index or another source confirms it (Araxxna's Husk and Totem of Tides are confirmed Lower Karazhan Halls / Stormwrought Ruins drops).
- Skegg's Shaman Leveling & Pre-BiS Guide is the single richest leveling source for all three roles (tank/DPS/heal share one build to level 33); item-by-level claims below are almost entirely from that one post plus Akos1896's reply in the same thread.
- T2.5 (AQ40) is explicitly the only shaman tank tier set (staff); Enhancement DPS has no T2.5 set at all ('a drought when AQ comes out').

Molten Core and other early fire-immune bosses (Ragnaros and everything in Onyxia's Lair/Blackwing Lair are fire-immune) make a fire-focused build a Nature-build fallback only for Nefarian-onward content. Post-1.18.1: "getting into kara10, zg & mc is easy often even in just questing greens. And that gear is much stronger than many dungeon items"; focus on Kara10 and ZG early — "kara has plenty of good caster items (Minds Key especially) and from zg you can get a great cloak and reputation for your shoulder enchants and zanza" [Atreidon (player), 2026-04-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174001#p174001). Separately: "Go kara10 every cd, alot of geared pugs and good epics. Also aq20 set is nice" [pagu (player), 2026-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174156#p174156).

### raid-t1
*Agreement: single. Written for: pre-1.18.1. Valid for 1.18.1: unknown. Only some Molten Core bosses resist fire; Ragnaros is fire-immune.*

**Stat priority**: Molten Core boss resistances given by a poster: Lucifron 93 fire/186 shadow, Gehennas 186 fire/93 shadow, Shazzrah 186 arcane/93 fire, Sulfuron Harbinger 93 fire, Golemagg 186 fire, Majordomo Executus 95 fire, Ragnaros fire-immune — meaning a fire-elemental build is a poor choice for most of the instance.

gearMarkdown.heading: Gaps
gearMarkdown.markdown:
- No item-level PvP gear list exists for any Shaman spec (unlike Rogue's Subtlety PvP list); Elemental/Enhancement hybrid PvP gearing is qualitative only (set names, no slots).
- No item-level Elemental raid-t2/t2.5/t3/t3.5 gear list; the corpus gives Molten Core boss fire-resistance numbers and post-1.18.1 general raid-choice advice, but no slot-by-slot list past pre-raid.
- Enhancement raid-t3.5 (Stormhowl) has no item-level list in the extracted posts, only that it is the stated upgrade target from T3.
- Enhancement raid-t2.5 (AQ40) has no Enhancement set at all per the sources, and no alternative item list is given for that phase beyond 'stick with T2 plus better 2h/trinkets/rings/neck'.
- Most items in the Enhancement-tank pre-raid-60 and raid-t1 lists (from Mimiwarmini's single detailed post) have no stated drop location; only Araxxna's Husk (Lower Karazhan Halls), Totem of Tides (Stormwrought Ruins) and Hatereaver Cog (Hateforge Quarry) are independently confirmed via structured/entity-index/items.json.
- Restoration has no raid-t1 or raid-t3 item-level gear list (only the pre-raid list and general 'sets are weak, T3.5 better than paladins'' commentary).
- Duids' Elemental pre-raid-and-BiS-by-phase spreadsheet (the single richest apparent Elemental source) is an external Google Sheet; its cell-by-cell content is not captured as text in this corpus, so only the items discussed directly in forum replies could be used here.
- No leveling-10-29 item list beyond the generic tank shield chain notes; Skegg's guide names most items from level 28 onward.

name: Mage

readme.heading: What 1.18.1 changed for mages (official)
readme.markdown:
- Ice Barrier: +5% Frost damage while active (was 15%) and +10% Frost damage for 1 min on cast — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
- Improved Fire Blast: GCD reduction 0.3/0.6/1.0 s — Jamey, revision 2026-01-26.
- Mirror Magic (T3.5 3-set) fixed: Flamestrike/Cone of Cold/Frost Nova/Blast Wave/Arcane Explosion initial hits can trigger a rewind (+10% Arcane, +20% Frost/Fire) — [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168).
- Wands benefit correctly from school-specific damage modifiers — same post.
- Blink usable again in Onyxia's Lair (hotfix 2026-03-21); PvP dampening becomes class/spec-dependent (numbers never published).
- Nothing in the Arcane tree changed; the last Arcane changes were 1.18.0 (Rupture missile bonus 25% → 20%, Arcane Focus ↔ Magic Absorption swap).

readme.heading: Gaps (not covered by any source — do not guess)
readme.markdown:
1. **Complete 51-point raid builds for Fire and Frost** — the wiki's "Pepo raid" / "Pepo frost" builds are images; forum build links are opaque `talents.turtlecraft.gg` exports.
2. **PvP talent allocations** for any spec on the 1.17.2+ tree; PvP stat priority; the 1.18.1 per-class PvP dampening numbers for Mage.
3. **2–3 target vs 4+ target thresholds** for Arcane and Fire (only Frost has "up to 5 / more than 5").
4. **Frost's "mana issues as of April 7th [2025]"** (wiki) — cause and status after 1.18.1 unknown.
5. **Fire T3.5 5-set bonus bug** (bug-report id 18568) — whether 1.18.1 fixed it.
6. **Leveling zone route by level bracket** and a leveling BiS list; which spell ranks to skip buying (only rank-1 keepers are documented).
7. **Spell/talent IDs** — none given by sources.
8. **Enchants** beyond the shoulder choice (2 haste vs "Saph"); consumable lists beyond mana tea/potions/Greater Fire Protection Potion; no Elixir of Arcane Power exists.
9. **Accelerated Arcana**: tooltip 6% (staff) vs measured 5% cast-time reduction (wiki) — unresolved.
10. **Arcane Missiles haste cap** value (wiki mentions a cap for stacked haste effects, no number).
11. **Whether Icicles should be cast without a Flash Freeze proc** (Crake yes; wiki sim and a raider no).
12. **Fire vs Frost in Molten Core** post-1.18.1 (Eluaria's claim challenged, no logs).
13. Staff rationale for the Improved Blizzard nerf (only inferable from the Icicles PvP comment).
14. Community wiki pages are marked `is_turtle_content: false` and are anonymous; treat their sims as single-source.
