playbooks.title: Mage — Frost — PvP (battlegrounds, world PvP, duels)
playbooks.intro: Source quality: **weak-to-medium**. No source posts a Frost PvP talent allocation for the current (1.17.2+) tree; the material is opinion threads about balance, race choice, a few macros and staff PvP-relevant changes. Everything predating the 1.17.2 Shatter nerf (2024-11-01) describes a stronger Frost.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role.** Control and survival caster: Frost Nova / Frostbite freezes → Shatter-boosted Frostbolt crits, Cone of Cold and Frostbolt slows, Ice Barrier, Ice Block (+ Cold Snap), Blink, Polymorph, Counterspell. Staff regard Frost as "already a strong contender" in PvP, which is why Icicles cannot slow and roots the caster ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102968#p102968)).
- **Standing: historically the mage PvP spec; since 1.17.2 contested against Arcane's burst.**
  - "Frost makes you realy good at 1v1 and gives you high amount of control and survival" [Likaleo, 2025-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122357#p122357).
  - "the best spec in the game for pvp in warsonng /Ab you know its not a kill based game? try using your toolkit to actually win the game by peeling and being annoying … They have not nerfed the most op part about frost, which is rank 1 frostbolt." [amanagor, 2024-12-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111502#p111502).
  - "I wouldn't call mage overpowered at all, they're pretty nicely balanced if anything as their damage output is limited to shatter combos which puts them in melee range almost and requires cooldowns." [Gantulga, 2023-12-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=82156#p82156) (pre-1.17.2).
  - "Frost is okay in Arena PvP, but doesn't really hold up in BGs, considering Arcane and Fire just outburst and outsustain it by a lot. Frost's only saving grace is the utility it provides" [Eluaria, 2026-02-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167923#p167923); "if you play frost mage in pvp at this point you are genuinely retarded anyway, its dead" [Terrydavis, 2025-12-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162458#p162458); "There is no reason to play frost in either pvp or pve … nerfed shatter" [amanagor, 2026-02-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167933#p167933) — the same author who praised it in 2024 (**his view changed after 1.18.0**).
  - Complaint side (Manletow, a self-described PvP shaman player, many threads 2023–2025): Frost "is overpowered in PvP (and PvE) so their 'bonus damage' should be nerfed from 100% → 50%" ([2023-12-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=82136#p82136)); "kamikaze" mages Blink into groups → Frost Nova → Cone of Cold → Arcane Explosion spam ([2024-09-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101677#p101677)); Blink 15 s "basically a pvp trinket" and Mana Shield spam make mages "deceptively tanky with like 12k hp once t2.5+" [Springboards, 2025-10-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155433#p155433). Counter-voice: "Frost mage is an absolute non-issue compared to actually broken specs" [Gantulga, 2024-09-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101680#p101680).
- **Matchups (player claims):** warlock is the mage counter, undead WotF helps ([Ataika, 2024-03-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=89764#p89764)); "every mage is 2-block here so I'd say mages are better [than warlocks in arena] due to burst damage and survivability" [Erhog, 2023-12-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=82180#p82180); vs shaman: "shaman walks up to you, casts earth shock once and you die … cant move while casting, you will get in range of shock" [amanagor, 2025-05-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131111#p131111) vs "vs both specs u play max range so he cant shock" [Forumdweller](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131107#p131107) — contested; vs hunters: dead zone abuse, Mana Shield absorbs, Dwarf Stoneform removes Viper Sting ([Forumdweller, 2025-05-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131099#p131099)); "cant even get in range of frost mages" (warrior-forum player); Feral druids and rogues kill mages easily ([Eluaria, 2025-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156219#p156219)).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
- **Gap:** no post gives a current Frost PvP allocation. The vanilla-style "deepfrost / elemental / PoM-pyro" builds "don't properly convert to turtle" ([Dorufin, 2025-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122332#p122332)) and the reply gave no tree.
- Talents named as PvP-relevant: Shatter (35%), Frostbite (Flash Freeze trigger; "a pvp talent" per the Karazhan-thread raider), Ice Barrier (1.18.1: +10% Frost for 1 min on cast — the barrier "being much more likely to break" in PvP was the original reasoning, Dragunovi 2024-10-12), Cold Snap ("why is cold snap so early in the talent tree" [Forumdweller, 2025-05-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132193#p132193)), Improved Counterspell 4 s silence ("This is an insane talent … Arcane atleast struggles to pick up ice block so either move improved counterspell further into the arcane tree so Ice Barrier frost mages can't grab it" [Forumdweller, 2025-05-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131637#p131637)), Presence of Mind ("POM is an insane utility that can substitute ice block" Forumdweller 2025-05-14), Improved Blizzard (rarely used in PvP: "Blizzard was only rarely used in some niche scenarios in PVP" [Manletow, 2025-11-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158932#p158932)). Icicles is "basically useless in PVP" ([Gattare, 2024-12-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111489#p111489)) and "infamous for cutting thru walls in PVP" per Manletow — contested; Flash Freeze on Free Action Potion/Blessing of Freedom was removed 2025-04-01 after "It's a free win whenever an ice mage sees someone pop a fap" ([Jammyzz, 2024-12-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111518#p111518)).
- Player build links (opaque exports): PvP Blast Wave build "If you want PvP spec, then why do you need Arcane Rupture? I'd go for Blast wave instead" `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage?points=VIDoLAAABAAAAABoqYQKAALAAoAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` [Xudo, 2024-10-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103310#p103310); Forumdweller's "stack arcane power & MQG … zg trinket" build `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage?points=CoAoDISAJKAoBAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAFYDTBBQAAAAAAAA%3D` [2025-05-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131096#p131096) (Arcane/Frost, "maybe ill go fire instead of frost second to pick up impact, fire reflect"). Old PoM/Pyro/Blast Wave builds (21/21/0 → 21/30/0 or 29/22/0) [Adunai, 2022-08-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=21823#p21823) are pre-rework.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- No Turtle-specific PvP weights. Asked by [Perkamov, 2025-12-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161504#p161504) ("Damage reduction first I guess, and then crit > sp > haste maybe?") — unanswered.
- Stamina: "USE STAMINA … full t3+life gem+stamina enchants" was advice to a *warrior* fighting mages ([Springboards, 2024-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107471#p107471)); mages have ~3k HP in PvP gear ("you call a mage with 3k hp naked? he's well-geared! a naked lvl 60 mage has less than 2k hp" [Xiangyu, 2025-08-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148046#p148046)). Reference damage: "Frost Mage Frostbolt does 550 to 600 damage with 455 Spell Power, full new PvP set and off set" (cross-forum player remark).
- Spell penetration "useful for PvP" ([Mackylol, 2024-02-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=88341#p88341)). Resistance gear is rare in PvP ("Arcane Resist is quite rare in PVP. Resistances in general are considered crappy/weak stats" [Manletow, 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157292#p157292)).
- Systems: Resilience "now reduces the entire critical damage taken" (changelog 2025-12-03); 1.18.1 makes the PvP Dampening debuff class/spec-dependent, numbers "at a later date" ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) — the Mage values were never posted (**gap**).

roleStrategy.heading: Rotation / tactics
roleStrategy.markdown:
- **Shatter combo:** freeze (Frost Nova, Frostbite proc) → max-rank Frostbolt (Shatter +35% crit); the rank-1/rank-10 macro switches rank on a frozen target (see `frost-ranged-dps.md`). Rank-1 Frostbolt spam for cheap slows is "the most op part about frost" (amanagor 2024-12-05).
- **Peel/objective play:** slows (Frostbolt, Cone of Cold, Frost Armor chill), Nova, Polymorph, Counterspell — "win the game by peeling and being annoying" (amanagor).
- **Escape:** Blink (breaks stuns/roots and the Icicles root), Ice Block, Cold Snap → second Block/Nova/Barrier; Blink from >20 m height fails ("blink in place" — [Atreidon, 2025-04-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126305#p126305)); Blink through closed doors removed 2025-12-24 and "an exploit with Blink" fixed 2026-02-25 (changelogs). Ice Block macro: `/stopcasting /cancelaura Ice Block /stopcasting /cast Ice Block` (wiki General FAQ).
- **Mana Shield** as a second health bar (Springboards, Forumdweller); Improved Mana Shield 13/25%.
- **AoE bomb:** Blink in → Frost Nova → Cone of Cold → Arcane Explosion spam finishes "at least a couple 'weakened' players" (Manletow's description of what Frost mages do; he considers it bad design).
- **Consumables:** Greater Fire Protection Potion "blocks 2600 dmg. and you can drink it up to an hour early", 2-min CD — advised *against* Fire/PoM-Pyro mages ([Atolius, 2025-06-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134628#p134628)); Zanza potion 3g ([Springboards, 2024-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107470#p107470)); cheap consumables exist to dismount and to remove Polymorph ([Sharmaine, 2025-10-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154580#p154580)); Dampen Magic was "bugged (negates too much)" in Dec 2023 ([Ataika](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=82144#p82144)) — later reworked to −3%/−2% flat (staff 2025-03-30).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
1. Casting Icicles in PvP expecting damage (rooted, no slow; useless per Gattare; only relevant if Flash Freeze procs off a permanently immune target — no longer off FAP/BoF).
2. Standing at mid range vs shamans/melee — cast at max range (Forumdweller) or expect to be shocked (amanagor).
3. Blinking while high in the air (blinks in place — Atreidon; "Blink when you are low").
4. Wasting Improved Counterspell on a target in Ice Block — Counterspell macro checks for Ice Block (wiki).
5. Letting Mana Shield drain you to zero — "if you get hit for 500 … you're left OOM at full health and are useless" ([Imonobor, 2023-12-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=82226#p82226), pre-rework numbers).

extraSections.heading: Race choice (PvP)
extraSections.markdown: [Best mage race for PvP thread, 2024-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=89723#p89723): Gladeshadow — Alliance: Gnome (Escape Artist 1 min, Expansive Mind), Human (Perception), Dwarf (Stoneform vs rogues); Horde: Forsaken (WotF vs fear and engineering items), Orc (stun resist; Turtle: −15% stun duration per the timeline); Goblin Exit Strategy "terrible" for mages; Troll Berserking "really a PvE build" ([p89754](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=89754#p89754)). Springboards: Orc "due to thousands of paladins", Dwarf over Gnome because Escape Artist has a cast time and UD rogues are common ([p89756](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=89756#p89756)). Ataika: undead because warlocks counter mages. High Elf Quel'dorei Meditation "not truly pvp relevant" (Gladeshadow); "Will i ever feel disadvantaged for not choosing a High elf" — "Nope, not at all" ([Terexin, 2025-07-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137872#p137872), who recommends Orc for the Blood Fury spell power).

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: Era: the wiki tables were revised 2025-10-01 (after 1.18.0). The **1.17.2** talent changes (Improved Blizzard slow 65% → 40%, Shatter 50% → 35%, new Arcane tree) are the ones that changed mage leveling; **1.18.1 changed nothing for leveling** except Ice Barrier's damage bonus (level 40+ Frost) and Improved Fire Blast's GCD. Advice about Blizzard AoE-grinding from before 2024-11-01 is superseded.

sections.heading: Which spec to level
sections.markdown:
| Spec | Verdict | Sources |
|---|---|---|
| **Frost** | Default / fastest, safest; best for hardcore (control), single target and CoC-kiting AoE | Wiki Levelling FAQ: "the idea that frost is the best for levelling still holds true … if going for pure levelling speed, both in single target and AOE scenarios frost still is the best"; "Frost is still the best choice for levelling because of aoe and cc though, obviously" [Bigsmerf, 2025-03-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122736#p122736); "Generally speaking, Frost wins out as an Open World Levelling Spec. The ability to freeze enemies in place and kite is incredibly useful and enables the spec to actually solo elite quests, which the other 2 specs can't reliably do" [Eluaria, 2026-04-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174948#p174948); "pick frost for leveling and aoe farm. from lvl 50 onwards you can aoe farm in dire maul east and do 50 to 60 in a few hours" [amanagor, 2025-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115611#p115611). **Consensus.** |
| **Fire** | Viable, "hardest but still very doable" (wiki General FAQ); "Fire is perfect for HC, if you don't have the experience for aoe farming (or just wanna play safe) only disadvantage is no Ice block --> cold snap" [Darktifa, 2023-11-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=75350#p75350); "most folks go Frost but Fire got a lot of love on Turtle WoW" [Chev03, 2026-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174149#p174149); Eluaria (above): "it is likely better to run a Fire Build with a decent amount of Points in Frost for survivability, as it will be faster kills overall" — **contested with the wiki's Frost-first line**. |
| **Arcane** | Viable, weaker open-world, good in dungeons | Wiki: "also good for leveling as you can completely remove spell pushback with the Improved Arcane missiles talent and has good mana recovery"; "Arcane I can only recommend for Dungeons, Open World it is by far weaker than the other 2" (Eluaria 2026-04-12); "During lvling you best go arcane (low downtime, 0% spellpushback, highest hit chance from talents, etc)" [Cheruscan, 2025-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158193#p158193) — **contested**. Against, right after 1.17.2: "Arcane mage in cc2 … is designed around making it equal to fire/frost in damage for lvl 60 raiding content. Pick fire or frost for leveling." [Wrathweaver, 2025-01-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115608#p115608), repeated 2025-02-11. Pre-rework: "I lvl'd 1-60 as arcane and I gotta say its really a breeze, esp in dungeon runs" [00sevin, 2023-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=38675#p38675) (superseded tree). |
| Battlemage (melee/wand weaving) | Curiosity only; works to ~30 then "spells outscale melee" | [Atolius, 2025-05-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=133463#p133463): staff 2.6 speed + wand 1.9, "of the Wolf/Falcon/Owl" gear, rotation Mana Shield → Arcane Rupture → wand → melee → Fire Blast → wand …; +9.3% DPS on a dummy, −11.9% in the field vs ranged Arcane at 26; "I'm level 29 now and already feeling a slowdown" ([2025-06-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134635#p134635)); "Mage at 32+ start to do very high spell dps. Not using spells is severely gimping" [Halfgeek9](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134644#p134644). |

"All three specs are fine for leveling play what seems fun to you." (wiki General FAQ). "there is no right or wrong build" [Darktifa, 2023-11-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=75523#p75523).

sections.heading: Talent order by level (wiki tables, single source)
sections.markdown:
All four tables are from [Mage Levelling FAQ (wiki), rev. 2025-10-01](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Levelling_FAQ) and stop at level 59 (50 points). Talent names as the wiki writes them; "Elemental Presicion" and "Arcane Subltety" are wiki typos.

### Frost single target
10–14 Improved Frostbolt 1→5 · 15–17 Frostbite 1→3 · 18–19 Improved Frost Nova 1→2 · 20–24 Ice Shards 1→5 · 25–29 Shatter 1→5 · 30 Ice Block · 31 Cold Snap · 32–34 Frost Channeling 1→3 · 35–37 Elemental Precision 1→3 · 38–39 Piercing Ice 1→2 · 40 Ice Barrier · 41 Piercing Ice 3 · 42–43 Arctic Reach 1→2 · 44–45 Arcane Subtlety 1→2 · 46–48 Arcane Focus 1→3 · 49–53 Arcane Concentration 1→5 · 54–56 Permafrost 1→3 · 57–59 Improved Cone of Cold 1→3.

Play: "simply Frostbolt mobs. You are able to get off ~3 frost bolts before they reach you, then you can nova, run/blink away, and start casting again. You can also use Cone of Cold to slow mobs in melee range, in case your nova is on cooldown." Same loop from [Shamma, 2022-10-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=27840#p27840): "freeze the mob and then crit it for as much as possible while frozen" (Frostbite/Shatter). Wiki Frost FAQ priorities: Improved Frostbolt > Elemental Precision > Ice Shards > Frost Channeling > Shatter > Frostbite > Ice Barrier > Arcane Concentration. Note: the Frostbite-shatter single-target spec and the AoE spec are exclusive — "you can't have Frostbite, else it'll ruin your AoE pull if one gets frozen" [Rudyraccoon, 2024-11-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107433#p107433).

### Frost AoE (Cone of Cold kiting, from level 26)
10–11 Frost Warding 1→2 · 12–14 Elemental Precision 1→3 · 15–17 Permafrost 1→3 · 18–19 Improved Frost Nova 1→2 · 20–24 Ice Shards 1→5 · 25–29 Shatter 1→5 · 30 Ice Block · 31 Cold Snap · 32–34 Improved Cone of Cold 1→3 · 35–36 Arctic Reach 1→2 · 37–39 Frost Channeling 1→3 · 40 Ice Barrier · 41–43 Piercing Ice 1→3 · 44–48 Impact 1→5 (Fire) · 49–53 Ignite 1→5 (Fire) · 54–56 Improved Flamestrike 1→3 (Fire) · 57–58 Arcane Subtlety 1→2 · 59 Burning Soul 1.

Play (wiki): gather melee mobs with wand / Counterspell / rank-1 Fire Blast / body aggro; Ice Block to stack them; rank-1 Frost Nova, move out; with ~4 s left on Nova cast Flamestrike, then Cone of Cold as it finishes ("This allows you to get the increased shatter crit chance on both spells"); kite in a circle or sideways ("Backpedalling will allow the mobs to catch up") with "permachill cone of cold, as the slow is longer than the cooldown"; Arcane Explosion while running when they are low; otherwise wait for Nova for another Flamestrike + Cone of Cold burst. Post-1.18.1 confirmation: "It is better to utilize Flamestrike, Frost Nova, and Cone of Cold to kite and AoE farm, with some Arcane Explosions inbetween. For AoE farming, we don't use Blizzard at all anymore" [Eluaria, 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171409#p171409). Blizzard starts at 20 (wiki: no longer viable), Cone of Cold is learnable at 26 ([Zulnam, 2025-03-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121484#p121484); Xudo wrote 30, corrected). Before 26: "improve frost armor, spam with Arcane Explosions … use Frost nova with Fireblast" for 3-mob pulls ([Xudo, 2025-02-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120513#p120513)); "you can technically start aoe farming from level 16, with flamestrike + arcane explosion. a bit extreme" (Zulnam). Xudo's alternative Frost/Fire "0/24/27" (Flamestrike crit via Nova + fire talents, Blast Wave, CoC) — export link only ([2024-12-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111491#p111491)).

Is AoE leveling still viable? **Contested but mostly yes-with-caveats:** "Improved blizzard is heavily nerfed for its ability to effortlessly destroy giant packs. so you have to rely more on cone of cold and frostnova on turtle. Its a bit less braindead to aoe level here. But its still entirely possible" [Atreidon, 2026-02-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168459#p168459); "yes its fine once you get cone of cold" [amanagor, 2025-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117090#p117090); "Mage aoe levelign just as strong here than it is in classic, if not stronger" [amanagor, 2026-02-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169382#p169382) vs "Mage's AoE farming has been trashed to shit on TWoW" [Eluaria, 2026-03-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171410#p171410); "With the current nerfs, it's not a good aoe class anymore while leveling" [Weirdyunus, 2025-02-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120499#p120499); "At this point you're better off leveling a prot paladin or even a survival hunter if you want to aoe grind" [Hotcoldman2, 2026-02-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168372#p168372). Staff reason for the nerf is only implied (Icicles comment: Frost "already a strong contender" in PvP); players believe it targeted farming/boosting ([Atreidon, 2025-12-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162407#p162407); [Zvyrhol, 2026-01-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165125#p165125)); "The philosophy of the Turtle WoW server is not aoe farming everything to reach level 60 as fast as possible. While you still can do it, know that the playstyle is not actively supported." [Trismegistos, 2024-02-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=87237#p87237). Expect competition on grind spots (Atreidon 2026-02-16).

### Fire single target (older wiki table, pre-1.18.0 talents)
10–14 Improved Fireball 1→5 · 15–16 Flame Throwing 1→2 · 17–19 Improved Fire Blast 1→3 · 20–22 Elemental Precision 1→3 · 23–27 Impact 1→5 · 28–30 Master of Elements 1→3 · 31 Pyroblast · 32 Burning Soul 1 · 33–35 Critical Mass 1→3 · 36–38 Hot Streak 1→3 · 39–42 Fire Power 1→4 · 43 Combustion · 44 Fire Power 5 · 45–46 Arcane Subtlety 1→2 · 47–49 Arcane Focus 1→3 · 50–54 Arcane Concentration 1→5 · 55–59 Ignite 1→5.

Hot Streak is now 2 ranks and Arcane Focus is no longer in row 1 (1.18.0), so prefer the newer path in [Mage Fire FAQ (wiki, rev. 2026-03-04)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Fire_FAQ): Improved Fireball 5, Ignite 5, Pyroblast (level 20) → Burning Soul 2 → Elemental Precision 3 → Arcane Subtlety 2, Magic Absorption 3 (30) → Arcane Concentration 5 → Incinerate 2, Master of Elements 3, Fire Vulnerability 3, Blast Wave 1, Critical Mass 3, Hot Streak 2, Fire Power 5, Combustion 1 (55) → 5 free. Play: "simply want to cast fireball. You can weave in fireblast if you are running, or scorch to finish off low hp mobs … if the mob gets close and your hp is low, simply frost nova and walk/blink away" (Levelling FAQ). Rudyraccoon's HC-oriented variant takes Impact and Elemental Precision "imagine using Pyroblast as an opener, and then it misses" ([2023-11-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=75490#p75490)); Darktifa played Fire to 40 then took Arcane for Arcane Concentration and Arcane Resilience at 59 (screenshots only).

### Arcane single target
10–14 Improved Arcane Missiles 1→5 · 15–19 Arcane Concentration 1→5 · 20 Arcane Rupture · 21–23 Arcane Impact 1→3 · 24 Arcane Focus 1 · 25–27 Arcane Meditation 1→3 · 28–29 Temporal Convergence 1→2 · 30 Accelerated Arcana · 31–33 Arcane Instability 1→3 · 34–35 Arcane Potency 1→2 · 36–39 Resonance Cascade 1→4 · 40 Resonance Cascade 5 · 41 Presence of Mind · 42 Temporal Convergence 3 · 43–46 Arcane Focus 2→5 · 47–48 Arcane Subtlety 1→2 · 49–51 Magic Absorption 1→3 · 52–56 Improved Fireball 1→5 · 57–59 Improved Fire Blast 1→3. Arcane Power: "probably not even worth putting a point in … until you get more geared" (Arcane FAQ).

Play (wiki): "just want to cast arcane missiles. Therefore getting improved arcane missiles is really important … You can play like a drain tank warlock, however you'll run out of health much quicker … If the mob has high hp, once you get it, you can start the fight with arcane rupture, however this will make your mana management much harder." Toaomb's open-world loop: Frostbolt for the slow → Arcane Missiles → Cone of Cold (rank 1 to save mana) when they reach you → run → Missiles again; multi-target: Arcane Explosion / Cone of Cold / Frost Nova / Fire Blast; "Try not to Blink, try to use Mage Armor to keep good mana, try not to use Mana Shield" ([2024-07-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=98354#p98354), [p98355](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=98355#p98355)). Schoop123's 1–60 report: Arcane Power is unusable solo while leveling (drain kills you on elites), useful only in group boss fights; Spirit feels like the main stat; Rupture buff window awkward ([2024-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107572#p107572)). Redmagejoe's pre-rework level-by-level links (14 → 58) are obsolete tree exports ([2023-07-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=54081#p54081)).

sections.heading: Respec points
sections.markdown:
- No source gives a fixed respec level. Practical pattern in sources: Frost to 60, then swap to raid spec at 60 (Akos1896 2024-03-28 for Fire at AQ40 — pre-rework); Goblin Brainwashing Device (dual spec) bought at 60 ([Joras333, 2023-10-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=69295#p69295)); respec cost quoted 5g early ([Koseku, 2024-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=86809#p86809)). Arcane levelers plan "to use Arcane in the endgame (to avoid added cost of changing specs and buying skills)" ([Traxahn, 2025-01-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118506#p118506)).
- Frost AoE spec ↔ single-target: exclusive because of Frostbite (Rudyraccoon).

sections.heading: Skill training priority
sections.markdown:
- "the most important thing is to make sure you learn spells from all specs. I made the mistake of trying to go only frost and missed out on some pretty helpful spells for the first 20 levels" [Liatris, 2023-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=39827#p39827). Contrast a Fire main who refuses to buy Frost spells ([Likaleo, 2024-04-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=93149#p93149)) — do not copy.
- Ranks bots should keep: rank 1 Frostbolt (slow/shatter macro, aggro drop, PvP), rank 1 Frost Nova (AoE pull per wiki), rank 1 Fire Blast (pulling), rank 1 Cone of Cold (cheap slow — Toaomb), rank 1 Arcane Explosion (Clearcasting fishing / out of combat — wiki macro), lower-rank Flamestrike (DoT stacking with a second rank — Mativh), rank 1 Blizzard (freeze trigger in Mativh's alt build). New spells by level from staff: Arcane Surge 32/40/48/56; Arcane Rupture ranks 20/28/36/44/52/60 (talent); Icicles 30/40/50/60 (talent); Arcane Intellect ranks 1/14/28/42/56; Arcane Brilliance 56; Fireball rank 12 from a level-60 book; Teleport: Theramore/Stonard from level-45 class quests (quest 41114 / 41117 per wiki), portals from Kara10 trash tomes (<1% — [Joras333, 2024-01-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83398#p83398)). Khadgar's Unlocking: rank 1 skill 15 (Ornate Bronze), rank 2 skill 75, rank 3 skill 135 (book 2g77s → quest paying 3g to Ol' Biggins), rank 4 skill 195 (Steel Lockbox) — "Take it as class flavor" [Elesion, 2023-07-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=53980#p53980). Conjured Mana Oranges: Dire Maul "Arcane Refreshment" quest → Archmage Malin / Bethor Iceshard → Archmage Xylem → Perfect Obsidian Shard from Moam (AQ20) (wiki General FAQ; [Balake, 2023-01-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=33103#p33103)). Polymorph: Cow tome from The Cow King (changelog 2023-06-14).
- Trainers: High Elf mages finishing the starting zone find no mage trainer in Darkshore or Darnassus ("Darnassus is a capital of the race that banished mages 7000 years ago" [Galendor, 2025-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117605#p117605)); trainer list on the wiki [Mage trainers](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_trainers) (Stormwind Wizard's Sanctum, Ironforge Hall of Mysteries, Undercity Magic Quarter, Orgrimmar Valley of Spirits, Thunder Bluff Pools of Vision).
- Conjure Water rank-by-target-level macro: `/script r=7;l={1,5,15,25,35,45,55};if not UnitIsFriend("player","target")then TargetUnit("player");end;t=UnitLevel("target");for i=r,1,-1 do if (t>=l[ i]) then CastSpellByName("Conjure Water(Rank "..i..")");break;end;end` ([Ballabulk, 2023-06-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=51518#p51518)); the addon Arcanum handles food/water/buffs by target level but not oranges/Theramore ([Ashstache, 2023-10-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=71290#p71290)); PortalTurtle / Cryolysis for portals ([addon thread](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=91783#p91783)).

sections.heading: Stats and gear while leveling
sections.markdown:
- "Int first, then stam and spirit. Spirit is basically useless and stam helps with AOE farming since you're less likely to go down in two taps. Otherwise, go for spell power when you reach the appropriate levels." [Bigsmerf, 2025-06-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137036#p137036); "stay geared INT>STAM and only go for these two stats and get gear from ah" [Eversongwoods, 2025-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117053#p117053); "prioritise intellect gear ('of the eagle' greens are very good for this)" (Zulnam 2025-03-03). **Consensus: Int > Stam**, Spirit contested (Bigsmerf "useless" vs Schoop123 "Spirit is your main stat" for Arcane and Roxanneflowers' 2020 Spirit theory). Spell power rings from ~20 (Breezy 2025-06-26).
- Survivability gear: "Maybe don't get all INT gear and swap some STAM gear for survivability?" [Darktifa, 2024-07-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=98320#p98320).
- "keep your gear up 2 date for your level (get the recent dungeon, quest or profession items) … Frost is a bit less gear dependent" (Chev03 2026-04-06).
- Named early items: Amber Rings +6 AP (battlemage only), Staff of the Friar / Thunderwood (battlemage). No leveling BiS list exists in the sources (**gap**).

sections.heading: Route: zones, dungeons, farms
sections.markdown:
- **Dire Maul East lashers** from 50: "aoe farm in dire maul east and do 50 to 60 in a few hours" (amanagor 2025-01-06); wiki gold farm "Lashers in Dire Maul east" with a video; "pull 8 lasher backs in DME and farm gold" (Forumdweller). "DM East whippers with herbalism" made better money than SM pulls ([Escapism, 2023-06-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=51016#p51016)).
- **Instance mega-pulls do not work**: ZF graveyard safe spots removed ("mobs can reach u when u jump on the wall" [Rogzn, 2023-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=45321#p45321); "they changed the pathing specifically so it doesn't work" [Mac, 2023-06-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=50914#p50914)); Maraudon/ZG pathing kites unreliable ([Kairion, 2023-05-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=47099#p47099)); "You can still do the normal CoC zg crocs farm and the mara turtle farm tho" [Thegr8equalizer, 2023-06-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=51019#p51019) — but "You made ZG crocs unfarmable" (itemization-thread player, 2024-10-30) — **superseded/contested**; "hyperspawns" in Westfall are not as in Classic ([Scelus12, 2023-12-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=82340#p82340)). Community disapproves of boosting ([Redmagejoe](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49419#p49419), [Drubarrymooer](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49483#p49483), 2023-06).
- Uther's Tomb group AoE farming still happens with a partner ([Ganostraza, 2026-01-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167064#p167064)).
- Boost meta (not solo): a level-60 boomkin with Thorns kills the pulls of an un-grouped alt, "you need 30 traveler tents … from 1-20 you can get 1 level every 10mins" ([Sineva1, 2026-02-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168464#p168464)) — single source.
- Quest oddities: Keeper Leena (Azshara mage quest) is reached via the Temple of Arkkoran ramp at 78,38, then a stone in a round chamber, needing the Staff of Eldara ([St0neh3ad, 2026-03-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169690#p169690)). Bingles' quest packs (Loch Modan, level 16 with a healer): Polymorph the healer, Frost Nova → Flamestrike → Blizzard, Cone of Cold on release (Liatris 2023-04-01; pre-Blizzard-nerf).
- Professions: Tailoring + Enchanting "Standard", Alchemy + Herbalism for pots/elixirs (Chev03); Engineering matters at 60 for sapper charges (wiki); Enchanting mages can solo into Uldaman's back door for the Artisan trainer with Frost control ([Roxanneflowers, 2020](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6936#p6936) — pre-nerf Blizzard).
- Zone list by bracket: **gap** — no source gives one for mages.

sections.heading: Kill loop and downtime
sections.markdown:
- Frost: 3 Frostbolts → Nova → Blink/run → repeat; CoC when Nova down (wiki).
- Fire: Fireball spam, Fire Blast while moving, Scorch to finish; Nova + walk if hit (wiki).
- Arcane: Frostbolt slow → Missiles → CoC r1 → reposition; AE/CoC/Nova/Fire Blast for multiples (Toaomb); use Mage Armor not Mana Shield to keep mana (Toaomb) — contrast Mativh's HC Fire-AoE build that "Focus only on Intellect, always use Mana Shield" and treats mana as health ([2023-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=76091#p76091), "I don't recommend it, but for me it worked").
- Drink/eat together after combat (Roxanneflowers); Wand Specialization mana-on-hit (Krautsurfer); Evocation; mana tea later.
- Melee as a mage misses ~20% more per level the mob is above you (Atolius) — never melee.

sections.heading: Hardcore-mode differences
sections.markdown:
- Prefer Fire single-target or Frost single-target over AoE grinding: "AoE farming seems a bit risky, especially if you're doing the hardcore challenge" (Rudyraccoon 2024-11-10); "It's a major issue for anyone playing frost mage in HC" that Blizzard no longer holds packs ([Soulitics, 2025-11-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158934#p158934)); Fire "perfect for HC … only disadvantage is no Ice block --> cold snap" (Darktifa). 
- A pure-Arcane "Arcanist challenge" (Arcane spells only) was proposed with a Spirit/Mana Shield/wand loop ([Nokid / Mativh, 2023-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=55843#p55843)) — no completion reported.
- "Kamikaze"/Blink-into-pack play and Icicles' self-root (30% base HP shatter) are the two mage mechanics most likely to kill a HC character; Icicles is not in any leveling table ("I don't recommend using icicles at all when leveling", wiki Frost FAQ).
- Slow-and-Steady challenge levelers pick Arcane for fun ([madferret, 2025-05-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=129301#p129301)).

gaps:
1. **Complete 51-point raid builds for Fire and Frost** — the wiki's "Pepo raid" / "Pepo frost" builds are images; forum build links are opaque `talents.turtlecraft.gg` exports.
2. **PvP talent allocations** for any spec on the 1.17.2+ tree; PvP stat priority; the 1.18.1 per-class PvP dampening numbers for Mage.
3. **2–3 target vs 4+ target thresholds** for Arcane and Fire (only Frost has "up to 5 / more than 5").
4. **Frost's "mana issues as of April 7th [2025]"** (wiki) — cause and status after 1.18.1 unknown.
5. **Fire T3.5 5-set bonus bug** (bug-report id 18568) — whether 1.18.1 fixed it.
6. **Leveling zone route by level bracket** and a leveling BiS list; which spell ranks to skip buying (only rank-1 keepers are documented).
7. **Spell/talent IDs** — none given by sources.
8. **Enchants** beyond the shoulder choice (2 haste vs "Saph"); consumable lists beyond mana tea/potions/Greater Fire Protection Potion; no Elixir of Arcane Power exists.
9. **Accelerated Arcana**: tooltip 6% (staff) vs measured 5% cast-time reduction (wiki) — unresolved.
10. **Arcane Missiles haste cap** value (wiki mentions a cap for stacked haste effects, no number).
11. **Whether Icicles should be cast without a Flash Freeze proc** (Crake yes; wiki sim and a raider no).
12. **Fire vs Frost in Molten Core** post-1.18.1 (Eluaria's claim challenged, no logs).
13. Staff rationale for the Improved Blizzard nerf (only inferable from the Icicles PvP comment).
14. Community wiki pages are marked `is_turtle_content: false` and are anonymous; treat their sims as single-source.
patchChanges:
- Ice Barrier: +5% Frost damage while active (was 15%) and +10% Frost damage for 1 min on cast — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
- Improved Fire Blast: GCD reduction 0.3/0.6/1.0 s — Jamey, revision 2026-01-26.
- Mirror Magic (T3.5 3-set) fixed: Flamestrike/Cone of Cold/Frost Nova/Blast Wave/Arcane Explosion initial hits can trigger a rewind (+10% Arcane, +20% Frost/Fire) — [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168).
- Wands benefit correctly from school-specific damage modifiers — same post.
- Blink usable again in Onyxia's Lair (hotfix 2026-03-21); PvP dampening becomes class/spec-dependent (numbers never published).
- Nothing in the Arcane tree changed; the last Arcane changes were 1.18.0 (Rupture missile bonus 25% → 20%, Arcane Focus ↔ Magic Absorption swap).

caveats: The only itemized pre-raid list for Mage comes from the community wiki's General FAQ page (authority: wiki, the least reliable tier per AGENTS.md) — the wiki itself says "no up-to-date pre-raid BiS, you can just jump right into raids." Forum threads asking for a BiS list (t13188, t18636, t22994) got no substantive answers; one reply just linked the wiki/AtlasLoot.

No raid-tier slot-by-slot BiS list exists for any Mage spec in any source; only tier-set bonus text, isolated named items, and one post naming a handful of BWL-era trinkets/weapons for Arcane (single source, post-1.18.1).

No Mage forum post is staff-authored on gear (0 staff posts touch itemization directly in the Mage forum's 683 posts); the itemization changelog (Dragunovi, 2026-02-15) is the only staff gear source, and it only lists numeric tweaks to existing items, not slot recommendations.
No leveling gear list exists for Mage at all (explicit gap in `leveling.md`) — only generic stat priority (Int > Stam) and two named early items.

I never go over 16% hit total" — [Ashafares (player), 2025-12-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=162161#p162161); then crit. name: Warlock
summary: Written 2026-09-10 from the Warlock forum (f=46, 155 threads / 1,084 posts, extraction spans 2020-07-21 .. 2026-04-10), the staff class-change thread (`t15157`, "Patch 1.17.2 & Beyond — Class & Gameplay Changes", including the 1.18.1 post p=166071 by Jamey, 2026-01-23, with revision blocks dated 2026-01-26 and 2026-03-19), `synthesis/1.18.1-master-changelog.md` (Classes → Warlock), `synthesis/turtle-vs-vanilla-timeline.md`, `structured/patches/1.18.1-changes.yaml`, cross-forum threads (Hardcore Lounge `t4856`, General `t11525`), and the community wiki (`Patch_1.18.1`, Warlock talent-calculator links quoted by players). Conventions: `synthesis/CONVENTIONS.md`.

readme.heading: Warlock tanking
readme.markdown:
Explicitly assessed as **not a supported role** by the sources, so no tank playbook was written (per the task instructions: only cover it as a role if sources treat it as viable). Evidence, all in `demonology-ranged-dps.md`:

- A player wished for a demon-tanking playstyle but described it as aspirational, not current: [Spriggit (player), 2023-10-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=74657#p74657).
- Voidwalker threat "doesn't really hold aggro as you get stronger" — Jumadforum (quoted in `demonology-ranged-dps.md`), and still true late in 1.18.1: "still my voidwalker is losing aggro" at character level 34 — [Milordas (player), 2026-03-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173046#p173046).
- No source anywhere in the Warlock forum, the master changelog, or the 1.18.1 staff post describes the Warlock (or its pet) tanking a dungeon or raid boss; the class's own demons are themselves described as squishy DPS/CC/utility tools ("As for Demonology, it's just three words: they don't survive" — LastyK, `demonology-ranged-dps.md`).

Do not build Warlock-tank bot behavior; if a future patch changes this, re-check the sources before adding a playbook.

readme.heading: Official 1.18.1 Warlock changes used (Jamey p=166071, 2026-01-23; revisions 2026-01-26 and 2026-03-19; hotfixes Torta p=172139/p=173490, Dragunovi itemization p=168272)
readme.markdown:
**Base post (2026-01-23):** Curse of Exhaustion mana 8%→14% base (110→190 at 60); Curse of Tongues R1 cast-speed reduction 50%→30%, R2 mana 110→240; Enslave Demon now −50% healing taken by the enslaved demon (shifted off Master Demonologist); Ritual of Doom initial cast 5→7 s, channel 5→3 s; Felhunter/Infernal armor −30% (≈5% less physical mitigation); Felguard Legion Strike healing reduction 10%→25%, Axe Toss stun 4 s→2 s; Searing Pain GCD 1.5 s→1 s; Hellfire SP scaling 2.2%→4.125%/tick, mana changed to a lower up-front cost + per-second channel cost (R1 645→160+30/s, R2 975→240+50/s, R3 1300→325+65/s); Ritual of Souls shard cost 1→3; Soulwell new model; Curse of Recklessness GCD 1.5 s→1 s; **Affliction** — Sinister Pursuit moved to Demonology as a 2-point pet-speed talent, Master Conjuror removed; **Demonology** — Master Summoner also cuts Ritual of Doom cooldown 25/50%, Master Demonologist loses the Greater-Demon healing reduction, Unleashed Potential gets a tracking buff, Soul Link transfer 25%→20%; **Tier bonuses** — Affliction T3 (4-set) Curse of Agony +100% first 4 ticks, Affliction T3.5 (3-set) Siphon Life mana/health return 50%→25%.

**Revision, 26 January 2026:** Ritual of Doom cast 3 s / channel 2 s / 1 summoner (final); Demon Gate Felguard spawn delay 6→4 s; Hellfire SP scaling raised to 6.66% (final); Searing Pain base cast 1.5→2.0 s, SP scaling to 57%; Bane also cuts Searing Pain cast time 0.1–0.5 s; Unleashed Potential procs on any direct damage, not only crits; Avoidance's AoE reduction also covers cleave damage; Curse of Shadow / Curse of the Elements GCD 1.5→1 s.

**Revision, 19 March 2026:** Searing Pain base damage for all ranks +~20%.

**Hotfixes (post-1.18.1):** Abolish Poison/Disease castable on demon pets (Torta, p=172139); Soul Entrapment no longer boosts damage while controlling a Greater Demon (Torta, p=173490); Demonic Sacrifice usable on Hardcore again (Torta, p=176101). **Unresolved player report:** Affliction mana-cost increases (Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues R2) prompted a post-release revert request (daleking0518, 2026-03-22) with no staff reply in the extract.

**New race/class combination:** **Dwarf Warlock** — "Bronzebeard dwarves practicing demonology in a secret coven within Ironforge"; announced 2025-10-03 (Torta p=154168), added to the first post 2025-10-23 (Torta p=156748). No mechanical racial difference is stated anywhere in the sources beyond the standard Dwarf racials (vanilla baseline, not from turtlecraft.gg) — see Gaps.

readme.heading: Gaps (not covered by any source — do not guess)
readme.markdown:
1. **Dwarf Warlock evaluation**: no forum post, wiki page, or staff note gives PvE/PvP viability, stat-racial synergy, or any Warlock-specific commentary on the Dwarf race — flagged in every file's Races section as an open gap rather than guessed.
2. **1.18.1 PvP dampening's per-spec values**: staff said dampening became "dynamic ... based on your class/spec instead of a flat number" (Torta, 2025-10-03) but no source publishes the Warlock-specific numbers.
3. **Full point-by-point 60 talent builds for Demonology and Destruction (Shadow/Fire) and for Demonology PvP**: every endgame build in those files is a `talents.turtlecraft.gg` or `talent-builder.haaxor1689.dev` link, not a decoded point list (only the primary Affliction leveling build in `leveling.md` is fully enumerated).
4. **Pre-raid BiS and current itemization lists**: no gear-guide thread got an answer (`t15091` "Gear guide for new 60?" has zero replies); gear notes throughout are piecemeal (named trinkets/effects), not full lists.
5. **Consumables**: beyond a few named trinkets/potions, no systematic flask/elixir/food list for any spec or for leveling.
6. **Leveling route**: no zone-by-zone path, dungeon-per-bracket list, or profession-pairing consensus beyond one Hardcore-Lounge Alchemy recommendation (contested on one number).
7. **Respec timing while leveling**: no source names a specific level to respec at (contrast e.g. the Paladin guide's "respec at 30 for Holy Shield").
8. **Post-1.18.1 re-evaluation of spec viability**: most "which spec is best" quotes predate 2026-03-20; only a handful of April 2026 posts (Momohomo, Sharmaine) speak to the live patch.
9. **Full pet-ability list and level-by-level unlocks** (Voidwalker/Imp/Succubus/Felhunter ability ranks) — only Torment (VW) and the 10-level threat-rank cadence are sourced.
10. **Spell/talent IDs**: no source in this forum or the changelog gives numeric spell IDs for Warlock abilities, so every `spell_id` field in the structured YAMLs is `null`.
11. **Warlock healing/off-healing, Warlock melee DPS**: not discussed anywhere — not roles the sources or the class kit support; omitted rather than invented.
12. **Demonic Sacrifice leveling build's current talent-tree position**: the single source for it (2025-03-05) predates CC3's rework of Demonic Sacrifice's row/prerequisite; its point link cannot be verified against the live tree from the extract.

readme.heading: Top open questions for the orchestrator
readme.markdown:
- Decode the `talents.turtlecraft.gg` and `talent-builder.haaxor1689.dev` `points=` strings for the Demonology, Destruction (Fire/Shadow), and Demonology-PvP endgame builds into explicit point lists.
- Find or fetch the Warlock Discord class-channel pins referenced twice in the sources ("check the pins in the warlock channel on the discord server" — Zulnam, 2025-04-11) — outside this repo's scope but flagged as the community's likely source of truth for current numbers.
- Any post-1.18.1 (after 2026-03-20) raid-log or dummy-test thread re-ranking the three specs, since the bulk of the DPS-comparison quotes used here are from January–February 2026, before the patch went live.
- The published 1.18.1 per-spec PvP dampening table, if one exists outside the extracted forum.

playbooks.title: Warlock — Affliction — Ranged DPS (raid / dungeon)
playbooks.intro:
Covers the post-Class-Changes-2 "Affliction Drain" build (Dark Harvest capstone, Malediction, Soul Siphon, Rapid Deterioration). Pre-CC2 Affliction (Dark Pact, Amplify Curse, Improved Drain Soul) no longer exists on Turtle; statements about it are marked obsolete. PvP use of Affliction is treated in a short section here because the sources do not treat it as a distinct build.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). Within pre-1.18.1 the Warlock kit changed several times: Class Changes 2 ("CC2", 1.17.2, announced 2024-10-12, live 2024-11-01), the 2024-11-20 and 2024-12-20 revisions, the 2025-03-30 round, and Class Changes 3 ("CC3", 1.18.0, announced 2025-07-25, live 2025-08-15). Every recommendation below says which kit it was written for.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: ranged DPS built on damage-over-time upkeep plus channelled drains (Drain Soul, Dark Harvest), with Nightfall-proc Shadow Bolts. Curses for the raid (Curse of Shadow / Curse of the Elements) are still expected from the Warlock; Malediction lets Curse of Agony coexist with them.
- **Strengths (sources)**: the easiest Warlock spec to gear — "gearing for it is much easier thanks to the 10% hit from talents. All you need is 5-6% hit and as much haste as you can get and it performs really well" [Spritzbube (player), 2026-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169207#p169207); the highest sustained single-target of the three specs in early-2026 dummy tests: "lacking 3% hit to being hit capped, i am pulling 450 DPS easy as a Dark harvest affliction warlock on elite lvl 63 dummy ... SM/RUIN ... 250 DPS" [Guiltyhaomarush (player), 2026-02-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168196#p168196); does not depend on crit or on a pet; Nightfall Shadow Bolts are "guaranteed to land" since 2024-12-20 [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460).
- **Weaknesses (sources)**: trash — "Affliction Warlock's main pain point" per staff, which is why Malediction now auto-applies Curse of Agony when you cast a support curse [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504); "in Raids most mobs will be dead before you dots can even tick" [Grizb37 (player), 2026-02-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168199#p168199); very mana hungry with Dark Pact removed ("The biggest drawback of turtle aff is that dark pact has been removed ... replaced with another very mana hungry channeled spell" [Wrathweaver (player), 2025-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122630#p122630)); channels are punished by pushback and boss knockbacks (Anub'Rekhan knock-up, Faerlina Rain of Fire, Maexxna web wrap — [LastyK (player), 2024-11-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107778#p107778)); wants a Shadow Priest's Shadow Weaving to shine: "for raids - u need shadow priest debuff for good dps" [Akarui (player), 2026-02-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168899#p168899).
- **Content**: raids at 60 — accepted, and by 2026 the forum's default PvE recommendation ("everyone in pve will tell you to switch to affliction with sacrifice demon" [Momohomo (player), 2026-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174180#p174180)). Dungeons — good (see `leveling.md` for the low-level dungeon pattern). Solo/farming — "a strong soloing build" (Grizb37, above). PvP — contested (see below). Hardcore — no Affliction-specific hardcore advice beyond leveling.
- **Community standing**: **favored for PvE since late 2025 / early 2026** (consensus of the 2026 posts: Spritzbube, Guiltyhaomarush, Momohomo, Grizb37; and the wiki lists "Affliction Drain" as a raid spec); **contested before that**: staff called it above-average only after the Dec-2024 fixes [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460); in Nov 2024 the top Chinese-server raider wrote "what Affliction can do, Shadow Destruction can also do ... and even performs better" [LastyK (player), 2024-11-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107778#p107778) and in March 2025 a full-T3 Affliction raider found "the DPS output in AQ40 and Naxx is severely lacking compared to DS/Ruin and Fire" [Bardicdm (player), 2025-03-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122244#p122244). Bots: use Affliction as the default raid spec from 2026 on; expect older raiders to still call SM/Ruin the "real" spec.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
### Endgame Affliction ("Affliction Drain") — 1.18.0 tree, valid for 1.18.1 with one edit

The most explicit allocation is the leveling guide reposted by [Nuninho32 (player), 2026-01-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166748#p166748) (written by "chappelles", link `https://talent-builder.haaxor1689.dev/c/1.18.0/warlock?points=EoASCASDJBFAB-AoD-F`); its endpoint at 53 is the raid core:

| Tree | Talent | Points | Notes / source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Affliction | Improved Corruption | 5/5 | instant Corruption; every guide agrees (chappelles; [Eversongwoods (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118774#p118774); [Spot (player), 2024-01-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83941#p83941)) |
| Affliction | Suppression | 3/5 (4/5 or 5/5 optional) | chappelles takes 3 then 4; Eversongwoods 5/5; the 10% Affliction hit is why "All you need is 5-6% hit" (Spritzbube, above) |
| Affliction | Improved Life Tap | 2/2 | chappelles; Eversongwoods |
| Affliction | Fel Concentration | 2/2 | chappelles; "spec into fel concentration asap" [Eversongwoods (player), 2025-03-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121836#p121836) |
| Affliction | Improved Drains | 2/2 | chappelles; Eversongwoods |
| Affliction | Nightfall | 2/2 | chappelles (1 at 25, 2 at 29) — **contested for leveling**: "I wouldnt bother with nightfall or ever cast a shadowbolt while leveling" [Eversongwoods (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118780#p118780); at 60 the raid variants keep it |
| Affliction | Soul Siphon | 3/3 | chappelles; the reason to keep Siphon Life up ("I need to keep this DOT to maintain the damage boost from the new fifth-tier talent" — LastyK, above) |
| Affliction | Malediction | 1/1 | chappelles ("QoL"); Xudo advised even SM/Ruin to take it [Xudo (player), 2024-11-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107805#p107805) |
| Affliction | Siphon Life | 1/1 | chappelles |
| Affliction | Rapid Deterioration | 1/2 (2/2 as filler) | chappelles |
| Affliction | Grim Reach | 2/2 | chappelles |
| Affliction | Shadow Mastery | 5/5 | chappelles; also the "strongest Life Tap" argument [Mitzter (player), 2025-07-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=138009#p138009) |
| Affliction | Dark Harvest | 1/1 | chappelles at 40; **contested at 60** (see rotation) |
| Destruction | Shadow Vulnerability | 5/5 | chappelles (41–45); "Shadow Vulnerability isnt anymore crit triggered and it gives 20% shadow buff to all shadow damage. This alone favors deep affliction" (Guiltyhaomarush, above); applied by Drain Soul ticks since CC3 |
| Demonology | Demonic Embrace | 5/5 | chappelles (46–50) |
| Demonology | Demonic Aegis | 3/3 | chappelles (51–53) |
| flexible | last 7 points | — | chappelles: "master conjurer, improved curse of agony, finishing suppression, curse of exhaustion & improved curse of exhaustion, finishing rapid deterioration, shadowburn for even more damage, fel domination and fel stamina". **Master Conjuror was removed in 1.18.1** (Jamey, above) — drop that option |

Raid variant that sacrifices the demon: "For later raids may eventually go for this, as pet will die to AOE" [Justgreens123 (player), 2025-11-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159958#p159958) — link `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warlock?points=FoASaAKDRBFAB-CrAAAB-F` (opaque; by the author's description it swaps the Demonology points into Soul Entrapment / Demonic Sacrifice). The same player in Naxx: "Have been running Affliction (without Dark Harvest, as DPS seems better with Drainsoul + nightfall procs). Using Demonic Sacrifice for dmg or reduced threat as situation demands" [Justgreens123 (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156392#p156392). Community wiki "Affliction Drain" link: `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warlock?points=FoAKaASDRBFAB-CrAAAB-F` (community wiki, not official: https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Warlock, revision 2026-01-16).

Demonic Sacrifice values since CC3: Imp +4% spell damage, Succubus −10% threat, Voidwalker 3% health / 4 s, Felhunter 3% mana / 4 s; Soul Entrapment +2/4/6% damage with no demon [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159). Demonic Sacrifice "is removed when you enslave a demon" [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504). A Hardcore-only bug prevented Demonic Sacrifice until it was hotfixed [Torta (staff), 2026-04-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=176101#p176101).

### Patch validity

- Anything mentioning Dark Pact, Amplify Curse, Improved Drain Soul (mana regen) or 5-point Fel Concentration is **pre-CC2 / obsolete** (e.g. [Roxanneflowers (player), 2020-07-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=7010#p7010)).
- Builds from Nov 2024 – Jul 2025 predate CC3's Fel Concentration (5 → 2 points) and Curse of Exhaustion split (10% base + Improved 15/30%).
- 1.18.1 removed Master Conjuror and moved Sinister Pursuit; otherwise the chappelles/Justgreens allocation stands. No post after 2026-03-20 re-evaluates the Affliction raid build; treat the 1.18.0 build as valid for 1.18.1 with those two edits.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- **Hit**: Suppression covers 10% for Affliction spells; players run "5-6% hit" on gear (Spritzbube, above). Shadow Bolt (Nightfall procs) does not benefit from Suppression, but Nightfall bolts cannot miss since 2024-12-20 (staff, above). Whether **Dark Harvest** is affected by hit is an open question: "With 15% hit, only Darkharvest misses 3 out of 10. Bad luck always on darkharvest or does hit not affect Darkharvest?" [Akarui (player), 2025-08-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147762#p147762); "I don't understand why it even has a resist chance at all" [Toxo (player), 2025-08-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148484#p148484). Gap. The 16% cap against level-63 bosses is vanilla baseline, not from turtlecraft.gg.
- **Haste** vs raw spell power: the wiki says "Stat Priority: Haste and Hit" (community wiki Warlock page); Spritzbube: "as much haste as you can get". The direct question "is Affli better with haste or full sp?" got no answer [Horcos (player), 2025-10-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157151#p157151) — gap. Haste mechanics on Turtle: Rapid Deterioration's 6% is multiplicative with gear haste and "the game works in 0.04 second ticks, and the game rounds up to the next full tick" [Atreidon (player), 2025-10-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156605#p156605) (answering a measured discrepancy table by [Veddel (player), 2025-10-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156602#p156602)); haste shortens DoT duration so you refresh more often ("DOTs will tick faster, and you'll find it nearly impossible to find a suitable moment to channel an 8-second spell" — LastyK, above); pushback on a hasted channel costs whole ticks: "Each tick drain soul = 0.91 sec. First pushing back - minus 1 sec. its full one tick and one unfinished, so its 2 ticks lost" [Akarui (player), 2025-09-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150902#p150902).
- **Crit / Intellect**: useless — "we dont really want spellcrit" [Kentorianx (player), 2025-01-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115165#p115165); "Its spell crit - useless for us, need more spd/haste/some hit" [Lavr (player), 2025-06-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137349#p137349); DoTs do not crit on Turtle (LastyK, above). Consensus.
- **Stamina**: valued because "A warlocks healthpool IS their mana" (Mitzter, above) and the Affliction sets are stamina-poor ("tier 2.5 affliction set has 0 stamina" — Kentorianx, above; "I would be running around on naxx with 2k health"). Consensus.
- **Spirit**: not a DPS stat. A 2020 build tried to exploit the 5-second rule with Spirit but found that on Turtle mana regen from Spirit is also suppressed **during** channels ("imposing a similar condition of (the same?) -100% debuff while channeling") [Roxanneflowers (player), 2020-09-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=7547#p7547) — single source, never re-tested; Justgreens123 (2025): "Spirit about worthless, as you get 0 regen in combat (unless troll)".
- Vampirism (% of damage returned as healing) exists as a Turtle stat on several items and on Felstone (community wiki Warlock page lists a "Vampirism" gear set); Felstone is 3% leech, improved by Improved Stones [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102973#p102973). A player reports Improved Stones showing only 2% Firestone crit instead of 4% [Guiltyhaomarush (player), 2026-03-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170140#p170140) and "2 points in the improved stones talent gives 4% instead of 6%" [Oddly (player), 2026-04-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174409#p174409) — unresolved.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation (raid boss)
rotationSingle.markdown:
Sources: wiki "Affliction Drain" ("Curse, Corruption, Siphon Life, Dark Harvest when its up otherwise Drain Soul"), [Justgreens123 (player), 2025-11-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159958#p159958) ("Generally rotation is CoA, Corruption, siphon life, soul drain. Can corruption first if you want nightfall to trigger"), [Eversongwoods (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118780#p118780) ("Use sl,agony,curse of shadows,corruption and either drain soul or dot up the next target"), Akarui's dummy tests (below).

**Opener** (boss, you are the curse Warlock): 1) Curse of Shadow or Curse of the Elements as assigned (1-s GCD since 1.18.1); with Malediction this also puts your highest Curse of Agony on the target. 2) Corruption (instant). 3) Siphon Life. 4) Immolate is **not** in the Affliction list; Campy adds it as a generic Warlock filler but his build is Destruction-heavy [Campy-TWForum (player), 2025-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121650#p121650) — do not copy. 5) Drain Soul.

**Priority list**:
1. If a Nightfall proc (Shadow Trance) is up: cast Shadow Bolt (instant, cannot miss). Whether to interrupt a Drain Soul / Dark Harvest channel for it is an open question the sources raise but do not answer (LastyK, above; "Its so stupid when u wait this proc a year but then u get 3-5 in row each tick" [Akarui (player), 2025-10-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156075#p156075)). Bot rule: break a Drain Soul channel for a proc; do not break Dark Harvest.
2. If the assigned support curse is missing: recast it (Malediction re-applies Curse of Agony with it).
3. If Corruption is missing or about to expire (haste shortens it — refresh "when needed" is the only guidance): recast Corruption.
4. If Siphon Life is missing: recast (keeps Soul Siphon at its 4-effect maximum together with Corruption, Curse of Agony and the support curse; "The debuff effects caused by the drain spells do not contribute" — Dragunovi CC2 post).
5. If Curse of Agony is missing and you are not the curse Warlock: Curse of Agony.
6. Dark Harvest if off cooldown — **contested**: Akarui measured "with drain soul + dots dps 8-10% more than with darkharvest+dots and ful t2.5 set" [Akarui (player), 2025-09-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153453#p153453), confirmed by "not using Dark Harvest makes you deal more dmg in the long run lol" [Horcos (player), 2025-10-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155815#p155815) and Justgreens123 (above); versus Guiltyhaomarush's 450 DPS "as a Dark harvest affliction warlock" (2026-02-14) and the wiki rotation. Akarui's own earlier finding was the opposite before CC3 ("With Darkharvest, the DPS on the boss dummy was 5-10% more than if you just throw DoTs and spam Drain Soul. With the 1.18 update, a useful talent appeared in the Destro tree ... now ... 2-5% more without" — 2025-08-22). Bot rule: skip Dark Harvest on bosses unless you can guarantee an uninterrupted 8-s channel; always use it on a target about to die (cooldown resets on kill, staff 2025-03-30).
7. Otherwise: Drain Soul (highest rank). "Drain soul scales alot better at low levels" [Grizb37 (player), 2026-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174185#p174185); "drain soul is better than sb in every way as a filler" (Eversongwoods, 2025-02-03). Drain Soul ticks can apply Shadow Vulnerability (CC3).
8. Life Tap when mana is below the cost of your next cycle; never hard-cast Shadow Bolt.

**Ranks**: drop Drain Soul rank only while leveling for mana ("I've just been using rank 1 DS because of the mana difference compared to rank 2" [Snipesta (player), 2025-02-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119257#p119257)); at 60 the dynamic per-second cost makes partial channels cheap (CC3). Rank-1 Corruption is the accepted "reflect breaker" on Karazhan mobs: "You can use it as kara reflect breaker but in case you are nightfall - rank 1 corruption is better" [Ataika (player), 2025-07-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137857#p137857).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **2–3 targets (dungeon trash)**: "dot everything up, once it has good threat, so your dots can be ticking on mobs that arent focused (not just 1 mob at a time). Then drain soul spam on the main target, you do not use shadow bolt" (Grizb37, 2026-04-06). Cast a support curse on each target if you have Malediction (auto Curse of Agony), then Corruption on each, then drain the kill target. Curse of Agony "is end-loaded" so multi-dotting it "rarely pulls aggro" [Nahath (player), 2023-08-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=58725#p58725) (pre-CC2 tooltip; the ramp-up still exists — "the incremental damage of Curse of Agony ... makes this curse perform poorly on trash mobs", LastyK).
- **4+ targets**: Affliction has no AoE of its own; the class AoE is Rain of Fire / Hellfire. "for 3 or more trash mobs, it's AOE Rain of Fire or occasionally ... I will Hellfire the trash (make sure the healer is aware)" (Campy, 2025-03-04). Hellfire on Turtle: 1.18.1 made it cheap (R3 325 mana + 65/s) and 6.66% SP per tick, Wrathstone cuts its self-damage by 30% but adds 40% Fire threat (Dragunovi CC2; Jamey 1.18.1). Rain of Fire ticks every 1 s since CC3. Ask the tank first: "I always ask the tank/s if they mind AOE, most are cool with it as long as you give a few seconds to build threat" (Campy).
- Expect trash to die before DoTs pay off; the staff's own framing is that Affliction should "better keep up ... namely on trash encounters" after the Malediction change (Torta 2025-03-30), not lead it.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Mana**: Life Tap is the engine ("Life tap for affliction is very important in the rotation. And for this, you need a lot of HP" [Akarui (player), 2025-07-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137847#p137847)); Improved Life Tap 2/2 and Shadow Mastery both scale it. T3.5 3-set gives 25% (was 50%) of Siphon Life drain back as mana since 1.18.1. Felstone leech heals the Warlock and the demon. Dark Pact is gone — a player explains you cannot summon the Imp as a battery any more (Arthurice, 2025-09-02). Tea shares the Healthstone cooldown [Ataika (player), 2023-12-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=79754#p79754) — decide per fight whether the Healthstone or the tea is your emergency button.
- **Soul Shards**: stack to 3 since CC2; Drain Soul on anything that gives XP/honor yields a shard; bots should keep a capped count — "shardcap addon IS working. But since here on twow shards are stacking to 3, if you want to have max 9 shards in inventory, you need to set shardcap at 3" [Milenski (player), 2025-03-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124319#p124319); shard-deleting macros exist on the community wiki (Warlock Macros page) and in [Roxanneflowers (player), 2020-07-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=7011#p7011). Shards can be lost when the pet despawns on flight paths — "I'm pretty sure you have to dismiss your summoned pet first to get the soul shard back" [Drubarrymooer (player), 2025-08-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148976#p148976). Ritual of Souls costs 3 shards since 1.18.1. Soul Bags give a 5–25% chance not to consume a reagent (CC2).
- **Drinking**: the class rarely drinks at 60 — "it's possible to have infinite sustainability as a Warlock (especially as Affliction). It feels amazing to never have to eat/drink while leveling!" [Finarfin (player), 2024-01-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84947#p84947). Drink only when both health and mana are low after a Life Tap chain.
- **Dark Harvest** (30 s CD) — see rotation; reset on kill.
- **Shadow Ward** on shadow-casting bosses (Campy). **Death Coil** as a self-heal / emergency (3-min CD). **Drain Life** is a niche self-heal: "99% of the time you will not use it in PVE. Only in rare situatins when healers cannot heal you and Death Coil on CD" [Akarui (player), 2025-07-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140392#p140392); counter-view: "drain life is great with voidwalker or ... when your potion, tea and healthstone are on cd ... It also conveniently bypasses 50% healing debuff from infernal" [Sharmaine (player), 2025-07-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140405#p140405).
- **Class mount**: Dreadsteed costs mana and breaks the 5-second rule; raiders use another mount for repeated mounting ("If you care for performance you never use class mounts" [Atreidon (player), 2024-06-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=97966#p97966)) — contested by casual players who use it anyway.

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- **Curse duty**: two or more Warlocks split Curse of Shadow / Curse of the Elements / Curse of Recklessness; Malediction means each of them still gets a Curse of Agony. Old advice that Siphon Life is skipped in raids "because both damage and healing cause threat" [Atreidon (player), 2023-12-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=81272#p81272) predates the debuff-limit removal and the Soul Siphon talent and is obsolete for Affliction.
- **Threat**: Affliction "hasn`t crits and it is much easier to control the threat" (Akarui, 2025-07-18). Options if needed: Voidstone (−10% spell threat, learned at 52, CC3 revision), sacrificed Succubus (−10%), Paladin Salvation, and the TWThreat meter ("instal TWT treat meter, ask pala about salva" — Akarui). Succubus Soothing Kiss reduces only the Succubus's threat, not yours [Hctwowfan (player), 2025-07-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140401#p140401) — despite the Dec-2024 tooltip saying it reduces both; treat as contested/bugged.
- **Pet choice in raids**: Imp (Blood Pact for the party) if it can survive; otherwise Demonic Sacrifice. "I always take my Imp in Dungeons and Raids, Blood Pack buffs all" (Campy). Pets die to raid AoE despite Avoidance (80% AoE reduction, also cleave since 1.18.1); on Four Horsemen marks, Thaddius polarity and Sapphiron's ice they die regardless [Erhog (player), 2025-04-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126753#p126753). Use **Pet Command: Take Position** (CC3) to park the Imp out of AoE and behind the boss.
- **Movement fights**: DoTs and instant Curse of Agony are the mobile damage; Grim Reach (+range) is taken for this; do not start Dark Harvest before a knockback.
- **Dispel-heavy PvE** (none noted) and **PvP**: Resilient Shadows 15% is "only +15% dispell protection which doesnt do that much" (Grizb37, 2026-02-14). Affliction in PvP is **contested**: "in BG's all your dots will be instantly dispelled especially because every game has like 5+ paladins" (Grizb37) and "affliction is not very good" for PvP [Eversongwoods (player), 2025-02-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118995#p118995) versus "warlocks are OP in bg, they fucking melt people" [Terrydavis (player), 2026-02-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169469#p169469) and "Affliction, if played properly, is a complete neusance that is hard to reach, incredibly mobile as they can just dot and gtfo" [Mitzter (player), 2025-06-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135904#p135904). Affliction PvP relies on Curse of Exhaustion for kiting; after CC3 cut it to 40% total ("Fine for Destro to not have 50% CoEx, but Affliction deep spec needs it" [Halfgeek9 (player), 2025-08-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143162#p143162)) and 1.18.1 raised its cost, it is weaker again. See `destruction-pvp.md` for the PvP toolkit that is shared.

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **BiS list (post-1.18.1, player-compiled, K40 era)**: Nathrezim Crown / Amulet / Mantle / Raiments / Leggings / Boots (T3.5), Kum'isha's Tattered Drape, Bindings of Contained Magic, Plagueheart Handwraps, Memory of the Last Guardian, Plagueheart Signet, Ring of the Fallen God, The Restrained Essence of Sapphiron, Eye of Dormant Corruption, Desecration + Master Dragonslayer's Orb, Hellflame wand [5mman (player), 2026-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173650#p173650) — the author calls it "dated"; reply: "Atiesh better than that combo...rag choker better as well some argue than the t3.5 neck" [Springboards (player), 2026-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173657#p173657). Single source each.
- **Tier sets**: Affliction alternative sets exist for T1, T2, T2.5 (Doomcaller's alt), T3 (Plagueheart Attire) and T3.5 (Nathrezim) with haste instead of crit [Dragunovi (staff), 2023-10-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=71030#p71030). Complaints: Attire "has ~73 [less] stamina" than Raiment and 7% haste vs 7% crit + 1% hit [Justgreens123 (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156392#p156392); T2.5 Affliction 5-set summons a Doomguard that "doesn't fight at all" [Aeotald (player), 2026-01-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166386#p166386), replaces your demon and "exists 5-10 sec, deals 90 dmg" (Akarui, 2025-08-22) — players wear 4/5 to avoid it [Lavr (player), 2025-06-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137318#p137318). 1.18.1 set-bonus changes: T3 4-set Curse of Agony +100% first 4 ticks; T3.5 3-set 25% Siphon Life return (Jamey 2026-01-23; also [Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272)).
- **Pre-raid**: "Do Sunken Temple once while leveling for the Soul Harvester ... spam Stormwind Vaults ... get your bis trinket, wand and ring ... Do LBRS once as a 10 man raid to get the Eye of the Beast quest ... Green Felcloth and of shadow wrath armor is insanely good ... Farm gold instead of hunting for every pre raid bis piece, not slacking on consumables will make your raid leaders appreciate you" [Grubi450 (player), 2023-05-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=48162#p48162); "People sleep on +Shadow Wrath Greens" (Grizb37, 2026-04-06); Turtle item list from a Discord: items 51755, 65003, 83468, 60501, 60551, 83465, 60622 on database.turtlecraft.gg [Mustachiocat (player), 2023-05-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=45182#p45182); "pre-raid isn't all that important ... besides hit cap, maybe some fire/arcane resist pots" [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-07-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141507#p141507). Bloodvine was nerfed before Aug 2023 (thread title "Bloodvine is nerfed", [Pngu (player), 2023-08-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=56028#p56028)).
- **Class weapon**: 1.18.1 added a Warlock class-weapon quest chain starting in Timbermaw Hold, "similiarly to Benediction/Anathema" — "How you start these questlines, we'll leave to you to discover" [Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272). Nothing in the extracted forum describes the reward; gap.
- **Enchants** (community wiki Warlock page, not official): gloves Shadow Power, legs/head Hoodoo Hex or Arcanum of Focus, weapon Spell Power, bracer Spell Power, cloak Subtlety, shoulder Zandalar Signet of Mojo, rings/neck Arcane Emerald Gemstone, belt Dreamsteel Belt Buckle, chest/boots Enchanted Armor Kit. The ZG head/leg enchant gives Warlocks 18 SP + 10 Sta (mages get 1% hit) [Maladron (player), 2023-09-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=62052#p62052).
- **Consumables**: Flask of Supreme Power (LastyK's numbers), fire/arcane protection potions for the relevant raids (Bigsmerf), Greater Holy Protection vs Paladins in PvP ("300-500 hp buff vs paladins" [Erhog (player), 2023-11-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=78940#p78940)), Healthstone (Major) — shares the tea/potion cooldown; Felstone (3% leech) as the default personal stone for Affliction, Voidstone if threat is a problem. Potion of Quickness is worthless for a spec whose spells are instant or channelled [Daftpunkerlol88 (player), 2024-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107603#p107603).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes (what players criticize)
mistakes.markdown:
- Hard-casting Shadow Bolt as Affliction — "you do not use shadow bolt, it takes too long to wind up" (Grizb37); Nightfall procs only.
- Casting Dark Harvest into a knockback / AoE and losing the 30-s cooldown (LastyK's Naxx list).
- Not keeping Siphon Life up (Soul Siphon loses a stack); refreshing DoTs early "costs a GCD" each time and wastes mana [Yggd (player), 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115748#p115748).
- Using Curse of Agony instead of the assigned raid curse when you are the only Warlock — Malediction gives both, so never drop Curse of Shadow/Elements.
- Hellfire / Inferno in dungeons without warning: "I had LBRS with t2 warlock who was constantly dying because he spammed Inferno on every mob pack. We wiped like 6 times" (f2 Announcements, [Anonymous player, 2024](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=12931)) — Infernal and Felguard turn hostile when control ends and are "consider[ed] griefing if you have them in a city" [Boeuff (player), 2025-01-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115350#p115350).
- Pet on aggressive near a boss — the Imp pulled Kruul before the pull; "Sounds like it was set on aggressive" [Grizb37 (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165986#p165986). Keep pets passive/defensive on pulls.
- Wearing Attire for the set bonus while dying to AoE — pick stamina where the sets are poor (Kentorianx, Justgreens).
- Letting shards overflow the bags; not keeping a shard for Soulstone/Healthstone/pet re-summon ("there are times you can die simply because you don't have soul shards" [Forumdweller (player), 2025-05-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=129896#p129896)).
- Relying on Curse of Weakness — "you can safely throw this garbage out of the spell bar" (Akarui, 2025-07-02); "It doesnt stack with other attack speed slows" [Atreidon (player), 2025-04-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=127400#p127400). Consensus that it is a last-resort or reflect-breaker only.
