playbooks.title: Warlock — Destruction — PvP (Conflagrate / NF-Conflagrate)
playbooks.intro:
The battleground and Blood Ring burst build: deep Destruction (Conflagrate, Shadowburn, Pyroclasm, Improved Soul Fire) with Affliction points for Curse of Exhaustion and/or Nightfall. The Soul Link builds are in `demonology-pvp.md`; Affliction PvP is a contested side-note in `affliction-ranged-dps.md`. This file also holds the class-wide PvP toolkit notes (fear, Death Coil, pets, races) because the sources discuss them here.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). PvP-relevant kit revisions: CC2 (live 2024-11-01: Conflagrate no longer needs/consumes Immolate; Curse of Exhaustion 30% at row 3 for every spec), CC3 (live 2025-08-15: Curse of Exhaustion 10% base + Improved 15/30% at row 5; Spellstone on-use; Fel Concentration affects Fear), 1.18.1 (live 2026-03-20: curse costs, Curse of Tongues, dynamic PvP dampening).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: glass-cannon burst caster with the class's CC (Fear, Howl of Terror, Death Coil, Succubus Seduction) and, since CC2, a 36-yard slow.
- **Strengths (sources)**: "nf/conflag destro lock has some of the highest burst in the game" [Springboards (player), 2025-05-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=129967#p129967); "adding CoE to destro changed warlock to an absolute god mode ... coe vs warrior pre charge absolutely destroys them; shamans can literally do nothing in 1v1; even rogues aren't a problem anymore since you can trinket stun into coil+coe+dot" [Trinaxyo ("Zergursoul") (player), 2024-12-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=114434#p114434); "Warlock is insane, especially destro right now. It just has very high skill cap" [Rektoshrekto123 (player), 2024-12-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=114503#p114503); Soul Fire "already oneshots even geared players if it crits" [amanagor (player), 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115752#p115752); Pyroclasm stun on Conflagrate "every 10 sec if u lucky" [Majestik51 (player), 2023-11-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=78898#p78898).
- **Weaknesses (sources)**: "Glascannon at its best ... If left in a 1v1 conflag destro is IMO the worst of the speccs" [Tbcb (player), 2024-05-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=94745#p94745); "if u play with this spec ... maybe u survive 2 more sec cause of coex curse, then u dead ... if u wont play demo spec in all bgs u cant survive as lock above 4-5 sec" [Majestik51 (player), 2024-12-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=114496#p114496) (paraphrase location: COEX thread); no mana sustain ("destruction locks have no sustain your mana is gone after a couple of casts" [Vrankz (player), 2025-05-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=129960#p129960)); BM hunters hard-counter ("you have to kill the pet basically then go for the hunter" — Springboards); paladin-heavy Alliance teams cleanse everything ("with amount of paladins 24/7 crosdispelling and every mage/druid using Decursive addon ... locks should rely only on hardcasting" [Ataika (player), 2023-11-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=78566#p78566)).
- **Community standing**: **favored PvP spec for Horde since CC2** ("thats why 90% horde locks are conflagrate novadays" [Ataika (player), 2024-11-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108889#p108889); "For pvp the best spec now is deep destruction, sl demo is mid and affliction is not very good" [Eversongwoods (player), 2025-02-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118995#p118995)); **contested after CC3** cut Curse of Exhaustion for non-Affliction ("i use coex now after respeccing demo which is ABSURDLY LAUGHABLY stronger than destro with coex" [Forumdweller (player), 2025-06-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135863#p135863); "Fine for Destro to not have 50% CoEx, but Affliction deep spec needs it. Else everyone is going to be Soul Link on warlock" [Halfgeek9 (player), 2025-08-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143162#p143162)). Class-wide reputation: "Warlocks have been strong class in PvP in patch 1.18.0. It's players' fault they don't play their class properly" (1.18.1 notes thread, [player, 2025-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=22214)) vs "Warlocks kinda suck at PVP" [Manletow (player), 2024-11-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110522#p110522). Bots: play Conflagrate on Horde; on Alliance expect Will of the Forsaken and Fear Ward to blunt fear ("keep in mind on twow alliance gameplay is harder due to horde acess to fear ward" [Ataika (player), 2025-05-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130223#p130223)).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
- **Conflagration** (wiki, community): `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warlock?points=AoAAAAAAAAAAAAAoAAAAAAAAAAAAFAFYRoSEFIAoBAA%3D` — "High burst damage; leverages destructive spells ... Requires precise timing".
- **NF/Conflagration** (wiki): `...?points=AoSQIYSAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAFAFARoCAFIAoBAA%3D` — "Incorporates Nightfall procs ... but with reduced stamina".
- Ataika's description of the CC2 meta build: "Its default nf-conflagrate build from vanilla that became much more powerful due to new coex the build did not have acess to previously" [Ataika (player), 2024-12-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=114375#p114375) (COEX thread) — i.e. Affliction to Nightfall (with Curse of Exhaustion when it sat at row 3) + Destruction to Conflagrate. His talent-tree screenshot shows "default conflagrate stamina bot with 30 yards in affliction spells" (Grim Reach) [Ataika (player), 2025](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=16718).
- Named Destruction talents from the PvP posts: Conflagrate, Pyroclasm 2/2 (26% stun on Conflagrate/Soul Fire/RoF/Hellfire, per channel not per tick), Improved Soul Fire ("buff from improved soul Fire usually usefoul After seduction as opener" [Eledit (player), 2024-12-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=16718)), Shadowburn, Intensity, Devastation/Ruin, Aftermath (daze, contested value), Bane.
- Affliction side after CC3: Curse of Exhaustion (row 3, 10%) is still reachable but only worth it with the row-5 Improved talent, which forces 20+ Affliction points; Grim Reach; Nightfall 2/2; Suppression instead of Fel Concentration "for less resistance" [Eledit (player), 2024-12-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=16718).
- Patch validity: every "COEX destro" claim (Dec 2024 – Jul 2025) is **pre-CC3**; from 2025-08-15 a Destruction build has at most 10% (or 40% with 20+ Affliction points), and from 1.18.1 the curse costs 190 mana. The wiki links carry no date; treat as CC2-era.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- Stamina first ("PvP is not PvE, survivability is better than raw damage. So everyone stack on stamina until they reach some comfortable amount to not die instantly" [Xudo (player), 2024-11-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108896#p108896)), then Shadow/Fire spell damage ("of shadow wrath" greens are cheap: "Chest with +23 shadow spell damage costs 3g" — Xudo), crit for Soul Fire/Conflagrate one-shots; hit is less important than in PvE (level-60 targets). Vampirism items/Felstone for sustain (wiki list; "Now i see these 100 heals on mhy 3k crits" — Ataika on Felstone, 2025-04-18, i.e. it is small).
- PvP set: the epic Warlock PvP set has "0% crit" vs 2% on the blue set [player, 2024-11-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=15404) (itemization thread); "PvP gear in general is complete garbage" [Eversongwoods (player), 2024-11-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110392#p110392); the Immolate cast-time glove bonus is "Miniscule" [Frantsel (player), 2025-02-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120996#p120996) though it helps casting while moving [Erhog (player), 2025-02-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120921#p120921). T2.5/T3 raid gear dominates BGs ("It is extremely unfun to fight warlocks whose dots kill you regardless if they do nothing else", f2 Tel'Abim thread, [player, 2023](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=11128)).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Hard-casting Fear on a melee target ("it takes 6 seconds to cast it against melees" [Forumdweller (player), 2025-04-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=127471#p127471)); use Death Coil/Seduce first, Howl of Terror only with Fel Concentration.
- Immolate on a seduced target (breaks Seduction).
- Using the Dreadsteed in combat zones (interruptible, silence-able: "you can't cast like death coil in shadow school spell, this makes you a punchbag" [Sharders (player), 2024-11-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108612#p108612)).
- Running out of shards for Shadowburn/Soul Fire/pet ("there are times you can die simply because you don't have soul shards" — Forumdweller 2025-05-06).
- Wrong pet for the match-up ("their problem as always since classic, is having the wrong pet out vs the class you are fighting" [Halfgeek9 (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130398#p130398)); Fel Domination is a 5-min Demonology talent, not baseline.
- Spamming Curse of Exhaustion after 1.18.1 without watching mana (190 per cast; daleking0518's post-release complaint).
- Fighting Undead with Fear/Seduce as your only plan; assuming Spell Lock silences.

extraSections.heading: Official kit — PvP-relevant
extraSections.markdown:
- CC2: Conflagrate no longer consumes Immolate, 1-s GCD (Dragunovi 2024-10-12) — "now every autistic chimp is able to conflagrate its target" [Ataika (player), 2025-04-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=127315#p127315); "The weird thing in new patch is Congflag no more consumes Immo., which basiclly means you lose the Immo in PVP ,or you lose Charm" [Sharders (player), 2024-11-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108596#p108596) (Immolate ticks break Seduction). Curse of Exhaustion 30% at row 3, Improved Debilitating Curses +10/20% (so 50%). Soul Fire ranks from 30.
- CC3: Curse of Exhaustion 10% base, Improved +15/30% at row 5 ("too easily accessible by other specializations which provided them with oppressive levels of control. We're now making its full power only accessible to Affliction warlocks" [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159)) — Akarui computed the new maximum as 40% [Akarui (player), 2025-07-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=142150#p142150); Spellstone became an on-use magic dispel + absorb (level × 12) sharing the Healthstone cooldown; Fel Concentration 2 pts also prevents pushback on Fear/Howl; Power Overwhelming breaks pet CC; Soul Fire 114% SP.
- 1.18.1: Curse of Exhaustion 190 mana at 60 (from 110); Curse of Tongues R1 30% / R2 240 mana; Curse of Recklessness 1-s GCD "for the fear-juggling technique"; Felguard Axe Toss 2 s, Legion Strike −25% healing; Soul Link 20%; Enslave −50% healing; Searing Pain 2.0-s cast / 57% SP / +20% base; **PvP dampening** "will now have dynamic reductions of Magical and Physical damage based on your class / spec instead of a flat number" [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168) (per-spec values not published in the extract — gap).
- Long-running bug: Felhunter **Spell Lock** silence "never lasts 3 seconds as tooltip says, it looks like 1 second duration max" [Ataika (player), 2023-11-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=78130#p78130); still reported 2025-09-26 [Forumdweller (player)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153349#p153349) with bug-report IDs 6299/1556/1236/13512; one player thought it "stealth fixed" in May 2025 [Forumdweller (player), 2025-05-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132118#p132118). Contested/unresolved.
- Other bugs used against you: Dampen Magic halving DoT damage (bug 5631, [Paybacksz (player), 2024-03-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=91420#p91420)); demons stop chasing stealthed targets by design ("Turtle wow changed this bug for balance purposes" [Ataika (player), 2024-01-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84191#p84191)); Paranoia not detecting stealth [Lilith23 (player), 2024-02-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=87634#p87634).

extraSections.heading: Opener and priority (1v1 / small-scale)
extraSections.markdown:
Sources: Tbcb (Blood Ring), Twospooky, Trinaxyo, Delalama (vs Paladin), Springboards (vs BM hunter), Vrankz.

**Opener**: 1) Succubus Lesser Invisibility → Seduction on the target or the healer ("You start invis, getting a spell off. Fear, Immo, Soulfire probably into an instant cast" — Tbcb; "Seduce 1st target, fear 2nd target, nuke 3rd target" [Twospooky (player), 2024-12-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111151#p111151)). 2) Curse of Exhaustion (if talented) or Curse of Tongues on casters / Curse of Agony on a target that will not be dispelled. 3) Soul Fire (hard-cast on a seduced/feared target — "Improved Soul Fire ... After seduction as opener"). 4) Immolate → Conflagrate → Shadowburn.

**Priority**:
1. Target in Conflagrate range with Immolate up and Conflagrate ready → Conflagrate (Pyroclasm stun chance).
2. Target below ~500 health (Shadowburn rank 6 threshold in Ulukay's macro) or fleeing → Shadowburn.
3. Nightfall proc → Shadow Bolt (NF build).
4. Melee on you: Death Coil (3-min CD; "Death coil if they deal 2000 damage" — Twospooky) → back away → Fear (Fel Concentration helps pushback; against WotF/Fear Ward expect failure) → Curse of Exhaustion (talented) → re-establish range. "Death Coil, walk the opposite way with melee snares on you, they try to chase but slowed by 50% too so they can't" (Halfgeek9, pre-CC3 numbers).
5. Immolate missing → Immolate (breaks Seduction on that target — only on your kill target).
6. Soul Fire ready and target controlled → Soul Fire.
7. Filler: Searing Pain (1.5 s with Bane) — after 1.18.1 it "benefit[s] from haste effects" and hits ~20% harder; still resisted by pushback — "you cannot even cast searing pains its just better to use souldrain" (Vrankz, pre-1.18.1, contested).
8. Healthstone / Spellstone (shared CD; Spellstone dispels magic on you and absorbs level × 12), Holy Protection potion vs Paladins (Erhog), engineering grenades to land casts ("if you do not tryhard with grenades/absorbs/potions" [Ataika (player), 2024-12-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111182#p111182)).

**Match-ups**: Paladin — "use felhunter to eat HoJ then use felhunter silence to lock them out of holy casts. Once HoJ and Repentance are on CD, they're defenseless against fear" [Delalama (player), 2023-10-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=74709#p74709) (Spell Lock silence is bugged — see above); BM Hunter — kill the pet first (Springboards); Priest — Felhunter Devour Magic on autocast "can singlehandedly make you win ... perma dispel his renew and bubble" [Forumdweller (player), 2025-05-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130077#p130077); Rogue — "you have to kill the pet basically" logic reversed: "pray that some lame rogue isn't going to cheap shot kidney thistle tea evis sapper charge you when you have felhunter out" [Forumdweller (player), 2025-05-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=129896#p129896); Undead — WotF removes Fear and Seduction ("leaving only 2 minute control from deth coil" [Twinking (player), 2024-02-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=87488#p87488)).

extraSections.heading: Battlegrounds
extraSections.markdown:
- "Charge on the bridge -> Press my buttons -> Win/Lose" in Blood Ring (Tbcb); in BGs "you get focused by war/paladin ... and you die within 2 hits" [Konstantin19 (player), 2024-12-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111178#p111178). First goal to reach is to get warsong reputation and rank 5" (Xudo 2024-11-20) vs "for crispy caster, you should try BG in 59 maybe" [Sharders (player), 2024-11-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108871#p108871). sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown:
Sources are the Warlock forum's leveling threads ("Warlock leveling tips" t16295, "Warlock affliction leveling mini guide (PvE)" t23778, "Get Sick or Get Demons" t15119, "Warlock best race" t19168, "Macros for leveling" t13648, "Demonology leveling/raid spec" t18544, "Why Alliance lock is the least played class" t11525), the Hardcore Lounge profession thread ("First HC, profession advice" t4856), and the CC2 staff post (Dragunovi, 2024-10-12, `t15157` p=102973) for baseline spell numbers. All dates UTC; eras as in the other Warlock files: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20).

No Turtle-specific leveling guide thread predates CC2 usefully: the oldest detailed build post in the forum (`t1188`, 2020, "Drain Soul Linked Spirit 15/31/5") uses talents removed or reworked by CC2 (Improved Healthstone, Improved Imp/Voidwalker/Succubus, Improved Enslave Demon, old Demonic Sacrifice) — **obsolete, not used below**. Two direct requests for a Turtle-specific DoT-leveling guide (`t10372`, 2023) were answered only with links to non-Turtle sites (icy-veins, warcrafttavern) — not a Turtle source, not used.

sections.heading: Which spec
sections.markdown:
**Consensus: Affliction is the default leveling spec; Demonology is the safer/tankier alternative, especially for Hardcore; Destruction is not recommended.**

- "the main difference between Affliction and Demonology for leveling is that one is good and the other is bad. Affliction gives you a lot of tools for leveling that will make your life easier. In contrast demonology gives you very little" — [Zulnam (player), 2024-10-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102810#p102810).
- "affliction is definitely better for leveling if you play it right. Demo is better for soloing elites and the better choice for hardcore as it is more survivable, being able to quick summon your demon is a life saver ... With affliction you can multi dot and drain tank a mob yourself while your void is dealing with another" — [Eversongwoods (player), 2024-10-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102794#p102794).
- "Leveling build depending on gear available for you. Affli is faster with decent items (alt or you have friends to backup or smth) while demo is safe and solid way to leveling even without any items. Destro is the worst." — [Erhog (player), 2025-03-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121852#p121852).
- "The general rule is Affli/Demo mixes are best for leveling ... The best vanilla spec to level for warlock is called 'Drain Tanking' and it assumes going deep into Affli ... With the new changes and faster ticks from Affli I imagine drain tanking would be even stronger now for leveling" — [Zulnam (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118801#p118801) (build link below).
- Contested detail on threat talents: "Personally I don't think you need Nether Studies. This is a new talent and lock had no issues with threat on their VW even before this" — [Zulnam (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118801#p118801) vs "Aim for nether studies ... This talent is important because it allows your void to keep agro pretty well" — [Ataika (player), 2024-12-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=114546#p114546).
- Demonology's endgame value is separately contested (raid/PvP viability) — see `demonology-ranged-dps.md` and `demonology-pvp.md`; while leveling, sources treat it only as a survivability/tanky pick, not a damage pick.
- Bots: default to Affliction; switch to (or blend in) Demonology for Hardcore or when soloing elites.

sections.heading: Talent point order by level 10–60
sections.markdown:
**Primary build — Affliction leveling (PvE), from a "Warlock affliction leveling mini guide" cross-posted from Reddit** — [Nuninho32 (player), quoting a guide "made by chappelles", 2026-01-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166748#p166748), 1.18.1-announced-pre-release, written against the **1.18.0 (CC3) talent tree** (link is to `talent-builder.haaxor1689.dev/c/1.18.0/warlock`). No source updates this order for 1.18.1's live curse/Searing Pain/Hellfire numbers, but those changes do not touch the talents this build takes, so it is treated as **still valid post-1.18.1** (not respecced away from by any source).

Build link: `https://talent-builder.haaxor1689.dev/c/1.18.0/warlock?points=EoASCASDJBFAB-AoD-F`

| Levels | Talent |
|---|---|
| 10–14 | Improved Corruption 5/5 |
| 15–17 | Suppression 3/5 |
| 18–19 | Improved Life Tap 2/2 (or interleave with Suppression — author's note: "I prefer the hit chance first but you can easily do lifetap before suppression, or, 2 points suppression → 2 points life tap → 1 point suppression") |
| 20–21 | Fel Concentration 2/2 |
| 22–23 | Improved Drains 2/2 |
| 24 | Suppression 4/5 **or** Improved Curse of Agony 1/3 — "if you plan to PvP I would definitely take curse of exhaustion 1/1" instead |
| 25 | Nightfall 1/2 |
| 26–28 | Soul Siphon 3/3 |
| 29 | Nightfall 2/2 |
| 30 | Malediction 1/1 ("if you plan to PvP, I would take improved curse of exhaustion around these levels" instead) |
| 31 | Siphon Life 1/1 (interchangeable with the previous pick; author found it "overkill for most mobs" — corruption + agony + drains already kills, so Siphon Life is "mana wasteful", contested/YMMV) |
| 32 | Rapid Deterioration 1/2 |
| 33–34 | Grim Reach 2/2 |
| 35–39 | Shadow Mastery 5/5 |
| 40 | Dark Harvest 1/1 |
| 41–45 | Shadow Vulnerability (Destruction tree) |
| 46–50 | Demonic Embrace 5/5 (Demonology tree) |
| 51–53 | Demonic Aegis (Demonology tree) |
| 54–60 | Free — author's suggested options: Master Conjurer, Improved Curse of Agony, finishing Suppression, Curse of Exhaustion + Improved Curse of Exhaustion, finishing Rapid Deterioration, Shadowburn, Fel Domination, Fel Stamina |

Source: [Nuninho32/chappelles, 2026-01-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166748#p166748).

**Alternative — CC2-era Affliction "no-Nightfall" order**, single source: "If you just stay affliction all the way with no pts in demo you can get siphon life, malediction and soul siphon talents followed by shadow mastery and then can just melt everything by the time you are lvl 40 ... I wouldnt bother with nightfall or ever cast a shadowbolt while leveling ... Use SL, Agony, Curse of Shadows, Corruption and either drain soul or dot up the next target." — [Eversongwoods (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118780#p118780). Opening priorities: "5/5 corruption, 5/5 suppression, 2/2 lifetap, 2/2 improved drains" then branch into Demonology or stay Affliction — [Eversongwoods (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118774#p118774).

**Alternative — beginner Affliction/Destruction build**, single source, no level breakdown given (opaque talent-calculator link `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warlock?points=FoASFYSARIAAAAAoTAAoAbAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=`), guidance: "Start with affliction, prioritise imp corruption, imp drains and fel concentration ... The general rule is Affli/Demo mixes are best for leveling, but if you know what you're doing you can easily go 11 points into destruction as well for Shadowburn." Also links the original vanilla "Drain Tanking" build (external Google Drive PDF, not fetchable/verifiable from these sources) — [Zulnam (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118801#p118801).

**Demonology hybrid — Demonic Sacrifice self-heal build (CC2/CC3 era, before Demonic Sacrifice moved and was reworked)**: "the tier 3 demonology talent Demonic Sacrifice ... sacrificing the voidwalker is actually incredibly good while leveling. You get a buff that heals for 3% every 5 seconds ... I can easily pull 2 or 3 mobs at a time, dot them all up, tank all the damage while wanding them down ... if you need to solo an elite you can just summon voidwalker, have it tank until its about to die, and then sacrifice it anyway to get the hp regen buff" — [Browntown22 (player), 2025-03-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121816#p121816), build link `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warlock?points=DoASAYBAAAAAAAAjDAABAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=`, planning to finish the Affliction tree. Countered: "The void sac buff is not exactly optimal for leveling but whatever works, i use it for farming sometimes. You should spec into fel concentration asap though it would make things a lot smoother." — [Eversongwoods (player), 2025-03-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121836#p121836). **Single source for the strategy, contested value**; note CC3 (2025-07-25) moved Demonic Sacrifice higher in the tree with a new prerequisite (see `synthesis/1.18.1-master-changelog.md` and the CC2/CC3 kit notes in `demonology-ranged-dps.md`), so the exact talent position in this 2025-03 link may no longer match the live tree — treat the level (row) as **outdated**, the strategy (sacrifice for HoT while leveling) as still reported workable.

**Respec points**: no source gives a single canonical respec level. Inferred from the above: players who level Affliction stay Affliction to 60 (Nuninho32/chappelles build has no respec built in); players who want Demonology's survivability go "12 pts affliction ... then go 8 into demo for the stamina and void talent" as a permanent split rather than a respec — [Erhog quoting the older "Get Sick or Get Demons" thread pattern](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102794#p102794) (Eversongwoods). No source reports respeccing specifically at a named level (contrast with the Paladin guide's "respec at 30"); this is a **gap**.

sections.heading: Skill training priority
sections.markdown:
- **Drain Soul** was reworked in CC2 into the class's core leveling/soloing tool: "Drains the soul of the target, causing X Shadow damage over 6 sec ... dealt slowly at first, and builds up ... If the target dies while being drained ... the caster gains a Soul Shard." Damage: R1 (10) 110, R2 (24) 280, R3 (38) 460, R4 (52) 760, R5 (60, new rank) 950, each tick 16.67% SP scaling. Mana: R1 55→90, R2 125→235, R3 210→405, R4 290→540, R5 655 — [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102973#p102973). Train every rank; it is a primary rotation piece in both leveling guides above ("drain soul/drain life/dark harvest on tougher mobs" — Nuninho32/chappelles).
- **Soul Fire**: gained two new early ranks and shifted level requirements — R1 (30) 175 mana / 453–571 dmg, R2 (38) 260 mana / 544–685, R3 (46, was 48) 305 mana / 623–784, R4 (54, was 56) 335 mana / 703–883; scales 125% of Spell Power; cooldown cut from 60 s to 30 s — [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102973#p102973). Train current ranks (the old rank levels moved).
- **Corruption**: baseline cast time cut from 2 s to 1.5 s (and further to instant at 5/5 Improved Corruption) — same source. Train Improved Corruption first per both leveling talent orders above.
- **Curse of Weakness**: reworked to a single rank, −15% attack speed instead of a flat damage reduction — same source; do not waste gold on multiple ranks (only one exists).
- **Searing Pain**: lost its threat-generation penalty in CC2 ("compensated by the new Wrathstone") and later (1.18.1) had its cast time raised to 2.0 s / 57% SP scaling / +20% base damage (see `synthesis/1.18.1-master-changelog.md` and `destruction-fire-ranged-dps.md`); no leveling source names it as a core leveling spell — used mainly by Fire/Destruction-leaning levelers.
- **Wand**: "up to lvl 40, your best damaging spell is wand. You don't need to spend mana on shadowbolts if your wand has better DPS and don't suffer pushback from mobs." — [Xudo (player), 2024-10-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102809#p102809). Train and upgrade it; the affliction leveling guide explicitly slots "wand" into the kill sequence for essential-spell newcomers — [funeh (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118779#p118779).
- **Shadow Bolt**: skippable while leveling Affliction per Eversongwoods above ("I wouldnt bother with nightfall or ever cast a shadowbolt while leveling, could save some gold and not train it"), but used as a Nightfall-proc filler in the primary 1.18.1-announced build and by at least one player at 32 ("I usually start my rotation with agony, immolation, corruption, wand, sometimes shadowbolt" — [Snipesta (player), 2025-02-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119257#p119257)). **Contested** whether to train it early.
- **Drain Soul rank choice**: "I've just been using rank 1 DS because of the mana difference compared to rank 2 ... I also have warmode enabled so, when im versing the opposite faction I always use rank 2 because it does a shitload of damage." — [Snipesta (player), 2025-02-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119257#p119257) — rank-down for mana efficiency in pure PvE, keep the top rank trained for PvP/warmode.
- **Voidwalker abilities**: "The most important vw ability is torment, make sure to get the new books when available and have it right-clicked so he auto uses it." — [Eversongwoods (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118780#p118780). Voidwalker threat scaling is stepped: "the voidwalker threat ability upgrades every ten levels (10, 20, etc) so it might be decent at holding threat when it gets a new rank and terrible at levels 17-19, 27-29, etc" — [chappelles/Nuninho32, 2026-01-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166748#p166748) (compared to Hunter pet Growl by the same author). No source gives a full Voidwalker/Imp/Succubus ability list with levels — **gap**.

sections.heading: Leveling playstyle
sections.markdown:
- **Pulling / mobs at once**: "Warlocks can relatively easily 'juggle' 2-3 mobs at a time; applying DoTs on all mobs, fearing one mob, tanking the second, pet handling the third. Keep in mind that with the changes to fel concentration, AoE fearing with howl of terror would be much easier." — [chappelles/Nuninho32, 2026-01-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166748#p166748). Demonic Sacrifice build pulls similarly: "I can easily pull 2 or 3 mobs at a time, dot them all up, tank all the damage while wanding them down, and then go do it again and be full hp by the time I reach the new mobs" — [Browntown22 (player), 2025-03-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121816#p121816).
- **Kill rotation (Affliction)**: "Corruption → curse of agony → drain soul/drain life/dark harvest (on tougher mobs) → shadow bolt whenever you get a nightfall proc." — [chappelles/Nuninho32, 2026-01-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166748#p166748). A tested variant at level 32: "agony, immolation, corruption, wand, sometimes shadowbolt but mostly wand then end it with drain soul" — [Snipesta (player), 2025-02-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119257#p119257). A newcomer's loop: "Agony, corruption, inmolation and then either wand or shadowbolt" — [funeh (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118779#p118779).
- **Drain tanking**: a named vanilla-derived Affliction technique — "The best vanilla spec to level for warlock is called 'Drain Tanking' and it assumes going deep into Affli. ... With the new changes and faster ticks from Affli I imagine drain tanking would be even stronger now for leveling." — [Zulnam (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118801#p118801). No source gives its exact talent list on the current tree (the linked PDF pre-dates CC2/CC3 and cannot be verified from the extract) — **gap**.
- **Demonic Sacrifice tanking loop (Demonology, contested niche)**: see build section above; described as letting you "just wand them down" while immune to death from small pulls, at the cost of pet DPS.
- **Downtime**: no dedicated Warlock-forum post on mana management while leveling beyond the talent notes above (Fel Concentration for uninterrupted drains, Improved Life Tap for mana-from-health efficiency, Improved Drains for extra Drain Mana return). Life Tap is implied as the default filler ("used ... instead of just Life Tap" is how the removed Dark Pact community-feedback thread frames the CC2-era mana loop — see `demonology-*` files) but no leveling-specific quote gives explicit HP/mana thresholds — **gap**.
- **Macros**: no Turtle-specific one-button leveling macro was produced in the sources; the thread that asked was answered only with links to Nostalrius-forum vanilla macros and a suggestion to use the "roid macros" addon: "1) pet attack 2) dots 3) siphon life. if u got roid macros addon, is not that hard to put them all together in 1 cast." — [Majestik51 (player), 2024-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=94513#p94513). Treat any specific macro syntax as **not from turtlecraft.gg**.

sections.heading: Stat priority while leveling
sections.markdown:
- "stam > int > shadow or spell power. Spirit isn't bad at low levels, under 20." — [Eversongwoods (player), 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118806#p118806).
- On trading Spirit for Stamina: "trading spirit for stamina is not really viable if you have low attributes overall. Also I suspect that this talent works only for *base* stats, not for improved with gear." — [Xudo (player), 2024-10-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102809#p102809) (referring to the Demonic Embrace-style Spirit→Stamina conversion talent).
- Affliction's kit is argued to matter more than raw stats at low level: "reduce enemy chance to resist your spells, refund mana after kill, slow curse (almost every elite can be killed by kiting)" — same Xudo post — and "up to lvl 40, your best damaging spell is wand ... don't suffer pushback from mobs", so hit/pushback resistance on gear is not chased as hard as at 60.
- No source gives numeric hit-cap or resist-cap targets for leveling (contrast the 60 stat-priority sections in the role playbooks); this is a **gap**.

sections.heading: Key gear upgrades
sections.markdown: No Warlock-forum thread gives a leveling item list (the "Gear guide for new 60?" thread, `t15091`, got no reply at all). Do not invent a list; bots should fall back to general upgrade heuristics (spell damage / stamina / intellect on cloth, fast off-hand/wand) already used in the rotations above, and to the pre-raid BiS sections of the spec/role playbooks once at 60. **Gap.**

sections.heading: Professions
sections.markdown:
No profession advice exists in the Warlock forum itself; the only sourced guidance is from the Hardcore Lounge, but its reasoning (survivability, soloing) generalizes to any Warlock who wants a self-sufficient leveling profession pair:

- "there are a lot of people that fall into think either alch/herb or engi/mining are the ideal HC professions ... As a warlock, I chose alchemy. This is because they don't have sprint or other great escape mechanisms, so a swiftness potion is always appreciated. Troll blood elixirs when combined with demon armor provides a bunch of health regeneration ... Engineering bombs would take time away from casting, so they wouldn't be very useful. Target dummies are ok, but warlocks already have pets to help manage agro as needed." Alchemy is also self-sufficient for a solo player, unlike Enchanting (needs a rod, and Uldaman for high-level recipes) or Engineering (needs leather from Leatherworkers/Skinners) — [Gladeshadow (player), 2022-11-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=29282#p29282).
- Correction/contested: "Troll's blood does not stack with Demon Armor. Demon Armor is better and whether you have a troll's blood on you or not is irrelevant ... The only really good utility pot that the warlock needs from alchemy (imo) is swiftness pot. You can get 2-3 stacks of those in your teens and just keep them and use them when needed, not all the time. They will last you till 60." — [Shamma (player), 2022-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=29285#p29285), disputed back by Gladeshadow citing (non-Turtle) Wowhead comments — [Gladeshadow (player), 2022-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=29340#p29340) — **contested, unresolved in the sources**.
- Trading for potions instead of leveling Alchemy yourself is reported impractical while solo: "it becomes increasingly improbable as you level up ... When I was in the 50 range, I knew 2 alchemists in my trading range ... never traded." — [Gladeshadow (player), 2022-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=29283#p29283).
- This is a general Hardcore-oriented, single-thread recommendation, not Warlock-forum consensus; no source discusses Tailoring/Enchanting, Herbalism/Alchemy tradeskill synergy with Warlock bag space, or profession choice for non-Hardcore leveling specifically — partial **gap**.

sections.heading: Race
sections.markdown:
No Warlock-forum thread evaluates race choice for leveling specifically; the closest sources discuss endgame PvE/PvP race choice (full detail in `destruction-pvp.md`'s Races section) plus two one-line leveling-adjacent remarks:

- "PVE warlocks and mages go gnome or troll(mage)" — [Veeco (player), 2023-11-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=76294#p76294), in a thread about racial power gaps.
- "Troll is actually the best Warlock race for PVE with Berserking and Regeneration alone" — [Kerenis (player), 2025-09-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150221#p150221) — **contested** against the Gnome recommendation above and against Ataika's PvP-oriented endgame race notes (Undead/Troll for Horde, Gnome for Alliance PvP) in `destruction-pvp.md`.
- For Alliance specifically, the "not play alliance" framing recurs in the Warlock forum's endgame threads (`destruction-pvp.md`) and is echoed for race choice generally: "racials are irrelevant, the key is to just not play alliance" — [Forumdweller (player), 2025-05-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130216#p130216) — a PvP-framed opinion, not evaluated for pure leveling/PvE.
- Dwarf Warlock (new 1.18.1 Alliance combination) has no leveling or endgame evaluation anywhere in the sources — **gap** (see README).
- No source evaluates Human, Orc, or Undead specifically for Warlock leveling speed/efficiency (only for level-60 PvP, in `destruction-pvp.md`) — **gap**.

sections.heading: Route
sections.markdown: No Warlock-forum source gives a zone-by-zone leveling route, a dungeon-per-bracket list, or named questing zones for either faction. The only zone names appearing anywhere near a Warlock-leveling context are in the 2020 pre-CC2 build thread (`t1188`, "clearing the Scarlet Monastery and Razorfen Downs" as a level-40ish milestone) — too old and non-specific to use as a route (SM/RFD are general Horde/Alliance dungeon staples, not a Warlock-specific pick, and the thread's talents are obsolete). **Gap — no route.**

sections.heading: Hardcore-mode differences
sections.markdown:
- Demonology is the spec sources recommend for Hardcore specifically: "Demo is better for soloing elites and the better choice for hardcore as it is more survivable, being able to quick summon your demon is a life saver." — [Eversongwoods (player), 2024-10-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102794#p102794). No opposing Hardcore-specific view is present (the general Affliction-favoring posts above are not framed for Hardcore).
- Profession pairing for Hardcore: Alchemy over Engineering or Tailoring/Enchanting, argued from survivability and solo self-sufficiency — see Professions section above (Gladeshadow/Shamma, `t4856`, Hardcore Lounge forum). Engineering is dismissed for Warlock specifically because "Engineering bombs would take time away from casting ... Target dummies are ok, but warlocks already have pets to help manage agro as needed" — [Gladeshadow (player), 2022-11-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=29282#p29282).
- Demonic Sacrifice's self-heal loop (Browntown22, above) is framed for general safety/tankiness while leveling, not Hardcore explicitly, but its "being pretty much immortal" framing (his words) makes it a plausible Hardcore pick — not confirmed by any Hardcore-specific post; treat as **inference, not sourced for Hardcore**.
- No source discusses Hardcore-specific Warlock risks (e.g., demon control loss, Ritual of Doom's revision history, Enslave Demon resist chains) or names avoid-lists for Hardcore Warlocks. **Gap.**

patchChanges:
**Base post (2026-01-23):** Curse of Exhaustion mana 8%→14% base (110→190 at 60); Curse of Tongues R1 cast-speed reduction 50%→30%, R2 mana 110→240; Enslave Demon now −50% healing taken by the enslaved demon (shifted off Master Demonologist); Ritual of Doom initial cast 5→7 s, channel 5→3 s; Felhunter/Infernal armor −30% (≈5% less physical mitigation); Felguard Legion Strike healing reduction 10%→25%, Axe Toss stun 4 s→2 s; Searing Pain GCD 1.5 s→1 s; Hellfire SP scaling 2.2%→4.125%/tick, mana changed to a lower up-front cost + per-second channel cost (R1 645→160+30/s, R2 975→240+50/s, R3 1300→325+65/s); Ritual of Souls shard cost 1→3; Soulwell new model; Curse of Recklessness GCD 1.5 s→1 s; **Affliction** — Sinister Pursuit moved to Demonology as a 2-point pet-speed talent, Master Conjuror removed; **Demonology** — Master Summoner also cuts Ritual of Doom cooldown 25/50%, Master Demonologist loses the Greater-Demon healing reduction, Unleashed Potential gets a tracking buff, Soul Link transfer 25%→20%; **Tier bonuses** — Affliction T3 (4-set) Curse of Agony +100% first 4 ticks, Affliction T3.5 (3-set) Siphon Life mana/health return 50%→25%.

**Revision, 26 January 2026:** Ritual of Doom cast 3 s / channel 2 s / 1 summoner (final); Demon Gate Felguard spawn delay 6→4 s; Hellfire SP scaling raised to 6.66% (final); Searing Pain base cast 1.5→2.0 s, SP scaling to 57%; Bane also cuts Searing Pain cast time 0.1–0.5 s; Unleashed Potential procs on any direct damage, not only crits; Avoidance's AoE reduction also covers cleave damage; Curse of Shadow / Curse of the Elements GCD 1.5→1 s.

**Revision, 19 March 2026:** Searing Pain base damage for all ranks +~20%.

**Hotfixes (post-1.18.1):** Abolish Poison/Disease castable on demon pets (Torta, p=172139); Soul Entrapment no longer boosts damage while controlling a Greater Demon (Torta, p=173490); Demonic Sacrifice usable on Hardcore again (Torta, p=176101). **Unresolved player report:** Affliction mana-cost increases (Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues R2) prompted a post-release revert request (daleking0518, 2026-03-22) with no staff reply in the extract.

**New race/class combination:** **Dwarf Warlock** — "Bronzebeard dwarves practicing demonology in a secret coven within Ironforge"; announced 2025-10-03 (Torta p=154168), added to the first post 2025-10-23 (Torta p=156748). No mechanical racial difference is stated anywhere in the sources beyond the standard Dwarf racials (vanilla baseline, not from turtlecraft.gg) — see Gaps.

caveats: No source gives a complete slot-by-slot raid-tier BiS list for any Warlock spec — only a single player's flat, unordered gear list (5mman's post, called "dated" by its own author), tier-set bonus text, and scattered named items. Forum threads that directly asked for a BiS list (`t6834`, `t20477`, `t15091`, `t22994`) mostly got "there's pretty much no need" or a dead Google-Sheets link back, not an answer.

`leveling.md` states explicitly that no Warlock-forum thread gives a leveling item list (a thread asking, `t15091`, got zero replies) — bots should fall back to general upgrade heuristics, not an invented list.

Item IDs are almost never given; where a forum post does give a database.turtlecraft.gg item link (Mustachiocat's 2023 list) the item names were not stated by the poster, only the numeric IDs and a one-word source tag.

name: Druid
summary: Written 2026-09-10 from the Druid forum (f=42, 225 threads / ~2,060 posts, extraction fetched 2026-09-10), the Class Changes 2 staff posts (2024-10-12, in `extracted/forum/f63-patch-notes-changelog/t15157-*.md`), the 1.18.1 class-changes post (p=166071, dated 2026-01-23 with revision blocks 2026-01-26 and 2026-03-19), `synthesis/1.18.1-master-changelog.md`, `synthesis/turtle-vs-vanilla-timeline.md`, `structured/patches/1.18.1-changes.yaml`, and the community wiki (Druid, Druid Bear/Cat/Caster Macros). Conventions: `synthesis/CONVENTIONS.md`.

readme.heading: Files
readme.markdown:
| File | Content | Source quality |
|---|---|---|
| `feral-tank.md` / `structured/classes/druid/feral-tank.yaml` | Bear/Dire Bear tank for dungeons and raids | **strong** on stat priority/mechanics (many detailed threads across 2023-2026), **medium** on the current (post-1.18.1) talent build (link-only, no decoded point list), **weak-medium, single-detailed-source** on post-1.18.1 standing |
| `feral-melee-dps.md` / `feral-melee-dps.yaml` | Cat DPS: powershift build vs. bleed/claw build, and how/when to switch | **strong** on rotation mechanics and the powershift-vs-bleed evolution (extensively argued, dozens of posts across 8+ threads spanning Oct 2024–Jun 2025), **medium** on gear/consumables, **weak, single-source** on exact post-1.18.1 item-dev complaints |
| `feral-pvp.md` / `feral-pvp.yaml` | Cat/Bear PvP toolkit | **weak**: the only full build link is pre-Class-Changes-2 and superseded; standing is argued from two contested single-author threads three years apart |

| `balance-pvp.md` / `balance-pvp.yaml` | Moonkin dot-kite PvP build | **medium**: one dedicated build/tactics thread plus standing complaints scattered across the general threads; no post-1.18.1 PvP-specific re-test found |
| `restoration-healer.md` / `restoration-healer.yaml` | Tree of Life/HoT build vs. Moonglow/Healing Touch build | **medium**: two build philosophies each documented by a handful of threads with build links but no full decoded point list, downranking rule of thumb is well-sourced |
| `restoration-pvp.md` / `restoration-pvp.yaml` | Battleground/arena survival, especially vs. Rogues | **strong** on the central Rogue-survival topic (one 31-post thread, extensively discussed and internally consistent), **weak** on anything beyond that matchup |
| `leveling.md` | Build order, race choice, skill training, playstyle, stats/gear, hardcore differences | **medium**: strong consensus on the Feral-favored / Balance-viable / hybrid-tank-for-HC framing and on-level talent-order anchors; **weak-to-no source** on a zone-by-zone route or a full skill-rank-skip table (gap, matching the paladin playbook's finding) |

readme.heading: Spec × role coverage
readme.markdown:
| Spec | Tank | Healer | Melee DPS | Ranged DPS | PvP | Leveling |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Feral | **strong** (playbook) | weak (hybrid tank/heal builds mentioned only in passing, no dedicated healer playbook — Feral is not a healing spec) | **strong** (playbook) | — | weak (playbook, contested/superseded build) | strong (dominant leveling recommendation) |
| Balance | none | weak (Balance-as-dungeon-healer mentioned only as a flex option, not a dedicated build) | — | **strong** (playbook) | medium (playbook) | medium (viable alternative, well-documented playstyle) |
| Restoration | — | **medium** (playbook) | — | — | strong on one matchup, weak elsewhere (playbook) | weak (HC-only steer toward tanking instead; Resto leveling not separately documented) |

Note: unlike the paladin's three specs mapping cleanly to tank/healer/DPS, Druid's four specs (Balance/Feral/Restoration, with Feral covering both tank and melee-DPS roles) is the class's defining hybrid structure — see the "hybrid identity" debate documented in `feral-melee-dps.md` and `feral-tank.md`.

readme.heading: Official 1.18.1 Druid changes used (Jamey p166071, 2026-01-23; revisions 2026-01-26 and 2026-03-19; hotfixes Torta p171608/p172139/p173490)
readme.markdown:
**General**: Maul threat modifier −15%, Savage Bite threat modifier −12% ("Feral Bears have been overly prominent in their threat output, leaving little room for other tanks to shine" — dev comment).

**Balance**: Balance of All Things reduced from 5 to 3 points and reworked (Wrath vs. Insect-Swarm'd target refunds 10/20/30% mana; Starfire vs. Moonfire'd target gains +2/4/6% crit chance, revised 2026-01-26 to +3/6/9%); Moonfury increased to 4/8/12% (2026-01-26 revision); Eclipse proc mechanism changed (2026-03-19 revision): "Damage from Wrath now has a 40% chance and Damage from Starfire now has a 60% chance to proc their beneficial effects" (superseding the 1.18.0-era 30%/50% chance mechanism documented in `synthesis/turtle-vs-vanilla-timeline.md`).

**Hotfixes (post-release, dated 2026-03-21 through 03-31)**: Pollen Burst healing scales with 25% pet AP (class attribution unclear — may be a Hunter-pet ability, not confirmed Druid); Fang of Alichos usable in shapeshift forms; Yoxtez gained +224 Feral Attack Power; Elune Infusion trigger bug fixed; Glyph of the Moon visual corrected (was causing Night Elf Balance druids in Moonkin Form to render as "a tiny cow" per player report).

**No changes shipped in 1.18.1 to**: Feral Combat talents/abilities directly (Cat or Bear, beyond the Maul/Savage Bite threat-modifier nerf above), Restoration talents/abilities, or the Druid talent trees' overall shape.

readme.heading: Gaps (not covered by any source — do not guess)
readme.markdown:
1. **Full point-by-point 60 builds for every spec/role**: every build cited is a talents.turtlecraft.gg calculator link that cannot be decoded from text, matching the same limitation found in the paladin playbook. Only leveling-order anchors and named "mandatory" talents are enumerated.
2. **Pre-raid BiS lists** for all four specs/roles on current itemization — no source gives one; players are repeatedly pointed to the Discord druid channel or community Google Sheets/gear-planner links (linked from the wiki, unverified against staff data).
3. **A full skill-training-rank-skip table** and **a zone-by-zone leveling route with dungeon-per-bracket list** — not found anywhere in the sources read.
4. **Post-1.18.1 quantitative re-verification**: almost every post-1.18.1 claim about spec standing (Bear tanking, Cat/Moonkin DPS rankings, Resto healing) comes from one or two detailed players (chiefly Noephix) with agreeing short replies, not independently repeated log analysis. Treat all "post-1.18.1 X is now worst/best" claims in these playbooks as **single-source, directionally likely but numerically unverified**.
5. **Exact post-1.18.1 Eclipse damage-bonus formula**: the proc-*chance* change (40%/60%) is official and quoted verbatim; whether the *bonus magnitude* (the 1.18.0-era "10% + 60% of spell crit" formula) also changed in 1.18.1 is not stated in the sources read.
6. **Crit-immunity/crush-cap Defense values for Bear tanks** on Turtle — no source gives a druid-specific number (the paladin playbook's 440/420 figure is explicitly a vanilla-baseline number for a shield tank and does not transfer).
7. **A named list of the current pre-raid-BiS or T3.5-tier armor-ignoring trinket** referenced as nerfed for Feral in 1.18.1 — players discuss its nerf without naming the item.
8. **Restoration-specific consumables and a numeric Healing Power/Intellect stat weight** — inferred from the shared caster consumable list (see `balance-ranged-dps.md`) but not independently confirmed for Restoration.
9. **Arena-specific PvP guidance** for Balance and Feral (only Restoration's arena difficulty is documented in any depth, via the Rogue-survival thread).
10. **A conclusive verdict on the "third, deep-Resto-without-Tree-or-Moonglow" build** floated in `restoration-healer.md` — flagged as promising by one poster with no follow-up confirmation found.
11. **Twink/leveling-specific gear lists** (e.g. the "49 Balance Druid" twink thread, t16360) exist but were not read in depth for these playbooks.
12. **Whether the "Devs hate Druids" community sentiment reflects actual relative underperformance or a vocal-minority perception** — sources are heavily weighted toward complaint threads by a small recurring set of authors (Noephix, Fugus, Tarsis, Grizb37, Wosator); no independent parse/log-aggregation source was found to cross-check their DPS/HPS claims against.

readme.heading: Top open questions for the orchestrator
readme.markdown:
- Fetch/decode the `talents.turtlecraft.gg` calculator links (the `?points=` query string) to turn every linked build in these playbooks into actual point lists — this is the single highest-value follow-up, affecting all seven spec/role files.
- Any post-1.18.1 raid logs, turtlogs.com rankings snapshots, or Discord class-channel guides for Druid (the forum repeatedly defers to Discord and to `turtlogs.com`, e.g. `https://www.turtlogs.com/pve/ranking`, for numbers that aren't reproduced in the forum text).
- A Turtle database dump (`database.turtlecraft.gg`) for exact Feral/Balance/Restoration spell values, idol/trinket effects, and tier-set bonuses at current itemization — every `spell_id` field in the structured YAML is null because no forum source gives one.
- Confirmation of which class "Pollen Burst" and "Elune Infusion" (both listed under Druid in the 1.18.1 hotfix notes with class attribution described as unclear in the master changelog) actually belong to — Druid pet-adjacent or Hunter pet.

playbooks.title: Druid — Feral tank (Bear/Dire Bear, dungeons and raids)
playbooks.intro: Playbook for a Bear-form tank on Turtle WoW, built from the Druid forum (f=42), the Class Changes 2 staff posts (2024-10-12) and the 1.18.1 patch notes (p=166071, revised 2026-01-26 and 2026-03-19). Sources are thicker for pre-1.18.1 stat priority and mechanics than for post-1.18.1 play; the 1.18.1 threat nerfs are official but the forum's reaction to them (post-2026-03-20) is a single vocal author corroborated by several short replies, not an independent re-test. Mark accordingly throughout.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: main tank or off-tank in Bear/Dire Bear Form, threat from Maul (auto-attack-timer rage dump), Swipe (AoE), Savage Bite (rage dump/snap threat) and Demoralizing Roar/Faerie Fire (Feral); Frenzied Regeneration and Barkskin (Feral) for self-healing/mitigation cooldowns.
- **Strengths (consensus, pre-1.18.1)**: cannot be polymorphed, hexed or disarmed; immune to Nefarian-style effects that only key off "warrior" mechanics (though Nefarian's Bellowing Roar/druid call specifically counters bears — see Common mistakes); scales threat with gear because Maul/Savage Bite/Swipe are damage multipliers rather than warrior-style flat threat add-ons — "we still have the most physical mitigation and if geared right can actually output the most threat-per-second" — [Elesion (player), 2023-08-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=58705#p58705). "100% viable. I've MT'd almost the entirety of MC, BWL, AQ40, and most of Naxx" — [Drubarrymooer (player), 2023-09-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=64890#p64890). "It's completely viable and sometimes optimal in basically all content from dungeons to raids... Druid always has been and always will be a great tanking class" — [Bigsmerf (player), 2023-08-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=58715#p58715).
- **Weaknesses (consensus)**: no −10% magic-damage stance (unlike warrior Defensive Stance), no reliable interrupt against stun-immune bosses (Bash is a stun, useless on stun-immune targets), cannot stance-dance out of fears (Ony/Nefarian fights), and Nefarian's druid-specific call "pretty much entirely prevents druids from tanking him" — [Elesion (player), 2023-08-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=58705#p58705). Cannot parry or block, so Defense rating is worth less than for a warrior/paladin ("Defense is 40% less effective here since you can't parry nor block" — [Sunken (player), 2025-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117585#p117585)) and true crit/crush immunity is unreachable the way it is for shield tanks.
- **Content**: dungeon main tank (near-universal), raid main/off-tank through Naxx-equivalent content (**contested for the hardest fights only**: "For Naxx... there are some select fights where bears have their place... I have not heard of a druid main-tanking all of Naxx but that doesn't mean it doesn't exist" — [Elesion (player), 2023-08-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=58705#p58705)); solo/open-world tanking of elites.
- **Community standing — pre-1.18.1**: **favored/consensus-viable**. Bear was explicitly called out by staff as overperforming going into 1.18.1: "While both Bear and Cat are performing well, Bear even more than we imagined" — [Jammyzz quoting the staff Dec-2024 patch notes (player), 2024-12-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113723#p113723).
- **Community standing — post-1.18.1**: **contested, trending negative**, single detailed source with several agreeing short replies. "Bear sucks because threat was the only thing going for them and now it's gone... Bears take over 2x the damage while having only around ~20% more HP than warriors... can't parry or block and is subject to crits and crushing blows... Bear snap threat is way worse than paladin's... Now there's literally no reason to bring a bear tank over warrior or paladin" — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173102#p173102). Counter-argument: "Bear is so unplayable that out of the fastest 10 Kara guilds only 8 of them are using a bear as maintank" (sarcastic — i.e. still 8/10) — [Velanyr (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173162#p173162), to which Noephix replies "In 3 months not a single one will. Takes time for people to catch up with bear nerfs" — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173218#p173218). "Feral is dogshit in PvP mate... they nerfed Bear into the ground so its basically just a punching bag, and does zero damage, because of the Savage Bite nerf back in December" — [Grizb37 (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171995#p171995).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
No source publishes a full decoded post-1.18.1 point list (talents.turtlecraft.gg links only, not decodable from text — same gap as the paladin playbook). Points named as mandatory/near-mandatory by multiple sources:

- **Omen of Clarity** and **Furor** — take by ~level 20/25 while leveling and keep at 60; "Always go Omen of Clarity first by Lv20, then into Furor by Lv25. The clearcasting procs very often and gives you tons of threat when tanking from all the free swipes you get in bear form" — [Captain4k (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165907#p165907).
- **Feral Instinct** (threat), **Thick Hide** (armor), **Blood Frenzy** + **Primal Fury** (attack speed/rage on crit) — cookie-cutter tank staples across every build cited.
- **Sylvan Blessing** — flagged as an underrated must-have for tank sustain: "A lot of people ignore [Sylvan Blessing] because it is worded weirdly. But it's a really important talent that helps keep you from going out of mana when you heal yourself in between mobs. This minimizes your down time" — [Captain4k (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165907#p165907).
- **Ancient Brutality** — **contested value**. Rage-on-dodge and (pre-2024-12-20) a vampirism component made it strong for tanking dodge-heavy fights, but the December 2024 rework removed the bear vampirism and left only the rage generation, which the community judged undertuned: "removing the Vampirism part of it completely kills the talent for Bears... perhaps 2/4/6 would be better" — [Jammyzz (player), 2024-12-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113723#p113723). Still wanted for the dodge synergy: "You actually want a fair amount of dodge because of ancient brutality" — [Drubarrymooer (player), 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115691#p115691).
- **Feral Adrenaline — avoid**. Near-unanimous criticism: "3 talent points for 45% dodge every 30 seconds is not good, also dodge doesn't push crits and crushes off the table, if you have 95% dodge then every attack from the boss that lands will be either a Crit or crush... No druid I know takes this talent" — [Jammyzz (player), 2024-12-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112877#p112877). "Bears can't get crit immunity, so the talent smoothes out peaks of critical damage" is the lone defense — [Xudo (player), 2024-12-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112876#p112876) — but even the staff's Dec-2024 dodge-chance buff (15/30/45% → 20/40/60%) didn't fix the complaint, since "the dodge chance was not the issue, the long 30 second ICD is" — [Jammyzz (player), 2024-12-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113723#p113723), echoed [2025-05-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=133058#p133058).
- A meta tank build link (**talent trees unchanged by 1.18.1**, so this is still valid): [https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/druid?points=BSAaAI-FAYYRaDQQIFQB-Ao](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165907#p165907) — [Captain4k (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165907#p165907).
- Older (2022-2023, pre-Class-Changes-2, **superseded**) hybrid tank/heal builds like Kairion's "cookiecutter druid tank build" ([p28953](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=28953#p28953)) used a different talent tree shape and should not be used as-is.

**Patch validity**: talent tree unchanged by 1.18.1; only the Maul/Savage Bite threat *modifiers* changed (see Cooldowns/threat below), so pre-1.18.1 talent choices are **still current** for 1.18.1.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
**Contested — no single agreed ordering**, but the framework used by the top reply in the main stat-priority thread is widely echoed:

> "I tend to look at stats in 2 broad categories: 1) Physical Mitigation — armor, dodge, defense. 2) Threat — hit, crit, attack power, haste. Depending on the task at hand you need to (re)balance those two... in 5-person instances lean heavier toward mitigation... in a raid where you have your own 5 healers you can slack on mitigation and go heavier into threat." — [Elesion (player), 2023-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60018#p60018)

Specific point callouts (mostly consensus):

- **Armor**: "iconic bear stat but once you get half-way decent gear you'll be drowning in it. Hitting the armor cap is quite easy to do on Turtle" — [Elesion (player), 2023-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60018#p60018); target "around 11-12k Armor" then deprioritize — [Inovatu (player), 2025-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117477#p117477).
- **Stamina**: always good, general survivability — consensus across all threads.
- **Defense**: **contested/low priority**. "Defense seems much too high on your list. It does very little for Druids (we don't block and we don't parry) making it an incredibly expensive way to boost dodge and add a little crit mitigation" — [Elesion (player), 2023-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60018#p60018); "Defense is 40% less effective here since you can't parry nor block" — [Sunken (player), 2025-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117585#p117585). Situational exception: stack it for fights that hit hard with limited healing — "Some bosses in bwl can hit you very hard if you aren't careful, so does twins in aq40 and bosses with limited healing like Erennius, Maexxna or Loatheb" — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115706#p115706).
- **Hit**: important for threat; effective melee hit cap on Turtle is **8%** — [Inovatu (player), 2025-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121590#p121590) — reduced to **5% with Natural Weapons (3/3, +3% hit)** — [Eyeburn (player), 2025-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121689#p121689). Hitting above cap "does absolutely nothing" and cannot counteract dodge/parry, which are governed by defense rating vs. weapon skill, not hit rating — [Atreidon (player), 2025-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121385#p121385).
- **Haste/attack speed**: **undervalued by newer players but rated highly** by veterans, because Maul rides the (slow, 2.5s) auto-attack timer: "Haste is completely missing and actually one of the best threat-generation stats... item budget wise 2% melee haste is equivalent to 1% melee crit and you can get a lot more threat out of 2% melee haste than 1% melee crit" — [Elesion (player), 2023-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60018#p60018); "Attackspeed is really, really good for Bears because more Attackspeed the faster you hit with Maul" — [Inovatu (player), 2025-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117477#p117477).
- **Crit**: better than assumed — "Crit seems too low on your list... melee crits double the damage and all our main threat skills are implemented as multipliers... a crit actually means double threat for us. And the synergy with Primal Fury is always nice" — [Elesion (player), 2023-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60018#p60018).
- **Agility/Dodge**: wanted for Ancient Brutality synergy but **do not itemize for raw dodge** — "Dont go for Dodge, go for Agility if you have to" — [Inovatu (player), 2025-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117477#p117477).
- Fight-dependent split, two schools cited by the same thread: general trash/most bosses → **hit until cap, agility, stamina**; hard-hitting/low-healing bosses → **hit until cap, defense, stamina, armor** — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115706#p115706).
- Community stat-weight tools (unofficial, not staff-verified): the **VanillaRatingBuster** addon with Taladril's community stat-weight spreadsheet, plus an updated Turtle-specific version by "AngryCat" shared in the Discord druid channel — [krylorandrax (player), 2025-01-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=116362#p116362). A generic wowhead/warcrafttavern vanilla bear-tank guide was called "dated" once Class Changes 2 landed — [Kethmandoo (player), 2025-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=117463#p117463), responding to [Dr Thrax (player), 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115719#p115719).

**Not found in sources**: exact crit-immunity or crush-cap Defense values for bears on Turtle (the paladin playbook's 440/420-Defense number is a vanilla-baseline figure, not druid-specific, and no source ports it to bears).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown:
No source gives a numbered priority list as explicit as the paladin playbook's; the pieces named across threads are:

1. Pull with **Faerie Fire (Feral)** rank 1 (cheap, high threat, applies armor debuff) — [Nuninho32 thread advice, Terrydavis (player), 2026-01-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165608#p165608).
2. **Maul** on cooldown/auto-attack timer as the primary rage dump and main threat tool.
3. **Savage Bite** as a rage dump and snap-threat cooldown, but note the pre-1.18.1 warning that it is Bear's only instant single-target burst tool and is now on a longer cooldown (6s → 9s as of Dec 2024) — "if just one of these misses, waiting 9 seconds for another will feel godawful" — [Jammyzz (player), 2024-12-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113723#p113723). **1.18.1 additionally cut Savage Bite's threat modifier by 12%** (official, [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)).
4. **Demoralizing Roar** to reduce incoming physical damage and (in PvP/against stealthed rogues) pull enemies out of stealth — [Xudo (player), 2025-10-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156325#p156325).
5. Downtime rage → **Enrage** (armor debuff on self, separate from the rage-gain buff since Class Changes 2) when threat is secure.

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **Swipe** is the core AoE threat tool; it scales with 4% of Attack Power as of the Nov-2024 rework (down from 8% at launch of Class Changes 2, then 6%, "This was 8% originally, this just feels unwarranted" — [Jammyzz (player), 2024-12-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113723#p113723); final value per `synthesis/turtle-vs-vanilla-timeline.md`: 8% → 6% → 4% AP).
- Faerie Fire (Feral) each new add to keep the armor debuff up and help hold aggro before Swipe catches up.
- Demoralizing Roar on pull for the raw damage-reduction; it also functions as an AoE stealth-detector against rogues.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Frenzied Regeneration**: converts rage to health (10 rage/s, 6/7/8% of Stamina per point of rage by rank); cooldown is 6 minutes pre-1.18.1 (reduced from 3 in the original Class Changes 2 pass, then only trimmed to 5 minutes in Dec 2024, which the community judged too small a fix: "no one will really feel a 1 minute cooldown decrease... reduce cooldown back to baseline 3 minutes or add 10% healing" — [Jammyzz (player), 2024-12-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113723#p113723)).
- **Barkskin (Feral)**: learned at 44/52/60; next 5/10/15 melee hits take 50% less damage, 20% movement slow, 12s duration, 10-minute cooldown; a niche panic button, not part of the normal rotation.
- **Ancient Brutality**: passive rage generator on dodge; treat as sustained resource generation rather than an on-demand cooldown (see Talent build for its contested tuning history).
- Rage management: no source gives a numeric "pool" target; the consensus is to keep Swipe/Maul/Savage Bite flowing and not to worry about rage starvation once Omen of Clarity/Furor/Blood Frenzy are talented.
- **Official 1.18.1 threat change**: Maul's threat modifier is reduced by 15% and Savage Bite's by 12%, explicitly to rein in bear threat dominance — "Feral Bears have been overly prominent in their threat output, leaving little room for other tanks to shine" — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). No compensating buff shipped in 1.18.1.

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- **Threat**: the class's biggest edge is that its core threat tools scale multiplicatively with gear (unlike warrior flat-threat abilities), so threat improves faster than expected as gear improves — [Elesion (player), 2023-08-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=58705#p58705). Post-1.18.1 this edge is explicitly smaller (see Cooldowns).
- **Mechanical gaps to plan around**: no interrupt against stun-immune casters, no −10% magic-damage stance, cannot stance-dance fears; Nefarian's bear-specific call effectively removes druids from that fight — [Elesion (player), 2023-08-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=58705#p58705).
- **Raid role competition**: in guilds stacked with geared/experienced warriors, bears are more likely to off-tank than main-tank purely for social/optimization reasons rather than mechanical ones: "geared and experienced warriors sign up as tanks and you have to find a spot" — [Elesion (player), 2023-08-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=58705#p58705). Post-1.18.1, Noephix argues this has hardened into "no reason to bring a bear tank over warrior or paladin" — [2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173102#p173102) — but the same thread notes 8/10 top Kara guilds were still running bear maintanks at the time of posting — [Velanyr (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173162#p173162).
- **PvP note**: feral bear PvP damage was hit hard by the same Savage Bite threat/damage trims, and a talent that previously granted +15% Savage Bite damage was "silently removed" per player report — "they even silently removed a talent to give 15% dmg to Savage bite" — [Wosator (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171996#p171996) (**single source, unconfirmed by an official patch line — flag as unverified**).

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Trinkets**: Hateforge trinket (+120 armor, 12 stam, 1% attack speed) was called out as a good early tank trinket — [Geojak (player), 2022-10-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=26875#p26875); Smoking Heart of the Mountain questioned as still BiS in the same thread (unanswered — **gap**).
- **Professions**: Herbalism/Alchemy suggested for a leveling tank (self-sufficiency, potion access) — [Geojak (player), 2022-10-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=26875#p26875).
- **Item budget warning, post-1.18.1**: "item devs strike once again, making bear t3 choke-full of useless and low-value stats like intellect or defense (bear cant parry or block, remember?). So the best current bear set in game by far is... PvP t3. Because pvp sets are naturally made with proper stats. Yes, bears have to spend months upon months on BGs to get their pve BiS set." — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173102#p173102). **Single source, not independently corroborated with a gear list — treat as a lead, not a confirmed BiS list.**
- Community (non-staff) gear-planning tool: "Feral Druid Tank gear guide" Google Sheet linked from the community wiki — `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19IALSBVKyTY1Gd63AQ-Bkbvv4I2KspxdPVWi6YtN1xA` (wiki, not turtlecraft.gg; treat as community, unverified).
- **No pre-raid BiS list found in the forum sources** — gap, same as the paladin playbook's finding for Protection.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Itemizing hard for raw Defense rating instead of Hit/Armor/Stamina, given Druids get no parry/block benefit from it.
- Chasing raw Dodge% instead of Agility-as-a-side-effect; Ancient Brutality rewards dodge procs but is not worth gearing dodge directly for.
- Taking **Feral Adrenaline** — near-unanimous "don't take it" advice due to the 30-second internal cooldown gutting its value.
- Treating Savage Bite as a spammable threat button post-1.18.1; its cooldown (9s) and reduced threat modifier make it a supplement, not the core rotation.
- Pulling without Faerie Fire's armor debuff, or without Demoralizing Roar against physical-heavy packs.
- Assuming bear can tank every fight equally: Nefarian and other fear-heavy/stance-dance-dependent encounters are specifically worse for bears — plan to swap tanks or specs for those pulls.
