playbooks.title: Druid — Restoration healer (HoT/Tree of Life and Healing Touch builds)
playbooks.intro: Playbook for the Restoration healing spec. Class Changes 2 (2024-10-12) pushed Restoration toward a "healing-over-time" identity via the Tree of Life Form and the new Efflorescence passive, while trying to solve the classic anti-synergy of multiple resto druids overwriting each other's HoTs. Sources split cleanly into two build philosophies — Moonglow/Healing Touch and Tree of Life/HoT — argued about at length but never resolved into a single "best" answer; PvP survivability is a separate, much more negative topic (see `restoration-pvp.md`).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: raid/dungeon healer, either via a HoT-stacking Tree of Life build (Rejuvenation/Regrowth/Swiftmend/Tranquility) or a Moonglow-enabled Healing Touch build with Nature's Grace/Aessina's Bloom synergy.
- **Strengths (consensus)**: mana efficiency, strong single-target and (via Aessina's Bloom + an existing Regrowth) throughput healing — "Aessina's Bloom really makes the throughput feel great, especially if a tree is already HoTing your target. I regularly get high or on top of the meters in raids up to naxx because of it" — [Bayanni (player), 2025-10-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155621#p155621). Spirit scales the whole party's regen, not just the caster's, making it a stronger stat than its "personal log" impact suggests (see Stat priority). "In raid content, resto druids are amazing — as long as we are the *only* resto druid... that one resto druid is a game changer, and no raid should be without" — [Lynxkitten (player), 2025-10-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155593#p155593).
- **Weaknesses (consensus)**: "we cannot compensate for an undergeared tank, where other healers sometimes can. This is because we have less up-front healing options, and our mana sustain can be tricky" in dungeon content — same source; **raid-slot scarcity**: "There is no discernable use to a second resto druid, compared to that raid slot being filled by virtually any other healer" — same source; Tree of Life Form cuts off Healing Touch and all offensive/utility casting while active, and slows movement 20% — a long-running complaint (see Talent build); PvP survivability is weak (see `restoration-pvp.md`).
- **Content**: raids (strong, capacity-limited to ~1-2 slots), dungeons (good but not carry-tier), leveling (viable, see `leveling.md`), PvP (weak — see `restoration-pvp.md`).
- **Community standing**: **consensus that the spec is functional but under-documented** — "I can hardly find any info or guides though on what to do or how to spec" is a repeated new-player complaint — [Mastrshake (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153729#p153729); [Hasenn117f (player), 2025-08-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=145447#p145447). Post-1.18.1: "resto sucks because there's only 1 slot for a resto druid in 40-man raid. Maybe 2, if they coordinate. But more than 2 — and they start griefing each other by overwriting each other's heals. Dev team's attempts to fix the problem didn't really help. And resto also sucks because holy priest does resto's 'speciality' (heal over time) much better" — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173102#p173102) (**single detailed source**, partially contradicted in the same thread by "Resto Druid aint that bad ngl when you stack druids the healing gets shared 3 ways but still decent" — [Froizerk (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173300#p173300)).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
Two build philosophies, both actively played; **no source decodes a single definitive 60-point list**, only talent-calculator links and named-talent descriptions:

- **Tree of Life / HoT build**: centers on Rejuvenation/Regrowth spam plus Swiftmend, with **Efflorescence** (level 60, Tree-Form-only passive: any time your Regrowth/Rejuvenation is about to be replaced, it instantly heals for a portion of the remaining duration) as the capstone payoff. Community build link: [https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/druid?points=BgAbAI--FAFABbFFALFQB](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156226#p156226) — [Bayanni (player), 2025-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156226#p156226), who also suggests swapping 2/2 Improved Tranquility for 2/2 Nature's Reach depending on raid needs (Naxx/AQ40 range utility vs. a stronger emergency cooldown).
- **Moonglow / Healing Touch build**: keeps Healing Touch as a spam-able direct heal, uses Moonglow for its mana-cost reduction while casting HT, and leans on **Aessina's Bloom** (Healing Touch on a Regrowth-affected target has a 30/60% chance to instantly heal for 6 seconds of Regrowth). Community build links: [https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/druid?points=oACYQKCYAI--FAoABLFDQAF](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147488#p147488) — [Skyfont (player), 2025-08-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147488#p147488); another variant [https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/druid?points=BgYbAKAYAI--FAoABbFFQI](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156226#p156226) — [Bayanni (player), 2025-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156226#p156226).
- **A third, less-tested "deep resto without Tree or Moonglow" route** was flagged as promising but unresolved in the sources read — [Bayanni (player), 2025-10-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155621#p155621) (**gap** — no follow-up confirmation found).
- **Contested QoL complaint (still open as of 1.18.1)**: **Nature's Focus** (spell-pushback-avoidance talent) costs a full 5 points for 70% protection on the non-Tree build, versus a 2-point cost for equivalent protection on every other healer class, and its cost locks a HT-build druid out of also taking both Regrowth and HT talents — [Bikicsunaj (player), 2026-02-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168231#p168231). No staff response found in sources.
- **Efflorescence confusion**: several players didn't realize it requires Tree of Life Form and is trainer-taught rather than a talent-tree entry — "requares tree form? seriously? On what basis was this strange decision made?" — [Zend (player), 2024-11-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105927#p105927); "Go visit a class trainer. Took me a week of tanking without Feral version of Barkskin before I had noticed lol" — [Drishby (player), 2025-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122605#p122605) (about a different trainer-taught spell, same confusion pattern). At least one player reported it not functioning at all — [PikxDizzy (player), 2025-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122961#p122961) (**single report, unconfirmed bug**).
- **1.18.1 tier-set complaint (post-patch)**: the T3.5 5-set "Blooming Bud" (boosts Swiftmend) was reworked with only a 20-second linger, "which only realistically affects the tanks to get the proc (240 healing once getting hit)"; the poster argues the set bonus philosophy (lower Swiftmend CD for more procs of a low-impact buff) no longer coheres and proposes reworking it into a Rejuvenation/Regrowth-crit-style proc instead — [Froizerk (player), 2026-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172927#p172927) (**single source suggestion, not an implemented change**).

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- **Spirit**: undervalued by personal healing logs but mechanically strong because of its party-wide effect: "1 spirit is 0.2 healing to every member of your party, so in a way every point of spirit is 1sp, very strong even if your personal logs don't reflect it" — [Bayanni (player), 2025-10-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155621#p155621) — cited as a reason to favor the Tree build early in a raid tier when spirit-heavy healing gear has less competition.
- **Downranking**: no numeric spell-rank table is given, but the community rule of thumb for choosing a Regrowth rank is: "spam regrowth with full mana and no buffs/consumables. If your mana lasts 45 seconds or more without any external help/no innervate/no potions you're good for 90% of the fights with that rank. If your mana lasts more than 1 min 15 secs use a higher rank and repeat until you're between 45 secs and 1 min 15 secs" — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153757#p153757). Max-rank Regrowth/Healing Touch is reserved for emergency top-ups; downranked casts are the sustained-healing default — same source.
- **No numeric weights for Healing Power or Intellect** are given by any source (**gap**).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target (tank) healing priority
rotationSingle.markdown:
- **HT build**: max-rank Healing Touch for emergency top-ups, downranked Healing Touch (per the 45s–75s mana-duration rule above) as the sustained tank heal, Regrowth layered on top when Aessina's Bloom is talented and a Regrowth is already present from any druid — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153732#p153732); [Bayanni (player), 2025-10-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155621#p155621).
- **Tree build**: "replace healing touch spam with regrowht spam" once raid-geared, since Tree Form locks out Healing Touch entirely — [Reploidrocsa (player), 2025-09-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153732#p153732). Tree is explicitly weaker as a **dungeon** tank-healer than as a raid healer: "Tree is good but limited due to not having a solid repeatable heal for tanks. They're solid for a raid but I'd hold off using them as dungeon healers unless you're stacked and your HoTs alone can keep the MT up" — [Bayanni (player), 2025-10-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155621#p155621).
- **Swiftmend**: instant-cast emergency heal, core to both builds; a "cancel Tree + cast Nature's Swiftness + cast heal" macro pattern is discussed in dedicated macro threads (t13046, not read in depth for this playbook — **gap**).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / raid healing
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **Tranquility**: completely reworked under Class Changes 2 — cooldown 5 → 30 minutes, mana cost doubled, tick rate 2s → 1s, baseline threat removed, now hits the **entire raid** instead of just the caster's party, and rank-1-through-4 durations are only 4/6/8/10 seconds respectively (official, [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102966#p102966)). The rework's stated goal was to make Tranquility "affect all raid members in close range of the druid, at a significantly decreased healing power and increased cooldown" so that "only Restoration druids will be able to unlock Tranquility's true potential" — same source. A dedicated thread ("Tranquility is too OP", 42 posts, t15878) argued the rework over/undershot this goal in both directions; not read in full for this playbook — **gap, revisit if raid-cooldown tuning detail is needed**.
- **HoT-overwrite anti-synergy**: the core design tension the Class Changes 2 patch tried to solve — a second druid's Rejuvenation/Regrowth *replaces* rather than stacks with the first druid's, and Efflorescence's instant-heal-on-replace was the intended mitigation, but players still find it painful when gear is uneven: "It is really a pain to be a less geared druid trying to get some healing done while the other druid doesn't have to care about anything... if you can't apply your hots it really hurts" — [Syndraela (player), 2025-02-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120862#p120862), who requests druids be allowed to overwrite each other's HoTs even with weaker versions specifically to trigger Efflorescence — unresolved as of the sources read.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Innervate**: by general Druid-community convention (referenced across multiple threads, not a single dedicated source) this is given to another healer or the caster's own mana-hungry raid role rather than self-used by a DPS-spec druid; no single authoritative thread quantifies the exact etiquette (**gap**).
- **Mana**: managed primarily through downranking (see Stat priority) and consumables; no Restoration-specific consumable list distinct from the general caster list was found (see `balance-ranged-dps.md`'s Gear section for the shared Major Mana Potion / Nordanaar Herbal Tea / Dark Rune / Nightfin Soup / Mageblood Potion list — **assume it applies to Restoration too, not independently confirmed for this spec — flag as inferred, not sourced directly**).
- **Swiftmend**: emergency mana-free-ish burst heal (consumes a HoT), core cooldown for both builds.

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- **Raid-slot planning**: bring at most one (rarely two, coordinated) Restoration druids to a raid; a third overlapping resto druid actively griefs the others' healing via HoT overwrite — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173102#p173102); [Lynxkitten (player), 2025-10-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155593#p155593).
- **Build choice by raid tier/competition**: favor the Tree/HoT build early in a raid tier (less competition for high-Spirit gear) and be willing to switch to Moonglow/HT if a second Tree druid joins or the tank needs more repeatable direct healing — [Bayanni (player), 2025-10-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155621#p155621).
- **Dungeon healing**: a Healing Touch-leaning build (even a full-Balance druid with spare healing gear, per `balance-ranged-dps.md`) is generally safer for undergeared/PUG dungeon groups than committing to Tree Form, given Tree's lack of a repeatable strong direct heal.
- **PvP**: see `restoration-pvp.md` — Restoration is reported as one of the weakest PvP healer specs on the server.

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Chronometer** addon recommended for tracking own HoT durations — [Pdwow (player), 2025-04-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126491#p126491); Cursive or DoTimer suggested as alternatives that "don't bug out in raids" — [Noephix (player), 2025-04-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128462#p128462).
- **PvP gear as a PvE starting point**: the leather "Abyssal" set from the Auction House was recommended over the early PvE blue set specifically because the blue set wastes stat points on Strength/Agility, while Abyssal gives Stamina/Intellect/spell power — [Halfgeek9 (player), 2025-05-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131901#p131901); the Moonheart PvP set was separately asked about as a starting point but not conclusively endorsed (**gap**) — [Krltbr (player), 2025-05-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131891#p131891).
- Community (non-staff) resources linked from the wiki: a "Turtle WoW Restoration Druid Overview" write-up (`https://rentry.co/kiv7ntyx`) and a pbrigade.gitlab.io gear-planner Restoration Druid BiS export — community-maintained, not staff-verified, content not independently read for this playbook (**gap**).
- **No pre-raid BiS list found in the forum sources** — gap, consistent with every other Druid role covered here.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Bringing more than one or two Restoration druids to a 40-man raid without explicit HoT-assignment coordination.
- Spamming max-rank heals instead of downranking to the mana-sustainable rank for the fight length.
- Trying to tank-heal a dungeon in full Tree Form without a strong repeatable direct heal backup.
- Forgetting Efflorescence must be trained from a class trainer and requires Tree of Life Form to function.
- Assuming a second (or third) druid's weaker HoT will stack instead of overwrite.

playbooks.title: Druid — Feral melee DPS (Cat Form)
playbooks.intro: Playbook for Cat-form DPS on Turtle WoW. This spec has the most forum churn of any Druid role: Class Changes 2 (2024-10-12) tried to give cats a non-powershifting "bleed" playstyle, the community spent roughly six months (Oct 2024 – May 2025) disputing whether it out-performed the classic Wolfshead/Furor **powershifting** loop, and by mid-2025 the bleed/claw build had become the accepted single-target meta — with powershifting kept only as the fallback for bleed-immune targets. 1.18.1 added no direct Feral DPS buffs or reworks; the only 1.18.1 changes that touch Cat are the Maul/Savage Bite tank-threat nerf (irrelevant to DPS), two item hotfixes (Yoxtez +224 Feral Attack Power, Fang of Alichos usable in forms) and a Kara40 trinket nerf that specifically hurt cat itemization. Post-1.18.1, multiple posters call Cat "no longer the worst DPS spec — moonkin is" (i.e. still near the bottom).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: single-target melee DPS via combo points (Shred/Claw → Rip/Ferocious Bite), with a defining choice between two playstyles:
  1. **Powershifting**: exploit Furor (100% chance to gain energy on shapeshift) + a Wolfsheart/Wolfshead-enchanted helm to cancel-and-reshift into Cat Form mid-fight, refilling energy from mana and spamming Shred.
  2. **Bleed/Claw**: keep Rake (9s) and Rip (up to 18s) rolling, spend energy on Claw (buffed vs. Rake targets by Open Wounds), and recover energy passively from Ancient Brutality's bleed-tick energy return instead of shifting.
- **Strengths**: highest scaling ceiling of any Druid spec purely on weapon/AP itemization ("Feral relies on everything being a stat stick to scale to their forms" — [Gorlocktheglock (player), 2026-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172912#p172912)); good solo/open-world/leveling damage; strong utility (Leader of the Pack crit aura, interrupts via Feral Charge/Bash).
- **Weaknesses (consensus)**: uniquely bad interaction with **glancing blows** — cats have no way to raise weapon skill in form (capped at the 300 baseline), unlike Hunter pets, which have their own weapon skill — "Feral Druids are the only Melee DPS class unable to counter the glancing blow mechanic" — [Slade1994 (player), 2025-03-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123857#p123857); weak AoE (Swipe requires Bear Form, Hurricane is a caster spell cats don't itemize for); every raid-power revision so far has been contested as insufficient (see Community standing).
- **Content**: leveling (very strong, see `leveling.md`), dungeons, raids (contested viability — see below), open-world/solo farming (strong).
- **Community standing — pre-1.18.1**: **contested, trending toward "underpowered relative to effort required."** "Feral is competitive thanks to powershifting. If you try to DPS as a feral druid without it you will be seriously gimped" — [Zulnam (player), 2025-02-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120217#p120217), arguing the spec is propped up entirely by a mechanic (powershifting) the devs themselves call an "abomination" in player-vs-player forum arguments. By mid-2025 the same debate flipped to defending the *bleed* build's higher DPS while lamenting bleed immunity: "Current top-5 druid DPS on Patchwerk is all claw cats. Claw is clearly ahead of powershred" — [Noephix (player), 2025-04-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128297#p128297); "Right now Bleed is ALOT more DPS, around 200+ extra than powershifting shred. You only powershift on bleed immune or you gimp your DPS potential" — [Grizb37 (player), 2025-06-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134389#p134389).
- **Community standing — post-1.18.1**: "OK, in 1.18.1 feral is no longer the worst DPS spec - moonkin is. So the title goes from druids to druids" — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172923#p172923), i.e. still bottom-tier, just not dead last. Item-design frustration continued: "Cat sucks because item devs made a mistake, refused to acknowledge and doubled down on it... Kara40 cat gear [has] tons of dump stats (roughly over 50% of stat budget)... Cat needs to be lvl 62 to take all the mandatory DPS talents without a single flex point. Too bad lvl cap is 60" — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173102#p173102).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
No source decodes a full post-1.18.1 point list (only talents.turtlecraft.gg calculator links, same gap as every other Druid role and the paladin playbook). Named mandatory talents by build:

- **Both builds**: Omen of Clarity, Furor, Blood Frenzy + Primal Fury, Improved Shred (unconditional Shred buff after entering Cat Form as of the 1.18.0 rework per `synthesis/turtle-vs-vanilla-timeline.md`).
- **Powershift build**: prioritizes Furor/Wolfshead synergy; skip Open Wounds and the bleed-energy side of Ancient Brutality.
- **Bleed/Claw build**: **Open Wounds** (Claw +10/20/30% vs. a Rake'd target, reworked Dec 2024 to scale off *every* active bleed including Ferocious Bite) and **Ancient Brutality**'s cat-form bleed-tick energy return (2/3/4 energy per tick as of the Dec-2024 rework, 3/5 by the 1.18.0 rework per the timeline) are the core enablers.
- Example builds shared in-thread (pre-1.18.1, talent tree unchanged in 1.18.1 so still structurally valid): [Bigsmerf's "optimal feral build" link](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106167#p106167) — [2024-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106167#p106167); a hybrid tank/DPS build by [Reploidrocsa](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110757#p110757) — [2024-11-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110757#p110757).
- **Point starvation, post-1.18.1**: raiding cats need Cat DPS talents *and* enough Bear talents to off-tank/tank trash, plus flex points — "We feel really starved for Talent points... ive got FOUR Feral specs just in my Brain Wash device" — [Snkx (player), 2025-08-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147482#p147482); Noephix's 2026-03-30 claim that the mandatory DPS talents alone require level 62 (**single source, uncorroborated with a specific point count — flag as unverified**).
- **Avoid**: Feral Adrenaline (see feral-tank.md — same criticism applies in Cat Form).

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- **Hit**: effective melee hit cap is **8%** — [Inovatu (player), 2025-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121590#p121590) — or **5% with Natural Weapons (3/3, +3% hit)** — [Eyeburn (player), 2025-03-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121689#p121689). Hitting above cap does nothing, and hit rating cannot reduce dodge/parry chance, which scales off weapon skill vs. defense — [Atreidon (player), 2025-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121385#p121385). Cats are permanently capped at 300 weapon skill (unarmed) regardless of gear, unlike weapon-using melee, which the community calls out as an unaddressed glancing-blow tax: "Feral Druids are the only Melee DPS class unable to counter the glancing blow mechanic" — [Slade1994 (player), 2025-03-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123857#p123857).
- **Strength/Agility ("stat-stick" scaling)**: primary offensive stats; cat/bear forms convert weapon-slot items into flat Feral Attack Power (FAP)/weapon damage, so any gear with Feral Attack Power or high Str/Agi is valuable regardless of nominal "weapon" status. Post-1.18.1 itemization complaint: "cats scale too well with str/agi, that's why we had to severely limit str/agi on t3.5 gear" (item-dev quote, reported by a player) — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172655#p172655); Feral T3.5's highest stat is Intellect, not Str/Agi — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172919#p172919).
- **Intellect on T2.5/T3.5 sets**: **contested**. Complaint: "126 stat points are wasted" on a PvE cat set with heavy Intellect — [Snkx (player), 2025-04-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128296#p128296) (see also [Jaffcover (player), 2024-12-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=114200#p114200)). Defense: "Druid gear needs to be viable for PvP too. INT is necessary for lasting in fights for shifting, healing, and dots" — [Darter (player), 2025-01-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118313#p118313), countered by "But T2.5 and T3.5 is not a PvP set, you have the Rank gear for that, ferals don't need int in PvE" — [Grizb37 (player), 2025-01-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118323#p118323).
- **Haste/attack speed**: **contested, likely overvalued by item designers per the community**. "They think 'feral is melee so haste is good on them' and keep showing haste down our throats despite the fact that feral is unique in this regard and only gets around 20-30% of its damage from autoattacks (other melee spec hover around 50%)" — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172655#p172655) (figure revised between posts; a later reply in the same thread restates it as ~20%). **Single source, not independently tested.**
- **Crit**: valued for Clearcasting/Primal Fury-adjacent synergy and raw combo-point-finisher damage; no numeric weight given by any source (**gap**).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown:
There is **no single agreed rotation** — pick based on whether the target can bleed.

### Bleed/Claw build (meta on non-bleed-immune targets since ~mid-2025)
1. Open with Rake, then build to 5 combo points with Claw (buffed by Open Wounds while Rake is up).
2. Apply Rip at 5 combo points; keep Tiger's Fury active (12s duration by the CC2 rework, grants an attack-speed buff plus baseline energy return per 3s as of 1.18.0).
3. Refresh Rake/Rip before they expire; spend excess energy on Claw between refreshes.
4. Weave in Ferocious Bite only when it won't clip a bleed refresh — a common complaint is that Ferocious Bite's "extra damage from spent energy" conversion feels bad and several players asked (unsuccessfully as far as sources show) for it to refresh Rip instead — [Keds (player), 2025-04-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128112#p128112).
5. Use **Idol of Laceration** (finishing moves have a 20%-per-combo-point chance to refund 15 energy on your next Shred; also procs off Ferocious Bite — [Inovatu (player), 2025-05-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132807#p132807)) to reduce the need to powershift at all.
6. **On a bleed-immune target, swap immediately to the powershift/Shred rotation below** — staying in bleed mode against immune mobs is a large DPS loss: "as soon as bleed immune came, he just fell off a cliff, whereas I switched to p shift shred and carried on dishing out damage" — [Snkx (player), 2025-04-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128296#p128296).

### Powershift build (fallback / preferred by players who dislike bleed-tracking, and the only option on bleed-immune targets)
1. Shred to build combo points, using a powershift macro (cancel Cat Form → Furor grants energy on reshift → immediately back into Cat Form) whenever energy is capped/near-capped.
2. Ferocious Bite at 5 combo points.
3. Tiger's Fury when available for the attack-speed buff — note it **drops when you shift out**, so timing matters; several players requested it persist through shifting, unresolved as of the sources read — [Euromind (player), 2024-11-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107934#p107934).
4. Track debuff/buff-slot pressure in 40-man raids: Open Wounds' buff and multiple bleeds compete for the 32-buff client display cap, though Turtle's server-side debuff limit is 64 — [Thrank (player), 2024-11-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107806#p107806), countered by [Glowingfrom (player), 2024-11-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107899#p107899) that addon-visible tracking is still capped lower.

### Bleed-immunity map (Kara40, single source, useful for planning rotation switches mid-raid)
"In Naxx almost nothing is immune to bleeds (even things that should be, like skeletons)... Kara40 is where 'BUT MUH RP' bullcrap starts once again. And it's 50/50. Most things before Anomalus (3rd boss) are not immune, Anomalus is immune and so is everything after him until chess (5th boss). Trash after chess is still immune until the portal orb, where it isn't immune again... Except for Rupturan." — [Noephix (player), 2025-05-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132929#p132929).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown:
Feral DPS has **weak AoE and no dedicated Cat-form AoE tool** — a repeated community complaint with no fix in the sources:

- Swipe requires **Bear Form**; usable for 2-3 add packs but tanks-in-DPS-gear generate less rage than a real tank, so damage is capped and "even a rank 1 Arcane Explosion mage could out-DPS you here" — [Rmoruser (player), 2025-05-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132794#p132794).
- Hurricane exists but is a caster (Balance) spell that cat-itemized druids don't have the spell power to use effectively, and using it means leaving Cat Form entirely — same source.
- No AoE threshold or priority list is given by any source (**gap** — treat single-target rules as the default even on 2-3 targets, switching to Bear/Swipe only when explicitly asked to help with adds).

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Tiger's Fury**: core cooldown for both builds; grants an attack-speed buff (talented) and (1.18.0) baseline energy return over time; **drops on shapeshift**, a frequently-cited pain point for powershifters.
- **Berserk**: 6-minute cooldown, +100% energy regen in Cat Form (or +20% max HP in Bear); criticized as too long to be a reliable raid DPS cooldown compared to ~2-3 minute burst windows on other classes: "in Molten Core or Blackwing Lair, I can't use Berserk on every boss, while other classes can use their burst on nearly every pull" — [Rmoruser (player), 2025-05-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132703#p132703).
- **Energy management**: bleed build sustains via Ancient Brutality's per-tick energy return plus Idol of Laceration procs; powershift build sustains via Furor + a Wolfshead/Wolfsheart-enchanted helm converting mana to energy on shapeshift.
- **No mana concerns** in Cat Form itself; mana only matters if the player leaves form to heal/dispel, which is generally discouraged in DPS contexts — "if you're getting out of form to heal allies — you're doing it wrong. The correct move is almost always to stay in cat form" — [Noephix (player), 2025-04-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128292#p128292).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- **Positioning**: attack from behind for Shred/Rake's positional requirement (PvE trash may allow front-attacks depending on tank generosity; raid bosses generally require behind-tanking Feral to be positioned correctly by the tank).
- **Glancing blows**: unaddressed weapon-skill gap (see Stat priority) — factor this into damage expectations rather than trying to itemize around it (no gear-side fix exists).
- **Track bleeds with an addon**: server-side/native UI cannot reliably show more than 32 buffs/16 debuffs without addons; use Cursive, DoTimer or a SuperWoW-based tracker — [Inovatu (player), 2025-05-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132728#p132728).
- **Hybrid pressure**: raiding cats are pushed to also carry Bear survivability/tank talents "just in case," which is the direct cause of the talent-point starvation complaints above — plan a primary DPS build and accept that off-tank utility talents (Feral Charge, Feral Swiftness) may not fit.

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Idol of Laceration**: core bleed-build idol — finishers have a 20%-per-combo-point chance to refund 15 energy on the next Shred (also procs from Ferocious Bite) — [Rmoruser/Inovatu (players), 2025-05-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132703#p132703).
- **Wolfshead Helm / Wolfsheart enchant + Furor**: the historic powershifting enabler; still functional post-1.18.1, though the spec's overall power now leans bleed-first on non-immune content.
- **Feral Attack Power (FAP) items**: prioritize any item with FAP or high Str/Agi regardless of "weapon" flavor text, since forms use these as stat sticks; Turtle has "added Feral Attack Power on many of the more undesirable weapons" as a long-running itemization theme (official, [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102966#p102966)). 1.18.1 hotfixes: **Yoxtez** gained +224 FAP, and **Fang of Alichos** became usable in shapeshift forms ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608)).
- **A Kara40 armor-ignoring trinket was nerfed in 1.18.1** and is no longer a strong feral pick, per player report — "Feral is good only if you have a trinket from Kara40 that ignores enemy armor" / "You mean the one that got nerfed in the recent patch and no longer good for feral?" — [Zvyrhol, Noephix (players), 2026-03-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172992#p172992) (the trinket's name is not given in this thread — **gap**).
- **Weight/sharpening stones**: contested value post-CC2, discussed in dedicated threads (t7634, t16120) but not resolved with a clear consensus in the material read for this playbook — **gap**.
- Community (non-staff) DPS/gear tools: "Feral Druid DPS gear guide" Google Sheet linked from the wiki (`https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EXmDujdlPD_s7xrLKjcFykBJIW_hmMhwRhSXZWUkKBQ`), also referenced directly in-thread — [Drubarrymooer (player), 2025-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124910#p124910).
- **No pre-raid BiS list found in sources** — gap.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Playing bleed rotation on a bleed-immune target instead of switching to powershift/Shred (large DPS loss).
- Ignoring Idol of Laceration and other energy-return tools, then over-relying on powershifting.
- Rolling on/wearing high-Intellect T2.5/T3.5 pieces as if Intellect were a real DPS stat in PvE.
- Letting Tiger's Fury drop mid-fight by shifting carelessly.
- Not tracking bleed durations with an addon and clipping Rake/Rip early.
- Expecting cat to carry AoE pulls — switch to Bear/Swipe or let another class lead on 3+ targets.
- Under-gearing weapon skill/hit thinking it matters for form combat the same way it does for weapon users — it doesn't (form weapon skill is fixed at 300).

playbooks.title: Druid — Balance ranged DPS (Moonkin)
playbooks.intro: Playbook for the "Boomkin" caster DPS spec. Class Changes 2 (2024-10-12) gave Balance its defining **Eclipse** mechanic and a Moonfire/Insect-Swarm/Wrath/Starfire four-button rotation; 1.18.1 changed Eclipse's proc mechanism and reworked Balance of All Things and Moonfury, with the headline Eclipse proc-chance change landing in the 2026-03-19 revision of p=166071 — right at patch release, so post-1.18.1 forum reaction is thin (a handful of threads, most echoing the same author). Sources are unusually detailed for this spec: two long, well-reasoned single-author write-ups (Tarsis pre-1.18.1, Scattyau post-1.18.1-announcement) anchor most of the rotation and stat-priority detail below and are corroborated by many shorter replies.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: ranged caster DPS via Wrath/Starfire with Moonfire/Insect Swarm DoTs, built around the **Eclipse** capstone that grants a temporary damage buff to one school after landing a proc from the other. Brings raid utility: one of only two classes that can decurse, Moonkin Aura (crit aura), Innervate, and (with talents) a battle resurrection.
- **Strengths**: strong raid utility (see above); competitive-to-strong leveling and questing damage via Entangling Roots CC (see `leveling.md`); scales well with gear/crit into T3/T3.5 — "Really coming online around AQ40 gear and then really starts to ascend when you start hitting set bonuses in T3 and T3.5" — [Noobikscube (player), 2025-06-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134706#p134706).
- **Weaknesses (consensus)**: Eclipse's RNG punishes rather than rewards — "every single RNG talent feels like you have a ticking clock that is wasting away while you're locked into casting something else, or they're inconsequential until you just happened to NOT get them" — [Scattyau (player), 2025-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159149#p159149); mana-hungry rotation with more buttons than most casters; DoT ticks and Hurricane **do not proc trinket effects** (Scythe, Clackora, Sigil) even post-1.18.1's new Fortune stat — [Auralys (player), 2026-03-23/26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172021#p172021); no on-demand burst cooldown, unlike every other caster DPS spec.
- **Content**: raids (contested — see standing), leveling/solo (strong, see `leveling.md`), PvP (see Role strategy and `balance-pvp.md`), dungeon AoE trash (weak — see Multi-target).
- **Community standing — pre-1.18.1**: **contested**, split between "competitive with proper play" and "structurally bottom-tier." "Balance Druid DPS is bottom of the DPS tier... its literally bottom of the barrel, not even mediocre" — [Halfgeek9 (player), 2025-05-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131905#p131905), citing top Kara40 boomkin logs around 940 DPS against top-mage logs around 1200-1400. Counter: "the class scales incredibly well... anyone saying Boomkin is bottom of the barrel is misinformed" with logs showing "12th/93 highest among all casters and 34th/230 across all dps" for the week cited — [Noobikscube (player), 2025-06-08/10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134706#p134706). A full-BIS Boomkin at perfect (impossible) 100% Eclipse-proc play was calculated to still lose to an average-geared Fire Shaman on a target dummy — [Scattyau (player), 2025-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159149#p159149) (**single detailed source, heavily agreed-with in replies but not independently log-verified**).
- **Community standing — post-1.18.1**: worse, largely because the Starfire-cast-time nerf inside the reworked Balance of All Things landed alongside the Eclipse proc-chance change: "we lost 20% spell haste on Starfire for 9% crit that doesn't scale eclipse - 3 second starfires feel like complete shit" — [Froghijab420 (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172180#p172180). "1.18.1 moonkin rework was supposed to be a slight buff — but ended up being ~15% dps nerf to already low-tier spec, resulting in moonkin becoming the worst 'proper' dps spec in the game. Below even cat" — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173102#p173102) (**single source, uncorroborated with logs**). A T3-geared main "parked" their boomkin in Orgrimmar after trying the new rotation once — [Trevor89 (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173305#p173305).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
No source decodes a full 60-point list; the shape given by the deepest post-CC2 write-up:

- **~35-38 points committed to core Balance talents** (all damage/hit/crit/range/cast-time/Moonkin Form/Balance of All Things/Eclipse talents) with only **2-3 flex points**, split between **Gale Winds** (raid AoE-slow utility, no personal damage) and **Guidance of the Dream** (interrupt/pushback avoidance — even fully talented it "still brings you to 76% during an enraged owlkin proc, so you still get pushback") — [Scattyau (player), 2025-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159149#p159149).
- **~13 points into Restoration for Genesis** ("+5/10/15% periodic damage/healing," reduced from an 18-point requirement in an earlier revision) — same source.
- **Moonfury** is criticized as a weak early investment ("flat damage early in the tree on a tier with 10 other points") that a redesign should fold into Moonkin Form — same source; **official 1.18.1 change increased its bonus to 4/8/12%** ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-26 revision](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)), so this specific complaint predates and is partially answered by the patch.
- **Leveling/PvP variants differ** — see `leveling.md` and `balance-pvp.md` for their own point orders (30-0-21 caster-kite PvP build, 19-11-21 melee-hybrid PvP build, and various leveling links).
- No source links a decoded talents.turtlecraft.gg calculator string for the current 60 raid build (**gap**, same limitation noted throughout every other Druid role and the paladin playbook).

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- **Crit over Haste, strongly**: "1% crit equal to around 4-5% Haste. It might even be worse" because Haste only affects Starfire (the two DoTs don't scale with it, and Wrath's cast time is already GCD-capped at 0 haste under the pre-1.18.1 spell-haste GCD rules), while Crit "triple-dips by increasing damage per cast, proccing Nature's Grace for far better haste, and also increasing the Eclipse multiplier" — [Scattyau (player), 2025-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159149#p159149) (a correction noted in the same thread: the spell GCD floor is 1.0s base / 0.5s talented, so Haste still benefits Wrath somewhat, but the crit-over-haste ranking stands). Item design nonetheless loads Balance gear (Atiesh, T3 8-set) with Haste — same source, calling this a mismatch.
- **Hit**: notably hard to reach cap from set gear alone — "on the entire 9 piece T3 set, there is only 4% spell hit. Unless you go out of your way to use Loetheb's staff or the regalia staff from AQ40, I'm not even sure we CAN get to hit cap" — [Dalijon (player), 2024-11-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110618#p110618); several top players "sacrific[e] a few % of hit (even on bosses) for better crit chance" as a deliberate trade — [kierova (player), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135108#p135108). A post-1.18.1 complaint asks for Natural Weapons to give 10% spell hit instead of the melee-oriented split it currently has — [Jizzus (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172261#p172261) (**single source suggestion, not an implemented change**).
- **Spell power**: baseline scaling stat, no numeric weight given (**gap**).
- **No numeric caps given for spell penetration** (**gap**, unlike the general vanilla-baseline figures cited elsewhere; not from Turtle sources).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown:
The rotation is **consensus in shape**, contested only in feel/reward:

1. Apply and maintain **Moonfire** and **Insect Swarm** on the target (both extended to 18-second durations under Class Changes 2).
2. Chain-cast **Wrath** while "fishing" for a Lunar Eclipse proc, or **Starfire** while fishing for a Nature Eclipse proc, depending on which Eclipse buff you currently hold or are chasing: "Previously, the balance druid rotation was keeping up moonfire (1st button) and pressing starfire (2nd button)... The current balance druid rotation is moonfire (1st), insect swarm (2nd), wrath (3rd), starfire (4th)" — [kierova (player), 2025-06-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134911#p134911).
3. **Eclipse proc mechanics** — this changed twice:
   - Pre-1.18.1 (1.18.0 rework, per `synthesis/turtle-vs-vanilla-timeline.md`): Wrath crits/hits had a 30% chance and Starfire a 50% chance to proc their Eclipse buff, worth "10% + 60% of spell crit" bonus damage rather than a flat 25/30%.
   - **1.18.1 (official, revision dated 2026-03-19)**: "Damage from Wrath now has a 40% chance and Damage from Starfire now has a 60% chance to proc their beneficial effects" — [Jamey (staff), 2026-03-19 revision of p166071](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
   - Each Eclipse buff lasts 15 seconds with a separate 30-second cooldown per school; both cannot be active simultaneously.
4. **Stopcasting**: because Eclipse windows are short and the proc can land mid-cast, "optimal gameplay" frequently means cancelling a cast already in progress to switch to the newly-buffed spell rather than let the current cast finish and waste part of the window — described as the single biggest "feel" complaint about the spec both pre- and post-1.18.1 — [Tarsis (player), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135044#p135044); [Auralys (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172020#p172020).
5. **Balance of All Things** (3 points as of 1.18.1, down from 5): Wrath cast on an Insect-Swarm'd target refunds 10/20/30% of its mana cost; Starfire gets a +3/6/9% (revised 2026-01-26 from an initial 2/4/6%) crit-chance bonus against a Moonfire'd target — [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23/26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). Community verdict pre-revision: "There is so much to hate here... they recharge randomly and unpredictably, with a 30% [chance] on each DOT tick" — [Scattyau (player), 2025-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159149#p159149).
6. **DoT-refresh tension**: because Insect Swarm and Moonfire have near-identical durations and both accumulate procs, optimal play sometimes clips one DoT early to refresh it under an active Eclipse bonus, desyncing the two — same source.

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **Hurricane** is the AoE tool (channeled, spell-power scaling, cooldown halved under CC2); weak for fast-dying open-world trash because mobs often die before Eclipse/DoT setup pays off — "Mob killing in open world, they die too fast to fully benefit from Eclipse... you spend the majority of your time with a -30% damage debuff" — [Tarsis (player), 2025-06-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135251#p135251).
- Same author notes trash-pack dotting requires first spamming Wrath to trigger the Lunar Eclipse before Moonfire application pays off, by which point trash is often already dead — same source.
- No raid-AoE priority list or target threshold given by any source (**gap**).

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **No on-demand burst cooldown** — repeatedly cited as the spec's single biggest structural gap versus every other caster: "unlike others, we don't even have a real burst cooldown to stabilize our damage or create a strong window" — [Auralys (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172020#p172020); "any other class have dps cooldowns on demand that they can use at the correct time during a fight... the moonkin doesnt" — [Tarsis (player), 2025-06-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135618#p135618).
- **Mana management**: consumables carry the spec through fights (see Gear below); Sylvan Blessing (100% mana regen while casting after a kill, 15s) helps while leveling/questing; Innervate is a group-support cooldown, generally given to healers rather than self-used in raids per general Druid etiquette threads (see `restoration-healer.md`).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- **Raid utility**: one of only two decurse classes; brings Moonkin Aura (crit) and, if talented, battle rez and mana return to a healer. Several posters argue the spec's raid value should be judged on this utility, not the damage meter alone — "By design the Druid identity IS THE support class... he supports other classes with auras and spells, if a key player dies he can resurrect him, restore mana to a healer that ran out, removes curses and poisons" — [Tarsis (player), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135044#p135044) (**contested** — opposing view: "Boomkin in raid goes pew pew, and damage meter numbers good so moonkin in exceptional spot" is dismissed by the same author as insufficient justification).
- **PvP**: see `balance-pvp.md` for the dedicated dot-kite build and rotation; Eclipse is widely reported as far weaker in PvP than PvE because sustained standing-still casting invites interrupts and burst — "if you want to heal and is not arcane damage boost time your opponent doesn't have to choose between interrupting your damage or wait for your heal/cc to go off, he just interrupts your nature school and you are stuck with the arcane school that now does 30% less damage" — [Tarsis (player), 2025-04-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126009#p126009).
- **Dungeon healing flex**: full Balance can competently heal 5-mans if geared for it — "Every druid spec can heal without a problem up to late game dungeons so long as you have spare gear for it. As a balance druid you get caster gear anyways so that isn't even a problem to worry about" — [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-04-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126323#p126323).

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- **Idols**: two named options, contested trade-off. A BoE idol giving "17% Moonfire damage that scales with Spellpower" is calculated as roughly a 4% total-DPS gain (Moonfire being ~22% of total damage) and is called "BIS forever" despite a low market price (~20g at time of posting); the alternative, **Ebb and Flow** (reduces Starfire cast time), "feels great casting faster Starfires" but is calculated as weaker in practice since Starfire is "our 4th best spell" — [Scattyau (player), 2025-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159149#p159149).
- **Consumables** (consensus list for raid mana sustain): Major Mana Potion, Nordanaar Herbal Tea, Dark Rune, Innervate, Nightfin Soup, Mageblood Potion — [kierova (player), 2025-06-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134911#p134911); corroborated (mana/dark rune/tea) by [Jizzus (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172261#p172261) for the post-1.18.1 patch.
- **T3/T3.5 tier set**: hit budget is thin (only 4% spell hit across the full T3 set — see Stat priority); the T3.5 5-piece Wrath-mana-refund synergy with Balance of All Things "increases this lacklustre effect by 50%, so you can feel so little, slightly more! Drop your Wrath down to 37 mana, 3 times!" (sarcastic) — [Scattyau (player), 2025-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159149#p159149).
- **Twink/leveling gear list**: a dedicated "49 Balance Druid — Twink talents and Gear list" thread exists (t16360) but was not read in depth for this playbook — **gap, follow up if a twinking guide is needed**.
- **No full pre-raid BiS list found in sources** — gap, consistent with every other Druid role covered here.
- Community (non-staff) tools: "Balance Druid DPS Calculator" Google Sheet and a `pbrigade.gitlab.io` gear-planner link with a pre-built Balance Druid BiS export are both linked from the wiki (`extracted/wiki/articles/Druid.md`) — community-maintained, not staff-verified.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Standing still to hard-cast Starfire in PvP — invites interrupts and burst; use the hit-n-run pattern from `balance-pvp.md` instead.
- Letting a cast finish after an Eclipse proc lands mid-cast instead of cancelling and switching (a real, if unintuitive, DPS gain).
- Gearing pure spell-power/haste while ignoring the crit-over-haste relationship and the thin hit budget on tier gear.
- Treating trash-pack Moonfire/Hurricane as free AoE — most trash dies before the DoT/Eclipse investment pays off.
- Assuming DoT ticks or Hurricane will proc on-hit trinkets (Scythe, Clackora, Sigil, Fortune-stat items) — they don't.
- Judging the spec purely on the damage meter without accounting for decurse/utility uptime, which several sources argue is core to the spec's actual raid value.

playbooks.title: Druid — Balance PvP (Moonkin dot-kite)
playbooks.intro: PvP-specific playbook for Balance Druid, split out from `balance-ranged-dps.md` because the sources treat PvP Moonkin as a distinct build and playstyle from the PvE Eclipse rotation. Sources are **medium**: one dedicated build/rotation thread plus scattered standing complaints from the general Balance threads and the post-1.18.1 class-standing threads.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: hit-and-run dot-kiter — apply Moonfire/Insect Swarm, root/kite melee, land opportunistic Wraths, off-heal with HoTs; not a stand-and-cast caster.
- **Standing — contested, leaning weak**: "Out of all three hybrids, druids are at the bottom of the list in pvp, moonkins especially — mediocre damage, no good def buttons, super weak against other casters. Cats aren't bad though" — [Turboman (player), 2025-11-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160309#p160309). Countered narrowly: "the only caster moonkin is weak to is shadow priest, id like to see a mage fight a moonkin (protip, they cant)" — [Springboards (player), 2025-11-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160430#p160430). Post-1.18.1, a general-standing thread calls Balance/Moonkin PvP "crispy chips for all other twow classes, almost no survivability" with mana draining in seconds if trying to self-heal — [Mistikkk (player), 2026-03-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172568#p172568). A separate feedback thread notes the Eclipse capstone specifically underperforms in PvP because opponents can simply interrupt whichever school is currently buffed and leave the druid stuck doing 30% less damage with the other — [Tarsis (player), 2025-04-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126009#p126009).
- **Content**: Arathi Basin / Alterac Valley flag/objective play (Druid is called out as especially strong here — see Role strategy), open-world/duel PvP (weak per the sources above), arena (not covered — gap).
- **Post-1.18.1 confirmation that the dot-kite build remains the standard**: "the only balance [...] spec really is the 30/0/21 for pvp (which is the best balance spec for pvp)" — [Froghijab420 (player), 2026-03-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172460#p172460) (**single source**, but consistent with the pre-1.18.1 build guidance below).
- **Moonfire damage reality check**: a claim that "t3 boomkins hit for 600-700 moonfires in pvp" was disputed by a self-described moonkin PvP main: "No they don't, you'd a full spellpower build to deal 450-500 moonfire dmg with all enchantments and such (and even that is nothing in comparison to others), and thats a bad way to pvp as moonkin because unlike other glass cannons, druids don't have meaningful defensive buttons like shields, hard cc or useful pets" — [Turboman (player), 2025-11-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160309#p160309).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
Two named PvP variants, both pre-1.18.1 (talent tree structurally unchanged by 1.18.1, so still applicable):

- **Classic 30-0-21 dot-kite build** (most-used): [https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/druid?points=pgCDYCFYBIAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAooADJDCIAAAAAA=](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143254#p143254) — "you dot up your opponent, kite him, stop him with roots and occasionally throw a few wraths. You can move 4 points from Nature's Grasp to Omen [of Clarity]" — [Turboman (player), 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143254#p143254).
- **19-11-21 melee-hybrid build** (situational, guild/premade play): [https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/druid?points=pACbQKAAAAAAAAFACYBAAAAAAAAAAooADJDCIAAAAAA=](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143254#p143254) — "You get increased stun, armor and charge but lose moonkin form and other spell bonuses for a more 'upclose' gameplay. I rarely use it, usually when i play in a team with guildies" — same source.
- A third, mana/Wrath-efficiency-leaning suggestion (30% arcane damage + 50% less mana for Wrath via Balance of All Things, plus Swiftmend for an instant heal) was floated but rejected by the thread as too PvE-standing-still-oriented for real PvP: "if you're freecasting and not being targeted [it's good]. But this is PVP, the more movement and utility you get trumps these PVE abilities" — [Thaladar (player), 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143211#p143211), responding to [Maximage (player), 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143201#p143201).
- **Feral Charge and a 5-point Resto Furor investment** are recommended over the last two rows of the Balance tree for PvP, since standing still to benefit from PvE-oriented capstones is rarely realistic in PvP — [Thaladar (player), 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143211#p143211).
- **Resto-side PvP points**: a 1-point Swiftmend and a 1-point Nature's Swiftness are recommended as the Restoration-tree component of a PvP Balance build for an emergency instant heal, per a post-1.18.1 build note (**single source, not independently corroborated**) — Froghijab420, referenced in the same 2026-03-25 post as the 30/0/21 confirmation above.
- **Numeric PvP tier estimate (1=worst, 5=best, pre-1.18.1, self-assigned, single source)**: Moonkin rated BG 3/Arena 2 pre-Class-Changes-2, rising to BG 4/Arena 3 post-CC2 — [Templar85 (player), 2024-05-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95354#p95354).
- Race note: Tauren's War Stomp is cited as a flag-carrier defensive combo with Regrowth ("stomp + Entangling Roots on a warrior/rogue, then travel form away has secured many flag caps") — [Jammyxx (player), 2023-03-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=36461#p36461); consistent with the general Tauren-for-PvP-minmax guidance in `leveling.md`.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- **Stamina-first**: opponents specifically want Stamina stripped from Holy/healing-capable PvP druids to be able to burst them down (parallel complaint from the general PvP standing thread, applies to Balance's off-heal capacity too — see `restoration-pvp.md` for the fuller version of this argument). No numeric weight given (**gap**).
- **Avoid full spellpower/glass-cannon itemization**: "Trying to go full spd is silly because you lose survivability against melee foes and never reach the dmg output of other casters (meaning they will out dps you in a duel with ease). Moonkins play best if they stack stam and certain set bonuses for attrition fights" — [Turboman (player), 2025-11-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160309#p160309).

roleStrategy.heading: Rotation / tactics
roleStrategy.markdown:
> "Moonkin's gameplay is basically a hit-n-run, you dot up enemies, throw a couple of wraths, kite and root, while keeping up your hots. Never try to play moonkin as a pure caster, nobody with half a brain will let you just stand there and cast away your starfires" — [Turboman (player), 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143254#p143254), confirmed by direct experience: "I tried to play as a caster mage and deep balance... i was targeted and depopped. No time to cast. Better off dot kite and off heal here and there" — [Reekharh (player), 2025-09-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150002#p150002).

1. Open at range with Moonfire/Insect Swarm to establish DoT pressure.
2. Root the target (Entangling Roots) and/or kite using Travel Form or terrain; reapply roots as they break.
3. Fire off Wrath opportunistically when safe to cast, rather than committing to a stand-and-cast pattern.
4. Off-heal (Rejuvenation/Regrowth) between DoT applications to sustain through the fight; do not expect to out-damage a focused-fire opponent through casting alone.
5. Against warlocks specifically: survive the initial burst (Conflagrate/Soulfire/Shadowburn), then disengage and harass with DoTs once their burst cooldowns are spent, since the warlock must close to melee range for Shadowburn — [Springboards (player), 2025-11-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160430#p160430) (**single source, one matchup only**).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Standing and hard-casting like a Mage/Warlock instead of using the dot-kite loop — the single most-repeated warning in the sources.
- Itemizing for maximum spell power/damage instead of Stamina and attrition-survival stats.
- Committing to the 30-0-21 build's PvE-flavored capstones as if they were reliable in open-field PvP.

playbooks.title: Druid — Feral PvP (Cat/Bear toolkit)
playbooks.intro: PvP-specific playbook for Feral Druid. Sources are **weak-to-medium**: one older (2024, pre-Class-Changes-2) "unkillable" toolkit thread whose talent build is superseded, plus post-1.18.1 case-study complaints that are detailed but single-author. Treat the tactical toolkit description (HoTs + bleeds + interrupts + dispel) as durable, and the specific talent build/power level as outdated.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: dual-form PvP — Cat Form for burst/openers (stealth Pounce/Ravage), Bear Form for survivability/CC-immunity windows and Charge-interrupts, with the caster kit (HoTs, dispel, roots) available whenever untransformed. **Two distinct sub-roles** are treated separately in the sources: objective play (Bear as flag carrier/point defender) and 1v1/duel power (weaker, see below).
- **Objective play — consensus strong, the spec's clearest PvP niche**: "10k+ HP, Frenzied Regen, double the armor of a warrior, and being able to shift in and out of forms to dispel movement debuffs makes them by far the best flag carriers in WSG and also very good point defenders in AB. Feral Charge has half the cooldown of warrior Intercept" — [Jstansberry (player), 2023-10-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=74040#p74040). "Feral is a top tier Blood Ring pick and hard counters most melees" — [Gantulga (player), 2023-11-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=75762#p75762). Still cited post-1.18.1-announcement: "Druid is the strongest class in the game for carrying flag in warsong, and so highly sought after in premades" — [amanagor (player), 2026-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165799#p165799).
- **1v1/duel power — consensus weak** (pre-Class-Changes-2 assessment, not re-tested post-CC2 in sources): "Feral Druid is C-tier in PVP. They can last a long time no doubt, but lack finishing power. And their Cat/Bear forms are lacking in generally useful abilities such as an interrupt" — [Manletow (player), 2023-10-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=73796#p73796). "The class has no meaningful cc and only has a delayed interrupt... it cannot use pots/trinkets/etc without breaking form. These things alone make the class C-tier" — [Mackylol (player), 2023-11-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=76016#p76016) (note: the consumables-in-form restriction this cites was removed under Class Changes 2, so this specific complaint is now stale). A pre-1.18.1 numeric tier estimate (1=worst, 5=best) rates Bear BG 5/Arena 5 pre-CC2 dropping to BG 3/Arena 3-4 post-CC2, and Cat BG 2-3/Arena 1-2 pre-CC2 rising to BG 3/Arena 2-3 post-CC2 — [Templar85 (player), 2024-05-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95354#p95354) and [2024-11-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110263#p110263) (**single source, self-assigned tier letters, not independently corroborated**).
- **Bear-form damage reality (pre-CC2, directionally still cited post-1.18.1 given the Savage Bite nerfs)**: "Bear hits like a wet noodle... paladin will cut through your armor with Holy Strike and casters nuke you down as bear" — [Grizb37 (player), 2024-05-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95356#p95356), who also notes Cat is usually forced into Bear anyway once focused: "in PvP Feral is forced into bear because everyone seems to focus you as cat" — same source.
- **Standing — contested, trending negative post-1.18.1**: Pre-Class-Changes-2, a player argued a geared druid using its "whole toolkit" (HoTs, bleeds, Innervate, charge-interrupts, dispel) could out-sustain most non-burst classes 1v1 — [Zahnfee (player), 2024-01-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84932#p84932) — but this was disputed in the same thread ("with the talent tree you posted you get raped by lots of classes" — [Holyhorrorr (player), 2024-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84979#p84979)) and a Ret Paladin burst combo (Holy Strike → Seal of Command → Judgement, then Hammer of Justice → Repentance to lock out Frenzied Regen) was given as a hard counter — [Springboards (player), 2024-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84993#p84993). Post-1.18.1, standing is reported as much worse for the Bear half of the toolkit specifically: "Feral is dogshit in PvP mate... they nerfed Bear into the ground so its basically just a punching bag, and does zero damage, because of the Savage Bite nerf back in December" — [Grizb37 (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171995#p171995). A detailed multi-matchup case study (vs. Ele/Enh Shaman, Assassination Rogue, Demo/Affliction Lock, Discipline Priest) concludes Feral can barely bring any of these opponents below 50% HP even when opening the fight, while taking devastating burst in return — [Wosator (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171992#p171992) (**single detailed source, contested in-thread**: "you don't have slow target and stun target (cat)... you are really bad at pvp, twow make druid from a meme class to top 1 pvp class" — [shadowchaos (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172071#p172071)).
- **Content**: dueling/open-world (contested, see above), BG objective play (Cat specifically called out as strong for stealth flag-running — see Role strategy); arena not covered (**gap**).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
- The only full build link in sources is Zahnfee's 2024 "unkillable" build ([https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/druid/P23I6-U2I6-5X36JU](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84932#p84932)), which uses the **pre-Class-Changes-2 talent tree format** (`talents.turtlecraft.gg/druid/<code>` rather than the current `talents.turtlecraft.gg/druid?points=<code>`) and is **superseded** — do not use as-is.
- General post-CC2 guidance (no full point list given): "Better to go full feral with omen for burst dmg, can destroy casters with ravage/shred high Crit chance... by not going HotW you lose alot of HP in bear and mana pool. Also lose 11% Crit from talents + not having the speed increase in cat form is annoying in PVP" — [Grizb37 (player), 2024-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=85018#p85018) — i.e. **Heart of the Wild and Feral Swiftness are treated as PvP essentials**, alongside Omen of Clarity for burst sustain.
- **No decoded post-1.18.1 PvP build found** — gap.

roleStrategy.heading: Rotation / tactics
roleStrategy.markdown:
The toolkit described (pre-CC2 source, mechanically still available but power level not re-verified against current numbers):

- **Openers**: Pounce (stealth stun) or Ravage (heavy frontloaded damage from stealth) from Cat Form.
- **Sustain loop**: HoTs (Rejuvenation/Regrowth) plus Innervate to out-heal non-burst damage; dispel poisons/curses/magic by shifting form (form-shift clears the effect) — "i ll insta outheal your damage with swiftmend, charge interrupt your drain or fear cast whenever i can and wait for you to be oom while dotting you up" — [Zahnfee (player), 2024-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84976#p84976).
- **Interrupts**: Feral Charge (stun + gap-close, ~15-second cooldown pre-CC2 per [Zahnfee (player), 2024-01-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84932#p84932)) used proactively against casters mid-cast, not just defensively; "Bear has both Feral Charge and Bash to interrupt" — [Jstansberry (player), 2023-10-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=74040#p74040), disputed as "not reliable interrupts" by [Manletow (player), 2023-10-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=73796#p73796).
- **Bear Form flag-carrier loop (WSG/AB objective play)**: pick up the flag/hold the point in Bear Form with HoTs pre-applied; shift in and out of forms specifically to shake movement-impairing debuffs/snares (a form-shift clears them); use Frenzied Regeneration when focused, but manage rage carefully — "Be careful with that bearheal, it eats all you rage" — [Frantsel (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156428#p156428); post-Class-Changes-2 Frenzied Regeneration was reported healing "around 25% health" with full rage — [Xfraz (player), 2024-11-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107713#p107713); use Travel Form (or Swift Travel Form once trained, see `leveling.md`) to disengage and run once clear.
- **Bear Form as a panic button (duel/arena context)**: switch to Bear to survive burst, apply Demoralizing Roar, and re-engage once healed — general pattern referenced across multiple threads, not a single dedicated source. **Do not expect to kill anything while sitting in Bear** — it is a survival/objective tool, not a damage tool, per the Bear-damage-reality quotes above.
- **Post-1.18.1 caution**: Bear-form damage output specifically is reported as gutted by the cumulative Savage Bite nerfs (Dec-2024 threat/damage trims plus the 1.18.1 threat-modifier cut), so leaning on Bear for offense rather than pure defense/CC-break/objective-holding is no longer supported by the sources — [Grizb37 (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171995#p171995).
- **1.18.1 system-wide PvP change**: the PvP Dampening debuff (introduced 1.18.0) became class/spec-dependent instead of a flat number for all classes in 1.18.1, intended to let staff tune viability per spec without player-target exceptions — official ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)); exact Feral-specific dampening values are not published in the sources read (**gap**).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Relying on the pre-Class-Changes-2 "unkillable" build/expectations without accounting for the talent tree rework and subsequent nerfs.
- Trying to out-damage burst classes (Rogue openers, Warlock fear→dot→drain chains, Paladin Holy Strike/Seal of Command burst) in a straight damage race instead of using the CC-break/heal/disengage loop.
- Neglecting Heart of the Wild and Feral Swiftness in a PvP build — cited as essential for both HP/mana pool and cat-form mobility.
- Expecting Bear Form to carry offense post-1.18.1; treat it as a defensive/CC-immunity/objective-holding tool only until further nerfs are walked back or countered by gear.
- Sitting in Bear Form expecting to actually kill an opponent, rather than using it purely to survive/hold an objective.
- Dumping all rage into Frenzied Regeneration when Maul/Bash still need it for pressure or interrupts.
