playbooks.title: Druid — Restoration PvP (battleground/arena healer)
playbooks.intro: PvP-specific playbook for Restoration Druid, split out because the forum treats "can a Resto druid survive a Rogue" as its own extensively-discussed topic distinct from PvE healing. Sources are **medium**: one long (31-post), detailed thread anchors most of the tactical advice, corroborated by several shorter threads and the general PvP-standing complaints.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: point/flag defense healer and off-healer in battlegrounds and 2v2/3v3 arena; expected to survive burst from stealth classes long enough for peels or to disengage, not to solo-win fights.
- **Standing — consensus negative, especially vs. Rogues**: "There is no chance for solo surviving same geared rogue as resto druid. Druids hasn't any form of control against rogue and cant heal because just stuck in bear form. Even tree cant help... Rogues are totally broken atm" — [Aristany (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156423#p156423). "TL;DR No, you won't survive, even in res gear" against an Envenom-specced Rogue, even playing the full defensive sequence perfectly — [Turboman (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157409#p157409). Post-1.18.1: "Just accept your fate that you are just a pinata for other classes to feast on you... resto and feral are just garbage" — [Wosator (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171999#p171999). One rogue-perspective counter-argument frames this as working as intended: "Rogues have essentially no aoe and no range, and are the worst class in the game by a 1000 miles when caught out of stealth... How exactly would you balance the scenario given the full scope of the game?" — [Scelus12 (player), 2025-10-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156346#p156346).
- **Content**: Battleground point/graveyard/flag defense (viable with team support), 2v2/3v3 arena (reported as very difficult solo — see Rotation/tactics), open-world ganking survival (weak vs. Rogues specifically).
- **Standing beyond the Rogue matchup**: "Resto Druid is bottom tier (but still viable as all Healers are desirable)" — [Manletow (player), 2024-05-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95352#p95352). A numeric pre-1.18.1 tier estimate (1=worst, 5=best, single source, self-assigned) rates Tree/Resto-healer among the lowest PvP specs in the class: BG 1-2/Arena 1 pre-Class-Changes-2, improving only to BG 2/Arena 1 post-CC2 — [Templar85 (player), 2024-05-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95354#p95354). A separate complaint (pre-1.18.1, Alliance-side) notes shaman Purge and priest dispel "making all our HoT spells basically useless" against organized opponents — [Elleshar (player), 2024-05-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95318#p95318) (**single source, faction-specific, not re-verified for 1.18.1**).
- **Burst-heal gap**: after cycling through Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Nature's Swiftness/Healing Touch and Swiftmend, one detailed poster reports being left with no further emergency option beyond continuing to spam Regrowth — "I'm left with basically one option: spam Regrowth" — [Thaladar (player), 2025-10-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156271#p156271); no source offers a resolution to this gap.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown:
**No dedicated, endorsed Resto-PvP point list found in sources** (gap) — the general Restoration talent guidance in `restoration-healer.md` applies, adjusted for survivability. One hybrid-healer build was posted as a question, not an endorsed recommendation: [https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/druid?points=BgAbAIAAAAAAAAAoaABAAAAAAAAAAotADNDAIAAAAAA=](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131891#p131891) — [Krltbr (player), 2025-05-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131891#p131891).

- A **4-piece PvP set bonus is treated as mandatory regardless of overall gear level**, specifically for its movement-speed component: "4 piece is kinda crucial to survive. I would always use 4 piece pvp set even if you have better gear. The speed bonus will save your life MANY times" — [Frantsel (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156428#p156428); "the R13 pvp set 3p bonus is a must for any druid spec" — [Turboman (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157409#p157409) (two different set-bonus thresholds cited by two players — **not reconciled in sources**).

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- **Stamina over Resilience, per one detailed report**: "Focus on stamina gear over anything else" — [Frantsel (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156428#p156428); a fully Kara-geared, all-stam-enchanted, titan-flasked player still couldn't survive an Envenom rogue's opener even with a perfect defensive sequence, concluding "resilience won't save you btw" — [Turboman (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157409#p157409). **Contested/unresolved** whether Resilience is simply undervalued in these reports or genuinely weak against the specific burst discussed (Dissolvent Poison damage, separately flagged as likely to be hotfixed — [marvian (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157341#p157341)).
- **Stealth detection stacking** (situational, not a raw combat stat but relevant to avoiding openers): Catseye Goggles (+18), Catseye Elixir (+10), the Druid PvP-rank gloves (+10, `https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=16448`), and the "Dyad of Twitching Elf Ears" (+10) sum to roughly +58 stealth detection, "just over perception which is +50"; teaming with a Human Warlock running Paranoia can push this over +100 — [Blackduck4 (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157346#p157346).

roleStrategy.heading: Rotation / tactics
roleStrategy.markdown:
A full defensive opener sequence against a Rogue (single detailed source, **contested — even executed perfectly it reportedly still loses to a geared Envenom rogue**):

> "LAP, fairy fire, NG, Barkskin, rejuv, motw-regrowth (optional), moonfire/swarm and then create distance. I also keep crunchy bread for blind removal... Problem is — even if i perform this line of counter actions perfectly — the rogue (envenom one) can simply outdamage everything i do." — [Turboman (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157464#p157464)

1. Pre-shield/pre-HoT before an expected engagement if possible (Rejuvenation, Barkskin).
2. **Save the PvP trinket specifically for the Kidney Shot**, not the opening Cheap Shot/Ambush stun — "save trinket for kidney-shot" is the repeated, agreed-on answer — [Scelus12 (player), 2025-10-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156369#p156369); confirmed by [Thaladar (player), 2025-10-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156353#p156353). Caveat: post-1.18.1, trinketing the Kidney Shot lets the Rogue immediately Blind and reset instead, since Blind became a physical (non-magic) debuff and can no longer be cleared by Abolish Poison after trinketing — [Isvya (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157381#p157381).
3. **Shift to Bear Form** as soon as a Rogue engagement is expected or in progress — repeatedly cited as close to mandatory: "you need to be in bearform no matter what or you're dead" — [Thaladar (player), 2025-10-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156345#p156345); "Be in bearform or stealth if you expect to be attacked" — [Frantsel (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156428#p156428). Trade-off: Bear Form locks out healing, so this is a survive-then-disengage tool, not a way to win the fight.
4. Use Feral Charge to stun and create separation, or Nature's Grasp/roots if the Rogue is chasing after Sprint — [Frantsel (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156428#p156428).
5. Demoralizing Roar can pull a stealthed Rogue out of stealth pre-emptively — [Xudo (player), 2025-10-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156325#p156325).
6. **Do not expect to solo-survive** — "not be alone" (grouping with allies who will peel) is explicitly called good advice specifically because a healer's team has a strong incentive to protect it — [Xudo (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156405#p156405).
7. In arena specifically, expect layered CC (Blind chains, engineering Scare Beast/FAP bombs) once an opponent adapts past a first attempt — "he even resorted to using FAP + scare beast engi bombs to force me into being CCd, whereby he had 2x blinds on the ready should I use trinket to help heal my allies" — [Thaladar (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157335#p157335), who concluded 2v2 arena as Resto felt "completely unwinnable" against a competent Rogue.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Fighting in caster form against a Rogue instead of shifting to Bear at the first sign of an engagement.
- Trinketing the opening stun instead of saving it for Kidney Shot.
- Assuming Resilience alone solves Rogue burst — multiple detailed reports say it doesn't, at least against Envenom-spec Rogues in the sources' gear range.
- Queuing solo into arena as Restoration without a coordinated partner who can peel.
- Skipping the 3-4 piece PvP set bonus in favor of higher-item-level PvE pieces — the set's speed/survivability bonus is reported as more valuable than the raw stat upgrade.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: Compiled from Druid-forum leveling threads. The dominant, near-unanimous recommendation is to level as **Feral (Cat, with detours into Bear for AoE/elites)**; Balance and a hybrid tank/heal build are viable alternatives with their own trade-offs. No source gives a full zone-by-zone route or a level-by-level skill-training table with exact gold costs, so those sections are thinner than the build/playstyle guidance — flagged as gaps below.

sections.heading: Which build
sections.markdown:
- **Feral (favored/consensus)**: fastest solo leveling and the standard recommendation for anyone planning to tank dungeons along the way. "Grinding dungeons doesnt help you level faster. At all. Open world grinding and quests especially when rested and using tents... will level you faster than any dungeon will... The reason for that is simple: feral druids dont scale with gear, much at all. Your forms will carry you level to level especially once you get cat form" — [Biggamehuntard (player), 2026-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170843#p170843).
- **Full Balance (viable alternative)**: "Moonkin for me is the most enjoyable to level, because as long as your enemy is not immune to Entangling Roots, he is dead" — [Tarsis (player), 2025-04-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126107#p126107). Slower than Cat due to mana regen downtime but considered "nice" and can heal any dungeon along the way — [Ironbob (player), 2025-02-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119155#p119155); [Bigsmerf (player), 2025-04-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126323#p126323).
- **Hybrid tank/heal (dungeon-focused)**: recommended specifically for Hardcore or anyone planning to level primarily in dungeon groups, since Resto is hard to solo-level and tanks are always in demand: "I'd suggest leveling as tank if you want to make your life easier. It's very hard to level as Resto and tanks are in short supply" — [Cyrin23 (player), 2024-11-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107212#p107212).
- **Race — contested**: "Night elf is true druidic race, tauren is a gimmick introduced for balancing reasons. If you're a pvp minmaxer = then choose tauren, everything else = night elf" — [Turboman (player), 2026-01-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165651#p165651), countered by "Tauren is always the better option due to their racial ability that grants 5% extra Stamina, which are tanks most important stat. Tauren also have a much bigger bear form model" for a tanking build — [Captain4k (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165907#p165907). Night Elf's Shadowmeld is called out as a PvP-leveling perk ("its pretty funny casting starfire while shadowmelded") — [Biggamehuntard (player), 2026-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170843#p170843). **No consensus** — pick by role (Tauren for a dedicated tank, Night Elf otherwise/for PvP openers).

sections.heading: Talent point order by level, 10–60
sections.markdown:
No source gives a single authoritative point-by-point table for the post-Class-Changes-2 talent tree; the pieces given, combined:

- **~Level 10-20 (Feral leveling path)**: put points toward the Cat Form movement-speed talent (Feral Swiftness/Feline Swiftness) as early as possible — "you wanna rush the additional movement speed in cat form talent as fast as you can, i think level 20/21ish is when you can get em" — [Biggamehuntard (player), 2026-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170843#p170843), echoed by an older (pre-CC2, structurally still directionally valid) build: "go feral to Feline Swiftness so you got a nice +30% cat movement speed at 21" — [Hctwowfan (player), 2024-05-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95535#p95535).
- **~Level 20-25**: pick up **Omen of Clarity** ("Then switch to balance to get Omen of Clarity asap" — same source) and **Furor** shortly after — "Always go Omen of Clarity first by Lv20, then into Furor by Lv25. The clearcasting procs very often and gives you tons of threat when tanking from all the free swipes you get in bear form. It also gives you free claws/shreds in cat form" — [Captain4k (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165907#p165907). A minority view delays Omen even further: "I don't think I grabbed Omen until I could grab the bleed->energy talent both" — [Biggamehuntard (player), 2026-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170843#p170843).
- **~Level 24+**: consider **Sylvan Blessing** (1 point) for self-sustain between fights — [Chev03 (player), 2026-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165791#p165791); an older thread also suggests 1/3 Owlkin Frenzy plus 2/2 Sylvan Blessing over a full 3/3 Owlkin investment while leveling as Balance — [Templar85 (player), 2025-01-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=116254#p116254).
- **~Level 30**: Swift Travel Form becomes available via the questline 'Mount Hyjal In Turmoil' (started at Loganaar in Moonglade) — official baseline change ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102966#p102966)). "Once you receive travelform, reset and get omen" — [Turboman (player), 2026-01-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165651#p165651) — i.e. some players deliberately delay a full respec until Travel Form is in hand.
- **Beyond 30, decision point (Feral)**: choose between AoE bear farming (3/3 Improved Thorns pre-CC2 equivalent, herd-and-Swipe play) or single-target Cat front-shredding, and skip/delay Improved Shred if not front-shredding much — [Hctwowfan (player), 2024-05-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95535#p95535). Note Bear's own damage doesn't come online until the rage-on-crit talent (~40+) and Savage Bite (54) — [Snkx (player), 2025-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122982#p122982).
- **Level 44/52/60**: Barkskin (Feral) is learned automatically with new ranks at these levels — official ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102966#p102966)).
- **Respeccing**: "you will respec at 60" is treated as a given for Balance levelers, who are told not to worry about filling out Vengeance/Nature's Reach or other endgame-only talents while leveling — [Tarsis (player), 2025-04-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126107#p126107).
- **No source gives a complete point-by-point table through 60** for any build — treat the above as anchors, not an exhaustive list (**gap**, matching the paladin playbook's equivalent finding).

sections.heading: Skill training priority
sections.markdown:
- **Watch your gold before level 40**: "before you reach lvl 40 only learn the skills you need! this is very important or you will go to 0 money" — [Terrydavis (player), 2026-01-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165608#p165608).
- **Faerie Fire rank 1 is sufficient for pulling** through most of leveling — same source.
- **No specific skipped-rank table** is given by any source (which ranks of Wrath/Starfire/Rejuvenation etc. are worth skipping) — **gap**.

sections.heading: Leveling playstyle
sections.markdown:
- **Pulling and kill pattern (Feral)**: "range pull 2-3 mobs with a DoT like Moonfire or Insect Swarm" then "switch to Bear and Swipe to cleave em down" on lower levels for speed — [Chev03 (player), 2026-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165791#p165791). At higher levels/more geared play, **single-target Cat is reported faster than Bear AoE farming**: "You don't level in bear form unless you want to spend 5 times longer killing each mob" — [Snkx (player), 2025-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122982#p122982) (contested by players who enjoy the 3-mob-Swipe playstyle regardless of raw speed — [Hctwuckles/slak, 2025-03-19/23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123470#p123470)). Bear's practical uses while leveling: hard-hitting elites, quest objectives that need tankiness, and general survivability buffer — [Dr Thrax (player), 2025-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123476#p123476).
- **Downtime**: keep a self-HoT running before pulling hard packs or bosses — "you also want to skill the healing over time and start hard packs and bosses with your own HOT on you" — [Terrydavis (player), 2026-01-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165608#p165608).
- **Balance playstyle**: "hot yourself and fight in bear" for the earliest levels (before ~20) if geared for it, then root-kite with Entangling Roots on 2+ pulls while DoTing others; use Hibernate instead of roots against Beasts; keep mana topped with a spirit-focused build and, once available, cast Wrath more freely thanks to Turtle's ~70% spell-pushback avoidance ("I found that Twow have added 70% chance to avoid interruption. You can try to spam-cast Wrath" — [Xudo (player), 2025-02-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119170#p119170)).
- **Fastest-XP mode**: for players optimizing pure leveling speed, questing is explicitly deprioritized in favor of Cat-form mob grinding — "If you look to lvl up as quick as possible, then skip questing and go cat mob grinding" — [Dr Thrax (player), 2025-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=123476#p123476), consistent with the "open world grinding and quests... will level you faster than any dungeon will" guidance above.
- **Macros**: a simple `/startattack` + `/cast <ability>` macro (auto-targets nearest enemy and starts the swing timer before the special) is recommended for every physical ability — [Chev03 (player), 2026-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165791#p165791), confirmed as needing a helper addon such as **CleveRoid Macros** to function on the 1.12 client — [Captain4k (player), 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165907#p165907).

sections.heading: Stats and gear while leveling
sections.markdown:
- **Feral**: "don't forget to spec into [Thick Hide] for the extra Armor. Healers will thank you and its generally useful. Many cat druids are squishy for missing out on it or forgetting to upgrade their items" — [Chev03 (player), 2026-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165791#p165791). One point in **Feral Instinct** is enough early, more only if threat is a problem — same source. If tanking dungeons while solo-leveling in gear that isn't stamina-heavy, consider keeping two gear sets ("for solo leveling stamina is not important at all so you might want to keep 2 gear sets" — [Terrydavis (player), 2026-01-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165608#p165608)). Cheap early enchants: a +9 Stamina bracer enchant (~1g) and a +70 Armor cloak enchant (~60s) are called good value for tanking, alongside cheap Leatherworking armor kits — same source.
- **Balance**: don't stress about matching "caster" leather (Int/Spirit) precisely — "pick anything with int/spirit" — [Tarsis (player), 2025-04-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126107#p126107).
- **Professions**: Alchemy is called out for mana-potion access on a Balance leveler ("if you like alchemy, mana potions are good to always have at hand, but whatever profession you feel like is fine" — same source); Herbalism/Alchemy also suggested for a tanking leveler's self-sufficiency — [Geojak (player), 2022-10-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=26875#p26875). No source gives a single "best" profession pairing across builds (**gap**).

sections.heading: Route
sections.markdown: **No zone-by-zone leveling route or dungeon-per-bracket list was found in the Druid forum sources** — this is a clear gap (the paladin playbook found the same gap). Cross-reference general leveling/dungeon guides from other forums if a route is needed; none is Druid-specific in the material read for this playbook.

sections.heading: Hardcore differences
sections.markdown:
- **Spec choice matters more**: tanking is explicitly recommended over Resto for Hardcore/dungeon-leveling because "it's very hard to level as Resto and tanks are in short supply" — [Cyrin23 (player), 2024-11-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107212#p107212). No Hardcore-specific talent build beyond this general steer was found — **gap** (a dedicated "HC druid talent build" thread, t14029, yielded only the pre-CC2 build discussed in Talent point order above, and a second HC thread, t15497, yielded only the tank-over-resto steer).
- **General caution**: no Hardcore-specific pulling/safety advice (mob-count limits, downtime buffers) beyond the standard leveling playstyle notes above was found in sources — **gap**.

gaps:
1. **Full point-by-point 60 builds for every spec/role**: every build cited is a talents.turtlecraft.gg calculator link that cannot be decoded from text, matching the same limitation found in the paladin playbook. Only leveling-order anchors and named "mandatory" talents are enumerated.
2. **Pre-raid BiS lists** for all four specs/roles on current itemization — no source gives one; players are repeatedly pointed to the Discord druid channel or community Google Sheets/gear-planner links (linked from the wiki, unverified against staff data).
3. **A full skill-training-rank-skip table** and **a zone-by-zone leveling route with dungeon-per-bracket list** — not found anywhere in the sources read.
4. **Post-1.18.1 quantitative re-verification**: almost every post-1.18.1 claim about spec standing (Bear tanking, Cat/Moonkin DPS rankings, Resto healing) comes from one or two detailed players (chiefly Noephix) with agreeing short replies, not independently repeated log analysis. Treat all "post-1.18.1 X is now worst/best" claims in these playbooks as **single-source, directionally likely but numerically unverified**.
5. **Exact post-1.18.1 Eclipse damage-bonus formula**: the proc-*chance* change (40%/60%) is official and quoted verbatim; whether the *bonus magnitude* (the 1.18.0-era "10% + 60% of spell crit" formula) also changed in 1.18.1 is not stated in the sources read.
6. **Crit-immunity/crush-cap Defense values for Bear tanks** on Turtle — no source gives a druid-specific number (the paladin playbook's 440/420 figure is explicitly a vanilla-baseline number for a shield tank and does not transfer).
7. **A named list of the current pre-raid-BiS or T3.5-tier armor-ignoring trinket** referenced as nerfed for Feral in 1.18.1 — players discuss its nerf without naming the item.
8. **Restoration-specific consumables and a numeric Healing Power/Intellect stat weight** — inferred from the shared caster consumable list (see `balance-ranged-dps.md`) but not independently confirmed for Restoration.
9. **Arena-specific PvP guidance** for Balance and Feral (only Restoration's arena difficulty is documented in any depth, via the Rogue-survival thread).
10. **A conclusive verdict on the "third, deep-Resto-without-Tree-or-Moonglow" build** floated in `restoration-healer.md` — flagged as promising by one poster with no follow-up confirmation found.
11. **Twink/leveling-specific gear lists** (e.g. the "49 Balance Druid" twink thread, t16360) exist but were not read in depth for these playbooks.
12. **Whether the "Devs hate Druids" community sentiment reflects actual relative underperformance or a vocal-minority perception** — sources are heavily weighted toward complaint threads by a small recurring set of authors (Noephix, Fugus, Tarsis, Grizb37, Wosator); no independent parse/log-aggregation source was found to cross-check their DPS/HPS claims against.
patchChanges:
**General**: Maul threat modifier −15%, Savage Bite threat modifier −12% ("Feral Bears have been overly prominent in their threat output, leaving little room for other tanks to shine" — dev comment).

**Balance**: Balance of All Things reduced from 5 to 3 points and reworked (Wrath vs. Insect-Swarm'd target refunds 10/20/30% mana; Starfire vs. Moonfire'd target gains +2/4/6% crit chance, revised 2026-01-26 to +3/6/9%); Moonfury increased to 4/8/12% (2026-01-26 revision); Eclipse proc mechanism changed (2026-03-19 revision): "Damage from Wrath now has a 40% chance and Damage from Starfire now has a 60% chance to proc their beneficial effects" (superseding the 1.18.0-era 30%/50% chance mechanism documented in `synthesis/turtle-vs-vanilla-timeline.md`).

**Hotfixes (post-release, dated 2026-03-21 through 03-31)**: Pollen Burst healing scales with 25% pet AP (class attribution unclear — may be a Hunter-pet ability, not confirmed Druid); Fang of Alichos usable in shapeshift forms; Yoxtez gained +224 Feral Attack Power; Elune Infusion trigger bug fixed; Glyph of the Moon visual corrected (was causing Night Elf Balance druids in Moonkin Form to render as "a tiny cow" per player report).

**No changes shipped in 1.18.1 to**: Feral Combat talents/abilities directly (Cat or Bear, beyond the Maul/Savage Bite threat-modifier nerf above), Restoration talents/abilities, or the Druid talent trees' overall shape.

gear.about: Gear recommendations for Druid (Balance ranged DPS, Feral melee DPS, Feral tank, Restoration healer) by spec/role and level bracket, with where-to-obtain, built from the Druid forum (f42), the Itemization forum's relic list and 1.18.1 changelog, and the existing class playbooks' "Gear, enchants and consumables" sections. Like every other class read for this series, no maintained Turtle-specific pre-raid or raid BiS list exists for any Druid spec/role; the strongest source found is a single level-49 "twink" gear list for Balance (leveling-30-49), which is unusually complete.
caveats: No pre-raid or raid BiS list exists for any Druid spec/role in the sources. "Balance gear is nonexistent" (t5704, 2023) is a representative thread title; the reply consensus is that leveling caster gear with actual spellpower is rare for every class, not uniquely absent for Druid, but that Balance-specific leather+spellpower gear barely exists before Molten Core/Tier 1.

Item IDs are filled only where a post links database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=N (Turtle's own item database), which is the case for nearly every item in the leveling-30-49 Balance list (t16360) and the relic list (t8229).

The leveling-30-49 Balance list is explicitly a level-49 twink list (a character parked below 50 for a fixed PvP/dungeon bracket, not a leveling-through-49 progression list) — it names the BiS ceiling for that bracket, not a route to reach it.

Faction-mirrored items (an Alliance version and a Horde version of the same conceptual reward) are recorded as the source wrote them; only one faction's item is kept as the primary entry per slot where both exist, to control file size — the other faction's exact name is in the equivalent bracket note or omitted; see gaps.

Restoration's pvp-60 bracket below is built directly from a single General/Druid-forum thread (t19402) that is NOT reflected in synthesis/classes/druid/restoration-pvp.md (that playbook file has no Gear section at all) — flagged as a primary-source addition beyond what the existing playbooks captured.

So the best current bear set in game by far is... PvP t3. Because pvp sets are naturally made with proper stats. Yes, bears have to spend months upon months on BGs to get their pve BiS set." Not independently corroborated with a gear list — treat as a lead, not a confirmed recommendation. — [Noephix (player), 2026-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173102#p173102)

gearMarkdown.heading: Gaps
gearMarkdown.markdown:
- No pre-raid-60 gear item list exists for Feral DPS, Feral tank (beyond one trinket), or Restoration; only Balance has a rich leveling list (twink-specific, not a leveling route) and a discussion thread naming crafted/dungeon options rather than a ranked list.
- The Kara40 armor-ignoring trinket nerfed in 1.18.1 (Feral DPS) is never named in the sources that discuss it.
- "Smoking Heart of the Mountain" was asked about as a possible Feral tank trinket but never confirmed or denied.
- The level-29 twink PvP gear list for Feral Druid, Hunter and Rogue ([t22403](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=22403)) names every item only via raw `database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=N` links with no item names in the post text — unusable without a live database lookup; not included above.
- "That new Wailing Caverns idol?" appears in the leveling-30-49 Balance list as an open question with no name resolved.
- No enchant list exists for any Druid spec/role beyond the single Wolfshead Helm mention for Feral and the leveling-30-49 Balance thread's unanswered enchant question.
- No raid-t1 or raid-t3.5 gear exists for Feral tank, and no raid-tier gear at all exists for Restoration beyond the T3.5 set-bonus design complaint (not a gear recommendation).
- Faction-mirrored item names in the leveling-30-49 Balance list are not reproduced in full above; see [t16360](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=16360) directly for both factions' exact names.
